' * Dang mo PART      -> tao ban ve cho part dang mo
' * Dang mo ASSEMBLY  -> 1 FILE BAN VE, moi part 1 SHEET (moi part 1 lan),
'                        xong tu doi ten sheet 1, 2, 3... va de mo (chua luu)
'
' 1. Tu tim mat co nhieu lo nhat -> lam hinh chieu chinh
' 2. Them hinh chieu canh (Projected View, lien ket voi hinh chinh)
' 3. Ghi kich thuoc vi tri lo kieu BASELINE tu canh trai & canh duoi,
'    xep tang 4 phia + kich thuoc bao ngoai cung
' 4. Chu thich lo: "6-O5.60 THRU", "4-O10.00 SAU 5.00", Hole Wizard -> Hole Callout
' 5. Ghi do day tren hinh chieu canh, luu ban ve canh file part

' --- GHI CHU HAN (thu muc BVHAN, moi cap):
'     TH1 cum han KHONG co cum con: cum -> "BV HAN TONG", part ben trong -> "BV HAN CON"
'     TH2 cum han CO cum con: cum -> "BV HAN TONG", part ngay ben trong -> "BV HAN CON",
'         cum con -> "BV HAN CON" + ve NHU 1 PART (kich thuoc day du), chi tiet ben trong cum con: khong xuat sheet
'     Part nam truc tiep trong BVHAN -> "BV HAN TONG" ---
'     SUA NOI DUNG / CO CHU / VI TRI GHI CHU HAN TAI DAY.
'     Chu co dau tieng Viet viet bang ma \uXXXX (file macro chi dung ASCII; go truc tiep chu co dau se thanh "?"):
'       a`=\u00E0  a'=\u00E1  a?=\u1EA3  a~=\u00E3  a.=\u1EA1  a(=\u0103  a^=\u00E2  dd=\u0111  DD=\u0110
'       e^=\u00EA  e^'=\u1EBF  e^`=\u1EC1  o^=\u00F4  o^?=\u1ED5  o+=\u01A1  u+=\u01B0  i`=\u00EC  u`=\u00F9
'       e~=\u1EBD  o^'=\u1ED1  a('=\u1EAF  a^?=\u1EA9  y~=\u1EF9  u`=\u00F9  E^=\u00CA  A^`=\u1EA6  Y~=\u1EF8  A^.=\u1EAC
'     (bang day du: tra "Unicode Vietnamese" - vd "\u1EBF" = "e^'" (ee + dau sac))

Public turnAxisPt As Variant
Public allDims As Collection         ' moi kich thuoc da tao: Array(dd, tenView, ngang, lo, hi, linePos, tx, ty, tamView)
Public turnTierLo As Long
Public slotFeatSet As Object
Public datumSg(2) As Long            ' moi truc model: goc kich thuoc o phia NHO NHAT cua (datumSg * toa do); 0 = chua xac dinh
Public thrByDia As Object            ' O lo (mm) -> thong tin ren da biet cua chi tiet (lo nhan ban / copy cung O)
Public patCache As Object             ' cum con (duong dan) -> tap component sinh ra boi Pattern / Mirror trong cum do
Public turnDiaDone As Object         ' O da ghi cua chi tiet (mm) -> khong ghi lai O do bang cap canh doi xung
Public cmPick As Object              ' center mark -> Array(tam x, tam y, khung x0, y0, x1, y1) tren giay
Public cmLines As Object             ' center mark + phuong -> duong tam (sketch) du phong de ghi kich thuoc

Public pendingDetail As Collection  ' cap kich thuoc de danh cho hinh trich: Array(view, e1, e2, horiz, chainId)
Public chainSeq As Long             ' so thu tu chuoi (de cac kich thuoc cung chuoi tren hinh trich chung 1 tang)
Private treeCache As Object         ' duong dan assembly -> (ten component -> so thu tu trong cay FeatureManager)
Private thrAxDone As Collection     ' mieng lo ren doc truc da ghi kich thuoc net manh (toa do giay x, y)
Private asmPW As Double, asmPH As Double   ' KHO GIAY THUC cua sheet ban ve lap (rong, cao - m); template co the khong phai A3
Private preSelViews As Collection         ' hinh chieu nguoi dung DANG CHON luc chay macro (truoc khi hien form)
Public sheetCount As Long      ' so sheet da tao trong ban ve chung (che do assembly)     ' ten feature -> Array(ren, thru, sau, duong kinh danh nghia mm, laCosmetic)

Private Function DocBool(ByVal k As String, ByVal macDinh As Boolean) As Boolean
    DocBool = (GetSetting(CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", k, IIf(macDinh, "1", "0")) = "1")
End Function

Private Sub GhiBool(ByVal k As String, ByVal gt As Boolean)
    SaveSetting CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", k, IIf(gt, "1", "0")
End Sub

' Hien form cai dat (neu project co UserForm ten frmTaoBanVe). Tra ve False neu nguoi dung bam Huy.
Private Function HienFormCaiDat() As Boolean
    Dim frm As Object, en As Long, eD As String
    If formDaChon Then                       ' vua chon tren form (form chay truc tiep) -> khong hoi lai
        formDaChon = False
        HienFormCaiDat = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    formAction = ""
    On Error Resume Next
    Set frm = VBA.UserForms.Add("frmTaoBanVe")
    en = Err.Number: eD = Err.Description
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' khong mo duoc form (chua tao form / loi trong code form) -> BAO LOI va dung (khong chay im lang)
    If frm Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Khong mo duoc UserForm frmTaoBanVe" & IIf(en <> 0, " (loi " & en & ": " & eD & ")", "") & "." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               "- Kiem tra form co ten (Name) = frmTaoBanVe va da dan code frmTaoBanVe_code.txt." & vbCrLf & _
               "- VBA editor > Debug > Compile VBAProject de xem dong bi loi.", vbCritical, APP_NAME
        Exit Function
    End If
    formFromMain = True
    frm.Show
    formFromMain = False
    HienFormCaiDat = (frm.Tag = "OK")
    Unload frm
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  SUA KICH THUOC SHEET DANG MO (nut tren form, khi dang mo BAN VE)
'===========================================================================
'===========================================================================
'  HOLE TABLE CHO HINH CHIEU CHINH (sheet dang mo)
'  - Goc toa do: truc X = CANH DUOI, truc Y = CANH TRAI cua hinh chinh (0,0 = giao 2 canh)
'  - Bang dat o GOC TREN BEN PHAI sheet (neo goc tren-phai), template chon tren form
'  - Hinh chinh: xoa kich thuoc vi tri lo + Hole Callout (da co trong bang), ghi lai kich thuoc
'    bao & hinh dang (bac, hoc, ranh); ghi chu (vat mep C, nhan hinh) giu nguyen
'===========================================================================
Public Function HoleTableSheet() As String
    Dim vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View
    Dim secBelow As Boolean, secRight As Boolean, swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc
    Dim turned As Boolean, tAx As Long, nDel As Long, ht As Object, msg As String
    Dim hA As Long, hS As Long, vA As Long, vS As Long
    Set vMain = MainViewOfSheet()
    If vMain Is Nothing Then HoleTableSheet = "LOI: khong tim thay hinh chieu chinh tren sheet dang mo.": Exit Function
    FindSideViews vMain, vBelow, vRight, secBelow, secRight
    If Not PrepViewContext(vMain) Then
        HoleTableSheet = "LOI: khong doc duoc part cua hinh chieu chinh (part phai dang mo / da nap).": Exit Function
    End If
    Set swPart = partModelRef
    turned = DetectTurned(swPart, tAx)
    ViewAxes vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS
    mainAx = 3 - hA - vA
    thick = Abs(partBox(3 + mainAx) - partBox(mainAx))
    sc = vMain.ScaleDecimal

    ' 1) Bang lo (that bai -> khong thay doi gi tren ban ve)
    Set ht = InsertHoleTableMain(vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS, msg)
    If ht Is Nothing Then HoleTableSheet = "LOI: khong tao duoc Hole Table - " & msg: Exit Function
    ' Bang o GOC TREN BEN TRAI khung; hinh chieu de len bang -> dich cum hinh sang phai
    Dim tRgt As Double, tBot As Double
    msg = msg & PlaceTableTopLeft(ht, tRgt, tBot)
    msg = msg & ShiftViewsClear(vMain, vBelow, vRight, tRgt, tBot)

    ' 2) Hinh chinh: bo kich thuoc vi tri lo + Hole Callout, ghi lai kich thuoc bao & hinh dang
    If Not turned Then
        delDimsOnly = True
        nDel = DeleteViewAnnotations(vMain)
        delDimsOnly = False
        DeleteViewConstruction vMain
        InitOccupancy vMain, vBelow, vRight
        SetDatumSigns vMain
        skipHoles = True
        DimensionPlateView vMain, mainAx, True, False, True, "Chinh"
        skipHoles = False
    End If
    If CLEANUP_DIMS Then CleanupAllSheets True
    If AUTO_ARRANGE Then
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        SapXepKichThuocSheet
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    HoleTableSheet = "Hole Table: " & msg & IIf(turned, " (chi tiet truc: giu nguyen kich thuoc)", " | xoa " & nDel & " kich thuoc cu")
End Function

Private Function InsertHoleTableMain(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal hA As Long, ByVal hS As Long, ByVal vA As Long, _
                                     ByVal vS As Long, msg As String) As Object
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double, org As Object, dOrg As Double
    Dim circles As Collection, entE As New Collection, faces As New Collection, it As Variant, f As Variant
    Dim hv(2) As Double, uv(2) As Double, vd(2) As Double, sgnV As Double, best As Object, ck As String
    Dim byC As Object, k As Long, ht As Object, vo As Object, tpl As String, X As Double, Y As Double, a As Variant
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    ' GOC TOA DO theo 2 CANH: truc X = canh DUOI, truc Y = canh TRAI cua hinh chieu
    ' (goc 0,0 = giao 2 canh -> dung ca khi goc bi vat / bo tron)
    Dim lines As Collection, eL As Variant, eB As Variant, haveAxes As Boolean
    Set lines = GetViewLines(v)
    BoundaryRef lines, True, xL, Array(xL, (yB + yT) / 2), eL
    BoundaryRef lines, False, yB, Array((xL + xR) / 2, yB), eB
    haveAxes = IsObject(eL) And IsObject(eB)
    If Not haveAxes Then
        ' khong co canh thang tren bien -> du phong: dinh goc trai-duoi
        Set org = CornerVertex(v, xL, yB, dOrg)
        If org Is Nothing Then msg = "khong tim thay canh trai / canh duoi cua chi tiet": Exit Function
    End If
    ' Huong ve nguoi nhin
    hv(hA) = hS: uv(vA) = vS
    vd(0) = hv(1) * uv(2) - hv(2) * uv(1): vd(1) = hv(2) * uv(0) - hv(0) * uv(2): vd(2) = hv(0) * uv(1) - hv(1) * uv(0)
    sgnV = vd(mainAx)
    ' Moi lo: canh MIENG LO (gan nguoi nhin nhat, lon nhat) -> mat phang chua mieng lo
    Set circles = GetModelCirclesAlong(v, mainAx)
    Set byC = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each it In circles
        ck = CenterKey(it)
        If Not byC.Exists(ck) Then
            byC.Add ck, it
        Else
            a = byC.Item(ck)
            If it(3) * sgnV > a(3) * sgnV + 0.0000001 Or (Abs(it(3) * sgnV - a(3) * sgnV) < 0.0000001 And it(4) > a(4)) Then byC.Item(ck) = it
        End If
    Next it
    If byC.Count = 0 Then msg = "hinh chieu chinh khong co lo": Exit Function
    For Each a In byC.items
        entE.Add a(0)
        AddFrontFace a(0), vd, faces
    Next a
    ' Template
    tpl = Trim(HOLE_TABLE_TEMPLATE)
    If tpl <> "" Then
        If Dir(tpl) = "" Then tpl = ""
    End If
    If tpl = "" Then
        tpl = swApp.GetExecutablePath & "\lang\english\standard hole table--letters.sldholtbt"
        If Dir(tpl) = "" Then tpl = ""
    End If
    ' Vi tri: GOC TREN BEN TRAI kho giay (neo goc tren-trai cua bang)
    X = 0: Y = SHEET_H
    Set vo = v
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    ' Luon bat "Combine same tags" (lo cung kich thuoc -> cung 1 tag + cot so luong) cho bang moi
    On Error Resume Next
    swDrawModel.Extension.SetUserPreferenceToggle swHoleTableCombineTags, swDetailingNoOptionSpecified, True
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' Mark: 1 = dinh goc, 2 = lo (canh / mat), 4 = canh truc X, 8 = canh truc Y
    For k = 1 To 2
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If haveAxes Then
            SelectEntMark v, eB, False, 4                     ' truc X = canh duoi
            SelectEntMark v, eL, True, 8                      ' truc Y = canh trai
        Else
            SelectEntMark v, org, False, 1
        End If
        If k = 1 Then
            For Each f In faces                               ' mat chua mieng lo
                SelectEntMark v, f, True, 2
            Next f
        Else
            For Each f In entE                                ' canh mieng lo
                SelectEntMark v, f, True, 2
            Next f
        End If
        Set ht = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set ht = vo.InsertHoleTable2(False, X, Y, swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopLeft, "A", tpl)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not ht Is Nothing Then Exit For
    Next k
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If ht Is Nothing Then
        msg = "SolidWorks khong nhan lua chon (truc X/Y + lo)"
    Else
        msg = byC.Count & " lo, " & IIf(haveAxes, "truc X = canh duoi, truc Y = canh trai", _
              "goc 0,0 tai dinh trai-duoi (khong co canh thang)") & IIf(tpl = "", ", template mac dinh", "") & _
              IIf(HoleTableCombineTags(ht), ", gop tag giong nhau", ", CHUA gop duoc tag giong nhau")
    End If
    Set InsertHoleTableMain = ht
End Function

' Bat "Combine same tags" cua Hole Table (IHoleTable.CombineTags) - truoc khi do kich thuoc / dat bang
Private Function HoleTableCombineTags(ByVal ht As Object) As Boolean
    Dim hf As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set hf = ht.HoleTable
    If Not hf Is Nothing Then
        If Not hf.CombineTags Then
            hf.CombineTags = True
            swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
        End If
        HoleTableCombineTags = hf.CombineTags
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Dua bang vao GOC TREN BEN TRAI cua KHO GIAY.
' Theo SolidWorks API: vi tri bang (IAnnotation.SetPosition, goc toa do = goc duoi-trai to giay) la GOC NEO
' theo ITableAnnotation.AnchorType; bang dang gan diem neo (Anchored) thi khong dich duoc -> bo gan truoc.
' Tra ve mep phai (tRgt) & mep duoi (tBot) uoc tinh cua bang
Private Function PlaceTableTopLeft(ByVal tb As Object, tRgt As Double, tBot As Double) As String
    Dim w As Double, h As Double, i As Long, nc As Long, nr As Long, ann As Object, at As Long
    Dim xT As Double, yT As Double, PX As Double, py As Double, sp As Variant, pos As Variant, ok As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    xT = 0: yT = SHEET_H
    sp = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetProperties2
    If Not IsEmpty(sp) Then
        If sp(6) > 0.05 Then yT = sp(6)
    End If
    nc = tb.ColumnCount: nr = tb.RowCount
    For i = 0 To nc - 1
        w = w + tb.GetColumnWidth(i)
    Next i
    For i = 0 To nr - 1
        h = h + tb.GetRowHeight(i)
    Next i
    If tb.Anchored Then tb.Anchored = False
    tb.AnchorType = swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopLeft
    at = -1
    at = tb.AnchorType
    Select Case at
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopRight: PX = xT + w: py = yT
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_BottomLeft: PX = xT: py = yT - h
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_BottomRight: PX = xT + w: py = yT - h
        Case Else: PX = xT: py = yT
    End Select
    Set ann = tb.GetAnnotation
    ann.SetPosition PX, py, 0
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    pos = Empty: pos = ann.GetPosition
    If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then ok = (Abs(pos(0) - PX) < 0.0005 And Abs(pos(1) - py) < 0.0005)
    On Error GoTo 0
    tRgt = xT + w: tBot = yT - h
    PlaceTableTopLeft = " | bang " & Format(w * 1000#, "0") & "x" & Format(h * 1000#, "0") & " mm, neo " & _
                        Choose(IIf(at >= 1 And at <= 4, at, 1), "tren-trai", "tren-phai", "duoi-trai", "duoi-phai") & _
                        IIf(ok, "", " (SolidWorks khong nhan vi tri moi)")
    If h > yT - 0.005 Then PlaceTableTopLeft = PlaceTableTopLeft & " (CAO HON KHO GIAY: " & nr & " hang)"
End Function

' Khung that cua bang tren giay: tu cac net ve (IDisplayData) cua annotation
Private Function TableBox(ByVal ann As Object, x0 As Double, y0 As Double, x1 As Double, y1 As Double) As Boolean
    Dim dsp As Object, n As Long, i As Long, ln As Variant, first As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dsp = ann.GetDisplayData
    If dsp Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    n = 0: n = dsp.GetLineCount
    If n = 0 Then Exit Function
    first = True
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        ln = Empty
        ln = dsp.GetLineAtIndex3(i)
        If IsEmpty(ln) Then ln = dsp.GetLineAtIndex2(i)
        If IsEmpty(ln) Then ln = dsp.GetLineAtIndex(i)
        If Not IsEmpty(ln) Then
            If UBound(ln) >= 4 Then
                If first Then
                    x0 = ln(0): x1 = ln(0): y0 = ln(1): y1 = ln(1): first = False
                End If
                If ln(0) < x0 Then x0 = ln(0)
                If ln(0) > x1 Then x1 = ln(0)
                If ln(1) < y0 Then y0 = ln(1)
                If ln(1) > y1 Then y1 = ln(1)
                If ln(3) < x0 Then x0 = ln(3)
                If ln(3) > x1 Then x1 = ln(3)
                If ln(4) < y0 Then y0 = ln(4)
                If ln(4) > y1 Then y1 = ln(4)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    TableBox = Not first And (x1 - x0) > 0.001 And (y1 - y0) > 0.001
End Function

' Cum hinh chieu de len bang (ke ca cho kich thuoc ben trai) -> dich ca cum sang phai (trong gioi han khung)
Private Function ShiftViewsClear(vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View, _
                                 ByVal tRgt As Double, ByVal tBot As Double) As String
    Dim cL As Double, cR As Double, cb As Double, cT As Double, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    Dim need As Double, room As Double, dx As Double, b0 As Double, r0 As Double, mv As Double
    If tRgt <= 0 Then Exit Function
    GetViewBox vMain, cL, cR, cb, cT
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then
        GetViewBox vBelow, xL, xR, yB, yT
        b0 = xL
        If xL < cL Then cL = xL
        If xR > cR Then cR = xR
        If yB < cb Then cb = yB
        If yT > cT Then cT = yT
    End If
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then
        GetViewBox vRight, xL, xR, yB, yT
        r0 = xL
        If xL < cL Then cL = xL
        If xR > cR Then cR = xR
        If yB < cb Then cb = yB
        If yT > cT Then cT = yT
    End If
    If cT + DIM_ROOM < tBot Then Exit Function                ' cum hinh nam han duoi bang
    need = (tRgt + DIM_ROOM) - cL
    If need <= 0.0005 Then Exit Function
    room = (SHEET_W - FRAME_R) - (cR + DIM_ROOM * 0.6)
    dx = need
    If dx > room Then dx = MaxD(room, 0)
    If dx <= 0.0005 Then ShiftViewsClear = " | khong du cho de dich hinh chieu khoi bang": Exit Function
    MoveView vMain, dx, 0
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    ' hinh con: neu khong tu di theo hinh chinh thi dich them
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then
        GetViewBox vBelow, xL, xR, yB, yT
        mv = xL - b0
        If mv < dx * 0.5 Then MoveView vBelow, dx - mv, 0
    End If
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then
        GetViewBox vRight, xL, xR, yB, yT
        mv = xL - r0
        If mv < dx * 0.5 Then MoveView vRight, dx - mv, 0
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    ShiftViewsClear = " | dich hinh chieu sang phai " & Format(dx * 1000#, "0") & " mm" & _
                      IIf(dx < need - 0.0005, " (chua du, hinh van sat bang)", "")
End Function

' Dinh nhin thay gan diem (x, y) tren giay nhat
Private Function CornerVertex(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, dBest As Double) As Object
    Dim ents As Variant, i As Long, p As Variant, a As Variant, xf As Object, d As Double
    dBest = 1E+30
    On Error Resume Next
    ents = ViewEnts(v, swViewEntityType_Vertex)
    If IsEmpty(ents) Then Exit Function
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
        p = Empty
        p = AsmPt(ents(i), ents(i).GetPoint)
        If Not IsEmpty(p) Then
            a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
            d = Sqr((a(0) - X) ^ 2 + (a(1) - Y) ^ 2)
            If d < dBest Then dBest = d: Set CornerVertex = ents(i)
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    If dBest > 0.004 Then Set CornerVertex = Nothing           ' qua xa goc (> 4 mm tren giay)
End Function

' Mat phang ke canh e, huong ve nguoi nhin (mat chua mieng lo) -> them vao faces (khong trung)
Private Sub AddFrontFace(ByVal e As Object, vd() As Double, faces As Collection)
    Dim fs As Variant, j As Long, fc As Object, nV As Variant, f As Variant, dup As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    fs = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If IsEmpty(fs) Then Exit Sub
    For j = 0 To UBound(fs)
        Set fc = Nothing
        Set fc = fs(j)
        If Not fc Is Nothing Then
            nV = Empty
            nV = fc.Normal
            If Not IsEmpty(nV) Then
                If nV(0) * vd(0) + nV(1) * vd(1) + nV(2) * vd(2) > 0.99 Then
                    dup = False
                    For Each f In faces
                        If f Is fc Then dup = True: Exit For
                    Next f
                    If Not dup Then faces.Add fc
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next j
End Sub

' Chon doi tuong trong hinh chieu voi MARK (dung cho lenh can phan loai lua chon)
Private Function SelectEntMark(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ent As Object, ByVal appendSel As Boolean, ByVal mk As Long) As Boolean
    Dim sm As SldWorks.SelectionMgr, sd As SldWorks.SelectData, en As SldWorks.Entity, n0 As Long
    Set sm = swDrawModel.SelectionManager
    If appendSel Then n0 = sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    Set sd = sm.CreateSelectData
    sd.View = v
    sd.Mark = mk
    On Error Resume Next
    Set en = ent
    If Not en Is Nothing Then en.Select4 appendSel, sd
    On Error GoTo 0
    SelectEntMark = (sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > n0)
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  XUAT LAI KICH THUOC SHEET DANG MO (chi tiet da sua -> cap nhat ban ve)
'  Xoa moi kich thuoc / ghi chu / duong tam sketch o CA 3 HINH CHIEU (giu nhan hinh, center mark)
'  roi ghi lai nhu khi tao ban ve moi (chi tiet tam/khoi hoac truc), kiem tra trung, sap xep
'===========================================================================
Public Function RedoSheetDims() As String
    Dim vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View
    Dim secBelow As Boolean, secRight As Boolean, swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc
    Dim turned As Boolean, tAx As Long, axisHoriz As Boolean, nDel As Long
    Dim hA As Long, hS As Long, vA As Long, vS As Long, sr As Variant, sNum As Double, sDen As Double
    Set vMain = MainViewOfSheet()
    If vMain Is Nothing Then RedoSheetDims = "LOI: khong tim thay hinh chieu chinh tren sheet dang mo.": Exit Function
    FindSideViews vMain, vBelow, vRight, secBelow, secRight
    If Not PrepViewContext(vMain) Then
        RedoSheetDims = "LOI: khong doc duoc part cua hinh chieu chinh (part phai dang mo / da nap).": Exit Function
    End If

    ' 1) Xoa HOLE TABLE (ca the lo A1, B... tren hinh) + MOI kich thuoc / ghi chu tren moi hinh chieu
    '    cua sheet (giu nhan hinh chieu) + duong tam sketch cu
    Dim nHT As Long, nHTcon As Long, vws As Variant, j As Long, vw As SldWorks.View
    skipHoles = False                               ' xuat lai: lo ghi bang Hole Callout nhu binh thuong
    delDimsOnly = False
    nHT = DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet(nHTcon)
    keepViewLabels = True
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If Not IsEmpty(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            Set vw = vws(j)
            If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" Then nDel = nDel + DeleteViewAnnotations(vw)
        Next j
    End If
    keepViewLabels = False
    DeleteViewConstruction vMain
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DeleteViewConstruction vBelow
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DeleteViewConstruction vRight

    ' 2) Loai chi tiet & huong
    Set swPart = partModelRef
    turned = DetectTurned(swPart, tAx)
    ViewAxes vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS
    mainAx = 3 - hA - vA
    thick = Abs(partBox(3 + mainAx) - partBox(mainAx))
    If turned Then
        If tAx = mainAx Then turned = False Else axisHoriz = (hA = tAx)
    End If
    sNum = 1: sDen = 1
    On Error Resume Next
    sr = vMain.ScaleRatio
    If Not IsEmpty(sr) Then sNum = sr(0): sDen = sr(1)
    On Error GoTo 0
    sc = vMain.ScaleDecimal

    ' 3) Ghi lai kich thuoc 3 hinh chieu
    InitOccupancy vMain, vBelow, vRight
    SetDatumSigns vMain
    DimensionAllViews partModelRef, vMain, vBelow, vRight, turned, tAx, axisHoriz, secBelow, secRight, sNum, sDen
    StyleOrdinateMain vMain, vBelow, vRight, turned
    If CLEANUP_DIMS Then CleanupAllSheets True
    If AUTO_ARRANGE Then
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        SapXepKichThuocSheet
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    RedoSheetDims = "Xoa " & nHT & " hole table, " & nDel & " kich thuoc/ghi chu cu, da xuat lai kich thuoc " & _
                    IIf(turned, "(chi tiet truc)", "(chi tiet tam/khoi)") & " cho " & _
                    (1 - (Not vBelow Is Nothing) - (Not vRight Is Nothing)) & " hinh chieu."
    If nHTcon > 0 Then
        RedoSheetDims = "LOI: da xuat lai kich thuoc nhung CHUA xoa duoc " & nHTcon & " hole table tren sheet nay." & vbCrLf & _
                        "Hay xoa bang tay (chuot phai bang -> Delete) va gui lai log cho tac gia."
    End If
End Function

' Xoa moi HOLE TABLE tren sheet dang mo (xoa bang -> the lo tren hinh chieu mat theo).
' Tra ve so bang da xoa; nRemain = so bang con lai (khong xoa duoc)
Private Function DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet(Optional nRemain As Long) As Long
    Dim feats As Collection, col As Collection, a As Variant, n0 As Long, ok As Boolean, cur As String
    cur = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName
    ' (1) Theo CAY FeatureManager cua ban ve: chon feature "Hole Table" -> xoa (nhu bam Delete trong cay)
    Set feats = HoleTableFeatures(cur)
    Set col = ScanHoleTables()
    n0 = feats.Count
    If col.Count > n0 Then n0 = col.Count
    If n0 = 0 Then nRemain = 0: Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each a In feats
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If a.Select2(False, 0) Then
            ok = False
            ok = swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0)
            If Not ok Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
        End If
    Next a
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    ' (2) Du phong: bang tim thay qua hinh chieu / to giay -> chon bang -> xoa
    Set col = ScanHoleTables()
    For Each a In col
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If a.GetAnnotation.Select3(False, Nothing) Then
            ok = False
            ok = swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0)
            If Not ok Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
        End If
    Next a
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    nRemain = HoleTableFeatures(cur).Count
    If ScanHoleTables().Count > nRemain Then nRemain = ScanHoleTables().Count
    DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet = n0 - nRemain
    If DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet < 0 Then DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet = 0
    dimLog = dimLog & "Xoa hole table: " & DeleteHoleTablesOnSheet & "/" & n0 & IIf(nRemain > 0, " (con " & nRemain & ")", "") & vbCrLf
End Function

' Feature "Hole Table" trong cay FeatureManager cua ban ve (ke ca trong thu muc Tables / duoi sheet)
' thuoc sheet shName. Bang khong xac dinh duoc sheet: chi lay khi ban ve chi co 1 sheet
Private Function HoleTableFeatures(ByVal shName As String) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, nSh As Long, nm As Variant
    Set HoleTableFeatures = col
    On Error Resume Next
    nm = swDraw.GetSheetNames
    If IsArray(nm) Then nSh = UBound(nm) + 1
    CollectHoleTableFeats swDrawModel.FirstFeature, col, 0, shName, (nSh <= 1)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Sub CollectHoleTableFeats(ByVal f As Object, col As Collection, ByVal depth As Long, ByVal shName As String, _
                                  ByVal oneSheet As Boolean)
    Dim sf As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, sp As Object, tbs As Variant, tsh As String, isHT As Boolean, cb As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And g < 20000
        g = g + 1
        isHT = False
        ' Hole Table: doi tuong rieng (IHoleTable) co thuoc tinh CombineTags (khong phu thuoc ten loai feature)
        Set sp = Nothing
        Set sp = f.GetSpecificFeature2
        If Not sp Is Nothing Then
            Err.Clear
            cb = sp.CombineTags
            isHT = (Err.Number = 0)
            Err.Clear
        End If
        If isHT Then
            tsh = ""
            tbs = Empty
            tbs = sp.GetTableAnnotations
            If IsArray(tbs) Then tsh = AnnSheetName(tbs(LBound(tbs)).GetAnnotation)
            If UCase(tsh) = UCase(shName) Or (tsh = "" And oneSheet) Then col.Add f
        ElseIf depth < 4 Then
            Set sf = Nothing
            Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
            If Not sf Is Nothing Then CollectHoleTableFeats sf, col, depth + 1, shName, oneSheet
        End If
        Set nx = Nothing
        If depth = 0 Then Set nx = f.GetNextFeature Else Set nx = f.GetNextSubFeature
        Set f = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Ten sheet chua 1 annotation (chu so huu la to giay hoac hinh chieu)
Private Function AnnSheetName(ByVal ann As Object) As String
    Dim ow As Object, sh As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ow = ann.Owner
    If ow Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    Set sh = ow.Sheet                                        ' chu so huu la hinh chieu -> sheet cua no
    If Not sh Is Nothing Then
        AnnSheetName = sh.GetName
    Else
        AnnSheetName = ow.GetName                            ' chu so huu la to giay
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Cac Hole Table tren sheet dang mo (duyet bang cua to giay & tung hinh chieu, ca annotation kieu bang)
Private Function ScanHoleTables() As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, seen As Object, vw As Object, nx As Object, tbs As Variant, i As Long
    Dim ann As Object, nxA As Object, guard As Long, g2 As Long
    Set seen = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set ScanHoleTables = col
    On Error Resume Next
    Set vw = swDraw.GetFirstView                     ' view dau = to giay cua sheet dang mo
    Do While Not vw Is Nothing And guard < 500
        guard = guard + 1
        tbs = Empty
        tbs = vw.GetTableAnnotations
        If IsArray(tbs) Then
            For i = LBound(tbs) To UBound(tbs)
                AddIfHoleTable tbs(i), col, seen
            Next i
        End If
        Set ann = Nothing
        Set ann = vw.GetFirstAnnotation3
        g2 = 0
        Do While Not ann Is Nothing And g2 < 5000
            g2 = g2 + 1
            If ann.GetType = swTableAnnotation Then AddIfHoleTable ann.GetSpecificAnnotation, col, seen
            Set nxA = Nothing
            Set nxA = ann.GetNext3
            Set ann = nxA
        Loop
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = vw.GetNextView
        Set vw = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Sub AddIfHoleTable(ByVal tb As Object, col As Collection, seen As Object)
    Dim isHole As Boolean, hf As Object, k As String
    If tb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    isHole = (tb.Type = swTableAnnotation_HoleChart)
    If Not isHole Then
        Set hf = tb.HoleTable
        isHole = Not hf Is Nothing
    End If
    If isHole Then
        k = tb.GetAnnotation.GetName
        If k = "" Then k = CStr(ObjPtr(tb))
        If Not seen.Exists(k) Then
            seen.Add k, 1
            col.Add tb
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Hinh chieu duoi (hinh bang / hinh cat) va hinh chieu phai (hinh canh) cua hinh chinh tren sheet
Private Sub FindSideViews(vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View, _
                          secBelow As Boolean, secRight As Boolean)
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, vw As SldWorks.View, ol As Variant, om As Variant, tp As Long
    Dim cx As Double, cy As Double, mx As Double, my As Double, mw As Double, mh As Double, d As Double
    Dim bB As Double, bR As Double, vUp As SldWorks.View, vLf As SldWorks.View, bU As Double, bL As Double
    om = vMain.GetOutline
    mx = (om(0) + om(2)) / 2: my = (om(1) + om(3)) / 2: mw = om(2) - om(0): mh = om(3) - om(1)
    bB = 1E+30: bR = 1E+30: bU = 1E+30: bL = 1E+30
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsEmpty(vws) Then Exit Sub
    For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
        Set vw = vws(j)
        If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" And vw.GetName2 <> vMain.GetName2 Then
            tp = vw.Type
            If tp <> swDrawingDetailView Then
                ol = vw.GetOutline
                cx = (ol(0) + ol(2)) / 2: cy = (ol(1) + ol(3)) / 2
                If Abs(cx - mx) < mw / 2 Then
                    d = Abs(cy - my)
                    If cy < my And d < bB Then bB = d: Set vBelow = vw
                    If cy > my And d < bU Then bU = d: Set vUp = vw
                ElseIf Abs(cy - my) < mh / 2 Then
                    d = Abs(cx - mx)
                    If cx > mx And d < bR Then bR = d: Set vRight = vw
                    If cx < mx And d < bL Then bL = d: Set vLf = vw
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next j
    ' goc chieu thu ba: hinh bang o tren, hinh canh o trai
    If vBelow Is Nothing Then Set vBelow = vUp
    If vRight Is Nothing Then Set vRight = vLf
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then secBelow = (vBelow.Type = swDrawingSectionView)
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then secRight = (vRight.Type = swDrawingSectionView)
End Sub

' Nhan hinh chieu (SECTION A-A, DETAIL B, SCALE...) -> khong xoa
Private Function IsViewLabelNote(ByVal ann As Object) As Boolean
    Dim t As String
    On Error Resume Next
    t = UCase(Trim(ann.GetSpecificAnnotation.GetText))
    On Error GoTo 0
    If InStr(t, "SECTION") > 0 Or InStr(t, "DETAIL") > 0 Or InStr(t, "SCALE") > 0 Or InStr(t, "VIEW") > 0 Then
        IsViewLabelNote = True
    ElseIf t Like "[A-Z]-[A-Z]*" Or t Like "[A-Z]" Then
        IsViewLabelNote = True
    End If
End Function

' Xoa duong tam / net dung (construction) trong sketch cua hinh chieu (do macro ve lan truoc)
Private Sub DeleteViewConstruction(v As SldWorks.View)
    Dim sk As Object, segs As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, cG As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sk = v.GetSketch
    If sk Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    segs = sk.GetSketchSegments
    If IsEmpty(segs) Then Exit Sub
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    For i = 0 To UBound(segs)
        cG = False
        cG = segs(i).ConstructionGeometry
        If cG Then
            If segs(i).Select4(True, Nothing) Then n = n + 1
        End If
    Next i
    If n > 0 Then DeleteSelected
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 1) HINH CHIEU CHINH: xoa het kich thuoc + ghi chu -> ghi lai bang ORDINATE ngang & doc
'    (goc = canh trai / canh duoi hinh chinh; toi tam lo, tam ranh, canh bac, 2 mep bao)
'    roi tao lai Hole Callout, ranh, vat mep C. Hai hinh chieu con lai giu nguyen.
Public Function OrdinateSheetHienTai() As String
    Dim v As SldWorks.View, nDel As Long, res As String
    Set v = MainViewOfSheet()
    If v Is Nothing Then OrdinateSheetHienTai = "LOI: khong tim thay hinh chieu chinh tren sheet dang mo.": Exit Function
    If Not PrepViewContext(v) Then
        OrdinateSheetHienTai = "LOI: khong doc duoc part cua hinh chieu chinh (part phai dang mo / da nap).": Exit Function
    End If
    nDel = DeleteViewAnnotations(v)
    res = OrdinateView(v)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    OrdinateSheetHienTai = "Hinh chieu chinh " & v.GetName2 & ": xoa " & nDel & " kich thuoc/ghi chu | " & res
    If AUTO_ARRANGE Then
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        OrdinateSheetHienTai = OrdinateSheetHienTai & vbCrLf & SapXepKichThuocSheet()
    End If
End Function

' Hinh chieu chinh cua sheet: hinh model (Named / Standard / Relative) lon nhat;
' khong co -> hinh model lon nhat khong phai hinh cat / hinh trich
Private Function MainViewOfSheet() As SldWorks.View
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, vw As SldWorks.View, tp As Long, ol As Variant, ar As Double, best As Double
    Dim pass As Long, ok As Boolean
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsEmpty(vws) Then Exit Function
    For pass = 1 To 2
        best = 0
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            Set vw = vws(j)
            If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" Then
                tp = vw.Type
                If pass = 1 Then
                    ok = (tp = swDrawingNamedView Or tp = swDrawingStandardView Or tp = swDrawingRelativeView)
                Else
                    ok = (tp <> swDrawingSectionView And tp <> swDrawingDetailView)
                End If
                If ok Then
                    ol = vw.GetOutline
                    ar = (ol(2) - ol(0)) * (ol(3) - ol(1))
                    If ar > best Then best = ar: Set MainViewOfSheet = vw
                End If
            End If
        Next j
        If Not MainViewOfSheet Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    Next pass
End Function

' Nap thong tin part cua hinh chieu (giong buoc dau MakePartDrawing) de dung lai cac ham ghi kich thuoc
Private Function PrepViewContext(v As SldWorks.View) As Boolean
    Dim pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc, i As Long, cfg As String, bodiesNow As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set pm = v.ReferencedDocument
    On Error GoTo 0
    If pm Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If pm.GetType <> swDocPART Then Exit Function
    Set swPart = pm
    cfg = ""
    On Error Resume Next
    cfg = v.ReferencedConfiguration
    If cfg <> "" Then
        If pm.ConfigurationManager.ActiveConfiguration.Name <> cfg Then pm.ShowConfiguration2 cfg
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    report = "": dimLog = "LOG SUA KICH THUOC - " & Now & vbCrLf
    nSelFail = 0: nDimFail = 0: nDimCalls = 0: nSlotMarks = 0
    Set cmPick = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cmLines = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set turnDiaDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set pendingDetail = New Collection: chainSeq = 0
    Set slotFeatSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set allDims = New Collection
    Set dimRects = New Collection
    Set usedNotes = New Collection
    For i = 0 To 2
        Set axDone(i) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        axOverall(i) = False
    Next i
    partBox = swPart.GetPartBox(True)
    BuildThreadMap pm
    Set partModelRef = pm
    bodiesNow = swPart.GetBodies2(swSolidBody, True)
    On Error Resume Next
    partBodies = Empty
    partBodies = bodiesNow
    On Error GoTo 0
    sc = v.ScaleDecimal
    InitOccupancy v, Nothing, Nothing
    PrepViewContext = True
End Function

' Xoa moi KICH THUOC (ke ca Hole Callout) va GHI CHU cua 1 hinh chieu (giu center mark, duong tam).
' Chon theo TEN (SelectByID2) -> EditDelete; con sot -> xoa tung cai; tra ve so da xoa that
Private Function DeleteViewAnnotations(v As SldWorks.View) As Long
    Dim n0 As Long, n1 As Long, pass As Long, lst As Collection, a As Variant
    n0 = CountViewAnnotations(v, Nothing)
    If n0 = 0 Then Exit Function
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    For pass = 1 To 2
        Set lst = New Collection
        CountViewAnnotations v, lst
        If lst.Count = 0 Then Exit For
        If pass = 1 Then
            ' xoa ca nhom
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            For Each a In lst
                SelectAnnotation v, a, True
            Next a
            DeleteSelected
        Else
            ' con sot: xoa tung cai
            For Each a In lst
                swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
                If SelectAnnotation(v, a, False) Then DeleteSelected
            Next a
        End If
    Next pass
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    n1 = CountViewAnnotations(v, Nothing)
    dimLog = dimLog & "Xoa kich thuoc/ghi chu hinh chinh: " & n0 - n1 & "/" & n0 & IIf(n1 > 0, " (con sot " & n1 & ")", "") & vbCrLf
    DeleteViewAnnotations = n0 - n1
End Function

' Dem (va gom vao lst neu co) cac annotation KICH THUOC / GHI CHU cua hinh chieu
Private Function CountViewAnnotations(v As SldWorks.View, lst As Collection) As Long
    Dim ann As Object, nx As Object, tp As Long, guard As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ann = v.GetFirstAnnotation3
    Do While Not ann Is Nothing And guard < 5000
        guard = guard + 1
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = ann.GetNext3
        tp = -1: tp = ann.GetType
        If tp = swDisplayDimension Or tp = swNote Then
            If tp = swNote And keepViewLabels Then
                If IsViewLabelNote(ann) Then tp = -1
            End If
            If tp = swNote And delDimsOnly Then tp = -1
            If tp <> -1 Then
                CountViewAnnotations = CountViewAnnotations + 1
                If Not lst Is Nothing Then lst.Add ann
            End If
        End If
        Set ann = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Chon 1 annotation: theo ten (kich thuoc: GetNameForSelection / ghi chu: Ten@View), du phong Select3
Private Function SelectAnnotation(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ann As Object, ByVal appendSel As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim sm As SldWorks.SelectionMgr, n0 As Long, nm As String, dd As Object, tp As Long, sd As Object
    Set sm = swDrawModel.SelectionManager
    n0 = sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    If Not appendSel Then n0 = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    tp = ann.GetType
    If tp = swDisplayDimension Then
        Set dd = ann.GetSpecificAnnotation
        nm = "": nm = dd.GetNameForSelection
        If nm <> "" Then swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 nm, "DIMENSION", 0, 0, 0, appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0
    Else
        nm = "": nm = ann.GetName
        If nm <> "" Then swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 nm & "@" & v.GetName2, "NOTE", 0, 0, 0, appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0
    End If
    If sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) <= n0 Then
        Set sd = sm.CreateSelectData
        sd.View = v
        ann.Select3 appendSel, sd
    End If
    If sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) <= n0 Then ann.Select3 appendSel, Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0
    SelectAnnotation = (sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > n0)
End Function

' Xoa doi tuong dang chon (EditDelete; du phong DeleteSelection2)
Private Sub DeleteSelected()
    On Error Resume Next
    If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) = 0 Then Exit Sub
    swDrawModel.EditDelete
    If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > 0 Then swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2 1
    If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > 0 Then swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Ghi ORDINATE ngang + doc cho 1 hinh chieu, roi Hole Callout / ranh / vat mep
Private Function OrdinateView(v As SldWorks.View) As String
    Dim hAx As Long, hSg As Long, vAx As Long, vSg As Long, nAx As Long
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double, lines As Collection
    Dim eL As Variant, eR As Variant, eB As Variant, eT As Variant
    ViewAxes v, hAx, hSg, vAx, vSg
    nAx = 3 - hAx - vAx
    mainAx = nAx
    thick = Abs(partBox(3 + nAx) - partBox(nAx))
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    Set lines = GetViewLines(v)
    BoundaryRef lines, True, xL, Array(xL, (yB + yT) / 2), eL
    BoundaryRef lines, True, xR, Array(xR, (yB + yT) / 2), eR
    BoundaryRef lines, False, yB, Array((xL + xR) / 2, yB), eB
    BoundaryRef lines, False, yT, Array((xL + xR) / 2, yT), eT

    Dim pts As New Collection, it As Variant, seen As Object, ck As String
    ' a) tam lo (moi tam 1 lan)
    Dim circles As Collection
    Set circles = GetModelCirclesAlong(v, nAx)
    If circles.Count = 0 Then Set circles = GetCirclesAlong(v, nAx)
    Set seen = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each it In circles
        ck = CenterKey(it)
        If Not seen.Exists(ck) Then seen.Add ck, 1: pts.Add Array(it(0), it(1), it(2))
    Next it
    ' b) tam ranh (Slot Center Mark) + tam cung le
    Dim slots As Collection, sl As Variant, bx As Variant, ann As Object, la As Variant
    Set slots = GetSlots(v, nAx)
    Set slotBoxes = New Collection
    For Each sl In slots
        bx = Array(MinD0(sl(2), sl(4)) - sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal - 0.0003, MinD0(sl(3), sl(5)) - sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal - 0.0003, _
                   MaxD(sl(2), sl(4)) + sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal + 0.0003, MaxD(sl(3), sl(5)) + sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal + 0.0003)
        slotBoxes.Add bx
        Set ann = SlotCenterMarkAnn(v, sl, bx)
        If Not ann Is Nothing Then pts.Add Array(ann, (sl(2) + sl(4)) / 2, (sl(3) + sl(5)) / 2)
    Next sl
    For Each la In loneArcs
        If Not PointInSlot(la(1), la(2)) Then
            Set ann = ArcCenterMarkAnn(v, la(0), la(1), la(2), la(4))
            If Not ann Is Nothing Then pts.Add Array(ann, la(1), la(2)) Else pts.Add Array(la(0), la(1), la(2))
        End If
    Next la
    ' c) canh hinh dang (bac, hoc...) nhin thay
    Dim hv(2) As Double, vv(2) As Double, vd As Variant, colX As Collection, colY As Collection
    hv(hAx) = hSg: vv(vAx) = vSg
    vd = Array(hv(1) * vv(2) - hv(2) * vv(1), hv(2) * vv(0) - hv(0) * vv(2), hv(0) * vv(1) - hv(1) * vv(0))
    Set colX = OutlinePositions(lines, True, xL, xR, (yB + yT) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
    Set colY = OutlinePositions(lines, False, yB, yT, (xL + xR) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
    If colX.Count + colY.Count = 0 And lines.Count > 8 Then
        vd = Array(-vd(0), -vd(1), -vd(2))
        Set colX = OutlinePositions(lines, True, xL, xR, (yB + yT) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
        Set colY = OutlinePositions(lines, False, yB, yT, (xL + xR) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
    End If
    If DIM_LEVEL >= 2 Then
        AddEnvelopeSteps lines, colX, True, xL, xR             ' buoc duong bao ngoai
        AddEnvelopeSteps lines, colY, False, yB, yT
    Else
        Set colX = New Collection: Set colY = New Collection   ' Basic: chi lo + bao
    End If

    ' d) ORDINATE 4 PHIA (goc van la canh TRAI / canh DUOI): vi tri GAN CANH NAO thi dat o canh do
    '    - toa do x: doi tuong nua tren -> ordinate ngang PHIA TREN, nua duoi -> PHIA DUOI
    '    - toa do y: doi tuong nua phai -> ordinate doc BEN PHAI, nua trai -> BEN TRAI
    '    - mep bao doi dien (kich thuoc bao): phia duoi / ben trai
    Dim xBot As New Collection, xTop As New Collection, yLft As New Collection, yRgt As New Collection
    Dim sxB As Object, sxT As Object, syL As Object, syR As Object, ym As Double, xm As Double
    Set sxB = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set sxT = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set syL = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set syR = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ym = (yB + yT) / 2: xm = (xL + xR) / 2
    For Each it In pts
        If it(2) > ym Then AddOrdItem xTop, sxT, it(0), it(1), xL Else AddOrdItem xBot, sxB, it(0), it(1), xL
        If it(1) > xm Then AddOrdItem yRgt, syR, it(0), it(2), yB Else AddOrdItem yLft, syL, it(0), it(2), yB
    Next it
    For Each it In colX                                   ' canh doc: x = it(1), giua canh y = it(2)
        If it(2) > ym Then AddOrdItem xTop, sxT, it(0), it(1), xL Else AddOrdItem xBot, sxB, it(0), it(1), xL
    Next it
    For Each it In colY                                   ' canh ngang: y = it(2), giua canh x = it(1)
        If it(1) > xm Then AddOrdItem yRgt, syR, it(0), it(2), yB Else AddOrdItem yLft, syL, it(0), it(2), yB
    Next it
    AddOrdItem xBot, sxB, eR, xR, xL
    AddOrdItem yLft, syL, eT, yT, yB
    Dim nH As Long, nV As Long
    nH = MakeOrdinate(v, True, eL, xBot, yB - DIM_FIRST, xm, "duoi")
    nH = nH + MakeOrdinate(v, True, eL, xTop, yT + DIM_FIRST, xm, "tren")
    nV = MakeOrdinate(v, False, eB, yLft, xL - DIM_FIRST, ym, "trai")
    nV = nV + MakeOrdinate(v, False, eB, yRgt, xR + DIM_FIRST, ym, "phai")
    RecordDimRect True, xL, xR, yB - DIM_FIRST
    If xTop.Count > 0 Then RecordDimRect True, xL, xR, yT + DIM_FIRST
    RecordDimRect False, yB, yT, xL - DIM_FIRST
    If yRgt.Count > 0 Then RecordDimRect False, yB, yT, xR + DIM_FIRST

    ' e) Hole Callout, ranh, vat mep (dat o cho trong, tranh 4 dai ordinate)
    SetNoteBox xL, xR, yB, yT, DIM_FIRST + 0.008, DIM_FIRST + 0.008, DIM_FIRST + 0.008, DIM_FIRST + 0.008
    If circles.Count > 0 Then
        nL = 0: nr = 0: noteSide = 0
        HoleNotes v, circles, xL - 0.03, xR + 0.03, yT, yB
    End If
    If slots.Count > 0 Then SlotNotes v, slots, xL - 0.03, xR + 0.03, yT, yB
    If ADD_CHAMFER_NOTE Then
        Dim pmT As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
        Set pmT = partModelRef
        ChamferNotes pmT, v, Nothing, Nothing
    End If
    OrdinateView = "ordinate ngang " & nH & " vi tri (duoi " & xBot.Count & ", tren " & xTop.Count & _
                   "), doc " & nV & " vi tri (trai " & yLft.Count & ", phai " & yRgt.Count & ")"
End Function

' 1 nhom ordinate: chon GOC (base) roi cac vi tri (tang dan) -> AddOrdinateDimension2
' items = Array(tham chieu, toa do); place = toa do duong kich thuoc (ngang: y; doc: x); mid = toa do con lai
Private Function MakeOrdinate(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal base As Variant, items As Collection, _
                              ByVal place As Double, ByVal mid As Double, ByVal sideName As String) As Long
    Dim arr() As Variant, n As Long, i As Long, j As Long, t As Variant, r As Long, mdo As Object, nSel As Long
    n = items.Count
    If n = 0 Then Exit Function
    ReDim arr(n - 1)
    For i = 1 To n: arr(i - 1) = items.Item(i): Next i
    For i = 0 To n - 2
        For j = i + 1 To n - 1
            If arr(j)(1) < arr(i)(1) Then t = arr(i): arr(i) = arr(j): arr(j) = t
        Next j
    Next i
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not SelectRef(v, base, False) Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Ordinate " & sideName & ": khong chon duoc goc" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If SelectRef(v, arr(i)(0), True) Then nSel = nSel + 1
    Next i
    Set mdo = swDrawModel
    r = -99
    On Error Resume Next
    If horiz Then
        r = mdo.AddOrdinateDimension2(ORD_HORIZ, mid, place, 0#)
    Else
        r = mdo.AddOrdinateDimension2(ORD_VERT, place, mid, 0#)
    End If
    mdo.SetPickMode
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    dimLog = dimLog & "Ordinate " & sideName & ": " & nSel & "/" & n & " vi tri, ma tra ve " & r & vbCrLf
    If r = 0 Or r = -1 Then MakeOrdinate = nSel          ' 0 = swCreateOrdDimErr_Success (True neu phien ban tra ve Boolean)
End Function

' Them 1 vi tri ordinate (bo vi tri trung goc / trung nhau 0.01 mm)
Private Sub AddOrdItem(items As Collection, seen As Object, ByVal ref As Variant, ByVal pos As Double, ByVal basePos As Double)
    Dim k As String
    If Abs(pos - basePos) / sc < 0.00001 Then Exit Sub
    k = Format(Abs(pos - basePos) / sc * 1000#, "0.00")
    If seen.Exists(k) Then Exit Sub
    seen.Add k, 1
    If IsObject(ref) Then
        items.Add Array(ref, pos)
    Else
        items.Add Array(ref, pos)
    End If
End Sub

' 2) SAP XEP kich thuoc cua sheet dang mo:
'    a) Kich thuoc THANG: moi phia cua moi hinh chieu, cac HE (cung 1 duong) xep tang dan theo do dai:
'       he NHO sat hinh, he LON xa dan (DIM_FIRST + k * DIM_STEP). Kich thuoc nam DE LEN hinh -> dua ra
'       phia gan nhat. He nao chu so de len chu khac -> day ra tang ngoai ke tiep.
'    b) Hole Callout, O, R, ghi chu (co duong dan): chu nam tren hinh hoac de len chu khac -> dua ra
'       cho trong gan nhat NGOAI hinh chieu.
Public Function SapXepKichThuocSheet() As String
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, vw As SldWorks.View, nMove As Long, nSys As Long, nLead As Long
    Dim occ As New Collection, boxes As New Collection, b As Variant
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsEmpty(vws) Then SapXepKichThuocSheet = "LOI: sheet khong co hinh chieu.": Exit Function
    ' Dang BOI DEN (chon) kich thuoc / ghi chu -> chi sap xep cac doi tuong do; khong chon -> ca sheet
    Set selFilter = ReadSelectedAnnots()
    ' Mui ten luon nam TRONG 2 duong giong: hoc kieu mui ten "trong" tu cac kich thuoc dai
    nArrowFix = 0
    ' Vung cam dat chu: hinh hoc moi hinh chieu
    For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
        Set vw = vws(j)
        If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" Then
            ViewGeomBox vw, xL, xR, yB, yT
            occ.Add Array(xL - 0.0005, yB - 0.0005, xR + 0.0005, yT + 0.0005)
            ' hinh chieu CUM (ban ve lap tong): giu nguyen balloon, khong sap xep
            If Not IsAsmView(vw) Then boxes.Add Array(vw, xL, xR, yB, yT)
        End If
    Next j
    ' a) kich thuoc thang
    For Each b In boxes
        Set vw = b(0)
        nMove = nMove + ArrangeLinearDims(vw, b(1), b(2), b(3), b(4), occ, nSys)
    Next b
    ' b) chu thich co duong dan
    For Each b In boxes
        Set vw = b(0)
        nLead = nLead + RelocateLeaderItems(vw, b(1), b(2), b(3), b(4), occ)
    Next b
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    SapXepKichThuocSheet = IIf(selFilter.Count > 0, "Chi cac doi tuong dang chon (" & selFilter.Count & "). ", "") & _
                           "Sap xep " & nSys & " he kich thuoc (dich " & nMove & ") | dua " & nLead & _
                           " chu thich ra cho trong | dao mui ten vao trong: " & nArrowFix & "."
    Set selFilter = Nothing
End Function

' Sap xep kich thuoc cho MOI sheet cua ban ve (sau khi tao ban ve)
Public Function SapXepTatCaSheet() As String
    Dim names As Variant, i As Long, cur As String, r As String, nOk As Long
    If swDraw Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    cur = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName
    names = swDraw.GetSheetNames
    If IsEmpty(names) Then Exit Function
    For i = sheetFrom To UBound(names)                  ' noi tiep: chi cac sheet moi
        swDraw.ActivateSheet names(i)
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True                 ' khong loc theo vung chon
        r = SapXepKichThuocSheet()
        If Left(r, 3) <> "LOI" Then nOk = nOk + 1
        dimLog = dimLog & "Sap xep sheet " & names(i) & ": " & r & vbCrLf
    Next i
    swDraw.ActivateSheet cur
    SapXepTatCaSheet = "Sap xep kich thuoc: " & nOk & "/" & (UBound(names) + 1 - sheetFrom) & " sheet"
End Function

Private Function ArrangeLinearDims(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal xL As Double, ByVal xR As Double, ByVal yB As Double, _
                                   ByVal yT As Double, occ As Collection, nSys As Long) As Long
    Dim dd As Object, nx As Object, tp As Long, pos As Variant, vl As Double, sd As Long, recs As New Collection
    Dim guard As Long, isH As Boolean, known As Boolean, w As Double, h As Double, inside As Boolean
    Dim a1 As Double, a2 As Double, haveSpan As Boolean, t As Double, nSkip As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dd = v.GetFirstDisplayDimension5
    Do While Not dd Is Nothing And guard < 5000
        guard = guard + 1
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = dd.GetNext5
        tp = DimTypeOf(dd)
        If (tp = swHorLinearDimension Or tp = swVertLinearDimension Or tp = swLinearDimension) And Not IsCalloutDim(dd) Then
            pos = Empty: vl = 0
            If IsSelectedDim(dd) Then FixArrowsInside dd       ' mui ten vao trong 2 duong giong
            pos = dd.GetAnnotation.GetPosition
            vl = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
            If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then
                ' PHUONG DO + VI TRI DUONG KICH THUOC: uu tien 2 MUI TEN (DisplayData),
                ' roi loai kich thuoc (ngang/doc), cuoi cung hinh hoc doi tuong duoc ghi
                Dim lpA As Double, haveLp As Boolean, arrH As Boolean, curLp As Double
                known = False: haveSpan = False: haveLp = False
                If DimArrowInfo(dd, arrH, a1, a2, lpA) Then
                    isH = arrH: known = True
                    ' toa do mui ten phai o gan chu (cung he toa do giay) moi dung duoc vi tri
                    If Abs(lpA - IIf(arrH, pos(1), pos(0))) < 0.015 Then haveLp = True: haveSpan = True
                End If
                If tp = swHorLinearDimension Or tp = swVertLinearDimension Then
                    If known And (arrH <> (tp = swHorLinearDimension)) Then haveLp = False: haveSpan = False
                    isH = (tp = swHorLinearDimension): known = True
                End If
                If Not known Then DimAttachInfo v, dd, isH, known, a1, a2, haveSpan
                If known Then
                    curLp = IIf(isH, pos(1), pos(0))
                    If haveLp Then curLp = lpA
                    ' DUONG kich thuoc nam tren hinh (theo phuong vuong goc) -> dua ra phia gan nhat
                    If isH Then
                        inside = (curLp > yB And curLp < yT)
                        If curLp > (yB + yT) / 2 Then sd = 2 Else sd = 1
                    Else
                        inside = (curLp > xL And curLp < xR)
                        If curLp >= (xL + xR) / 2 Then sd = 4 Else sd = 3
                    End If
                    t = IIf(isH, pos(0), pos(1))
                    EstDimSize dd, w, h
                    ' kich thuoc dua tu tren hinh ra: chu dat giua 2 duong giong neu du cho
                    If inside And haveSpan Then
                        If Abs(a2 - a1) > w + 0.004 Then t = (a1 + a2) / 2
                    End If
                    If IsSelectedDim(dd) Then
                        recs.Add Array(dd, sd, curLp, t, vl, w, h, inside)
                    Else
                        ' khong nam trong vung chon: giu nguyen, coi la vung da chiem
                        occ.Add DimTextRect(sd, t, curLp, w, h)
                    End If
                Else
                    nSkip = nSkip + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
        Set dd = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
    If nSkip > 0 Then dimLog = dimLog & "[" & v.GetName2 & "] " & nSkip & " kich thuoc khong xac dinh duoc phuong -> giu nguyen" & vbCrLf
    For sd = 1 To 4
        ArrangeLinearDims = ArrangeLinearDims + ArrangeSide(recs, sd, xL, xR, yB, yT, occ, nSys)
    Next sd
End Function

' Hinh hoc cac doi tuong duoc ghi kich thuoc (tren giay) -> phuong do (isH: do theo X) & 2 vi tri dau (a1, a2)
Private Sub DimAttachInfo(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal dd As Object, isH As Boolean, known As Boolean, _
                          a1 As Double, a2 As Double, haveSpan As Boolean)
    Dim ents As Variant, i As Long, g As New Collection, it As Variant, g1 As Variant, g2 As Variant
    Dim ldx As Double, ldy As Double, vert1 As Boolean, vert2 As Boolean
    known = False: haveSpan = False
    On Error Resume Next
    ents = dd.GetAnnotation.GetAttachedEntities3
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(ents) Then Exit Sub
    For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
        it = EntitySheetGeom(v, ents(i))
        If Not IsEmpty(it) Then g.Add it
    Next i
    If g.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub
    g1 = g.Item(1)
    If g.Count = 1 Then
        ' 1 canh thang: kich thuoc chieu dai canh
        If g1(0) = "L" Then
            ldx = Abs(g1(3) - g1(1)): ldy = Abs(g1(4) - g1(2))
            isH = (ldx >= ldy): known = True: haveSpan = True
            If isH Then a1 = g1(1): a2 = g1(3) Else a1 = g1(2): a2 = g1(4)
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    g2 = g.Item(2)
    If g1(0) = "L" Then vert1 = (Abs(g1(4) - g1(2)) > Abs(g1(3) - g1(1)))
    If g2(0) = "L" Then vert2 = (Abs(g2(4) - g2(2)) > Abs(g2(3) - g2(1)))
    If g1(0) = "L" And g2(0) = "L" Then
        If vert1 And vert2 Then
            isH = True: known = True
        ElseIf Not vert1 And Not vert2 Then
            isH = False: known = True
        End If
    ElseIf g1(0) = "L" Then
        isH = vert1: known = True
    ElseIf g2(0) = "L" Then
        isH = vert2: known = True
    Else
        ' 2 diem: phuong ro rang (lech > 3 lan)
        ldx = Abs(GeomX(g1) - GeomX(g2)): ldy = Abs(GeomY(g1) - GeomY(g2))
        If ldx > 3 * ldy Then
            isH = True: known = True
        ElseIf ldy > 3 * ldx Then
            isH = False: known = True
        End If
    End If
    If known Then
        If isH Then a1 = GeomX(g1): a2 = GeomX(g2) Else a1 = GeomY(g1): a2 = GeomY(g2)
        haveSpan = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Function GeomX(g As Variant) As Double
    If g(0) = "L" Then GeomX = (g(1) + g(3)) / 2 Else GeomX = g(1)
End Function

Private Function GeomY(g As Variant) As Double
    If g(0) = "L" Then GeomY = (g(2) + g(4)) / 2 Else GeomY = g(2)
End Function

' Doi tuong (canh / dinh / net sketch / diem sketch) -> Array("L", x1, y1, x2, y2) hoac Array("P", x, y) tren giay
Private Function EntitySheetGeom(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ent As Object) As Variant
    Dim c As Object, cp As Variant, p As Variant, a As Variant, b As Variant, xf As Object, sk As Object, ixf As Object
    On Error GoTo fin
    If ent Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If TypeOf ent Is SldWorks.edge Then
        Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
        Set c = ent.GetCurve
        If c.IsLine Then
            cp = AsmCP(ent, ent.GetCurveParams2)
            a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
            b = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(3), cp(4), cp(5))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
            EntitySheetGeom = Array("L", a(0), a(1), b(0), b(1))
        ElseIf c.IsCircle Then
            p = AsmCirc(ent, c.CircleParams)
            a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
            EntitySheetGeom = Array("P", a(0), a(1))
        End If
    ElseIf TypeOf ent Is SldWorks.Vertex Then
        Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
        p = AsmPt(ent, ent.GetPoint)
        a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        EntitySheetGeom = Array("P", a(0), a(1))
    ElseIf TypeOf ent Is SldWorks.SketchLine Then
        Set sk = v.GetSketch
        Set ixf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform.Inverse
        a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(ent.GetStartPoint2.X, ent.GetStartPoint2.Y, 0)).MultiplyTransform(ixf).ArrayData
        b = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(ent.GetEndPoint2.X, ent.GetEndPoint2.Y, 0)).MultiplyTransform(ixf).ArrayData
        EntitySheetGeom = Array("L", a(0), a(1), b(0), b(1))
    ElseIf TypeOf ent Is SldWorks.SketchPoint Then
        Set sk = v.GetSketch
        Set ixf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform.Inverse
        a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(ent.X, ent.Y, 0)).MultiplyTransform(ixf).ArrayData
        EntitySheetGeom = Array("P", a(0), a(1))
    End If
fin:
End Function

' 1 phia: gom he (cung duong, lech < 1.5 mm; kich thuoc de len hinh = he rieng), xep tang dan theo tong do dai;
' moi he 1 tang; chu de len chu da dat -> day ra tang ke tiep; 2 chu cung he de nhau -> tach ra he rieng
Private Function ArrangeSide(recs As Collection, ByVal sd As Long, ByVal xL As Double, ByVal xR As Double, _
                             ByVal yB As Double, ByVal yT As Double, occ As Collection, nSys As Long) As Long
    Dim r As Variant, a() As Variant, n As Long, i As Long, j As Long, t As Variant, edg As Double, sg As Long
    Dim sysId() As Long, nS As Long, span() As Double, ord() As Long, k As Long, lp As Double
    Select Case sd
        Case 1: edg = yB: sg = -1
        Case 2: edg = yT: sg = 1
        Case 3: edg = xL: sg = -1
        Case Else: edg = xR: sg = 1
    End Select
    For Each r In recs
        If r(1) = sd Then n = n + 1
    Next r
    If n = 0 Then Exit Function
    ReDim a(n - 1): i = 0
    For Each r In recs
        If r(1) = sd Then a(i) = r: i = i + 1
    Next r
    ' sap: kich thuoc ngoai hinh theo khoang cach (gan -> xa); kich thuoc de len hinh xep cuoi
    For i = 0 To n - 2
        For j = i + 1 To n - 1
            If SideKey(a(j), edg) < SideKey(a(i), edg) Then t = a(i): a(i) = a(j): a(j) = t
        Next j
    Next i
    ReDim sysId(n - 1): ReDim span(n - 1)
    nS = 0
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If i = 0 Then
            nS = 1
        ElseIf a(i)(7) Or a(i - 1)(7) Or Abs(a(i)(2) - a(i - 1)(2)) > 0.0015 Then
            nS = nS + 1
        End If
        sysId(i) = nS - 1
        span(nS - 1) = span(nS - 1) + a(i)(4)
    Next i
    ReDim ord(nS - 1)
    For i = 0 To nS - 1: ord(i) = i: Next i
    For i = 0 To nS - 2
        For j = i + 1 To nS - 1
            If span(ord(j)) < span(ord(i)) - 0.0000001 Then k = ord(i): ord(i) = ord(j): ord(j) = k
        Next j
    Next i
    ' Dat tung he: tang thap nhat con trong (khong de len chu da dat)
    Dim s As Long, tierNext As Long, tr As Long, ok As Boolean, rc As Variant, placed As Collection
    Dim newLp() As Double, deferred As New Collection, defNow As Collection, d As Variant
    ReDim newLp(n - 1)
    tierNext = 0
    For s = 0 To nS - 1
        tr = tierNext
        Do
            lp = edg + sg * (DIM_FIRST + tr * DIM_STEP)
            ok = True
            Set placed = New Collection
            Set defNow = New Collection
            For i = 0 To n - 1
                If sysId(i) = ord(s) Then
                    rc = DimTextRect(sd, a(i)(3), lp, a(i)(5), a(i)(6))
                    If RectHitsAny(rc, occ) Then ok = False: Exit For
                    If RectHitsAny(rc, placed) Then
                        defNow.Add i                         ' de chu cung he -> tach rieng
                        sysId(i) = -1
                    Else
                        placed.Add rc
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
            ' tra lai cac kich thuoc vua tach cua he nay (de thu lai / de giu nguyen he)
            For Each d In defNow
                sysId(d) = ord(s)
            Next d
            If ok Or tr > tierNext + 8 Then Exit Do
            tr = tr + 1
        Loop
        ' tach han cac kich thuoc de chu trong he nay sang danh sach rieng
        For Each d In defNow
            sysId(d) = -1
            deferred.Add d
        Next d
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            If sysId(i) = ord(s) Then newLp(i) = lp
        Next i
        For Each rc In placed
            occ.Add rc
        Next rc
        tierNext = tr + 1
    Next s
    ' cac kich thuoc bi tach: moi cai 1 tang ngoai cung con trong
    For Each d In deferred
        tr = tierNext
        Do
            lp = edg + sg * (DIM_FIRST + tr * DIM_STEP)
            rc = DimTextRect(sd, a(d)(3), lp, a(d)(5), a(d)(6))
            If Not RectHitsAny(rc, occ) Or tr > tierNext + 8 Then Exit Do
            tr = tr + 1
        Loop
        newLp(d) = lp: occ.Add rc
        tierNext = tr + 1
        nS = nS + 1
    Next d
    ' Ap dung
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If Abs(newLp(i) - a(i)(2)) > 0.0002 Then
            If sd <= 2 Then
                a(i)(0).GetAnnotation.SetPosition a(i)(3), newLp(i), 0
            Else
                a(i)(0).GetAnnotation.SetPosition newLp(i), a(i)(3), 0
            End If
            ArrangeSide = ArrangeSide + 1
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    nSys = nSys + nS
End Function

' Kich thuoc / ghi chu DANG CHON tren ban ve (bo den truoc khi chay) -> tap ten
Private Function ReadSelectedAnnots() As Object
    Dim d As Object, sm As SldWorks.SelectionMgr, i As Long, n As Long, o As Object, nm As String
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set ReadSelectedAnnots = d
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sm = swDrawModel.SelectionManager
    n = sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    For i = 1 To n
        Set o = Nothing
        Set o = sm.GetSelectedObject6(i, -1)
        If Not o Is Nothing Then
            nm = ""
            If TypeOf o Is SldWorks.DisplayDimension Then
                nm = "D|" & o.GetNameForSelection
            ElseIf TypeOf o Is SldWorks.note Then
                nm = "A|" & o.GetAnnotation.GetName
            ElseIf TypeOf o Is SldWorks.Annotation Then
                nm = "A|" & o.GetName
            End If
            If nm <> "" And nm <> "D|" And nm <> "A|" Then d(nm) = 1
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Function IsSelectedDim(ByVal dd As Object) As Boolean
    Dim nm As String
    If selFilter Is Nothing Then IsSelectedDim = True: Exit Function
    If selFilter.Count = 0 Then IsSelectedDim = True: Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    nm = dd.GetNameForSelection
    IsSelectedDim = selFilter.Exists("D|" & nm) Or selFilter.Exists("A|" & dd.GetAnnotation.GetName)
End Function

Private Function IsSelectedAnn(ByVal ann As Object) As Boolean
    Dim dd As Object
    If selFilter Is Nothing Then IsSelectedAnn = True: Exit Function
    If selFilter.Count = 0 Then IsSelectedAnn = True: Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    If selFilter.Exists("A|" & ann.GetName) Then IsSelectedAnn = True: Exit Function
    Set dd = ann.GetSpecificAnnotation
    If Not dd Is Nothing Then
        If TypeOf dd Is SldWorks.DisplayDimension Then IsSelectedAnn = selFilter.Exists("D|" & dd.GetNameForSelection)
    End If
End Function

' Vi tri 2 MUI TEN cua kich thuoc (IDisplayData): phuong do, 2 dau do (a1, a2) & vi tri duong kich thuoc (lp)
Private Function DimArrowInfo(ByVal dd As Object, isH As Boolean, a1 As Double, a2 As Double, lp As Double) As Boolean
    Dim dsp As Object, n As Long, p As Variant, q As Variant, ddx As Double, ddy As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dsp = dd.GetDisplayData
    If dsp Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    n = 0: n = dsp.GetArrowHeadCount
    If n < 2 Then Exit Function
    p = Empty: q = Empty
    p = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex2(0)
    q = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex2(1)
    If IsEmpty(p) Or IsEmpty(q) Then
        p = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex(0)
        q = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex(1)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(p) Or IsEmpty(q) Then Exit Function
    If UBound(p) < 1 Or UBound(q) < 1 Then Exit Function
    ddx = Abs(q(0) - p(0)): ddy = Abs(q(1) - p(1))
    If ddx > 3 * ddy And ddx > 0.0001 Then
        isH = True: a1 = p(0): a2 = q(0): lp = (p(1) + q(1)) / 2: DimArrowInfo = True
    ElseIf ddy > 3 * ddx And ddy > 0.0001 Then
        isH = False: a1 = p(1): a2 = q(1): lp = (p(0) + q(0)) / 2: DimArrowInfo = True
    End If
End Function

' Dau huong 2 mui ten so voi trung diem (+1 / -1 neu 2 mui ten cung kieu; 0 = khong ro). span = khoang cach 2 dau mui ten
Private Function RawArrowSign(ByVal dd As Object, Optional span As Double) As Long
    Dim dsp As Object, p As Variant, q As Variant, mx As Double, my As Double, dp As Double, dq As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dsp = dd.GetDisplayData
    If dsp Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If dsp.GetArrowHeadCount < 2 Then Exit Function
    p = Empty: q = Empty
    p = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex2(0)
    q = dsp.GetArrowHeadAtIndex2(1)
    If IsEmpty(p) Or IsEmpty(q) Then Exit Function
    If UBound(p) < 5 Or UBound(q) < 5 Then Exit Function
    mx = (p(0) + q(0)) / 2: my = (p(1) + q(1)) / 2
    span = Sqr((p(0) - q(0)) ^ 2 + (p(1) - q(1)) ^ 2)
    dp = p(3) * (p(0) - mx) + p(4) * (p(1) - my)
    dq = q(3) * (q(0) - mx) + q(4) * (q(1) - my)
    If dp > 0 And dq > 0 Then RawArrowSign = 1
    If dp < 0 And dq < 0 Then RawArrowSign = -1
End Function

' Kieu "mui ten trong" = kieu cua da so kich thuoc DAI (> 30 mm tren giay, du cho mui ten nam trong)
Private Function CalibArrowSign(vws As Variant) As Long
    Dim j As Long, vw As Object, dd As Object, nx As Object, s As Long, sp As Double, np As Long, nm As Long, guard As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
        Set vw = vws(j)
        Set dd = Nothing
        Set dd = vw.GetFirstDisplayDimension5
        guard = 0
        Do While Not dd Is Nothing And guard < 5000
            guard = guard + 1
            Set nx = Nothing
            Set nx = dd.GetNext5
            sp = 0
            s = RawArrowSign(dd, sp)
            If sp > 0.03 Then
                If s = 1 Then np = np + 1
                If s = -1 Then nm = nm + 1
            End If
            Set dd = nx
        Loop
    Next j
    On Error GoTo 0
    If nm > np Then CalibArrowSign = -1 Else CalibArrowSign = 1
End Function

' Dua 2 mui ten vao TRONG 2 duong giong: ArrowSide = swDimArrowsInside (0) cho moi kich thuoc thang
Private Sub FixArrowsInside(ByVal dd As Object)
    Dim cur As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    cur = -1
    cur = dd.ArrowSide
    If cur <> swDimArrowsInside Then
        dd.ArrowSide = swDimArrowsInside
        If dd.ArrowSide = swDimArrowsInside Then nArrowFix = nArrowFix + 1
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Khoa sap xep trong 1 phia: kich thuoc de len hinh xep sau cung
Private Function SideKey(r As Variant, ByVal edg As Double) As Double
    SideKey = Abs(r(2) - edg)
    If r(7) Then SideKey = SideKey + 10
End Function

' Khung chu so kich thuoc thang (ngang: chu tren duong; doc: chu ben trai duong)
Private Function DimTextRect(ByVal sd As Long, ByVal t As Double, ByVal lp As Double, ByVal w As Double, _
                             ByVal h As Double) As Variant
    If sd <= 2 Then
        DimTextRect = Array(t - w / 2, lp - 0.0004, t + w / 2, lp + h)
    Else
        DimTextRect = Array(lp - h, t - w / 2, lp + 0.0004, t + w / 2)
    End If
End Function

Private Function RectHitsAny(rc As Variant, rects As Collection) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    For Each q In rects
        If rc(0) < q(2) And rc(2) > q(0) And rc(1) < q(3) And rc(3) > q(1) Then RectHitsAny = True: Exit Function
    Next q
End Function

' Hole Callout / kich thuoc co dong chu phu (khong xep tang nhu kich thuoc thang)
Private Function IsCalloutDim(ByVal dd As Object) As Boolean
    Dim s As String
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove)
    If Trim(s) <> "" Then IsCalloutDim = True: Exit Function
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow)
    If Trim(s) <> "" Then IsCalloutDim = True: Exit Function
    s = "": s = UCase(dd.GetText(swDimensionTextSuffix))
    IsCalloutDim = (InStr(s, "THRU") > 0 Or InStr(s, "<HOLE") > 0)
End Function

' Uoc luong kich thuoc chu cua 1 kich thuoc (m tren giay)
Private Sub EstDimSize(ByVal dd As Object, w As Double, h As Double)
    Dim pre As String, suf As String, ab As String, be As String, vl As Double, nLine As Long, nCh As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    vl = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
    pre = CleanCodes(dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix))
    suf = CleanCodes(dd.GetText(swDimensionTextSuffix))
    ab = CleanCodes(dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove))
    be = CleanCodes(dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow))
    On Error GoTo 0
    nCh = Len(pre) + Len(ToMM(vl)) + Len(suf)
    If Len(ab) > nCh Then nCh = Len(ab)
    If Len(be) > nCh Then nCh = Len(be)
    nLine = 1 - (Trim(ab) <> "") - (Trim(be) <> "")
    w = nCh * 0.0022 + 0.002
    h = nLine * 0.0048
End Sub

' Bo ma <...> (moi ma tinh 1 ky tu) de uoc do dai chu
Private Function CleanCodes(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim p As Long, q As Long
    p = InStr(s, "<")
    Do While p > 0
        q = InStr(p, s, ">")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        s = Left(s, p - 1) & "#" & mid(s, q + 1)
        p = InStr(p + 1, s, "<")
    Loop
    CleanCodes = Replace(Replace(s, vbCr, ""), vbLf, "")
End Function

' Hole Callout, kich thuoc O / R / goc, ghi chu cua 1 hinh chieu: chu DE LEN hinh hoac DE LEN chu khac
' -> dua ra cho trong gan nhat ngoai hinh (duong dan van gan vao lo / canh)
Private Function RelocateLeaderItems(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal xL As Double, ByVal xR As Double, ByVal yB As Double, _
                                     ByVal yT As Double, occ As Collection) As Long
    Dim ann As Object, nx As Object, tp As Long, guard As Long, items As New Collection, it As Variant
    Dim pos As Variant, w As Double, h As Double, rc As Variant, dd As Object, dtp As Long, txt As String
    Dim box As Variant, bad As New Collection, PX As Double, py As Double
    box = Array(xL, yB, xR, yT)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ann = v.GetFirstAnnotation3
    Do While Not ann Is Nothing And guard < 5000
        guard = guard + 1
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = ann.GetNext3
        tp = -1: tp = ann.GetType
        pos = Empty: pos = ann.GetPosition
        If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then
            If tp = swDisplayDimension Then
                Set dd = ann.GetSpecificAnnotation
                dtp = DimTypeOf(dd)
                ' kich thuoc thang thuong & ordinate da xu ly rieng
                If Not ((dtp = swHorLinearDimension Or dtp = swVertLinearDimension Or dtp = swLinearDimension) _
                        And Not IsCalloutDim(dd)) And dtp <> swOrdinateDimension And dtp <> swHorOrdinateDimension _
                        And dtp <> swVertOrdinateDimension Then
                    EstDimSize dd, w, h
                    items.Add Array(ann, pos(0), pos(1), w, h)
                End If
            ElseIf tp = swNote Then
                txt = "": txt = ann.GetSpecificAnnotation.GetText
                ' the lo cua Hole Table (A1, B12... ; gop tag giong nhau: A, B...) phai nam tai lo -> khong dich
                If Not (UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z]#" Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z]##" Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z]###" _
                        Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z][A-Z]#" Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z][A-Z]##" _
                        Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z]" Or UCase(Trim(txt)) Like "[A-Z][A-Z]") Then
                    NoteSize txt, w, h
                    items.Add Array(ann, pos(0), pos(1), w, h)
                End If
            End If
        End If
        Set ann = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' giu nguyen chu dang o cho tot; gom cac chu can dua ra
    For Each it In items
        rc = Array(it(1), it(2) - it(4), it(1) + it(3), it(2))
        If RectHitsAny(rc, occ) And IsSelectedAnn(it(0)) Then
            bad.Add it
        Else
            occ.Add rc
        End If
    Next it
    For Each it In bad
        If FreeSpotNear(it(1), it(2), it(3), it(4), occ, PX, py) Then
            On Error Resume Next
            it(0).SetPosition PX, py, 0
            On Error GoTo 0
            occ.Add Array(PX - 0.001, py - it(4) - 0.001, PX + it(3) + 0.001, py + 0.001)
            RelocateLeaderItems = RelocateLeaderItems + 1
        End If
    Next it
End Function

' Kich thuoc chu cua ghi chu (nhieu dong)
Private Sub NoteSize(ByVal txt As String, w As Double, h As Double)
    Dim ln As Variant, i As Long, m As Long
    ln = Split(Replace(CleanCodes2(txt), vbCr, ""), vbLf)
    For i = 0 To UBound(ln)
        If Len(ln(i)) > m Then m = Len(ln(i))
    Next i
    If m = 0 Then m = 4
    w = m * 0.0022 + 0.002
    h = (UBound(ln) + 1) * 0.0048
    If h < 0.0048 Then h = 0.0048
End Sub

Private Function CleanCodes2(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim p As Long, q As Long
    p = InStr(s, "<")
    Do While p > 0
        q = InStr(p, s, ">")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        s = Left(s, p - 1) & "#" & mid(s, q + 1)
        p = InStr(p + 1, s, "<")
    Loop
    CleanCodes2 = s
End Function

' Cho trong gan (cx, cy) nhat cho khung chu w x h (goc tren-trai = (px, py)): khong de len vung cam, trong khung ban ve
Private Function FreeSpotNear(ByVal cx As Double, ByVal cy As Double, ByVal w As Double, ByVal h As Double, _
                              occ As Collection, PX As Double, py As Double) As Boolean
