    Dim r As Double, k As Long, dirs As Variant, ddx As Double, ddy As Double, nrm As Double, rc As Variant
    dirs = Array(Array(1, 1), Array(-1, 1), Array(1, -1), Array(-1, -1), Array(1, 0), Array(0, 1), Array(-1, 0), Array(0, -1))
    For r = 0.004 To 0.15 Step 0.003
        For k = 0 To UBound(dirs)
            ddx = dirs(k)(0): ddy = dirs(k)(1)
            nrm = Sqr(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy)
            PX = cx + r * ddx / nrm
            py = cy + r * ddy / nrm
            If ddx < 0 Then PX = PX - w
            If ddy > 0 Then py = py + h
            rc = Array(PX - 0.001, py - h - 0.001, PX + w + 0.001, py + 0.001)
            If rc(0) > FRAME_L + 0.002 And rc(2) < SHEET_W - FRAME_R - 0.002 And _
               rc(1) > FRAME_B + 0.002 And rc(3) < SHEET_H - FRAME_T - 0.002 Then
                If Not RectHitsAny(rc, occ) Then FreeSpotNear = True: Exit Function
            End If
        Next k
    Next r
End Function

' Loai kich thuoc (swDimensionType_e)
Private Function DimTypeOf(ByVal dd As Object) As Long
    DimTypeOf = -1
    On Error Resume Next
    DimTypeOf = dd.Type2
    If DimTypeOf = -1 Then DimTypeOf = dd.GetType
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Khung HINH HOC cua hinh chieu tren giay (hop bao part chieu len); khong doc duoc part -> khung view
Private Sub ViewGeomBox(v As SldWorks.View, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double)
    Dim pm As Object, b As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, k As Long, a As Variant, first As Boolean, ol As Variant
    Dim xf As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set pm = v.ReferencedDocument
    If Not pm Is Nothing Then
        If pm.GetType = swDocPART Then b = pm.GetPartBox(True)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(b) Then
        ol = v.GetOutline
        xL = ol(0): yB = ol(1): xR = ol(2): yT = ol(3)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    first = True
    For i = 0 To 1
        For j = 0 To 1
            For k = 0 To 1
                a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(b(i * 3), b(1 + j * 3), b(2 + k * 3))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                If first Then
                    xL = a(0): xR = a(0): yB = a(1): yT = a(1): first = False
                Else
                    If a(0) < xL Then xL = a(0)
                    If a(0) > xR Then xR = a(0)
                    If a(1) < yB Then yB = a(1)
                    If a(1) > yT Then yT = a(1)
                End If
            Next k
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub

'===========================================================================
'  KICH HOAT BANG MAT KHAU (lan dau tren moi may)
'  Nhap dung MAT_KHAU 1 lan -> luu ma kich hoat (gan voi ten may) vao Registry -> lan sau khong hoi
'===========================================================================
Private Function YeuCauKichHoat() As Boolean
    Dim frm As Object, i As Long, s As String
    If Not DUNG_MAT_KHAU Then YeuCauKichHoat = True: Exit Function      ' da TAT mat khau
    If DaKichHoat() Then YeuCauKichHoat = True: Exit Function
    formMode = "PASS"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set frm = VBA.UserForms.Add("frmTaoBanVe")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not frm Is Nothing Then
        formFromMain = True
        frm.Show
        formFromMain = False
        Unload frm
    Else
        ' chua co form -> hop nhap (khong an ky tu)
        For i = 1 To 3
            s = InputBox("Nhap mat khau de kich hoat macro (lan dau):", APP_NAME)
            If s = "" Then Exit For
            If KiemTraMatKhau(s) Then Exit For
            MsgBox "Sai mat khau. Con " & (3 - i) & " lan.", vbExclamation, APP_NAME
        Next i
    End If
    formMode = ""
    YeuCauKichHoat = DaKichHoat()
End Function

Private Function DaKichHoat() As Boolean
    DaKichHoat = (GetSetting("TBVGC", "L", "P", "") = MaKichHoat())
End Function

' Dung mat khau -> luu ma kich hoat cua may nay
Public Function KiemTraMatKhau(ByVal s As String) As Boolean
    If s = MAT_KHAU Then
        SaveSetting "TBVGC", "L", "P", MaKichHoat()
        KiemTraMatKhau = True
    End If
End Function

' Ma kich hoat = bam (mat khau + ten may): chep Registry sang may khac / doi mat khau -> phai nhap lai
Private Function MaKichHoat() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = MAT_KHAU & "|" & UCase(Environ("COMPUTERNAME")) & "|TBVGC"
    MaKichHoat = BamChuoi(s, 33) & BamChuoi(StrReverse(s), 131)
End Function

Private Function BamChuoi(ByVal s As String, ByVal mul As Double) As String
    Dim h As Double, k As Double, i As Long, m As Double
    m = 2147483629#
    h = 5381
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        k = h * mul + AscW(mid(s, i, 1)) + i * 7
        h = k - Int(k / m) * m
    Next i
    BamChuoi = Right("00000000" & Hex(CLng(h)), 8)
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  HAN SU DUNG (chi 1 gia tri: NGAY_HET_HAN)
'  - NGAY_HET_HAN = "" -> dung vinh vien
'  - Qua ngay NGAY_HET_HAN -> khoa tren may do (ghi Registry
'    HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\VB and VBA Program Settings\TBVGC)
'  - Gia han: sua NGAY_HET_HAN trong code (ngay khac) -> may da khoa tu mo lai
'  - Vat dong ho may tinh lui ve truoc lan chay gan nhat -> khoa
'===========================================================================
Private Function KiemTraHanDung(thongBao As String) As Boolean
    Const RA As String = "TBVGC", rs As String = "L"
    Dim homNay As Date, ngayCuoi As Date, han As Date, s As String, conLai As Long, dauPB As String

    homNay = Date
    ' GIA HAN: NGAY_HET_HAN trong code doi -> "dau phien ban" doi -> xoa khoa cu tren may nay
    dauPB = BamChuoi(Trim(NGAY_HET_HAN) & "|" & RA, 57)
    If GetSetting(RA, rs, "V", "") <> dauPB Then
        On Error Resume Next
        DeleteSetting RA, rs, "K"
        DeleteSetting RA, rs, "A"                                    ' (ban cu: ngay bat dau dem so ngay)
        On Error GoTo 0
        SaveSetting RA, rs, "V", dauPB
    End If

    ' "" = dung VINH VIEN
    If Trim(NGAY_HET_HAN) = "" Then KiemTraHanDung = True: Exit Function
    If Not DocNgayHetHan(NGAY_HET_HAN, han) Then
        thongBao = "NGAY_HET_HAN sai dinh dang: """ & NGAY_HET_HAN & """" & vbCrLf & _
                   "Dung dang ""yyyy-mm-dd"" (vd ""2026-12-31"") hoac de """" (vinh vien)."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If GetSetting(RA, rs, "K", "") <> "" Then GoTo khoa              ' da bi khoa truoc do
    ' Chong vat dong ho lui
    s = GetSetting(RA, rs, "B", "")
    If s <> "" Then
        If Not GiaiMaNgay(s, ngayCuoi) Then GoTo khoa                ' du lieu bi sua
        If homNay < ngayCuoi - 1 Then GoTo khoa
    End If
    If homNay > han Then GoTo khoa

    If homNay > ngayCuoi Then SaveSetting RA, rs, "B", MaHoaNgay(homNay)
    conLai = CLng(han - homNay) + 1
    If conLai <= 3 Then
        MsgBox "Macro con " & conLai & " ngay su dung (den het ngay " & Format(han, "dd/mm/yyyy") & ").", _
               vbExclamation, "Sap het han"
    End If
    KiemTraHanDung = True
    Exit Function

khoa:
    SaveSetting RA, rs, "K", MaHoaNgay(homNay)
    thongBao = "Macro tao ban ve da HET HAN SU DUNG (han: " & Format(han, "dd/mm/yyyy") & ")." & vbCrLf & _
               "Vui long lien he tac gia de duoc gia han."
End Function

' Doc ngay het han: "yyyy-mm-dd" hoac "dd/mm/yyyy" (dau / hoac -)
Private Function DocNgayHetHan(ByVal s As String, d As Date) As Boolean
    Dim p As Variant, Y As Long, m As Long, dd As Long
    s = Trim(Replace(s, "/", "-"))
    p = Split(s, "-")
    If UBound(p) <> 2 Then Exit Function
    If Len(Trim(p(0))) = 4 Then
        Y = Val(p(0)): m = Val(p(1)): dd = Val(p(2))
    Else
        dd = Val(p(0)): m = Val(p(1)): Y = Val(p(2))
    End If
    If Y < 2000 Or Y > 2999 Or m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then Exit Function
    d = DateSerial(Y, m, dd)
    If Day(d) <> dd Then Exit Function                              ' vd 31/02 khong hop le
    DocNgayHetHan = True
End Function

' Ngay -> chuoi ma hoa co ma kiem tra (sua tay trong Registry se bi phat hien)
Private Function MaHoaNgay(ByVal d As Date) As String
    Dim n As Long
    n = CLng(Int(d))
    MaHoaNgay = CStr(n Xor 23164) & "-" & CStr((n * 7 + 13) Mod 9973)
End Function

Private Function GiaiMaNgay(ByVal s As String, d As Date) As Boolean
    Dim p As Long, n As Long, c As Long
    p = InStr(s, "-")
    If p < 2 Then Exit Function
    On Error GoTo fin
    n = CLng(Left(s, p - 1)) Xor 23164
    c = CLng(mid(s, p + 1))
    If c <> (n * 7 + 13) Mod 9973 Then Exit Function
    d = CDate(n)
    GiaiMaNgay = True
fin:
End Function

Sub main()
    ' Kiem tra han su dung truoc khi lam bat cu viec gi
    Dim hanMsg As String
    If Not KiemTraHanDung(hanMsg) Then
        MsgBox hanMsg, vbCritical, "Het han su dung"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Lan dau tren may nay: nhap MAT KHAU kich hoat
    If Not YeuCauKichHoat() Then
        MsgBox "Chua kich hoat (sai mat khau hoac da huy).", vbExclamation, APP_NAME
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set swMath = swApp.GetMathUtility
    sheetFrom = 0
    RefreshLastDrawingPath                       ' cap nhat duong dan ban ve gan nhat (neu da duoc luu)

    Dim doc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
    Set doc = swApp.ActiveDoc
    If doc Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Hay mo file PART hoac ASSEMBLY.", vbExclamation: Exit Sub
    End If
    activeIsDrawing = (doc.GetType = swDocDRAWING)
    If Not activeIsDrawing And doc.GetPathName = "" Then
        MsgBox "Hay luu file truoc khi chay macro.", vbExclamation: Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Ban ve: ghi nho cac hinh chieu DANG CHON ngay khi chay macro (dung cho Auto balloon)
    Set preSelViews = Nothing
    If activeIsDrawing Then
        Set swDrawModel = doc
        Set swDraw = doc
        Set preSelViews = SelectedDrawingViews()
    End If

    ' Cai dat: mac dinh -> gia tri da luu -> form (Huy = dung macro)
    NapCaiDat
    If SHOW_SETTINGS_FORM Then
        If Not HienFormCaiDat() Then Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Tat hop thoai "Modify" khi ghi kich thuoc (Tools > Options > General > Input dimension value)
    ' -> kich thuoc tu dong OK, khong can xac nhan; chay xong tra lai cai dat cu
    Dim oldInputDim As Boolean
    oldInputDim = swApp.GetUserPreferenceToggle(swInputDimValOnCreate)
    swApp.SetUserPreferenceToggle swInputDimValOnCreate, False

    ' BAN VE dang mo: chay chuc nang sua kich thuoc da chon tren form
    If activeIsDrawing Then
        Dim resD As String
        Set swDrawModel = doc
        Set swDraw = doc
        batchMode = False
        If SheetIsAssembly() And formAction <> "BAL" Then
            ' sheet ban ve lap tong (chi co hinh chieu cum): khong ghi / sua kich thuoc chi tiet
            resD = "LOI: sheet dang mo la BAN VE LAP (assembly)." & vbCrLf & _
                   "Cac chuc nang EDIT DRAWING chi dung cho sheet chi tiet (part)."
        Else
            Select Case formAction
                Case "ORD": resD = OrdinateSheetHienTai()
                Case "RED": resD = RedoSheetDims()
                Case "HOL": resD = HoleTableSheet()
                Case "BAL": resD = BalloonSheet(True)          ' Auto balloon: xoa balloon cu tren sheet, gan lai
                Case "ARR": resD = SapXepKichThuocSheet()
                Case Else
                    resD = "LOI: dang mo BAN VE -> hay chon chuc nang tren form (can UserForm frmTaoBanVe)."
            End Select
        End If
        swApp.SetUserPreferenceToggle swInputDimValOnCreate, oldInputDim
        If Left(resD, 3) = "LOI" Then
            MsgBox resD, vbExclamation, APP_NAME
        Else
            dimLog = dimLog & resD & vbCrLf
            MsgBox "Hoan thanh", vbInformation, APP_NAME
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Select Case doc.GetType
        Case swDocPART
            batchMode = False
            Dim resP As String
            If APPEND_LAST Then
                resP = AppendPartDrawing(doc)            ' noi tiep 1 sheet vao ban ve macro tao gan nhat
            Else
                resP = MakePartDrawing(doc)
            End If
            ' Auto Note: ghi chu theo vat lieu (MATERIAL) cho sheet vua tao
            If Left(resP, 3) <> "LOI" And AUTO_NOTE And Not swDrawModel Is Nothing Then resP = resP & vbCrLf & AddMaterialNote(doc, "")
            If Left(resP, 3) <> "LOI" And Not swDrawModel Is Nothing Then RememberDrawing swDrawModel
            If Left(resP, 3) = "LOI" Then
                MsgBox resP, vbExclamation, APP_NAME
            Else
                MsgBox "Da chay xong.", vbInformation, APP_NAME
            End If
        Case swDocASSEMBLY
            If formAction = "TBX" Then
                ' Xuat thiet bi tieu chuan (TBTC / TBC / TBD) ra Excel
                Dim resX As String
                resX = ExportStandardParts(doc, TB_EXPORT_FOLDERS, QTY_SETS)
                If Left(resX, 3) = "LOI" Then
                    MsgBox resX, vbExclamation, APP_NAME
                ElseIf Left(resX, 2) = "OK" Then
                    ' chi bao "Hoan thanh" (+ ghi chu Ma goi y neu co), hien tren cung ke ca khi cua so Excel dang o truoc
                    MsgBox DecodeU("Ho\u00E0n th\u00E0nh") & mid(resX, 3), vbInformation + vbSystemModal + vbMsgBoxSetForeground, APP_NAME
                End If                                     ' "" = da huy luu: bang van mo trong Excel
            ElseIf formAction = "QTY" Then
                ' Dem so luong moi cum con / part -> ghi custom property QTY (khong tu luu file)
                Dim resQ As String
                resQ = CountQty(doc, QTY_FOLDERS, QTY_SETS)
                If Left(resQ, 3) = "LOI" Then
                    MsgBox resQ, vbExclamation, APP_NAME
                Else
                    MsgBox DecodeU("Ho\u00E0n th\u00E0nh") & resQ, vbInformation, APP_NAME
                End If
            Else
                batchMode = True
                BatchAssembly doc
            End If
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Hay mo file PART hoac ASSEMBLY (khong phai ban ve).", vbExclamation
    End Select

    swApp.SetUserPreferenceToggle swInputDimValOnCreate, oldInputDim
End Sub

'===========================================================================
'  ASSEMBLY: tao ban ve lan luot cho tung part (khong trung lap)
'===========================================================================
Public Sub BatchAssembly(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2)
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long
    Dim comp As SldWorks.Component2, p As String, parts As Object, pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    swAsm.ResolveAllLightWeightComponents False

    ' 1) Danh sach part / cum con se xuat (dung chung voi cua so Choose...)
    Dim asms As Object, weldSet As Object, weldAsmSet As Object, cntS As Object
    Set parts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set asms = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set weldSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set weldAsmSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cntS = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ' cum con LUON co sheet ban ve lap; o "Top assembly sheet" chi bat / tat sheet cum tong (topOn)
    If Not CollectDrawItems(asmModel, True, parts, asms, weldSet, weldAsmSet, cntS) Then
        MsgBox "Assembly khong co chi tiet.", vbExclamation: Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim nTb As Long, nEx As Long, nVirt As Long, nFld As Long, nPat As Long, nSup As Long, nAsmSkip As Long
    nFld = cntS("fld"): nPat = cntS("pat"): nTb = cntS("tb"): nEx = cntS("ex")
    nVirt = cntS("virt"): nSup = cntS("sup"): nAsmSkip = cntS("asm")
    ' danh sach chi tiet / cum thuoc thu muc han (de kiem tra trong log)
    Dim weldLog As String, kw As Variant, shTp As String
    For Each kw In weldSet.Keys
        If parts.Exists(kw) Then
            shTp = "sheet chi tiet"
        ElseIf asms.Exists(kw) Then
            shTp = IIf(asms.Item(kw)(4) = "W", "sheet ve nhu part (cum con han)", "sheet ban ve lap")
        Else
            shTp = "KHONG co sheet"
        End If
        weldLog = weldLog & "  BVHAN: " & mid(kw, InStrRev(kw, "\") + 1) & " -> " & WeldTag(weldSet.Item(kw)) & " | " & shTp & vbCrLf
    Next kw

    ' 1c) TUY CHON tren form: chi ban ve lap / chi muc da chon / noi tiep (bo qua muc da co sheet)
    Dim topOn As Boolean, nOpt As Long, optLog As String, appendDoc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, exist As Object, k0 As Variant
    topOn = ASM_SHEET                                ' bo tick -> chi bo qua sheet cum tong dang mo
    If ASM_ONLY Then
        nOpt = nOpt + parts.Count
        parts.RemoveAll
        optLog = optLog & "Chi xuat ban ve lap: bo " & nOpt & " chi tiet" & vbCrLf
    End If
    If SEL_ONLY Then
        If PICK_ASM <> LCase(asmModel.GetPathName) Or PICK_ITEMS = "" Then
            MsgBox "Chua chon muc nao (Selected items only): bam Choose... tren form de chon.", vbExclamation, APP_NAME
            Exit Sub
        End If
        For Each k0 In parts.Keys
            If InStr(1, PICK_ITEMS, "|" & k0 & "|", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then parts.Remove k0: nOpt = nOpt + 1
        Next k0
        For Each k0 In asms.Keys
            If InStr(1, PICK_ITEMS, "|" & k0 & "|", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then asms.Remove k0: nOpt = nOpt + 1
        Next k0
        If InStr(1, PICK_ITEMS, "|" & LCase(asmModel.GetPathName) & "|", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then topOn = False
        optLog = optLog & "Chi muc da chon: con " & parts.Count & " chi tiet, " & asms.Count & " cum con" & _
                 IIf(topOn, " + cum tong", "") & vbCrLf
    End If
    If APPEND_LAST Then
        Set appendDoc = FindLastDrawing()
        If appendDoc Is Nothing Then
            MsgBox "Khong tim thay ban ve truoc de noi tiep." & vbCrLf & _
                   "Bo tick 'Append to last drawing' de tao file ban ve moi.", vbExclamation, APP_NAME
            Exit Sub
        End If
        Set exist = DrawingModelSet(appendDoc)
        Dim nDup As Long
        For Each k0 In parts.Keys
            If exist.Exists(k0) Then parts.Remove k0: nDup = nDup + 1: optLog = optLog & "  da co sheet: " & k0 & vbCrLf
        Next k0
        For Each k0 In asms.Keys
            If exist.Exists(k0) Then asms.Remove k0: nDup = nDup + 1: optLog = optLog & "  da co sheet: " & k0 & vbCrLf
        Next k0
        If topOn And exist.Exists(LCase(asmModel.GetPathName)) Then
            topOn = False: nDup = nDup + 1: optLog = optLog & "  da co sheet: " & LCase(asmModel.GetPathName) & vbCrLf
        End If
        optLog = "Noi tiep vao: " & appendDoc.GetTitle & " | bo qua " & nDup & " muc da co sheet" & vbCrLf & optLog
    End If
    If parts.Count = 0 And asms.Count = 0 And Not topOn Then
        MsgBox "Khong co muc nao can tao ban ve." & vbCrLf & IIf(optLog <> "", Replace(optLog, "  da co sheet: ", "  - "), ""), _
               vbExclamation, APP_NAME
        Exit Sub
    End If


    ' 2) Chay luon (khong hoi xac nhan); so luong bo qua ghi vao log
    Dim skipInfo As String
    skipInfo = "Bo qua: thu muc " & SKIP_FOLDERS & ": " & nFld & " | Pattern/Mirror: " & nPat & " | Toolbox: " & nTb & _
               " | Exclude BOM: " & nEx & " | part ao: " & nVirt & " | suppress: " & nSup & " | cum con bo qua: " & nAsmSkip & _
               IIf(optLog <> "", vbCrLf & optLog, "") & IIf(weldLog <> "", vbCrLf & "THU MUC HAN:" & vbCrLf & weldLog, "")

    ' 3) Lan luot tung part -> 1 sheet
    Dim errs As Long, warns As Long, res As String, summary As String, fullLog As String
    Dim nOk As Long, nErr As Long, idx As Long, t As Single, k As Variant, it As Variant, mNote As String, matLog As String
    Set swDrawModel = Nothing
    sheetCount = 0: sheetFrom = 0
    If Not appendDoc Is Nothing Then
        ' NOI TIEP: sheet moi them vao cuoi ban ve truoc; cac buoc xu ly cuoi chi lam tren sheet moi
        Set swDrawModel = appendDoc
        Set swDraw = appendDoc
        sheetCount = UBound(swDraw.GetSheetNames) + 1
        sheetFrom = sheetCount
        Set allDims = New Collection
        EnsureDrawingActive
    End If
    t = Timer
    ' 3a) Sheet DAU = BAN VE LAP CUM TONG (tuy chon tren form)
    Dim nAsmErr As Long, asmErr As String
    If topOn Then
        res = MakeAssemblySheet(asmModel, "")
        If Left(res, 3) = "LOI" Then nAsmErr = nAsmErr + 1: asmErr = Split(res, vbCrLf)(0)
        summary = summary & "0. " & mid(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\") + 1) & _
                  " (ban ve lap cum tong): " & Split(res, vbCrLf)(0) & vbCrLf
        fullLog = fullLog & String(70, "=") & vbCrLf & asmModel.GetPathName & " (BAN VE LAP CUM TONG)" & vbCrLf & res & vbCrLf
    End If

    ' 3b) Chi tiet & cum con theo THU TU CAY FeatureManager
    Dim ord() As Variant, nOrd As Long, j As Long, j2 As Long, tmpIt As Variant
    ReDim ord(1 To parts.Count + asms.Count + 1)
    For Each k In parts.Keys
        nOrd = nOrd + 1: ord(nOrd) = parts.Item(k)
    Next k
    For Each k In asms.Keys
        nOrd = nOrd + 1: ord(nOrd) = asms.Item(k)
    Next k
    For j = 2 To nOrd                                         ' sap xep theo vi tri trong cay (on dinh)
        tmpIt = ord(j)
        j2 = j - 1
        Do While j2 >= 1
            If ord(j2)(3) <= tmpIt(3) Then Exit Do
            ord(j2 + 1) = ord(j2)
            j2 = j2 - 1
        Loop
        ord(j2 + 1) = tmpIt
    Next j

    For j = 1 To nOrd
        it = ord(j)
        idx = idx + 1
        Set pm = Nothing
        If IsObject(it(2)) Then Set pm = it(2)
        If it(4) = "A" Or it(4) = "W" Then
            ' ---- CUM CON: sheet ban ve lap ("A") / cum con han ve nhu 1 part ("W", TH2) ----
            If pm Is Nothing Then
                Set pm = swApp.OpenDoc6(it(0), swDocASSEMBLY, swOpenDocOptions_Silent, CStr(it(1)), errs, warns)
            End If
            If pm Is Nothing Then
                res = "LOI: khong mo duoc cum con (ma " & errs & ")"
            Else
                If it(4) = "W" Then
                    res = MakeWeldAsmSheet(pm, CStr(it(1)))
                Else
                    res = MakeAssemblySheet(pm, CStr(it(1)))
                End If
                ' ghi chu han: cum han -> "BV HAN TONG"; cum con trong cum han -> "BV HAN CON" (o Auto Note)
                If Left(res, 3) <> "LOI" And AUTO_NOTE And weldSet.Exists(LCase(it(0))) Then
                    If AddWeldNote(WeldText(weldSet.Item(LCase(it(0)))), WELD_NOTE_Y) Then _
                        res = res & " | ghi chu: " & WeldTag(weldSet.Item(LCase(it(0))))
                End If
            End If
            If Left(res, 3) = "LOI" Then nAsmErr = nAsmErr + 1: asmErr = Split(res, vbCrLf)(0)
            summary = summary & idx & ". " & mid(it(0), InStrRev(it(0), "\") + 1) & _
                      IIf(it(4) = "W", " (cum con han - ve nhu part): ", " (ban ve lap cum con): ") & _
                      Split(res, vbCrLf)(0) & vbCrLf
            fullLog = fullLog & String(70, "=") & vbCrLf & it(0) & IIf(it(4) = "W", " (CUM CON HAN - VE NHU PART)", " (BAN VE LAP CUM CON)") & _
                      vbCrLf & res & vbCrLf & IIf(it(4) = "W", dimLog & vbCrLf, "")
        Else
            ' ---- CHI TIET: sheet ban ve gia cong ----
            If pm Is Nothing Then        ' model chua nap -> mo an
                Set pm = swApp.OpenDoc6(it(0), swDocPART, swOpenDocOptions_Silent, CStr(it(1)), errs, warns)
            End If
            If pm Is Nothing Then
                res = "LOI: khong mo duoc part (ma " & errs & ")"
            Else
                If CStr(it(1)) <> "" Then pm.ShowConfiguration2 CStr(it(1))
                res = MakePartDrawing(pm)
                ' Auto Note: part truc tiep trong BVHAN -> "BV HAN TONG"; part trong cum han -> "BV HAN CON";
                '            part khac -> ghi chu theo vat lieu (thuoc tinh MATERIAL)
                If Left(res, 3) <> "LOI" And AUTO_NOTE Then
                    If weldSet.Exists(LCase(it(0))) Then
                        If AddWeldNote(WeldText(weldSet.Item(LCase(it(0)))), WELD_NOTE_Y) Then _
                            res = res & " | ghi chu: " & WeldTag(weldSet.Item(LCase(it(0))))
                    Else
                        mNote = AddMaterialNote(pm, CStr(it(1)))
                        res = res & " | " & mNote
                        If InStr(mNote, "khong ghi") > 0 Then matLog = matLog & "  " & mid(it(0), InStrRev(it(0), "\") + 1) & ": " & mNote & vbCrLf
                    End If
                End If
            End If
            If Left(res, 3) = "LOI" Then nErr = nErr + 1 Else nOk = nOk + 1
            summary = summary & idx & ". " & mid(it(0), InStrRev(it(0), "\") + 1) & ": " & Split(res, vbCrLf)(0) & vbCrLf
            fullLog = fullLog & String(70, "=") & vbCrLf & it(0) & vbCrLf & res & vbCrLf & dimLog & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next j

    If matLog <> "" Then summary = summary & vbCrLf & "CHI TIET CHUA GHI NOTE VAT LIEU (MATERIAL trong / chua thuoc nhom):" & vbCrLf & matLog
    ' 4) Doi ten sheet 1, 2, 3... ; de ban ve mo (chua luu). Noi tiep: chi xu ly cac sheet moi
    Dim aErr As Long, nNewSh As Long
    nNewSh = sheetCount - sheetFrom
    If Not swDrawModel Is Nothing Then
        summary = summary & FinishNewSheets()
        RememberDrawing swDrawModel                  ' nho ban ve nay cho lan "Append to last drawing" sau
    End If
    sheetFrom = 0

    ' Log tong canh assembly
    Dim logPath As String, ts As Object
    logPath = Left(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\")) & "BatchDrawingLog.txt"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ts = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").CreateTextFile(logPath, True)
    ts.Write "TAO BAN VE TU ASSEMBLY: " & asmModel.GetPathName & vbCrLf & Now & vbCrLf & skipInfo & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
             summary & vbCrLf & fullLog
    ts.Close
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' Chi bao DA CHAY XONG (chi tiet xem file log)
    MsgBox "Da chay xong: " & nNewSh & " sheet" & IIf(Not appendDoc Is Nothing, " (noi tiep vao " & swDrawModel.GetTitle & ")", "") & _
           "." & IIf(nErr > 0, vbCrLf & "Co " & nErr & " part loi (xem log).", "") & _
           IIf(nAsmErr > 0, vbCrLf & "Co " & nAsmErr & " sheet lap loi: " & asmErr, ""), vbInformation, APP_NAME
End Sub

'===========================================================================
'  DANH SACH MUC XUAT BAN VE (dung chung: Auto Drawing & cua so Choose...)
'  parts / asms : duong dan (chu thuong) -> Array(path, cfg, ModelDoc2, treeKey, "P" / "A")
'  weldSet / weldAsmSet : file thuoc thu muc han (BVHAN) / cum nam truc tiep trong thu muc han
'  cnt  : so ban lap bo qua theo ly do: "fld" thu muc, "pat" Pattern/Mirror, "tb" Toolbox, "ex" Exclude BOM,
'         "virt" part ao, "sup" suppress, "asm" cum con bo qua
'  info (tuy chon): "Q|path" -> so ban lap (khong suppress), "L|path" -> cap trong cay (0 = ngay duoi cum tong)
'  withAsm = False: khong lay cum con (tat ban ve lap)
'===========================================================================
Public Function CollectDrawItems(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal withAsm As Boolean, parts As Object, asms As Object, _
                                 weldSet As Object, weldAsmSet As Object, cnt As Object, Optional info As Object = Nothing) As Boolean
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long, comp As SldWorks.Component2, p As String
    Dim pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, skipSet As Object, patSet As Object, skipPaths As Object, doneAsm As Object
    Dim weldTop As Object, tk As String, lv As Long, lp As String, k As Variant
    Dim wk As String, isW As Boolean, skipIn As Boolean, wCache As Object, tmpA As Variant
    For Each k In Array("fld", "pat", "tb", "ex", "virt", "sup", "asm")
        cnt(k) = 0
    Next k
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    swAsm.ResolveAllLightWeightComponents False
    Set subSkipCache = Nothing
    Set patCache = Nothing
    Set skipSet = GetFolderComponents(asmModel)     ' component nam trong thu muc TBTC/TBC/TBD...
    Set patSet = GetPatternComponents(asmModel)     ' component sinh ra boi LocalLPattern / Mirror... cua cum tong
    comps = swAsm.GetComponents(False)
    If IsEmpty(comps) Then Exit Function
    CollectDrawItems = True

    ' FILE can bo qua: co it nhat 1 ban lap nam trong thu muc TBTC/TBC/TBD
    ' -> moi ban lap khac cua file do (Pattern, Mirror, copy) cung bo qua
    Set skipPaths = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        If InSkipFolder(comp, skipSet) Then AddCompPaths comp, skipPaths
    Next i
    ' Pattern / Mirror co chi tiet goc (seed) bi bo qua -> moi chi tiet sinh ra cung bo qua
    AddPatternSkips asmModel, skipPaths
    Set doneAsm = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        Set pm = comp.GetModelDoc2
        If Not pm Is Nothing Then
            If pm.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY And Not doneAsm.Exists(LCase(pm.GetPathName)) Then
                doneAsm.Add LCase(pm.GetPathName), 1
                AddPatternSkips pm, skipPaths                ' Pattern / Mirror ben trong cum con
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' Moi chi tiet / cum con: vi tri trong cay FeatureManager (tren -> xuoi, cum con -> cac chi tiet ben trong)
    Set treeCache = Nothing
    ResetWeldCache
    Set weldTop = GetFolderComponents(asmModel, WELD_FOLDERS)
    Set wCache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        If IsCompSuppressed(comp) Then
            cnt("sup") = cnt("sup") + 1                     ' chi tiet / cum con dang SUPPRESS -> khong xuat
        Else
            p = comp.GetPathName: lp = LCase(p)
            ' THU MUC HAN (BVHAN): TH1 / TH2 -> loai ghi chu ("T" / "C"); chi tiet ben trong cum con han -> khong xuat
            wk = WeldRole(comp, weldTop, wCache, isW, skipIn)
            If skipIn Then GoTo nextCompCD
            If wk <> "" Then
                If wk = "T" Or Not weldSet.Exists(lp) Then weldSet(lp) = wk     ' TONG uu tien hon CON
            End If
            If isW Then weldAsmSet(lp) = 1                  ' cum con trong cum han -> ve nhu 1 part
            If Not info Is Nothing Then
                info("Q|" & lp) = info("Q|" & lp) + 1
                lv = Len(comp.Name2) - Len(Replace(comp.Name2, "/", ""))
                If Not info.Exists("L|" & lp) Then
                    info("L|" & lp) = lv
                ElseIf lv < info("L|" & lp) Then
                    info("L|" & lp) = lv
                End If
            End If
            tk = TreeKey(comp, asmModel)
            If LCase(Right(p, 7)) = ".sldprt" And parts.Exists(lp) Then
                KeepFirstKey parts, lp, tk                    ' ban lap khac cua cung file: giu vi tri dau tien
            ElseIf LCase(Right(p, 7)) = ".sldasm" Then
                ' CUM CON -> sheet ban ve lap rieng (bo qua giong chi tiet: thu muc, Pattern/Mirror, ao, Exclude BOM)
                ' cum co vai tro han (BVHAN: cum han / cum con han) LUON xuat, ke ca khi file bi bo qua o cho khac
                If Not withAsm Then
                ElseIf asms.Exists(lp) Then
                    KeepFirstKey asms, lp, tk
                ElseIf InStr(p, "^") > 0 Then
                    cnt("asm") = cnt("asm") + 1
                ElseIf wk = "" And (skipPaths.Exists(lp) Or InPatternInstance(comp, patSet)) Then
                    cnt("asm") = cnt("asm") + 1
                ElseIf wk = "" And SKIP_EXCLUDED_BOM And comp.ExcludeFromBOM Then
                    cnt("asm") = cnt("asm") + 1
                Else
                    asms.Add lp, Array(p, comp.ReferencedConfiguration, comp.GetModelDoc2, tk, "A")
                End If
            ElseIf LCase(Right(p, 7)) = ".sldprt" Then
                ' part co vai tro han (BVHAN: "BV HAN TONG" / "BV HAN CON") LUON xuat ban ve, ke ca khi cung file
                ' con nam trong thiet bi TBTC/TBC/TBD, Pattern/Mirror hay Exclude from BOM o cho khac
                If InStr(p, "^") > 0 Then
                    cnt("virt") = cnt("virt") + 1             ' part ao (luu trong assembly) -> bo qua
                ElseIf wk = "" And skipPaths.Exists(lp) Then
                    cnt("fld") = cnt("fld") + 1               ' thuoc TBTC/TBC/TBD (ke ca Pattern/Mirror cua chung)
                ElseIf wk = "" And InPatternInstance(comp, patSet) Then
                    cnt("pat") = cnt("pat") + 1               ' ban sinh ra boi Pattern / Mirror (ban goc van xuat neu co)
                ElseIf wk = "" And SKIP_EXCLUDED_BOM And comp.ExcludeFromBOM Then
                    cnt("ex") = cnt("ex") + 1
                Else
                    Set pm = comp.GetModelDoc2
                    If wk = "" And SKIP_TOOLBOX And IsToolboxPart(pm) Then
                        cnt("tb") = cnt("tb") + 1
                    Else
                        parts.Add lp, Array(p, comp.ReferencedConfiguration, pm, tk, "P")
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
nextCompCD:
    Next i
    ' cum con ben trong cum han (TH2) -> loai "W": ve nhu 1 part (kich thuoc day du, khong BOM / balloon)
    For Each k In asms.Keys
        If weldAsmSet.Exists(k) Then
            tmpA = asms.Item(k): tmpA(4) = "W": asms.Item(k) = tmpA
        End If
    Next k
End Function

' Vai tro han cua 1 ban lap (thu muc BVHAN o moi cap):
'  "T" = BV HAN TONG: part / cum nam TRUC TIEP trong thu muc han
'  "C" = BV HAN CON : part hoac cum con nam NGAY BEN TRONG 1 cum han (cum nam truc tiep trong thu muc han)
'  isW    = True: cum con ngay ben trong cum han (TH2) -> ve nhu 1 part
'  skipIn = True: nam BEN TRONG 1 cum con han (TH2) -> khong xuat sheet
Private Function WeldRole(ByVal comp As Object, weldTop As Object, cache As Object, isW As Boolean, skipIn As Boolean) As String
    Dim par As Object, a As Object, pp As Object, g As Long
    isW = False: skipIn = False
    If InWeldFolder(comp, weldTop, True) Then WeldRole = "T": Exit Function
    Set par = comp.GetParent
    If par Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If IsWeldAsm(par, weldTop, cache) Then
        WeldRole = "C"
        isW = (LCase(Right(comp.GetPathName, 7)) = ".sldasm")
        Exit Function
    End If
    ' to tien (cum con) co cha la cum han -> ban lap nay nam ben trong 1 cum con han
    Set a = par
    Do While Not a Is Nothing And g < 50
        g = g + 1
        Set pp = a.GetParent
        If pp Is Nothing Then Exit Do
        If IsWeldAsm(pp, weldTop, cache) Then skipIn = True: Exit Function
        Set a = pp
    Loop
End Function

' Cum han = file .SLDASM nam TRUC TIEP trong thu muc han (o cap cua no)
Private Function IsWeldAsm(ByVal c As Object, weldTop As Object, cache As Object) As Boolean
    Dim k As String
    k = UCase(c.Name2)
    If cache.Exists(k) Then IsWeldAsm = cache.Item(k): Exit Function
    If LCase(Right(c.GetPathName, 7)) = ".sldasm" Then IsWeldAsm = InWeldFolder(c, weldTop, True)
    cache.Item(k) = IsWeldAsm
End Function

' Danh sach cho cua so Choose...: Collection cac Array(duong dan chu thuong, ten, loai "T"/"A"/"P", so luong, cap)
' (cum tong dau tien, roi cac cum con / chi tiet theo thu tu cay FeatureManager)
Public Function DrawItemList(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As Collection
    Dim parts As Object, asms As Object, ws As Object, wa As Object, cnt As Object, info As Object
    Dim col As New Collection, ord() As Variant, n As Long, k As Variant, j As Long, j2 As Long, tmp As Variant, lp As String
    Set DrawItemList = col
    If asmModel Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    Set parts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set asms = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set ws = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set wa = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cnt = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set info = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If Not CollectDrawItems(asmModel, True, parts, asms, ws, wa, cnt, info) Then Exit Function
    col.Add Array(LCase(asmModel.GetPathName), FileBaseName(asmModel.GetPathName), "T", 1, -1)
    If parts.Count + asms.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    ReDim ord(1 To parts.Count + asms.Count)
    For Each k In parts.Keys
        n = n + 1: ord(n) = parts.Item(k)
    Next k
    For Each k In asms.Keys
        n = n + 1: ord(n) = asms.Item(k)
    Next k
    For j = 2 To n                                      ' sap xep theo vi tri trong cay (on dinh)
        tmp = ord(j): j2 = j - 1
        Do While j2 >= 1
            If ord(j2)(3) <= tmp(3) Then Exit Do
            ord(j2 + 1) = ord(j2): j2 = j2 - 1
        Loop
        ord(j2 + 1) = tmp
    Next j
    For j = 1 To n
        lp = LCase(ord(j)(0))
        col.Add Array(lp, FileBaseName(ord(j)(0)), ord(j)(4), info("Q|" & lp), info("L|" & lp))
    Next j
End Function

' Duong dan (chu thuong) cac component dang CHON trong SolidWorks (Ctrl+click tren cay / man hinh)
Public Function SelectedCompPaths(doc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As Object
    Dim d As Object, sm As Object, n As Long, i As Long, c As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set SelectedCompPaths = d
    If doc Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sm = doc.SelectionManager
    n = sm.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    For i = 1 To n
        Set c = Nothing
        Set c = sm.GetSelectedObjectsComponent4(i, -1)
        If Not c Is Nothing Then
            If c.GetPathName <> "" Then d(LCase(c.GetPathName)) = 1
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  NOI TIEP VAO BAN VE MACRO TAO GAN NHAT ("Append to last drawing")
'  - Moi ban ve macro tao duoc gan ma AD_ID (custom property cua file ban ve) + luu ma & duong dan vao Registry
'  - Tim: ban ve dang mo co AD_ID trung -> file da luu (duong dan nho) -> hoi chon file .SLDDRW
'===========================================================================
Private Function DrawingAdId(ByVal d As Object) As String
    Dim cpm As SldWorks.CustomPropertyManager, v As String, rv As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cpm = d.Extension.CustomPropertyManager("")
    If Not cpm Is Nothing Then cpm.Get4 "AD_ID", False, v, rv
    DrawingAdId = Trim(v)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Gan ma AD_ID (neu chua co) cho ban ve vua tao / vua noi tiep va nho lai trong Registry
Public Sub RememberDrawing(d As SldWorks.ModelDoc2)
    Dim id As String, cpm As SldWorks.CustomPropertyManager
    If d Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    id = DrawingAdId(d)
    If id = "" Then
        Randomize
        id = Format(Now, "yyyymmddhhnnss") & CStr(Int(Rnd * 1000))
        On Error Resume Next
        Set cpm = d.Extension.CustomPropertyManager("")
        cpm.Add3 "AD_ID", 30, id, 2                    ' 30 = Text, 2 = ghi de
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    SaveSetting CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_ID", id
    SaveSetting CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_PATH", d.GetPathName
End Sub

' Ban ve gan nhat dang mo va da duoc luu -> cap nhat duong dan (de lan sau mo lai duoc khi da dong)
Public Sub RefreshLastDrawingPath()
    Dim id As String, d As Object, nx As Object, g As Long
    id = GetSetting(CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_ID", "")
    If id = "" Or swApp Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = swApp.GetFirstDocument
    Do While Not d Is Nothing And g < 2000
        g = g + 1
        If d.GetType = swDocDRAWING Then
            If DrawingAdId(d) = id And d.GetPathName <> "" Then
                SaveSetting CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_PATH", d.GetPathName
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = d.GetNext
        Set d = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Public Function FindLastDrawing() As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
    Dim id As String, pth As String, d As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, e As Long, w As Long
    Dim f As String, oOpt As Long, oCfg As String, oDisp As String
    id = GetSetting(CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_ID", "")
    pth = GetSetting(CAIDAT_APP, "CaiDat", "LAST_DRAW_PATH", "")
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 1) dang mo (ke ca chua luu)
    If id <> "" Then
        Set d = swApp.GetFirstDocument
        Do While Not d Is Nothing And g < 2000
            g = g + 1
            If d.GetType = swDocDRAWING Then
                If DrawingAdId(d) = id Then Set FindLastDrawing = d: Exit Function
            End If
            Set nx = Nothing
            Set nx = d.GetNext
            Set d = nx
        Loop
    End If
    ' 2) da dong: mo lai file da luu
    If pth <> "" Then
        If Dir(pth) <> "" Then
            Set d = Nothing
            Set d = swApp.OpenDoc6(pth, swDocDRAWING, swOpenDocOptions_Silent, "", e, w)
            If Not d Is Nothing Then Set FindLastDrawing = d: Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    ' 3) khong tim thay -> hoi chon file ban ve
    f = swApp.GetOpenFileName("Chon ban ve can noi tiep (Append to last drawing)", "", _
                              "SOLIDWORKS Drawing (*.slddrw)|*.slddrw|", oOpt, oCfg, oDisp)
    If f <> "" Then
        Set d = Nothing
        Set d = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(f)
        If d Is Nothing Then Set d = swApp.OpenDoc6(f, swDocDRAWING, swOpenDocOptions_Silent, "", e, w)
        If Not d Is Nothing Then Set FindLastDrawing = d
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Tap file model (chu thuong) da co hinh chieu trong ban ve -> bo qua khi noi tiep
Public Function DrawingModelSet(dm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As Object
    Dim d As Object, dd As SldWorks.DrawingDoc, names As Variant, i As Long, sh As SldWorks.Sheet, vws As Variant
    Dim j As Long, p As String
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set DrawingModelSet = d
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dd = dm
    names = dd.GetSheetNames
    If IsEmpty(names) Then Exit Function
    For i = 0 To UBound(names)
        Set sh = Nothing
        Set sh = dd.Sheet(names(i))
        vws = Empty
        vws = sh.GetViews
        If IsArray(vws) Then
            For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
                p = ""
                p = LCase(vws(j).GetReferencedModelName)
                If p <> "" Then d(p) = 1
            Next j
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Che do PART + "Append to last drawing": them 1 sheet vao ban ve gan nhat (bo qua neu chi tiet da co sheet)
Private Function AppendPartDrawing(partModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As String
    Dim tgt As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, exist As Object, r As String
    Set tgt = FindLastDrawing()
    If tgt Is Nothing Then
        AppendPartDrawing = "LOI: khong tim thay ban ve truoc de noi tiep." & vbCrLf & _
                            "Bo tick 'Append to last drawing' de tao file ban ve moi.": Exit Function
    End If
    Set exist = DrawingModelSet(tgt)
    If exist.Exists(LCase(partModel.GetPathName)) Then
        AppendPartDrawing = "LOI: chi tiet nay da co sheet trong ban ve " & tgt.GetTitle & " -> khong xuat lai.": Exit Function
    End If
    Set swDrawModel = tgt
    Set swDraw = tgt
    sheetCount = UBound(swDraw.GetSheetNames) + 1
    sheetFrom = sheetCount
    Set allDims = New Collection
    EnsureDrawingActive
    batchMode = True                                  ' them sheet vao ban ve co san (khong tao file moi)
    r = MakePartDrawing(partModel)
    batchMode = False
    If Left(r, 3) <> "LOI" Then r = r & vbCrLf & FinishNewSheets()
    sheetFrom = 0
    AppendPartDrawing = r
End Function

' Buoc cuoi tren cac sheet MOI (tu sheetFrom): xoa view trong, doi ten 1, 2, 3..., don & sap xep kich thuoc
Private Function FinishNewSheets() As String
    Dim s As String
    EnsureDrawingActive
    If DELETE_EMPTY_VIEWS Then DeleteEmptyViews
    RenameSheetsSequential
    ' Di lan luot tung sheet: xoa kich thuoc thua, go chong cheo
    If CLEANUP_DIMS Then s = s & vbCrLf & CleanupAllSheets()
    ' Mac dinh: sap xep kich thuoc tung sheet (he nho sat hinh, lon xa dan, dua ra ngoai hinh)
    If AUTO_ARRANGE Then s = s & vbCrLf & SapXepTatCaSheet()
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    swDrawModel.ViewZoomtofit2
    FinishNewSheets = s
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  DOI TEN FILE PART / ASSEMBLY TRONG CUM DANG MO (nut "Rename parts..." -> cua so Rename)
'  - Thu tu tu tren xuong theo cay FeatureManager; moi FILE 1 ten (lan xuat hien dau tien)
'  - Ten moi: TienTo-STT (cap ngay duoi cum tong); trong cum con: TenMoiCumCon-STT, noi tiep moi cap (CDX-5-2-1)
'  - STT: 1, 2, 3... hoac A, B, C... (qua Z -> AA, AB...); bo qua ten da dung / file da co trong thu muc
'  - Khong doi ten: folder trong danh sach skip (va moi chi tiet ben trong), suppress, Toolbox, part ao;
'    file co ten bat dau "TienTo-" -> giu nguyen (coi nhu da doi ten; ten do khong cap lai)
'  - Doi ten bang RenameDocument cua SolidWorks: cum & ban ve DANG MO tu cap nhat; file doi ten khi Save All
'  - Chi tiet DOI XUNG (Mirror Components, opposite hand): ten = "Mirror" + ten moi cua chi tiet goc
'    (kieu SolidWorks), khong lay so thu tu; doi ten truc tiep loi -> sua feature Mirror Components
'  - Chon muc (o tick cua so Rename): excl = file (chu thuong) KHONG doi ten -> giu ten, khong chiem so thu tu
'    (danh so lien tuc cho muc duoc chon); chi tiet ben trong cum khong chon lay TEN HIEN TAI cua cum lam goc
'  - reuse = True: dung lai cay cum da doc (tick / bo tick, doi Prefix) -> nhanh
'  - SUA TEN THIET BI (REN_TXT_ON): part & cum trong folder REN_TXT_FLD (moi cap, ke ca moi thu ben trong cum thiet bi)
'    -> thay REN_RPL_FIND bang REN_RPL_WITH (moi cho, khong phan biet hoa thuong; "" = xoa, vd xoa "C1-"),
'       roi ten = REN_TXT_PRE + ten + REN_TXT_SUF (khong danh so); bo qua Toolbox, part ao, file NGOAI thu muc du an
'    (file thu vien dung chung); ten da co chu them -> giu nguyen
'  Phan tu ke hoach: Array(duong dan, ten cu, ten moi, "P"/"A"/"M", cap, ghi chu, co doi ten?, component,
'                          assembly chua feature mirror, ten feature mirror)
'===========================================================================
Public Function BuildRenamePlan(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal prefix As String, ByVal useLetters As Boolean, _
                                ByVal skipFolders As String, Optional excl As Object = Nothing, _
                                Optional ByVal reuse As Boolean = False) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, rc As Variant, pre As String, key As String, k As Variant
    Dim done As Object, newOf As Object, ctx As Object, used As Object, origB As Object, mirList As New Collection
    Dim lp As String, base As String, parKey As String, parBase As String, cnt As Long, cand As String, note As String
    Dim newB As String, doIt As Boolean, seedP As String, seedNew As String, tOn As Boolean
    Set BuildRenamePlan = col
    prefix = Trim(prefix)
    If asmModel Is Nothing Or prefix = "" Then Exit Function
    pre = UCase(prefix) & "-"
    If excl Is Nothing Then Set excl = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    key = LCase(asmModel.GetPathName) & "|" & UCase(Trim(skipFolders)) & "|" & UCase(Trim(REN_TXT_FLD))
    If Not (reuse And renCacheKey = key And Not renRecs Is Nothing) Then
        renCacheKey = ""
        If Not RenameReadTree(asmModel, skipFolders, REN_TXT_FLD) Then Exit Function
        renCacheKey = key
    End If
    ' ten moi khong trung voi BAT KY file nao dang co trong cum
    Set used = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each k In renAllNames.Keys
        used(k) = 1
    Next k
    Set done = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")     ' file da xu ly -> ten moi (rong = khong doi)
    Set newOf = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")    ' ban lap (Name2) -> ten goc cho chi tiet ben trong
    Set ctx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")      ' cha (Name2, "" = cum tong) -> STT da cap
    Set origB = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")    ' file (chu thuong) -> ten goc (giu hoa thuong)
    tOn = REN_TXT_ON And (REN_TXT_PRE <> "" Or REN_TXT_SUF <> "" Or REN_RPL_FIND <> "")
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each rc In renRecs
        ' rc = Array(comp, duong dan, chu thuong, Name2, cha, ten, duoi, thu muc, P/A, cap, ly do bo qua,
        '            mirror: goc, cum, feature, trong folder THEM CHU?, ly do khong them chu)
        lp = rc(2): parKey = rc(4): base = rc(5)
        ' ---- THEM CHU: muc trong folder thiet bi duoc tick (moi cap, ca ben trong cum thiet bi) ----
        If tOn And rc(14) Then
            If done.Exists(lp) Then GoTo nextRc
            origB(lp) = base
            note = "": newB = base: doIt = False
            If rc(15) <> "" Then
                note = rc(15)
            Else
                ' thay / xoa chu (moi cho trong ten, khong phan biet hoa thuong) roi them chu dau / cuoi
                If REN_RPL_FIND <> "" Then newB = Trim(Replace(newB, REN_RPL_FIND, REN_RPL_WITH, 1, -1, vbTextCompare))
                If REN_TXT_PRE <> "" Then
                    If UCase(Left(newB, Len(REN_TXT_PRE))) <> UCase(REN_TXT_PRE) Then newB = REN_TXT_PRE & newB
                End If
                If REN_TXT_SUF <> "" Then
                    If UCase(Right(newB, Len(REN_TXT_SUF))) <> UCase(REN_TXT_SUF) Then newB = newB & REN_TXT_SUF
                End If
                If newB = "" Then
                    note = "ten moi rong - bo qua": newB = base
                ElseIf newB = base Then
                    note = "da dung ten - bo qua"
                ElseIf excl.Exists(lp) Then
                    note = "not selected": newB = base
                ElseIf UCase(newB) <> UCase(base) And (used.Exists(UCase(newB)) Or Dir(rc(7) & newB & rc(6)) <> "") Then
                    note = "trung ten file " & newB: newB = base
                Else
                    note = "TB folder - doi ten": doIt = True
                    used(UCase(newB)) = 1
                End If
            End If
            done(lp) = newB
            newOf(rc(3)) = newB
            col.Add Array(rc(1), base, IIf(doIt, newB, ""), rc(8), rc(9), note, doIt, rc(0), "", "")
            GoTo nextRc
        End If
        If parKey = "" Then
            parBase = prefix
        Else
            parBase = ""
            If newOf.Exists(parKey) Then parBase = newOf.Item(parKey)
            If parBase = "" Then GoTo nextRc             ' ben trong cum khong doi ten (thiet bi, cum bo qua...)
        End If
        If done.Exists(lp) Then                          ' ban lap khac cua file da xu ly
            If done.Item(lp) <> "" Then newOf(rc(3)) = done.Item(lp)
            GoTo nextRc
        End If
        origB(lp) = base
        ' chi tiet doi xung: dat ten sau cung (can ten moi cua chi tiet goc), khong lay so thu tu
        If rc(11) <> "" Then
            done(lp) = ""
            mirList.Add rc
            GoTo nextRc
        End If
        note = "": newB = "": doIt = False
        If rc(10) <> "" Then
            note = rc(10)
        ElseIf UCase(Left(base, Len(pre))) = pre Then
            note = "da doi ten - bo qua": newB = base
        ElseIf parKey <> "" And UCase(Left(base, Len(parBase) + 1)) = UCase(parBase) & "-" Then
            note = "da doi ten - bo qua": newB = base     ' da mang ten theo cum (vd TenCum-1)
        ElseIf excl.Exists(lp) Then
            note = "not selected": newB = base            ' giu ten; chi tiet ben trong lay ten nay lam goc
        Else
            cnt = ctx.Item(parKey)
            Do
                cnt = cnt + 1
                cand = parBase & "-" & RenTok(cnt, useLetters)
            Loop While used.Exists(UCase(cand)) Or Dir(rc(7) & cand & rc(6)) <> ""
            ctx.Item(parKey) = cnt
            used(UCase(cand)) = 1
            newB = cand: doIt = True
        End If
        If newB <> "" Then newOf(rc(3)) = newB
        done(lp) = newB
        col.Add Array(rc(1), base, IIf(doIt, newB, ""), rc(8), rc(9), note, doIt, rc(0), "", "")
nextRc:
    Next rc
    ' ---- chi tiet DOI XUNG: "Mirror" + ten moi cua chi tiet goc ----
    For Each rc In mirList
        lp = rc(2): base = rc(5)
        seedP = rc(11): seedNew = ""
        If done.Exists(seedP) Then seedNew = done.Item(seedP)
        If seedNew = "" And origB.Exists(seedP) Then seedNew = origB.Item(seedP)
        If seedNew = "" Then seedNew = FileBaseName(seedP)
        newB = "Mirror" & seedNew
        doIt = False
        If excl.Exists(lp) Then
            note = "mirror - not selected"
        ElseIf UCase(base) = UCase(newB) Then
            note = "mirror - dung ten roi"
        ElseIf used.Exists(UCase(newB)) Or Dir(rc(7) & newB & rc(6)) <> "" Then
            note = "mirror - trung ten file " & newB
        Else
            note = "mirror cua " & seedNew: doIt = True
            used(UCase(newB)) = 1
        End If
        col.Add Array(rc(1), base, IIf(doIt, newB, ""), "M", rc(9), note, doIt, rc(0), rc(12), rc(13))
    Next rc
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Cua so Rename: doc cay cum 1 LAN (thu tu FeatureManager, folder bo qua, Toolbox, file doi xung) -> renRecs / renAllNames
Private Function RenameReadTree(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal skipFolders As String, _
                                ByVal txtFolders As String) As Boolean
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, n As Long
    Dim inSkip() As Boolean, inTxt() As Boolean, txtSet As Object, isTb As Boolean, tNote As String, projDir As String
    Dim tks() As String, ord() As Long, tmpS As String, tmpl As Long, comp As Object, par As Object
    Dim p As String, lp As String, typ As String, sNote As String, parKey As String, nm2 As String
    Dim oldSkip As String, skipSet As Object, mirMap As Object, doneDoc As Object, pm As Object, tbx As Object
    Dim mSeed As String, mDoc As String, mFeat As String, b As String
    Set renRecs = New Collection
    Set renAllNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    swAsm.ResolveAllLightWeightComponents False
    comps = swAsm.GetComponents(False)
    If IsEmpty(comps) Then Exit Function
    n = UBound(comps) + 1

    ' thu tu cay FeatureManager (tren -> xuong, cum con -> cac chi tiet ben trong)
    Set treeCache = Nothing
    ReDim tks(1 To n): ReDim ord(1 To n)
    For i = 1 To n
        tks(i) = TreeKey(comps(i - 1), asmModel): ord(i) = i - 1
    Next i
    For i = 2 To n
        tmpS = tks(i): tmpl = ord(i): j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 1
            If tks(j) <= tmpS Then Exit Do
            tks(j + 1) = tks(j): ord(j + 1) = ord(j): j = j - 1
        Loop
        tks(j + 1) = tmpS: ord(j + 1) = tmpl
    Next i

    ' folder KHONG doi ten (o Skip folders) va folder THEM CHU (o tick TBTC / TBC / TBD): moi cap, ke ca ben trong cum
    ReDim inSkip(1 To n): ReDim inTxt(1 To n)
    oldSkip = SKIP_FOLDERS
    SKIP_FOLDERS = Trim(skipFolders)
    Set subSkipCache = Nothing
    Set skipSet = GetFolderComponents(asmModel)
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = 1 To n
        inSkip(i) = InSkipFolder(comps(ord(i)), skipSet)
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Trim(txtFolders) <> "" Then
        SKIP_FOLDERS = Trim(txtFolders)
        Set subSkipCache = Nothing
        Set txtSet = GetFolderComponents(asmModel)
        On Error Resume Next
        For i = 1 To n
            inTxt(i) = InSkipFolder(comps(ord(i)), txtSet)
        Next i
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    SKIP_FOLDERS = oldSkip
    Set subSkipCache = Nothing
    ' thu muc du an = thu muc cum tong (ca thu muc con): file ngoai = thu vien dung chung -> khong them chu
    projDir = LCase(Left(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\")))

    ' file DOI XUNG do feature Mirror Components tao ra (trong cum tong + moi cum con); ten moi file trong cum
    Set mirMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set doneDoc = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    CollectMirrorFiles asmModel, mirMap
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        Set pm = Nothing
        b = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        b = UCase(FileBaseName(comps(i).GetPathName))
        Set pm = comps(i).GetModelDoc2
        On Error GoTo 0
        If b <> "" Then renAllNames(b) = 1
        If Not pm Is Nothing Then
            If pm.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                If Not doneDoc.Exists(LCase(pm.GetPathName)) Then
                    doneDoc.Add LCase(pm.GetPathName), 1
                    CollectMirrorFiles pm, mirMap
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    Set tbx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")      ' file -> la Toolbox? (doc 1 lan moi file)
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = 1 To n
        Set comp = comps(ord(i))
        p = "": p = comp.GetPathName: lp = LCase(p)
        If p = "" Then GoTo nextRd
        If IsCompSuppressed(comp) Then GoTo nextRd
        Set par = Nothing: Set par = comp.GetParent
        parKey = ""
        If Not par Is Nothing Then parKey = UCase(par.Name2)
        nm2 = comp.Name2
        typ = IIf(LCase(Right(p, 7)) = ".sldasm", "A", "P")
        isTb = False
        If typ = "P" And InStr(p, "^") = 0 Then
            If Not tbx.Exists(lp) Then tbx(lp) = IsToolboxPart(comp.GetModelDoc2)
            isTb = tbx.Item(lp)
        End If
        sNote = "": mSeed = "": mDoc = "": mFeat = ""
        If inSkip(i) Then
            sNote = "folder bo qua"
        ElseIf mirMap.Exists(lp) Then
            mSeed = mirMap.Item(lp)(0): mDoc = mirMap.Item(lp)(1): mFeat = mirMap.Item(lp)(2)
        ElseIf InStr(p, "^") > 0 Then
            sNote = "part ao"
        ElseIf isTb Then
            sNote = "Toolbox"
        End If
        ' them chu: khong ap dung cho part ao / Toolbox / file ngoai thu muc du an
        tNote = ""
        If inTxt(i) Then
            If InStr(p, "^") > 0 Then
                tNote = "part ao"
            ElseIf isTb Then
                tNote = "Toolbox"
            ElseIf Left(lp, Len(projDir)) <> projDir Then
                tNote = "file thu vien ngoai du an"
            End If
        End If
        renRecs.Add Array(comp, p, lp, UCase(nm2), parKey, FileBaseName(p), mid(p, InStrRev(p, ".")), _
                          Left(p, InStrRev(p, "\")), typ, Len(nm2) - Len(Replace(nm2, "/", "")), sNote, mSeed, mDoc, mFeat, _
                          inTxt(i), tNote)
nextRd:
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    RenameReadTree = True
End Function

' Danh dau "can luu" (SetSaveFlag) moi file trong cum CO THAM CHIEU NGOAI (feature in-context, dau "->") va moi cum,
' de Save All ghi lai duong dan tham chieu theo TEN FILE MOI. Save All chi luu file "da sua": file tham chieu
' khong bi danh dau se giu duong dan cu tren o dia -> mo lai thay "->?" (mat lien ket). Tra ve so file da danh dau
Private Function MarkExtRefDocsDirty(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As Long
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long, md As Object, seen As Object, k As String
    Dim nx As Long, ro As Boolean
    Set seen = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    comps = swAsm.GetComponents(False)
    If Not IsEmpty(comps) Then
        For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
            Set md = Nothing
            Set md = comps(i).GetModelDoc2
            If Not md Is Nothing Then
                k = "": k = LCase(md.GetPathName)
                If k <> "" And Not seen.Exists(k) Then
                    seen.Add k, 1
                    Err.Clear
                    nx = 0: nx = md.ListExternalFileReferencesCount
                    If Err.Number <> 0 Then nx = 1                  ' khong doc duoc -> van danh dau cho chac
                    If nx > 0 Or md.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                        ro = False: ro = md.IsOpenedReadOnly
                        If Not ro Then md.SetSaveFlag: MarkExtRefDocsDirty = MarkExtRefDocsDirty + 1
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If
    asmModel.SetSaveFlag
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' STT: 1, 2, 3... hoac A..Z, AA, AB... (kieu cot Excel)
Private Function RenTok(ByVal n As Long, ByVal useLetters As Boolean) As String
    Dim s As String, r As Long
    If Not useLetters Then RenTok = CStr(n): Exit Function
    Do While n > 0
        r = (n - 1) Mod 26
        s = Chr(65 + r) & s
        n = (n - 1) \ 26
    Loop
    RenTok = s
End Function

' Doi ten theo ke hoach: tra ve so file da doi; loi -> errLog; ghi RenameLog.txt canh cum.
' Cach cua SolidWorks: CHON component trong cum dang mo roi goi RenameDocument cua CUM
' (giong chuot phai component tren cay -> Rename); du phong: chon bang chuoi SelectByID2, roi goi tren file component
Public Function ApplyRename(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, plan As Collection, errLog As String) As Long
    Dim it As Variant, comp As Object, md As Object, r As Long, lg As String, sid As String, okSel As Boolean, aErr As Long
    Dim mTxt As String, nMir As Long
    lg = "DOI TEN FILE - " & Now & vbCrLf & asmModel.GetPathName & vbCrLf & String(70, "-") & vbCrLf
    On Error Resume Next
    swApp.ActivateDoc3 asmModel.GetTitle, False, swDontRebuildActiveDoc, aErr
    On Error GoTo 0
    For Each it In plan
        If it(6) Then
            r = -1
            Set comp = Nothing
            On Error Resume Next
            Set comp = it(7)
            ' 1) chon component (doi tuong) -> RenameDocument cua cum
            asmModel.ClearSelection2 True
            okSel = False
            okSel = comp.Select4(False, Nothing, False)
            If okSel Then r = asmModel.Extension.RenameDocument(CStr(it(2)))
            ' 2) chon bang chuoi SelectByID2 cua component
            If r <> 0 Then
                asmModel.ClearSelection2 True
                sid = "": sid = comp.GetSelectByIDString
                If sid <> "" Then
                    If asmModel.Extension.SelectByID2(sid, "COMPONENT", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0) Then _
                        r = asmModel.Extension.RenameDocument(CStr(it(2)))
                End If
            End If
            ' 3) du phong: goi tren chinh file component
            If r <> 0 Then
                Set md = Nothing
                Set md = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(it(0))
                If Not md Is Nothing Then r = md.Extension.RenameDocument(CStr(it(2)))
            End If
            asmModel.ClearSelection2 True
            ' 4) chi tiet doi xung: SolidWorks khong cho doi ten truc tiep -> sua feature Mirror Components
            '    (chay sau cung: chi tiet goc da doi ten truoc)
            mTxt = ""
            If r <> 0 And it(3) = "M" And it(9) <> "" Then
                nMir = nMir + 1
                If MirrorFeatRename(CStr(it(8)), CStr(it(9)), CStr(it(1)), CStr(it(2)), mTxt) Then r = 0
            End If
            On Error GoTo 0
            If r = 0 Then
                ApplyRename = ApplyRename + 1
                lg = lg & "  OK    " & it(1) & "  ->  " & it(2) & IIf(mTxt <> "", "  (" & mTxt & ")", "") & vbCrLf
            Else
                errLog = errLog & it(1) & " -> " & it(2) & ": loi " & r & IIf(mTxt <> "", " / " & mTxt, "") & vbCrLf
                lg = lg & "  LOI   " & it(1) & "  ->  " & it(2) & "  (ma " & r & ")" & IIf(mTxt <> "", " / " & mTxt, "") & vbCrLf
            End If
        ElseIf it(5) <> "" Then
            lg = lg & "  bo qua " & it(1) & "  (" & it(5) & ")" & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next it
    On Error Resume Next
    If nMir > 0 Then asmModel.EditRebuild3
    asmModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' giu LIEN KET IN-CONTEXT (lo ve trong cum, feature co dau "->"): danh dau "can luu" cac file co tham chieu ngoai
    renExtN = 0
    If ApplyRename > 0 Then renExtN = MarkExtRefDocsDirty(asmModel)
    renCacheKey = ""                                 ' ten file da doi -> lan sau doc lai cay
    WriteLogFile asmModel, "RenameLog.txt", lg & String(70, "-") & vbCrLf & _
                 "Da doi ten: " & ApplyRename & " file. CHUA LUU: bam Save All (dong khong luu = huy doi ten)." & vbCrLf & _
                 "Lien ket in-context: da danh dau can luu " & renExtN & " file co tham chieu ngoai -> Save All de luu " & _
                 "duong dan tham chieu theo ten moi (khong luu = lo ve trong cum mat lien ket)." & vbCrLf & _
                 IIf(errLog <> "", "Neu van loi: Tools > Options > System Options > FeatureManager > bat " & _
                 "'Allow component files to be renamed from FeatureManager tree' roi chay lai." & vbCrLf & _
                 "File mirror chua doi duoc: chuot phai feature Mirror Components > Edit Feature > " & _
                 "buoc dat ten file (Filenames) > sua ten roi OK." & vbCrLf, "")
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  XUAT THIET BI TIEU CHUAN RA EXCEL (nut Export to Excel, dang mo ASSEMBLY)
'  - Thiet bi = component nam TRUC TIEP trong folder duoc tick (TBTC / TBC / TBD) o MOI CAP cum;
'    cum con nam trong folder = 1 thiet bi (khong liet ke / khong dem chi tiet ben trong no)
'  - Gop theo FILE; SL/Bo = tong so ban lap trong cum (ke ca LocalLPattern / Mirror, ke ca trong cum con),
'    bo ban lap dang suppress
'  - File mau "Thiet bi tieu chuan" (.xlsx) cung thu muc macro; hoi noi luu; dien STT, Ma san pham (ten file),
'    SL/Bo, Hinh anh (anh truc do cua thiet bi); hang / cot tu gian theo anh
'===========================================================================
' nSets: so bo (o "Number of clusters") -> cot "So bo"; cot "Tong SL" = SL/Bo x So bo; cot "Ten cum" = ten file cum tong
Public Function ExportStandardParts(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal folderList As String, _
                                    Optional ByVal nSets As Long = 1) As String
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long, comp As SldWorks.Component2, pm As Object
    Dim topSet As Object, cache As Object, devPaths As Object, lp As String, tk As String, doneAsm As Object
    Dim cnt As Object, ref As Object, keyT As Object, k As Variant
    Dim tbLog As String, kk As Variant, why As String
    If Trim(folderList) = "" Then ExportStandardParts = "LOI: chua tick folder nao (TBTC / TBC / TBD).": Exit Function
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    swAsm.ResolveAllLightWeightComponents False
    comps = swAsm.GetComponents(False)
    If IsEmpty(comps) Then ExportStandardParts = "LOI: assembly khong co chi tiet.": Exit Function

    ' 1) File thiet bi: component nam TRUC TIEP trong folder duoc chon (moi cap cum)
    Set topSet = GetFolderComponents(asmModel, folderList)
    Set cache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set devPaths = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        If Not IsCompSuppressed(comp) Then
            If DirectInFolderList(comp, topSet, folderList, cache) Then devPaths(LCase(comp.GetPathName)) = 1
        End If
    Next i
    tbLog = "LOG XUAT THIET BI TIEU CHUAN - " & Now & vbCrLf & asmModel.GetPathName & vbCrLf & _
            "Folder: " & folderList & vbCrLf & String(70, "-") & vbCrLf
    tbLog = tbLog & "Cum tong: " & topSet.Count & " ten trong folder" & vbCrLf
    For Each kk In cache.Keys
        tbLog = tbLog & "Cum con: " & kk & " -> " & cache.Item(kk).Count & " ten trong folder" & vbCrLf
    Next kk
    If devPaths.Count = 0 Then
        WriteTbLog asmModel, tbLog
        ExportStandardParts = "LOI: khong co thiet bi nao trong folder " & folderList & "." & vbCrLf & "(xem TBTC_ExportLog.txt canh assembly)"
        Exit Function
    End If
    ' 1b) Pattern / Mirror sinh tu thiet bi (vd Mirror tao file doi xung moi) -> cung la thiet bi
    AddPatternSkips asmModel, devPaths, True
    Set doneAsm = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set pm = Nothing
        Set pm = comps(i).GetModelDoc2
        If Not pm Is Nothing Then
            If pm.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY And Not doneAsm.Exists(LCase(pm.GetPathName)) Then
                doneAsm.Add LCase(pm.GetPathName), 1
                AddPatternSkips pm, devPaths, True
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    ' 1c) Cum con CO folder thiet bi rieng (TBTC / TBC / TBD ben trong) = cum co khi, KHONG phai 1 thiet bi:
    '     dem cac thiet bi trong folder cua no (ke ca khi file cum nay con nam trong folder o cho khac)
    For Each kk In cache.Keys
        If cache.Item(kk).Count > 0 And devPaths.Exists(kk) Then
            devPaths.Remove kk
            tbLog = tbLog & "Cum co folder thiet bi ben trong -> khong tinh la 1 thiet bi: " & kk & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next kk

    ' 2) Dem ban lap: moi component (moi cap, ke ca Pattern / Mirror) co file la thiet bi,
    '    khong suppress, khong nam BEN TRONG 1 thiet bi khac (vd vit cua xi lanh)
    Set cnt = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set ref = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set keyT = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set treeCache = Nothing
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        lp = LCase(comp.GetPathName)
        If devPaths.Exists(lp) Then
            why = ""
            If IsCompSuppressed(comp) Then
                why = "suppress"
            ElseIf InsideDevice(comp, devPaths) Then
                why = "nam trong 1 thiet bi khac"
            End If
            tbLog = tbLog & IIf(why = "", "  DEM   ", "  BO QUA ") & comp.Name2 & IIf(why = "", "", "  (" & why & ")") & vbCrLf
            If why = "" Then
                cnt(lp) = cnt(lp) + 1
                If Not ref.Exists(lp) Then ref.Add lp, comp
                tk = TreeKey(comp, asmModel)
                If Not keyT.Exists(lp) Then
                    keyT.Add lp, tk
                ElseIf tk < keyT.Item(lp) Then
                    keyT.Item(lp) = tk
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    WriteTbLog asmModel, tbLog
    If cnt.Count = 0 Then ExportStandardParts = "LOI: khong dem duoc thiet bi (deu dang suppress?).": Exit Function

    ' thu tu: theo cay FeatureManager
    Dim ord() As String, n As Long, a As Long, b As Long, t As String
    ReDim ord(1 To cnt.Count)
    For Each k In cnt.Keys
        n = n + 1: ord(n) = k
    Next k
    For a = 2 To n
        t = ord(a): b = a - 1
        Do While b >= 1
            If keyT.Item(ord(b)) <= keyT.Item(t) Then Exit Do
            ord(b + 1) = ord(b): b = b - 1
        Loop
        ord(b + 1) = t
    Next a

    ' 3) File mau (de READ-ONLY cung duoc: mo chi doc, khong bao gio ghi de file mau)
    Dim tplPath As String, xL As Object, sv As Variant, initName As String, asmDir As String
    tplPath = FindTbTemplate()
    If tplPath = "" Then
        ExportStandardParts = "LOI: khong tim thay file mau " & Chr(34) & DecodeU(TB_TEMPLATE_NAME) & ".xlsx" & Chr(34) & _
                              " trong thu muc macro:" & vbCrLf & swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    Set xL = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If xL Is Nothing Then ExportStandardParts = "LOI: khong mo duoc Excel tren may nay.": Exit Function

    ' 4) Dien du lieu TRUOC (Excel chay an), hoi noi luu SAU
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, hdr As Long, cSTT As Long, cMa As Long, cSL As Long, cImg As Long, r As Long
    Dim imgDir As String, imgF As String, okImg As Boolean, shp As Object, cel As Object, nImg As Long, g As Long, c0 As Long
    Dim wMa As Double, cBo As Long, cTong As Long, cCum As Long, cLast As Long, fCols As Collection, fc As Variant
    Dim asmName As String, cG As Long, cTen As Long, cXx As Long, cDv As Long, cGia As Long
    Dim tplIsXlsm As Boolean, codeOK As Boolean, goiyNote As String, asXlsm As Boolean
    If nSets < 1 Then nSets = 1
    asmName = FileBaseName(asmModel.GetPathName)
    xL.ScreenUpdating = False
    xL.DisplayAlerts = False
    ' tat su kien: file mau .xlsm co macro Ma goi y (Worksheet_Change) -> khong de no chay khi macro dang dien du lieu
    On Error Resume Next
    xL.EnableEvents = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    On Error Resume Next
    ' UpdateLinks = 0, ReadOnly = True, IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended = True
    Set wb = xL.Workbooks.Open(tplPath, 0, True, , , , True)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If wb Is Nothing Then
        xL.Quit
        ExportStandardParts = "LOI: khong mo duoc file mau:" & vbCrLf & tplPath
        Exit Function
    End If
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    TbFindColumns ws, hdr, cSTT, cMa, cSL, cImg
    TbFindExtraColumns ws, hdr, cImg, cBo, cTong, cCum
    cLast = cImg
    If cCum > cLast Then cLast = cCum
    ' cot "Ma goi y" (chi khi da chon file lich su mua hang trong Settings) + cot Ten / Xuat xu / Don vi / Don gia
    If Trim(LSMH_PATH) <> "" Then
        TbFindGoiYColumns ws, hdr, cImg, cG, cTen, cXx, cDv, cGia
        If cG > cLast Then cLast = cG
    End If
    ' cong thuc co san o hang du lieu DAU cua file mau (vd Tong SL, Thanh tien) -> chep xuong moi hang
    Set fCols = New Collection
    On Error Resume Next
    For c0 = 1 To cLast
        If ws.Cells(hdr + 1, c0).HasFormula Then fCols.Add Array(c0, ws.Cells(hdr + 1, c0).FormulaR1C1)
    Next c0
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' 4a) chu: STT / Ma san pham / SL
    r = hdr
    For a = 1 To n
        lp = ord(a)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, cSTT).Value = a
        ws.Cells(r, cMa).Value = FileBaseName(ref.Item(lp).GetPathName)
        ws.Cells(r, cMa).WrapText = False
        ws.Cells(r, cSL).Value = cnt.Item(lp)                                        ' SL / 1 bo
        On Error Resume Next
        For Each fc In fCols                                                          ' cong thuc cua file mau
            If r > hdr + 1 Then ws.Cells(r, fc(0)).FormulaR1C1 = fc(1)
        Next fc
        If cBo > 0 Then ws.Cells(r, cBo).Value = nSets: ws.Cells(r, cBo).HorizontalAlignment = -4108
        If cTong > 0 Then
            ' file mau chua co cong thuc Tong SL -> Tong SL = SL/Bo x So bo
            If Not ws.Cells(r, cTong).HasFormula And cBo > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, cTong).Formula = "=" & ws.Cells(r, cSL).Address(False, False) & "*" & ws.Cells(r, cBo).Address(False, False)
            End If
            ws.Cells(r, cTong).HorizontalAlignment = -4108
        End If
        If cCum > 0 Then ws.Cells(r, cCum).Value = asmName: ws.Cells(r, cCum).WrapText = False
        On Error GoTo 0
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, cLast)).VerticalAlignment = -4108       ' xlCenter
        ws.Cells(r, cSTT).HorizontalAlignment = -4108: ws.Cells(r, cSL).HorizontalAlignment = -4108
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, cLast)).Borders.LineStyle = 1           ' xlContinuous
    Next a
    ' 4b) o Ma san pham: tu gian do rong theo ten dai nhat (khong hep hon do rong cot trong file mau)
    wMa = ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(hdr + 1, cMa), ws.Cells(r, cMa)).Columns.AutoFit
    If ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth + 2 < wMa Then
        ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth = wMa
    ElseIf ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth + 2 <= 255 Then
        ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth = ws.Columns(cMa).ColumnWidth + 2              ' chua le 2 ben
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' o Ten cum: tu gian theo ten (khong hep hon do rong cot trong file mau)
    If cCum > 0 Then
        wMa = ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(hdr + 1, cCum), ws.Cells(r, cCum)).Columns.AutoFit
        If ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth + 2 < wMa Then
            ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth = wMa
        ElseIf ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth + 2 <= 255 Then
            ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth = ws.Columns(cCum).ColumnWidth + 2
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    ' 4d) MA GOI Y tu file lich su mua hang: danh sach chon trong o + macro chon ma -> dien thong tin
    tplIsXlsm = (LCase(Right(tplPath, 5)) = ".xlsm")
    codeOK = False
    If cG > 0 Then goiyNote = TbFillGoiY(xL, wb, ws, hdr, hdr + n, cMa, cG, cTen, cXx, cDv, cGia, tplIsXlsm, codeOK)
    ' 4c) hinh anh: chup truc do thiet bi -> chen vao o, gian hang / cot cho vua
    imgDir = Environ("TEMP") & "\AutoDrawing_TB"
    On Error Resume Next
    MkDir imgDir
    On Error GoTo 0
    r = hdr
    For a = 1 To n
        lp = ord(a)
        r = r + 1
        imgF = imgDir & "\tb_" & a & ".bmp"
        okImg = SnapModelImage(ref.Item(lp), imgF)
        If okImg Then
            ws.rows(r).RowHeight = TB_IMG_PT + 8
            g = 0
            Do While ws.Columns(cImg).Width < TB_IMG_PT + 8 And g < 200
                g = g + 1
                ws.Columns(cImg).ColumnWidth = ws.Columns(cImg).ColumnWidth + 1
            Loop
            Set cel = ws.Cells(r, cImg)
            Set shp = Nothing
            On Error Resume Next
            Set shp = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(imgF, 0, -1, cel.Left + (cel.Width - TB_IMG_PT) / 2, cel.Top + 4, TB_IMG_PT, TB_IMG_PT)
            If Not shp Is Nothing Then
                shp.Placement = 1                              ' xlMoveAndSize: hinh di theo o
                nImg = nImg + 1
            End If
            Kill imgF
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next a
    ' tra lai cua so assembly
    Dim aErr As Long
    swApp.ActivateDoc3 asmModel.GetTitle, False, swDontRebuildActiveDoc, aErr

    ' 5) Hien bang da dien len truoc, roi hoi noi luu
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Activate
    ws.Cells(1, 1).Select
    xL.EnableEvents = True                         ' bat lai su kien: tu day nguoi dung chon Ma goi y moi tu dien
    xL.ScreenUpdating = True
    xL.Visible = True
    xL.UserControl = True                          ' Excel van mo sau khi macro ket thuc
    SetForegroundWindow xL.hWnd
    On Error GoTo 0
    asmDir = Left(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\"))
    ' co macro chon Ma goi y (hoac file mau .xlsm) -> luu .xlsm de giu macro
    asXlsm = codeOK Or tplIsXlsm
    initName = asmDir & FileBaseName(asmModel.GetPathName) & " - Thiet bi tieu chuan" & IIf(asXlsm, ".xlsm", ".xlsx")
    Dim nTry As Long, okSave As Boolean
    Do
        nTry = nTry + 1
        sv = xL.GetSaveAsFilename(initName, IIf(asXlsm, "Excel Macro-Enabled Workbook (*.xlsm), *.xlsm", _
                                  "Excel Workbook (*.xlsx), *.xlsx"), 1, "Luu danh sach thiet bi tieu chuan")
        If VarType(sv) = vbBoolean Then
            ' Huy: de nguyen bang da dien trong Excel (nguoi dung tu luu sau), khong bao loi
            xL.DisplayAlerts = True
            ExportStandardParts = ""
            Exit Function
        End If
        If LCase(CStr(sv)) = LCase(tplPath) Then
            MsgBox "Khong the ghi de file mau (read-only)." & vbCrLf & "Hay chon ten / thu muc khac.", _
                   vbExclamation + vbSystemModal, APP_NAME
        Else
