            Err.Clear
            On Error Resume Next
            wb.SaveAs CStr(sv), IIf(asXlsm, 52, 51)        ' 52 = .xlsm (co macro), 51 = .xlsx
            okSave = (Err.Number = 0)
            On Error GoTo 0
            If okSave Then Exit Do
            MsgBox "Khong luu duoc file:" & vbCrLf & CStr(sv) & vbCrLf & _
                   "(file dang mo hoac thu muc chi doc). Hay chon noi khac.", vbExclamation + vbSystemModal, APP_NAME
        End If
        initName = CStr(sv)
    Loop While nTry < 10
    xL.DisplayAlerts = True
    If Not okSave Then ExportStandardParts = "": Exit Function
    ' file da luu van mo trong Excel de xem
    ExportStandardParts = "OK" & goiyNote
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  DEM SO LUONG (Count QTY)
'  - Dem moi cum con / part o MOI CAP trong assembly dang mo: tong cho ca cum tong (nhan qua cac cap),
'    ke ca ban sao LocalLPattern / Mirror va cum con lap lai; khong dem chi tiet SUPPRESS.
'    Chi tiet "Exclude from BOM" van dem binh thuong. Gop theo TEN FILE (moi configuration cong chung).
'  - Folder TBTC / TBC / TBD: chi dem folder duoc tick (folderList). Cum con nam trong folder = 1 thiet bi:
'    ghi QTY cho chinh cum do, KHONG ghi vao chi tiet ben trong. Folder khong tick: bo qua, giu QTY cu.
'    Folder BVHAN (va moi chi tiet ngoai folder thiet bi): luon dem.
'  - So luong x nSets ("Number of clusters"). Cum tong dang mo: QTY = nSets.
'  - Ghi vao property QTY_PROP o tab CONFIGURATION SPECIFIC cua cac configuration duoc dung trong assembly
'    (giu kieu Number / Text dang co; chua co thi tao kieu Number). Tab Custom: chi cap nhat neu da co san QTY.
'    KHONG tu luu file (nguoi dung Save All).
'  - Log: QtyLog.txt canh file assembly. Tra ve "" (xong) / " (... loi)" / "LOI: ..."
'===========================================================================
Public Function CountQty(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal folderList As String, ByVal nSets As Long) As String
    Const ALL_DEV As String = "TBTC,TBC,TBD"
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, comps As Variant, i As Long, comp As SldWorks.Component2
    Dim topAll As Object, topTick As Object, cacheAll As Object, cacheTick As Object, dev As Object
    Dim qty As Object, ref As Object, keyT As Object, k As Variant, lp As String, nm As String, cfgs As Object
    Dim why As String, tk As String, qLog As String, skLog As String, nSkip As Long
    If nSets < 1 Then nSets = 1
    folderList = Trim(folderList)
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    swAsm.ResolveAllLightWeightComponents False
    comps = swAsm.GetComponents(False)
    If IsEmpty(comps) Then CountQty = "LOI: assembly khong co chi tiet.": Exit Function

    ' 1) Thiet bi: component nam TRUC TIEP trong folder TBTC / TBC / TBD (o cap cua no)
    '    dev: Name2 -> True (folder duoc tick: dem) / False (khong tick: bo qua)
    Set topAll = GetFolderComponents(asmModel, ALL_DEV)
    Set cacheAll = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cacheTick = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If folderList <> "" Then Set topTick = GetFolderComponents(asmModel, folderList)
    Set dev = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        If DirectInFolderList(comp, topAll, ALL_DEV, cacheAll) Then
            nm = UCase(comp.Name2)
            dev(nm) = False
            If Not topTick Is Nothing Then
                If DirectInFolderList(comp, topTick, folderList, cacheTick) Then dev(nm) = True
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    ' cum co folder TBTC / TBC / TBD ben trong = cum co khi, khong phai 1 thiet bi -> dem ca ben trong
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        nm = UCase(comp.Name2): lp = LCase(comp.GetPathName)
        If dev.Exists(nm) And cacheAll.Exists(lp) Then
            If cacheAll.Item(lp).Count > 0 Then dev.Remove nm
        End If
    Next i

    ' 2) Dem tung ban lap (moi cap) theo file
    Set qty = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set ref = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set keyT = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set cfgs = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set treeCache = Nothing
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        Set comp = comps(i)
        lp = LCase(comp.GetPathName): nm = UCase(comp.Name2)
        why = ""
        If lp = "" Then
            why = "khong co file"
        ElseIf IsCompSuppressed(comp) Then
            why = "suppress"
        ElseIf InsideDevInstance(comp, dev) Then
            why = "nam trong 1 thiet bi"
        ElseIf dev.Exists(nm) Then
            If Not dev.Item(nm) Then why = "folder thiet bi khong tick"
        End If
        If why = "" Then
            qty(lp) = qty(lp) + 1
            If Not ref.Exists(lp) Then ref.Add lp, comp
            ' configuration duoc dung cua file nay (ghi QTY vao tung configuration)
            If Not cfgs.Exists(lp) Then cfgs.Add lp, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            If comp.ReferencedConfiguration <> "" Then cfgs.Item(lp).Item(comp.ReferencedConfiguration) = 1
            tk = TreeKey(comp, asmModel)
            If Not keyT.Exists(lp) Then
                keyT.Add lp, tk
            ElseIf tk < keyT.Item(lp) Then
                keyT.Item(lp) = tk
            End If
        Else
            nSkip = nSkip + 1
            skLog = skLog & "  BO QUA  " & comp.Name2 & "  (" & why & ")" & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next i

    ' thu tu: theo cay FeatureManager
    Dim ord() As String, n As Long, a As Long, b As Long, t As String
    If qty.Count > 0 Then
        ReDim ord(1 To qty.Count)
        For Each k In qty.Keys
            n = n + 1: ord(n) = k
        Next k
        For a = 2 To n
            t = ord(a): b = a - 1
            Do While b >= 1
                If keyT.Item(ord(b)) <= keyT.Item(t) Then Exit Do
                ord(b + 1) = ord(b): b = b - 1
            Loop
            ord(b + 1) = t
        Next a
    End If

    ' 3) Ghi QTY vao tung file (khong luu)
    Dim md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, q As Long, nOk As Long, nErr As Long, ro As String, nNew As Long, made As Boolean
    For a = 1 To n
        lp = ord(a): q = qty.Item(lp) * nSets
        Set md = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set md = ref.Item(lp).GetModelDoc2
        If md Is Nothing Then Set md = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(ref.Item(lp).GetPathName)
        On Error GoTo 0
        ro = ""
        If md Is Nothing Then
            nErr = nErr + 1
            qLog = qLog & "   LOI  " & FileBaseName(ref.Item(lp).GetPathName) & "  (khong mo duoc file)" & vbCrLf
        ElseIf SetQtyProp(md, q, cfgs.Item(lp), made) Then
            nOk = nOk + 1
            If made Then nNew = nNew + 1: ro = "  (tao moi QTY)"
            If md.IsOpenedReadOnly Then ro = ro & "  (READ-ONLY: khong luu duoc)"
            qLog = qLog & Right(Space(6) & CStr(q), 6) & "  " & FileBaseName(ref.Item(lp).GetPathName) & _
                   "  [" & Join(cfgs.Item(lp).Keys, ", ") & "]" & ro & vbCrLf
        Else
            nErr = nErr + 1
            qLog = qLog & "   LOI  " & FileBaseName(ref.Item(lp).GetPathName) & "  (khong ghi duoc QTY)" & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next a
    ' cum tong dang mo: QTY = so bo (configuration dang kich hoat)
    Dim topCfg As Object, acn As String
    Set topCfg = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    acn = asmModel.ConfigurationManager.ActiveConfiguration.Name
    On Error GoTo 0
    If acn <> "" Then topCfg.Item(acn) = 1
    If SetQtyProp(asmModel, nSets, topCfg, made) Then
        nOk = nOk + 1
        If made Then nNew = nNew + 1
        qLog = Right(Space(6) & CStr(nSets), 6) & "  " & FileBaseName(asmModel.GetPathName) & "  [" & acn & "]  (cum tong)" & _
               IIf(made, "  (tao moi QTY)", "") & vbCrLf & qLog
    Else
        nErr = nErr + 1
        qLog = "   LOI  " & FileBaseName(asmModel.GetPathName) & "  (cum tong: khong ghi duoc QTY)" & vbCrLf & qLog
    End If

    WriteLogFile asmModel, "QtyLog.txt", _
        "LOG DEM SO LUONG (Count QTY) - " & Now & vbCrLf & asmModel.GetPathName & vbCrLf & _
        "Property: " & QTY_PROP & "   |   Number of clusters: " & nSets & "   |   Dem folder: " & _
        IIf(folderList = "", "(khong)", folderList) & " + moi chi tiet ngoai TBTC/TBC/TBD" & vbCrLf & _
        "Da ghi: " & nOk & " file (tao moi QTY: " & nNew & ")   |   Loi: " & nErr & "   |   Ban lap bo qua: " & nSkip & vbCrLf & _
        "CHUA LUU: kiem tra roi bam Save All." & vbCrLf & String(70, "-") & vbCrLf & _
        "   QTY  File" & vbCrLf & qLog & String(70, "-") & vbCrLf & skLog
    If nErr > 0 Then CountQty = vbCrLf & "(" & nErr & " file loi - xem QtyLog.txt)"
End Function

' Component nam BEN TRONG 1 ban lap thiet bi (cum cha / ong ... la thiet bi trong dev)?
Private Function InsideDevInstance(ByVal comp As Object, dev As Object) As Boolean
    Dim c As Object, nx As Object, g As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set c = comp.GetParent
    Do While Not c Is Nothing And g < 50
        g = g + 1
        If dev.Exists(UCase(c.Name2)) Then InsideDevInstance = True: Exit Function
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = c.GetParent
        Set c = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Ghi QTY vao tab CONFIGURATION SPECIFIC cua cac configuration trong cfgList (+ tab Custom neu da co san QTY).
' Danh dau file da sua, KHONG luu. Tra ve True khi moi cho ghi deu doc lai dung gia tri.
' made = True neu co it nhat 1 noi CHUA CO QTY va da duoc tao moi (part hoac assembly)
Private Function SetQtyProp(md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal q As Long, cfgList As Object, made As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim k As Variant, ok As Boolean, nW As Long, acn As String, mk As Boolean
    ok = True: made = False
    If Not cfgList Is Nothing Then
        For Each k In cfgList.Keys
            If CStr(k) <> "" Then
                nW = nW + 1
                If Not QtyWriteOne(md, CStr(k), q, True, mk) Then ok = False
                If mk Then made = True
            End If
        Next k
    End If
    ' khong doc duoc configuration cua ban lap -> dung configuration dang kich hoat cua file (van ghi tab Configuration Specific)
    If nW = 0 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        acn = md.ConfigurationManager.ActiveConfiguration.Name
        On Error GoTo 0
        If acn <> "" Then
            nW = 1
            If Not cfgList Is Nothing Then cfgList.Item(acn) = 1
            If Not QtyWriteOne(md, acn, q, True, mk) Then ok = False
            If mk Then made = True
        End If
    End If
    ' tab Custom: chi cap nhat khi file da co san QTY o day (khong tao them); van khong co configuration -> ghi tab Custom
    If Not QtyWriteOne(md, "", q, (nW = 0), mk) Then ok = False
    If mk Then made = True
    On Error Resume Next
    md.SetSaveFlag                                 ' de Save All biet file da thay doi
    On Error GoTo 0
    SetQtyProp = ok
End Function

' Ghi QTY vao 1 bang property (cfgName = "" -> tab Custom). Giu kieu dang co (Number / Text);
' chua co: createIfMissing = True -> tao kieu Number, False -> bo qua (tra ve True)
Private Function QtyWriteOne(md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal cfgName As String, ByVal q As Long, _
                             ByVal createIfMissing As Boolean, created As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim cpm As SldWorks.CustomPropertyManager, tp As Long, v As String, rv As String, names As Variant
    Dim i As Long, has As Boolean
    created = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cpm = md.Extension.CustomPropertyManager(cfgName)
    If cpm Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    names = cpm.GetNames
    If IsArray(names) Then
        For i = 0 To UBound(names)
            If UCase(CStr(names(i))) = UCase(QTY_PROP) Then has = True: Exit For
        Next i
    End If
    If Not has And Not createIfMissing Then QtyWriteOne = True: Exit Function
    tp = 0
    If has Then tp = cpm.GetType2(QTY_PROP)
    If tp = 0 Then tp = 3                          ' 3 = swCustomInfoNumber (giong mau QTY dang dung); 30 = Text
    Err.Clear
    cpm.Add3 QTY_PROP, tp, CStr(q), 2              ' 2 = swCustomPropertyReplaceValue
    v = "": rv = ""
    cpm.Get4 QTY_PROP, False, v, rv
    If Trim(v) <> CStr(q) Then                     ' du phong: Set2, roi xoa - tao lai
        Err.Clear
        cpm.Set2 QTY_PROP, CStr(q)
        v = "": cpm.Get4 QTY_PROP, False, v, rv
        If Trim(v) <> CStr(q) Then
            Err.Clear
            cpm.Delete QTY_PROP
            cpm.Add2 QTY_PROP, tp, CStr(q)
            v = "": cpm.Get4 QTY_PROP, False, v, rv
        End If
    End If
    QtyWriteOne = (Trim(v) = CStr(q))
    created = (QtyWriteOne And Not has)            ' chua co QTY -> vua tao moi
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Ghi file log canh file assembly
Private Sub WriteLogFile(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal fname As String, ByVal txt As String)
    Dim fp As String, ts As Object
    fp = Left(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\")) & fname
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ts = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").CreateTextFile(fp, True)
    If Not ts Is Nothing Then ts.Write txt: ts.Close
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Ghi log xuat thiet bi canh file assembly: TBTC_ExportLog.txt
Private Sub WriteTbLog(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal txt As String)
    Dim fp As String, ts As Object
    fp = Left(asmModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(asmModel.GetPathName, "\")) & "TBTC_ExportLog.txt"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ts = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").CreateTextFile(fp, True)
    If Not ts Is Nothing Then ts.Write txt: ts.Close
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Component nam BEN TRONG 1 thiet bi khac (cum cha la thiet bi)?
Private Function InsideDevice(ByVal comp As Object, devPaths As Object) As Boolean
    Dim c As Object, nx As Object, g As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set c = comp.GetParent
    Do While Not c Is Nothing And g < 50
        g = g + 1
        If devPaths.Exists(LCase(c.GetPathName)) Then InsideDevice = True: Exit Function
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = c.GetParent
        Set c = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Ten file khong duong dan, khong duoi
Private Function FileBaseName(ByVal p As String) As String
    p = mid(p, InStrRev(p, "\") + 1)
    If InStrRev(p, ".") > 0 Then p = Left(p, InStrRev(p, ".") - 1)
    FileBaseName = p
End Function

' File mau "Thiet bi tieu chuan" (.xlsx / .xlsm / .xls) trong thu muc macro (ten co dau hoac khong dau)
Private Function FindTbTemplate() As String
    Dim fso As Object, fld As Object, f As Object, base As String, ext As String, sig As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set fld = fso.GetFolder(swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder)
    If fld Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    For Each f In fld.Files
        ext = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(f.Name))
        base = fso.GetBaseName(f.Name)
        If (ext = "xlsx" Or ext = "xlsm" Or ext = "xls") And Left(base, 2) <> "~$" Then
            sig = AsciiLetters(base)
            If base = DecodeU(TB_TEMPLATE_NAME) Or sig = "thitbtiuchun" Or sig = "thietbitieuchuan" Then
                FindTbTemplate = f.path
                If ext = "xlsm" Then Exit Function         ' co ca .xlsx va .xlsm -> uu tien .xlsm (co macro Ma goi y)
            End If
        End If
    Next f
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' ===========================================================================
'  MA GOI Y (Export to Excel): ma MSP gan dung nhat trong FILE LICH SU MUA HANG (Settings > Purchases)
'  - Do giong = trung binh (giong ca chuoi: 1 - so ky tu phai sua / do dai) va (trung tu DAU ma / ma ngan hon);
'    chi so cac ma co cung 3 ky tu dau (sau khi bo dau cach, "_", phan "(...)" cua ten file)
'  - Toi da GOIY_MAX ma, do giong >= GOIY_MIN; giong nhat truoc, cung muc -> ngay mua gan nhat truoc
'  - Moi ma 1 dong, ngay / ten / xuat xu / don vi / don gia cua LAN MUA GAN NHAT
'  - O "Ma goi y" = danh sach (Data Validation) dien san ma giong nhat; chon ma -> macro Worksheet_Change chen vao
'    sheet thiet bi thay Ma san pham + dien Ten / Xuat xu / Don vi / Don gia (du lieu o sheet an "AD_GoiY")
' ===========================================================================
' Cot "Ma goi y" (chua co -> them sau cot cuoi, cung dinh dang tieu de) + cot Ten / Xuat xu / Don vi / Don gia (0 = khong co)
Private Sub TbFindGoiYColumns(ByVal ws As Object, ByVal hdr As Long, ByVal cImg As Long, cG As Long, cTen As Long, _
                              cXx As Long, cDv As Long, cGia As Long)
    Dim c As Long, t As String, sg As String, lastC As Long
    cG = 0: cTen = 0: cXx = 0: cDv = 0: cGia = 0
    For c = 1 To 40
        t = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        t = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(hdr, c).Value))
        On Error GoTo 0
        If t <> "" Then
            lastC = c
            sg = AsciiLetters(t)
            If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("g\u1EE3i \u00FD"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sg = "mgi" Or sg = "magoiy" Then
                cG = c
            ElseIf InStr(1, t, DecodeU("T\u00EAn c\u1EE5m"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sg = "tncm" Or sg = "tencum" Then
                ' cot Ten cum: bo qua
            ElseIf StrComp(Left(t, 3), DecodeU("T\u00EAn"), vbTextCompare) = 0 Or Left(sg, 3) = "ten" Then
                If cTen = 0 Then cTen = c
            ElseIf InStr(1, t, DecodeU("Xu\u1EA5t x\u1EE9"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, t, DecodeU("Ngu\u1ED3n g\u1ED1c"), vbTextCompare) > 0 _
                   Or InStr(1, t, DecodeU("H\u00E3ng"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sg = "xuatxu" Or sg = "nguongoc" Or sg = "hang" Or sg = "maker" Then
                cXx = c
            ElseIf InStr(1, t, DecodeU("\u0110\u01A1n v\u1ECB"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or StrComp(t, DecodeU("\u0110VT"), vbTextCompare) = 0 _
                   Or sg = "dvt" Or sg = "donvi" Then
                cDv = c
            ElseIf InStr(1, t, DecodeU("\u0110\u01A1n gi\u00E1"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sg = "dongia" Then
                cGia = c
            End If
        End If
    Next c
    If cG = 0 Then
        cG = IIf(lastC > 0, lastC + 1, cImg + 1)
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Cells(hdr, cImg).Copy ws.Cells(hdr, cG)
        ws.Cells(hdr, cG).Value = DecodeU("M\u00E3 g\u1EE3i \u00FD")
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
End Sub

' Dien cot Ma goi y cho cac hang hdr+1..lastR. Tra ve ghi chu cho thong bao cuoi ("" = binh thuong).
' codeOK = file xuat co macro chon ma chay duoc (chen tu dong, hoac file mau .xlsm da co san)
Private Function TbFillGoiY(ByVal xL As Object, ByVal wb As Object, ByVal ws As Object, ByVal hdr As Long, ByVal lastR As Long, _
                            ByVal cMa As Long, ByVal cG As Long, ByVal cTen As Long, ByVal cXx As Long, ByVal cDv As Long, _
                            ByVal cGia As Long, ByVal tplIsXlsm As Boolean, codeOK As Boolean) As String
    Dim info As Object, idx As Object, eR As String, wsG As Object, r As Long, sug As Collection, it As Variant, v As Variant
    Dim used As Object, nD As Long, j As Long, dev As String, rng As Object, w0 As Double, nNo As Long
    codeOK = tplIsXlsm
    If Dir(LSMH_PATH) = "" Then
        TbFillGoiY = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: khong tim thay file lich su mua hang (Settings > Purchases):" & vbCrLf & LSMH_PATH
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not LsmhLoad(xL, LSMH_PATH, info, idx, eR) Then TbFillGoiY = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: " & eR: Exit Function
    ' sheet an chua du lieu goi y
    On Error Resume Next
    xL.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.Worksheets("AD_GoiY").Delete
    Set wsG = wb.Worksheets.Add(after:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    wsG.Name = "AD_GoiY"
    On Error GoTo 0
    If wsG Is Nothing Then TbFillGoiY = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: khong tao duoc sheet AD_GoiY.": Exit Function
    wsG.Columns(1).NumberFormat = "@"
    wsG.Columns(10).NumberFormat = "@"
    wsG.Range("A1:F1").Value = Array("MSP", "TEN", "XUAT XU", "DON VI", "DON GIA", "NGAY MUA")
    v = Array("HDR", hdr, "GOIY", cG, "MA", cMa, "TEN", cTen, "XUATXU", cXx, "DONVI", cDv, "DONGIA", cGia, "LSMH", LSMH_PATH)
    For j = 0 To 7
        wsG.Cells(j + 1, 8).Value = v(2 * j): wsG.Cells(j + 1, 9).Value = v(2 * j + 1)
    Next j
    Set used = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nD = 1
    For r = hdr + 1 To lastR
        dev = CStr(ws.Cells(r, cMa).Value)
        wsG.Cells(r, 10).Value = dev                                   ' ten file goc (cho "(Giu ma goc)")
        Set sug = GySuggest(dev, info, idx)
        j = 0
        For Each it In sug
            j = j + 1
            v = info.Item(it)                                          ' Array(ma, ten, xuat xu, don vi, don gia, ngay)
            wsG.Cells(r, 10 + j).NumberFormat = "@"
            wsG.Cells(r, 10 + j).Value = v(0) & " | " & Format(v(5), "dd\/mm\/yyyy")
            If Not used.Exists(it) Then
                nD = nD + 1: used.Add it, nD
                wsG.Cells(nD, 1).Value = v(0): wsG.Cells(nD, 2).Value = v(1): wsG.Cells(nD, 3).Value = v(2)
                wsG.Cells(nD, 4).Value = v(3): wsG.Cells(nD, 5).Value = v(4)
                wsG.Cells(nD, 6).Value = CDate(v(5)): wsG.Cells(nD, 6).NumberFormat = "dd/mm/yyyy"
            End If
        Next it
        If j > 0 Then
            wsG.Cells(r, 11 + j).Value = DecodeU("(Gi\u1EEF m\u00E3 g\u1ED1c)")
            Set rng = wsG.Range(wsG.Cells(r, 11), wsG.Cells(r, 11 + j))
            On Error Resume Next
            With ws.Cells(r, cG).Validation
                .Delete
                .Add 3, 1, 1, "='AD_GoiY'!" & rng.Address              ' xlValidateList
                .IgnoreBlank = True
                .InCellDropdown = True
                .ShowError = False                                     ' van go tay duoc
            End With
            ws.Cells(r, cG).NumberFormat = "@"
            ws.Cells(r, cG).Value = wsG.Cells(r, 11).Value              ' dien san ma giong nhat (chua thay Ma san pham)
            On Error GoTo 0
        Else
            nNo = nNo + 1
        End If
        ws.Cells(r, cG).WrapText = False
    Next r
    ' o Ma goi y: tu gian theo noi dung (khong hep hon do rong cot trong file mau)
    w0 = ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(hdr + 1, cG), ws.Cells(lastR, cG)).Columns.AutoFit
    If ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth + 2 < w0 Then
        ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth = w0
    ElseIf ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth + 4 <= 255 Then
        ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth = ws.Columns(cG).ColumnWidth + 4        ' cho mui ten danh sach
    End If
    wsG.Visible = 2                                                    ' xlSheetVeryHidden
    On Error GoTo 0
    If nNo > 0 Then TbFillGoiY = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: " & nNo & " thiet bi khong co ma giong >= " & Format(GOIY_MIN * 100, "0") & "%."
    TbFillGoiY = TbFillGoiY & GoiYInject(wb, ws, tplIsXlsm, codeOK)
End Function

' Chen macro chon ma (Worksheet_Change) vao sheet thiet bi. Can Excel cho phep truy cap VBA project
' (Trust access to the VBA project object model). File mau .xlsm da dan san macro -> dung luon
Private Function GoiYInject(ByVal wb As Object, ByVal ws As Object, ByVal tplIsXlsm As Boolean, codeOK As Boolean) As String
    Dim cM As Object, txt As String, nL As Long
    codeOK = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cM = wb.VBProject.VBComponents(ws.CodeName).CodeModule
    On Error GoTo 0
    If cM Is Nothing Then
        If tplIsXlsm Then codeOK = True: Exit Function
        GoiYInject = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: Excel chan chen macro -> chon ma CHUA tu dien thong tin." & vbCrLf & _
                     "Excel > File > Options > Trust Center > Trust Center Settings > Macro Settings >" & vbCrLf & _
                     "tick 'Trust access to the VBA project object model' roi xuat lai." & vbCrLf & _
                     "(Hoac: doi file mau sang .xlsm va dan code MaGoiY_SheetCode.txt vao sheet thiet bi.)"
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    nL = cM.CountOfLines
    If nL > 0 Then txt = cM.lines(1, nL)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If InStr(1, txt, "AUTO DRAWING - MA GOI Y", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then codeOK = True: Exit Function
    If InStr(1, txt, "Worksheet_Change", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
        codeOK = tplIsXlsm
        GoiYInject = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: sheet trong file mau da co Worksheet_Change rieng -> khong chen macro chon ma."
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    cM.AddFromString GoiYSheetCode()
    codeOK = (Err.Number = 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not codeOK Then GoiYInject = vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Ma goi y: loi khi chen macro chon ma vao file Excel."
End Function

    Dim s As String

    s = s & "    Set rng = d.Range(d.Cells(r, 11), d.Cells(r, 11 + j))" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        .IgnoreBlank = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .InCellDropdown = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .ShowError = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Me.Cells(r, cG).Value = d.Cells(r, 11).Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Dong du lieu (sheet AD_GoiY, cot A..F) cua 1 ma; chua co -> them" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyDataRow(ByVal d As Worksheet, ByVal key As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim f As Range, n As Long, v As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    v = gyInfo.Item(key)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set f = d.Range(""A2:A"" & d.Rows.Count).Find(What:=GyEsc(CStr(v(0))), LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not f Is Nothing Then GyDataRow = f.Row: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    n = d.Cells(d.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If n < 2 Then n = 2" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    d.Cells(n, 1).Value = v(0): d.Cells(n, 2).Value = v(1): d.Cells(n, 3).Value = v(2)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    d.Cells(n, 4).Value = v(3): d.Cells(n, 5).Value = v(4)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    d.Cells(n, 6).Value = CDate(v(5)): d.Cells(n, 6).NumberFormat = ""dd/mm/yyyy""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyDataRow = n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Ky tu dac biet cua Find (~ * ?)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyEsc(ByVal s As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyEsc = Replace(Replace(Replace(s, ""~"", ""~~""), ""*"", ""~*""), ""?"", ""~?"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Nap file lich su mua hang (duong dan o AD_GoiY!I8) 1 lan moi phien: gyInfo(MA IN HOA) = Array(ma, ten, xuat xu," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' don vi, don gia, ngay) cua LAN MUA GAN NHAT; gyIdx(3 ky tu dau cua ma da chuan hoa) = Collection cac ma" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyNap(ByVal d As Worksheet) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As String, wb As Workbook, w As Workbook, sh As Worksheet, ws As Worksheet, wasOpen As Boolean, scr As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim r0 As Long, c As Long, t As String, sg As String, lastR As Long, i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cM As Long, cT As Long, cU As Long, cP As Long, cN As Long, cD As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim vM As Variant, vT As Variant, vU As Variant, vP As Variant, vN As Variant, vD As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim k As String, dt As Double, k3 As String, pr As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not gyInfo Is Nothing Then GyNap = True: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    p = Trim(CStr(d.Range(""I8"").Value))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If p = """" Then Application.StatusBar = ""Ma goi y: chua co duong dan file lich su mua hang (Settings > Purchases)"": Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Dir(p) = """" Then Application.StatusBar = ""Ma goi y: khong tim thay file "" & p: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.StatusBar = ""Ma goi y: dang doc file lich su mua hang...""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    scr = Application.ScreenUpdating" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each w In Application.Workbooks" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If StrComp(w.FullName, p, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then Set wb = w: wasOpen = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next w" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If wb Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set wb = Application.Workbooks.Open(p, 0, True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If wb Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Application.ScreenUpdating = scr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Application.StatusBar = ""Ma goi y: khong mo duoc file "" & p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        For r0 = 1 To 10" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cM = 0: cT = 0: cU = 0: cP = 0: cN = 0: cD = 0" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                        cM = c" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ElseIf sg = ""date"" Or sg = ""ngay"" Or sg = ""ngy"" Or sg = ""ngaymua"" Or sg = ""ngymua"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cD = c" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ElseIf Left(sg, 3) = ""ten"" Or Left(sg, 2) = ""tn"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cT = c" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ElseIf sg = ""dvt"" Or sg = ""vt"" Or sg = ""donvi"" Or sg = ""nv"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cU = c" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ElseIf sg = ""gia"" Or sg = ""gi"" Or sg = ""dongia"" Or sg = ""ngi"" Or sg = ""price"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cP = c" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ElseIf sg = ""nguongoc"" Or sg = ""ngungc"" Or sg = ""xuatxu"" Or sg = ""xutx"" Or sg = ""hang"" Or sg = ""hng"" Or sg = ""maker"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cN = c" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        Next r0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next sh" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not wasOpen Then wb.Close False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = scr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.StatusBar = ""Ma goi y: file lich su mua hang khong co cot MSP / DATE""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "coBang:" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        If cU > 0 Then vU = ws.Range(ws.Cells(r0 + 1, cU), ws.Cells(lastR, cU)).Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If cP > 0 Then vP = ws.Range(ws.Cells(r0 + 1, cP), ws.Cells(lastR, cP)).Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If cN > 0 Then vN = ws.Range(ws.Cells(r0 + 1, cN), ws.Cells(lastR, cN)).Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Set gyIdx = CreateObject(""Scripting.Dictionary"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If IsArray(vM) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = 1 To UBound(vM, 1)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                dt = GyDate(vD(i, 1))" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                If Not gyInfo.Exists(k) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    gyInfo.Add k, Array(Trim(CStr(vM(i, 1))), GyVal(vT, i), GyVal(vN, i), GyVal(vU, i), pr, dt)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                        gyIdx.Item(k3).Add k" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                ElseIf dt >= gyInfo.Item(k)(5) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    gyInfo.Item(k) = Array(Trim(CStr(vM(i, 1))), GyVal(vT, i), GyVal(vN, i), GyVal(vU, i), pr, dt)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyVal(v As Variant, ByVal i As Long) As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyVal = """"" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not IsArray(v) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If IsError(v(i, 1)) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If IsEmpty(v(i, 1)) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If VarType(v(i, 1)) = vbString Then GyVal = Trim(v(i, 1)) Else GyVal = v(i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Ngay mua: o ngay that hoac chu ""dd/mm/yyyy"" (ca ""-"" / "".""); khong doc duoc -> 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyDate(ByVal v As Variant) As Double" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim s As String, pt As Variant, dd As Long, mm As Long, yy As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If IsError(v) Or IsEmpty(v) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If VarType(v) = vbDate Or (IsNumeric(v) And VarType(v) <> vbString) Then GyDate = CDbl(v): Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    s = Trim(CStr(v))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(s, "" "") > 0 Then s = Left(s, InStr(s, "" "") - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    pt = Split(Replace(Replace(s, ""-"", ""/""), ""."", ""/""), ""/"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If UBound(pt) <> 2 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (IsNumeric(pt(0)) And IsNumeric(pt(1)) And IsNumeric(pt(2))) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    dd = CLng(pt(0)): mm = CLng(pt(1)): yy = CLng(pt(2))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If yy < 100 Then yy = yy + 2000" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If mm < 1 Or mm > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyDate = CDbl(DateSerial(yy, mm, dd))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyAscii(ByVal s As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long, ch As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    s = LCase(s)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To Len(s)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ch = Mid(s, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ch >= ""a"" And ch <= ""z"" Then GyAscii = GyAscii & ch" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Chuan hoa ma: in hoa, bo phan ""(...)"", dau cach, ""_"", dau ""-"" o 2 dau" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyNorm(ByVal s As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    s = UCase(Trim(s))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    p = InStr(s, ""("")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If p > 1 Then s = Left(s, p - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    s = Replace(Replace(s, "" "", """"), ""_"", """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While Left(s, 1) = ""-""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        s = Mid(s, 2)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While Right(s, 1) = ""-"" And Len(s) > 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        s = Left(s, Len(s) - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyNorm = s" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Toi da GY_MAX ma gan dung nhat; khong co ma nao -> thu lai sau khi bo doan dau ngan (vd ""C1-"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GySuggest(ByVal dev As String) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim a As String, p As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    a = GyNorm(dev)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set GySuggest = GySug1(a)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If GySuggest.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p = InStr(a, ""-"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If p >= 2 And p <= 4 And Len(a) - p >= 3 Then Set GySuggest = GySug1(Mid(a, p + 1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' Do giong = trung binh (giong ca chuoi) va (trung tu dau / ma ngan hon), lam tron %; giong nhat truoc, cung muc -> mua gan nhat" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GySug1(ByVal a As String) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim b As String, k As Variant, sc As Double, la As Long, lb As Long, pre As Long, i As Long, n As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim kk(1 To GY_MAX) As String, ss(1 To GY_MAX) As Double, dd(1 To GY_MAX) As Double, d As Double, p As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set GySug1 = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    la = Len(a)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If la < 3 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not gyIdx.Exists(Left(a, 3)) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each k In gyIdx.Item(Left(a, 3))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        b = GyNorm(CStr(k)): lb = Len(b)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If lb > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            pre = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do While pre < la And pre < lb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Mid(a, pre + 1, 1) <> Mid(b, pre + 1, 1) Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                pre = pre + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sc = ((1 - GyLev(a, b) / IIf(la > lb, la, lb)) + pre / IIf(la < lb, la, lb)) / 2" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sc = Int(sc * 100 + 0.5) / 100" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If sc >= GY_MIN Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                d = gyInfo.Item(k)(5)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                p = n + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Do While p > 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If ss(p - 1) > sc Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If ss(p - 1) = sc And dd(p - 1) >= d Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    p = p - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If p <= GY_MAX Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    For i = IIf(n < GY_MAX, n, GY_MAX - 1) To p Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        kk(i + 1) = kk(i): ss(i + 1) = ss(i): dd(i + 1) = dd(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    kk(p) = CStr(k): ss(p) = sc: dd(p) = d" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If n < GY_MAX Then n = n + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next k" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        GySug1.Add kk(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' So ky tu phai them / bot / sua de a thanh b (Levenshtein)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GyLev(ByVal a As String, ByVal b As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim la As Long, lb As Long, i As Long, j As Long, p() As Long, c() As Long, cost As Long, v As Long, ch As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    la = Len(a): lb = Len(b)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If la = 0 Then GyLev = lb: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If lb = 0 Then GyLev = la: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReDim p(0 To lb): ReDim c(0 To lb)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For j = 0 To lb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p(j) = j" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next j" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To la" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        c(0) = i: ch = Mid(a, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For j = 1 To lb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Mid(b, j, 1) = ch Then cost = 0 Else cost = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            v = p(j) + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If c(j - 1) + 1 < v Then v = c(j - 1) + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If p(j - 1) + cost < v Then v = p(j - 1) + cost" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            c(j) = v" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next j" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For j = 0 To lb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            p(j) = c(j)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next j" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GyLev = p(lb)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    GoiYSheetCode = s
End Function

' Doc file lich su mua hang (moi lan xuat): info(MA IN HOA) = Array(ma, ten, xuat xu, don vi, don gia, ngay) cua LAN MUA
' GAN NHAT; idx(3 ky tu dau cua ma da chuan hoa) = Collection cac MA IN HOA. Cot tim theo tieu de (MSP, DATE bat buoc)
Private Function LsmhLoad(ByVal xL As Object, ByVal path As String, info As Object, idx As Object, eR As String) As Boolean
    Dim wbL As Object, wsL As Object, sh As Object, r0 As Long, c As Long, t As String, sg As String, oldSec As Long
    Dim cM As Long, cT As Long, cu As Long, cp As Long, cn As Long, cd As Long, lastR As Long, i As Long
    Dim vM As Variant, vT As Variant, vU As Variant, vP As Variant, vn As Variant, vd As Variant
    Dim k As String, d As Double, k3 As String, pr As Variant
    Set info = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set idx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    oldSec = xL.AutomationSecurity
    xL.AutomationSecurity = 3                          ' msoAutomationSecurityForceDisable: khong chay macro cua file nay
    Set wbL = xL.Workbooks.Open(path, 0, True, , , , True)
    xL.AutomationSecurity = oldSec
    On Error GoTo 0
    If wbL Is Nothing Then eR = "khong mo duoc file lich su mua hang:" & vbCrLf & path: Exit Function
    For Each sh In wbL.Worksheets
        For r0 = 1 To 10
            cM = 0: cT = 0: cu = 0: cp = 0: cn = 0: cd = 0
            For c = 1 To 30
                t = ""
                On Error Resume Next
                t = Trim(CStr(sh.Cells(r0, c).Value))
                On Error GoTo 0
                If t <> "" Then
                    sg = AsciiLetters(t)
                    If sg = "msp" Or sg = "masp" Or sg = "mahang" Or sg = "mhng" Then
                        cM = c
                    ElseIf sg = "date" Or sg = "ngay" Or sg = "ngy" Or sg = "ngaymua" Or sg = "ngymua" Then
                        cd = c
                    ElseIf Left(sg, 3) = "ten" Or StrComp(Left(t, 3), DecodeU("T\u00EAn"), vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                        cT = c
                    ElseIf sg = "dvt" Or sg = "donvi" Or StrComp(t, DecodeU("\u0110VT"), vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                        cu = c
                    ElseIf sg = "gia" Or sg = "dongia" Or sg = "price" Or InStr(1, t, DecodeU("gi\u00E1"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                        cp = c
                    ElseIf sg = "nguongoc" Or sg = "ngungc" Or sg = "xuatxu" Or sg = "xutx" Or sg = "hang" Or sg = "maker" Then
                        cn = c
                    End If
                End If
            Next c
            If cM > 0 And cd > 0 Then Set wsL = sh: GoTo coBang
        Next r0
    Next sh
    wbL.Close False
    eR = "file lich su mua hang khong co cot MSP va DATE (hang tieu de)."
    Exit Function
coBang:
    lastR = wsL.Cells(wsL.rows.Count, cM).End(-4162).Row         ' xlUp
    If lastR <= r0 Then wbL.Close False: eR = "file lich su mua hang khong co du lieu.": Exit Function
    vM = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cM), wsL.Cells(lastR, cM)).Value
    vd = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cd), wsL.Cells(lastR, cd)).Value
    If cT > 0 Then vT = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cT), wsL.Cells(lastR, cT)).Value
    If cu > 0 Then vU = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cu), wsL.Cells(lastR, cu)).Value
    If cp > 0 Then vP = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cp), wsL.Cells(lastR, cp)).Value
    If cn > 0 Then vn = wsL.Range(wsL.Cells(r0 + 1, cn), wsL.Cells(lastR, cn)).Value
    wbL.Close False
    For i = 1 To UBound(vM, 1)
        k = ""
        If Not IsError(vM(i, 1)) Then k = UCase(Trim(CStr(vM(i, 1))))
        If k <> "" Then
            d = LsmhDate(vd(i, 1))
            pr = LsVal(vP, i)
            If Not IsNumeric(pr) Or VarType(pr) = vbString Then pr = ""
            If Not info.Exists(k) Then
                info.Add k, Array(Trim(CStr(vM(i, 1))), LsVal(vT, i), LsVal(vn, i), LsVal(vU, i), pr, d)
                k3 = Left(GyNorm(k), 3)
                If k3 <> "" Then
                    If Not idx.Exists(k3) Then idx.Add k3, New Collection
                    idx.Item(k3).Add k
                End If
            ElseIf d >= info.Item(k)(5) Then                       ' lan mua gan hon (cung ngay -> dong sau)
                info.Item(k) = Array(Trim(CStr(vM(i, 1))), LsVal(vT, i), LsVal(vn, i), LsVal(vU, i), pr, d)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    LsmhLoad = (info.Count > 0)
    If Not LsmhLoad Then eR = "file lich su mua hang khong co ma MSP nao."
End Function

' Gia tri dong i cua 1 cot da doc (khong co cot / o loi -> "")
Private Function LsVal(v As Variant, ByVal i As Long) As Variant
    LsVal = ""
    If Not IsArray(v) Then Exit Function
    If IsError(v(i, 1)) Then Exit Function
    If IsEmpty(v(i, 1)) Then Exit Function
    If VarType(v(i, 1)) = vbString Then LsVal = Trim(v(i, 1)) Else LsVal = v(i, 1)
End Function

' Ngay mua: o ngay that hoac chu "dd/mm/yyyy" (ca "dd-mm-yyyy", "dd.mm.yyyy"). Khong doc duoc -> 0
Private Function LsmhDate(ByVal v As Variant) As Double
    Dim s As String, pt As Variant, dd As Long, mm As Long, yy As Long
    If IsError(v) Or IsEmpty(v) Then Exit Function
    If VarType(v) = vbDate Or (IsNumeric(v) And VarType(v) <> vbString) Then LsmhDate = CDbl(v): Exit Function
    s = Trim(CStr(v))
    If InStr(s, " ") > 0 Then s = Left(s, InStr(s, " ") - 1)
    pt = Split(Replace(Replace(s, "-", "/"), ".", "/"), "/")
    If UBound(pt) <> 2 Then Exit Function
    If Not (IsNumeric(pt(0)) And IsNumeric(pt(1)) And IsNumeric(pt(2))) Then Exit Function
    dd = CLng(pt(0)): mm = CLng(pt(1)): yy = CLng(pt(2))
    If yy < 100 Then yy = yy + 2000
    If mm < 1 Or mm > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then Exit Function
    LsmhDate = CDbl(DateSerial(yy, mm, dd))
End Function

' Chuan hoa ma de so: in hoa, bo phan "(...)", dau cach, "_", dau "-" o 2 dau (vd "C-UNCH6-25_" -> "C-UNCH6-25")
Private Function GyNorm(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim p As Long
    s = UCase(Trim(s))
    p = InStr(s, "(")
    If p > 1 Then s = Left(s, p - 1)
    s = Replace(Replace(s, " ", ""), "_", "")
    Do While Left(s, 1) = "-"
        s = mid(s, 2)
    Loop
    Do While Right(s, 1) = "-" And Len(s) > 0
        s = Left(s, Len(s) - 1)
    Loop
    GyNorm = s
End Function

' Toi da GOIY_MAX ma (khoa info) gan dung nhat voi ma thiet bi. Khong co ma nao -> thu lai sau khi bo doan dau
' ngan truoc dau "-" (1-3 ky tu, vd "C1-C-CBSA3-6" -> "C-CBSA3-6")
Private Function GySuggest(ByVal dev As String, info As Object, idx As Object) As Collection
    Dim a As String, p As Long
    a = GyNorm(dev)
    Set GySuggest = GySug1(a, info, idx)
    If GySuggest.Count = 0 Then
        p = InStr(a, "-")
        If p >= 2 And p <= 4 And Len(a) - p >= 3 Then Set GySuggest = GySug1(mid(a, p + 1), info, idx)
    End If
End Function

' a = ma da chuan hoa. Giong nhat truoc (lam tron %), cung muc -> mua gan nhat truoc
Private Function GySug1(ByVal a As String, info As Object, idx As Object) As Collection
    Dim b As String, k As Variant, sc As Double, la As Long, lb As Long, pre As Long, i As Long, n As Long
    Dim kk(1 To GOIY_MAX) As String, ss(1 To GOIY_MAX) As Double, dd(1 To GOIY_MAX) As Double, d As Double, p As Long
    Set GySug1 = New Collection
    la = Len(a)
    If la < 3 Then Exit Function
    If Not idx.Exists(Left(a, 3)) Then Exit Function
    For Each k In idx.Item(Left(a, 3))
        b = GyNorm(CStr(k)): lb = Len(b)
        If lb > 0 Then
            pre = 0
            Do While pre < la And pre < lb
                If mid(a, pre + 1, 1) <> mid(b, pre + 1, 1) Then Exit Do
                pre = pre + 1
            Loop
            sc = ((1 - GyLev(a, b) / IIf(la > lb, la, lb)) + pre / IIf(la < lb, la, lb)) / 2
            sc = Int(sc * 100 + 0.5) / 100
            If sc >= GOIY_MIN Then
                d = info.Item(k)(5)
                p = n + 1
                Do While p > 1
                    If ss(p - 1) > sc Then Exit Do
                    If ss(p - 1) = sc And dd(p - 1) >= d Then Exit Do
                    p = p - 1
                Loop
                If p <= GOIY_MAX Then
                    For i = IIf(n < GOIY_MAX, n, GOIY_MAX - 1) To p Step -1
                        kk(i + 1) = kk(i): ss(i + 1) = ss(i): dd(i + 1) = dd(i)
                    Next i
                    kk(p) = CStr(k): ss(p) = sc: dd(p) = d
                    If n < GOIY_MAX Then n = n + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next k
    For i = 1 To n
        GySug1.Add kk(i)
    Next i
End Function

' So ky tu phai them / bot / sua de a thanh b (Levenshtein)
Private Function GyLev(ByVal a As String, ByVal b As String) As Long
    Dim la As Long, lb As Long, i As Long, j As Long, p() As Long, c() As Long, cost As Long, v As Long, ch As String
    la = Len(a): lb = Len(b)
    If la = 0 Then GyLev = lb: Exit Function
    If lb = 0 Then GyLev = la: Exit Function
    ReDim p(0 To lb): ReDim c(0 To lb)
    For j = 0 To lb
        p(j) = j
    Next j
    For i = 1 To la
        c(0) = i: ch = mid(a, i, 1)
        For j = 1 To lb
            If mid(b, j, 1) = ch Then cost = 0 Else cost = 1
            v = p(j) + 1
            If c(j - 1) + 1 < v Then v = c(j - 1) + 1
            If p(j - 1) + cost < v Then v = p(j - 1) + cost
            c(j) = v
        Next j
        For j = 0 To lb
            p(j) = c(j)
        Next j
    Next i
    GyLev = p(lb)
End Function

' Chi giu chu cai ASCII (chu thuong) - so ten file co dau / khong dau
Private Function AsciiLetters(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, ch As String
    s = LCase(s)
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = mid(s, i, 1)
        If ch >= "a" And ch <= "z" Then AsciiLetters = AsciiLetters & ch
    Next i
End Function

' Cot "So bo", "Tong SL", "Ten cum" trong hang tieu de (so sanh co dau, du phong bang chu cai khong dau).
' Chua co cot "Ten cum" -> them ngay sau cot cuoi (cung dinh dang tieu de). Khong thay So bo / Tong SL -> 0
Private Sub TbFindExtraColumns(ByVal ws As Object, ByVal hdr As Long, ByVal cImg As Long, cBo As Long, cTong As Long, cCum As Long)
    Dim c As Long, t As String, sig As String, lastC As Long
    cBo = 0: cTong = 0: cCum = 0
    For c = 1 To 40
        t = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        t = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(hdr, c).Value))
        On Error GoTo 0
        If t <> "" Then
            lastC = c
            sig = AsciiLetters(t)
            If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("S\u1ED1 b\u1ED9"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sig = "sb" Or sig = "sob" Then cBo = c
            If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("T\u1ED5ng SL"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sig = "tngsl" Or sig = "tongsl" Then cTong = c
            If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("T\u00EAn c\u1EE5m"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Or sig = "tncm" Or sig = "tencum" Then cCum = c
        End If
    Next c
    If cCum = 0 Then
        cCum = IIf(lastC > 0, lastC + 1, cImg + 1)
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Cells(hdr, cImg).Copy ws.Cells(hdr, cCum)
        ws.Cells(hdr, cCum).Value = DecodeU("T\u00EAn c\u1EE5m")
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
End Sub

' Tim hang tieu de & cot STT / Ma san pham / SL/Bo / Hinh anh trong file mau (khong thay -> cot mac dinh A, C, F, L)
Private Sub TbFindColumns(ByVal ws As Object, hdr As Long, cSTT As Long, cMa As Long, cSL As Long, cImg As Long)
    Dim r As Long, c As Long, t As String, lastC As Long
    hdr = 0
    For r = 1 To 30
        For c = 1 To 30
            t = ""
            On Error Resume Next
            t = UCase(Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, c).Value)))
            On Error GoTo 0
            If t = "STT" Then hdr = r: cSTT = c: Exit For
        Next c
        If hdr > 0 Then Exit For
    Next r
    If hdr = 0 Then hdr = 7: cSTT = 1
    For c = 1 To 40
        t = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        t = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(hdr, c).Value))
        On Error GoTo 0
        If t <> "" Then lastC = c
        If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("M\u00E3 s\u1EA3n ph\u1EA9m"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Then cMa = c
        If InStr(1, t, "SL/B", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then cSL = c
        If InStr(1, t, DecodeU("H\u00ECnh \u1EA3nh"), vbTextCompare) > 0 Then cImg = c
    Next c
    If cMa = 0 Then cMa = 3
    If cSL = 0 Then cSL = 6
    If cImg = 0 Then
        ' chua co cot "Hinh anh": them ngay sau cot cuoi, cung dinh dang tieu de
        cImg = IIf(lastC > 0, lastC + 1, 12)
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Cells(hdr, cSL).Copy ws.Cells(hdr, cImg)
        ws.Cells(hdr, cImg).Value = DecodeU("H\u00ECnh \u1EA3nh")
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
End Sub

' Chup anh TRUC DO (to bong) cua thiet bi -> file BMP. Mo cua so tai lieu tam thoi roi dong lai
Private Function SnapModelImage(ByVal comp As Object, ByVal f As String) As Boolean
    Dim md As Object, md2 As Object, e As Long, w As Long, tp As Long, t As String, wasVis As Boolean, aErr As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set md = comp.GetModelDoc2
    If md Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    tp = md.GetType
    wasVis = md.Visible
    Set md2 = swApp.OpenDoc6(md.GetPathName, tp, swOpenDocOptions_Silent, "", e, w)
    If md2 Is Nothing Then Set md2 = md
    t = md2.GetTitle
    swApp.ActivateDoc3 t, False, swDontRebuildActiveDoc, aErr
    md2.ShowNamedView2 "*Isometric", 7                     ' swIsometricView
    md2.ViewDisplayShaded
    md2.ViewZoomtofit2
    md2.GraphicsRedraw2
    If Dir(f) <> "" Then Kill f
    SnapModelImage = md2.SaveBMP(f, TB_IMG_PX, TB_IMG_PX)
    If SnapModelImage Then SnapModelImage = (Dir(f) <> "")
    If Not wasVis Then swApp.CloseDoc t                    ' dong cua so vua mo (tai lieu van nap trong cum)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  CUM CON HAN (TH2: cum con nam ngay ben trong 1 cum han trong thu muc BVHAN) -> VE NHU 1 PART
'  - 3 hinh chieu (chinh = dien tich lon nhat, bang, canh), khong BOM, khong balloon, ti le nhu part
'  - Kich thuoc: dung ENGINE CUA PART (bao, bac, vi tri lo, ranh...) tren canh / lo cua MOI chi tiet trong cum
'    (asmDimMode: toa do tung chi tiet doi ve he toa do cum). Khong co hinh cat / ren / vat mep (du lieu rieng cua part)
'===========================================================================
Public Function MakeWeldAsmSheet(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal cfgName As String) As String
    Dim asmPath As String, swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, box As Variant, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Dim i As Long, vIdx As Long, w As Double, h As Double, vName As String, sNum As Double, sDen As Double
    Dim tmpl As String, newDoc As Boolean, swSheet As SldWorks.Sheet, sp As Variant, mx As Double, my As Double
    Dim vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View
    Dim hA As Long, hS As Long, vA As Long, vS As Long
    report = ""
    asmPath = asmModel.GetPathName
    If asmPath = "" Then MakeWeldAsmSheet = "LOI: cum con chua duoc luu": Exit Function
    nSelFail = 0: nDimFail = 0: nDimCalls = 0: nSlotMarks = 0: nRawCircles = 0
    Set cmPick = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cmLines = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set turnDiaDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set pendingDetail = New Collection: chainSeq = 0
    Set slotFeatSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set thrAxDone = New Collection
    skipHoles = False
    If Not batchMode Or sheetCount = 0 Then Set allDims = New Collection
    dimLog = "LOG GHI KICH THUOC (CUM CON HAN - VE NHU PART) - " & Now & vbCrLf

    ' ---- hop bao cum (he toa do cum) ----
    If cfgName <> "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        asmModel.ShowConfiguration2 cfgName
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    box = swAsm.GetBox(0)
    If Not IsArray(box) Then MakeWeldAsmSheet = "LOI: khong doc duoc kich thuoc bao cua cum con": Exit Function
    partBox = box
    dx = Abs(box(3) - box(0)): dy = Abs(box(4) - box(1)): dz = Abs(box(5) - box(2))
    For i = 0 To 2
        Set axDone(i) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        axOverall(i) = False
    Next i
    ' hinh chinh = huong nhin co DIEN TICH LON NHAT (giong part dang tam / khoi)
    vIdx = 0
    If dx * dz > dx * dy * 1.001 Then vIdx = 1
    If dz * dy > IIf(vIdx = 1, dx * dz, dx * dy) * 1.001 Then vIdx = 2
    mainAx = Choose(vIdx + 1, 2, 1, 0)
    Select Case vIdx
        Case 0: w = dx: h = dy: thick = dz
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Front", ChrW(&H524D) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case 1: w = dx: h = dz: thick = dy
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Top", ChrW(&H4E0A) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case Else: w = dz: h = dy: thick = dx
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Right", ChrW(&H53F3) & ChrW(&H89C6))
    End Select
    ' khong co du lieu rieng cua part (khoi dac, ren, ban tia canh khuat)
    Set partModelRef = Nothing
    partBodies = Empty
    Set threadMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set ctList = Nothing

    ' ---- ti le + sheet ----
    ChooseScale w, h, thick, sNum, sDen
    sc = sNum / sDen
    If swDrawModel Is Nothing Or sheetCount = 0 Then
        tmpl = DRAWING_TEMPLATE
        If tmpl = "" Then tmpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(swDefaultTemplateDrawing)
        Set swDrawModel = swApp.NewDocument(tmpl, swDwgPaperA3size, SHEET_W, SHEET_H)
        If swDrawModel Is Nothing Then MakeWeldAsmSheet = "LOI: khong tao duoc ban ve. Template: " & tmpl: Exit Function
        Set swDraw = swDrawModel
        newDoc = True
        If STANDARD_FILE <> "" Then
            If Dir(STANDARD_FILE) <> "" Then
                On Error Resume Next
                swDrawModel.Extension.LoadDraftingStandard STANDARD_FILE
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
    Else
        EnsureDrawingActive
        If Not AddSheetLikeFirst(sNum, sDen) Then MakeWeldAsmSheet = "LOI: khong kich hoat duoc sheet moi": Exit Function
    End If
    sheetCount = sheetCount + 1
    Set swSheet = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet
    sp = swSheet.GetProperties2
    swSheet.SetProperties2 sp(0), sp(1), sNum, sDen, FIRST_ANGLE, sp(5), sp(6), True
    With swDrawModel.Extension
        .SetUserPreferenceToggle swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForHoles, swDetailingNoOptionSpecified, True
        .SetUserPreferenceToggle swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForSlots, swDetailingNoOptionSpecified, True
    End With

    ' ---- 3 hinh chieu nhu part: CHINH, DUOI (bang), PHAI (canh) ----
    mx = 0.08 + w * sc / 2
    my = SHEET_H - 0.065 - h * sc / 2
    Set vMain = swDraw.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3(asmPath, vName, mx, my, 0)
    If vMain Is Nothing Then
        If newDoc Then CloseNewDrawing: sheetCount = 0
        MakeWeldAsmSheet = "LOI: khong tao duoc hinh chieu chinh cua cum con (" & vName & ")": Exit Function
    End If
    SetViewCfg vMain, cfgName
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    Set vBelow = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(mx, my - h * sc / 2 - 0.035 - thick * sc / 2, 0, False)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    Set vRight = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(mx + w * sc / 2 + 0.045 + thick * sc / 2, my, 0, False)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    If AUTO_SCALE Then
        AutoScaleAndLayout vMain, vBelow, vRight, sNum, sDen
    Else
        LayoutViews vMain, vBelow, vRight
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    InitOccupancy vMain, vBelow, vRight
    SetDatumSigns vMain

    ' ---- kich thuoc: engine cua part tren hinh chieu cum (giong luong part tam / khoi) ----
    asmDimMode = True
    Set compXf = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set compNm = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error GoTo dimFail
    ViewAxes vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS
    DimensionPlateView vMain, mainAx, True, False, True, "Chinh", True, 0, 0, IIf(DIM_STYLE = 3, 0, 1)
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vBelow, vA, False, False, True, "Duoi"
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vRight, hA, False, True, True, "Phai"
    If DIM_STYLE <> 3 Then DimensionPlateView vMain, mainAx, True, False, False, "Chinh (bo sung)", True, 0, 0, 2
    report = report & StyleOrdinateMain(vMain, vBelow, vRight, False)
    On Error GoTo 0
    GoTo dimDone
dimFail:
    report = report & "LOI engine kich thuoc cum con han: " & Err.Description & " (giu cac kich thuoc da ghi)" & vbCrLf
    Resume dimDone
dimDone:
    AsmDimEnd
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    If Not batchMode Then
        If DELETE_EMPTY_VIEWS Then DeleteEmptyViews
        If CLEANUP_DIMS Then report = report & CleanupAllSheets()
        If AUTO_ARRANGE Then report = report & SapXepTatCaSheet() & vbCrLf
    End If
    MakeWeldAsmSheet = "Sheet " & sheetCount & " (cum con han - ve nhu part)" & vbCrLf & "Ti le: " & sNum & ":" & sDen & _
                       "   |   Hinh chinh: " & vName & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & report & "Loi chon/tao: " & nSelFail & "/" & nDimFail
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  GHI CHU HAN (goc duoi-trai kho giay)
'===========================================================================
' Thuoc tinh MATERIAL cua chi tiet: tab Configuration Specific (cfg; rong -> configuration dang dung), roi tab Custom.
' Khong co -> "" (khong ghi note)
Public Function MaterialOf(pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal cfg As String) As String
    Dim cpm As SldWorks.CustomPropertyManager, v As String, rv As String, nm As Variant
    If pm Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    If cfg = "" Then cfg = pm.ConfigurationManager.ActiveConfiguration.Name
    For Each nm In Array(cfg, "")
        Set cpm = Nothing
        Set cpm = pm.Extension.CustomPropertyManager(CStr(nm))
        If Not cpm Is Nothing Then
            v = "": rv = ""
            cpm.Get4 "MATERIAL", False, v, rv
            If Trim(rv) <> "" Then MaterialOf = Trim(rv): Exit Function
            If Trim(v) <> "" And Left(Trim(v), 1) <> "$" Then MaterialOf = Trim(v): Exit Function
        End If
    Next nm
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Nhom vat lieu: "AL" = nhom / nhua (MAT_AL_LIST), "ST" = thep / hop kim (MAT_STEEL_LIST), "" = khong xac dinh
Public Function MaterialGroup(ByVal mat As String) As String
    Dim m As String, t As Variant
    m = UCase(Replace(Replace(Trim(mat), " ", ""), vbTab, ""))
    If m = "" Then Exit Function
    For Each t In Split(UCase(Replace(MAT_AL_LIST, " ", "")), ",")
        If t <> "" Then
            If Left(m, Len(t)) = t Then MaterialGroup = "AL": Exit Function
        End If
    Next t
    For Each t In Split(UCase(Replace(MAT_STEEL_LIST, " ", "")), ",")
        If t <> "" Then
            If Left(m, Len(t)) = t Then MaterialGroup = "ST": Exit Function
        End If
    Next t
End Function

' Ghi chu theo vat lieu tren sheet hien hanh (part ngoai BVHAN). Tra ve mo ta cho log
Private Function AddMaterialNote(pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, ByVal cfg As String) As String
    Dim mat As String, g As String
    mat = MaterialOf(pm, cfg)
    If mat = "" Then AddMaterialNote = "note vat lieu: khong co MATERIAL -> khong ghi": Exit Function
    g = MaterialGroup(mat)
    If g = "" Then AddMaterialNote = "note vat lieu: '" & mat & "' chua thuoc nhom nao -> khong ghi": Exit Function
    If AddWeldNote(DecodeU(IIf(g = "AL", MAT_AL_TEXT, MAT_STEEL_TEXT)), WELD_NOTE_Y) Then
        AddMaterialNote = "note vat lieu: " & mat & " -> " & IIf(g = "AL", "nhom / nhua", "thep / hop kim")
    Else
        AddMaterialNote = "note vat lieu: LOI chen ghi chu (" & mat & ")"
    End If
End Function

' Noi dung ghi chu: kind "T" -> WELD_TONG_TEXT ("BV HAN TONG"), "C" -> WELD_CON_TEXT ("BV HAN CON")
Public Function WeldText(ByVal kind As String) As String
    WeldText = DecodeU(IIf(kind = "T", WELD_TONG_TEXT, WELD_CON_TEXT))
End Function

Public Function WeldTag(ByVal kind As String) As String
    WeldTag = IIf(kind = "T", "BV HAN TONG", "BV HAN CON")
End Function

' "\u1EBF" -> ky tu Unicode tuong ung (viet tieng Viet co dau trong file macro chi dung ASCII)
Public Function DecodeU(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, r As String, h As String
    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(s)
        If mid(s, i, 2) = "\n" Then                       ' xuong dong
            r = r & vbCrLf
            i = i + 2
            GoTo nextCh
        End If
        If mid(s, i, 2) = "\u" And i + 5 <= Len(s) Then
            h = mid(s, i + 2, 4)
            If h Like "[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]" Then
                r = r & ChrW(CLng("&H" & h))
                i = i + 6
                GoTo nextCh
            End If
        End If
        r = r & mid(s, i, 1)
        i = i + 1
nextCh:
    Loop
    DecodeU = r
End Function

' Ghi chu tren TO GIAY cua sheet dang mo (KHONG gan vao hinh chieu -> khong di theo hinh chieu), CHI 1 LAN:
' hang dau tien cach mep giay trai WELD_NOTE_X, mep tren hang dau cach mep duoi yTop; font WELD_NOTE_FONT, co WELD_NOTE_PT.
' Chen 1 lan sau khi bo kich hoat hinh chieu; neu SolidWorks van gan vao hinh chieu -> xoa (kiem tra da xoa)
' roi chen 1 lan trong SHEET FORMAT (luon co dinh). Khong xoa duoc -> giu nguyen (khong chen them).
Private Function AddWeldNote(ByVal txt As String, ByVal yTop As Double) As Boolean
    Dim nt As Object, shName As String, sv As Object, t0 As String, p0 As Variant, where As String
    On Error Resume Next
    EnsureDrawingActive
    shName = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName
    ' bo kich hoat hinh chieu: kich hoat "hinh" to giay + kich hoat lai sheet
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    Set sv = Nothing
    Set sv = swDraw.GetFirstView
    If Not sv Is Nothing Then swDraw.ActivateView sv.GetName2
    swDraw.ActivateSheet shName
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    Set nt = Nothing
    Set nt = swDrawModel.InsertNote(txt)
    If nt Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "LOI: khong chen duoc ghi chu han" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    FormatPlaceWeldNote nt, yTop
    where = "to giay"
    t0 = "": t0 = nt.GetText
    p0 = Empty: p0 = nt.GetAnnotation.GetPosition
    If NoteAtInModelView(t0, p0) Then
        ' bi gan vao hinh chieu -> xoa
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        nt.GetAnnotation.Select3 False, Nothing
        swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
        If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > 0 Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If NoteAtInModelView(t0, p0) Then
            where = "hinh chieu (khong xoa duoc - giu 1 ghi chu)"
        Else
            ' da xoa -> chen 1 lan trong Sheet Format
            swDraw.EditTemplate
            Set nt = Nothing
            Set nt = swDrawModel.InsertNote(txt)
            If Not nt Is Nothing Then FormatPlaceWeldNote nt, yTop
            swDraw.EditSheet
            where = IIf(nt Is Nothing, "LOI chen trong sheet format", "sheet format")
        End If
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    dimLog = dimLog & "Ghi chu han: " & where & vbCrLf
    AddWeldNote = (InStr(where, "LOI") = 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Font, co chu & vi tri: HANG DAU TIEN (goc TREN-trai cua chu) tai WELD_NOTE_X, yTop tren giay
Private Sub FormatPlaceWeldNote(ByVal nt As Object, ByVal yTop As Double)
    Dim ann As Object, tf As Object, ext As Variant, pos As Variant, dx As Double, dy As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ann = nt.GetAnnotation
    Set tf = Nothing
    Set tf = ann.GetTextFormat(0)
    If Not tf Is Nothing Then
        tf.TypeFaceName = WELD_NOTE_FONT
        tf.CharHeightInPts = WELD_NOTE_PT
        ann.SetTextFormat 0, False, tf
    End If
    ' vi tri ghi chu = goc TREN-trai chu -> dat, do khung chu thuc, chinh cho mep trai / mep tren dung cho
    ann.SetPosition WELD_NOTE_X, yTop, 0
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    ext = Empty
    ext = nt.GetExtent
    If IsArray(ext) Then
        dx = WELD_NOTE_X - ext(0): dy = yTop - ext(4)
        If Abs(dx) > 0.0001 Or Abs(dy) > 0.0001 Then
            pos = Empty
            pos = ann.GetPosition
            If IsArray(pos) Then ann.SetPosition pos(0) + dx, pos(1) + dy, 0
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Co ghi chu (cung noi dung, cung vi tri) nam trong hinh chieu model nao cua sheet dang mo khong?
Private Function NoteAtInModelView(ByVal txt As String, ByVal p0 As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim vw As Object, nxV As Object, nt As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, gv As Long, pos As Variant
    If Not IsArray(p0) Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    Set vw = swDraw.GetFirstView                  ' view dau = to giay -> bat dau tu view thu 2
    If Not vw Is Nothing Then Set vw = vw.GetNextView
    Do While Not vw Is Nothing And gv < 500
        gv = gv + 1
        Set nt = Nothing
        Set nt = vw.GetFirstNote
        g = 0
        Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
            g = g + 1
            If nt.GetText = txt Then
                pos = Empty
                pos = nt.GetAnnotation.GetPosition
                If IsArray(pos) Then
                    If Abs(pos(0) - p0(0)) < 0.0005 And Abs(pos(1) - p0(1)) < 0.0005 Then NoteAtInModelView = True: Exit Function
                End If
            End If
            Set nx = Nothing
            Set nx = nt.GetNext
            Set nt = nx
        Loop
        Set nxV = Nothing
        Set nxV = vw.GetNextView
        Set vw = nxV
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  THU TU CAY FeatureManager
'===========================================================================
' Khoa sap xep cua 1 component (ngu canh cum tong): so thu tu o MOI cap, vd "00005.00002."
' -> cum con dung truoc cac chi tiet ben trong no; chi tiet trong cum con theo cay cua cum con
Private Function TreeKey(ByVal comp As Object, ByVal topDoc As Object) As String
    Dim chain As New Collection, c As Object, nx As Object, guard As Long, i As Long
    Dim doc As Object, d As Object, nm As String, ix As Long, key As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Set c = comp
    Do While Not c Is Nothing And guard < 50
        guard = guard + 1
        If chain.Count = 0 Then chain.Add c Else chain.Add c, , 1
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = c.GetParent
        Set c = nx
    Loop
    Set doc = topDoc
    For i = 1 To chain.Count
        ix = 99999
        If Not doc Is Nothing Then
            Set d = Nothing
            Set d = TreeOrderOf(doc)
            nm = LCase(LastSeg(chain(i).Name2))
            If Not d Is Nothing Then
                If d.Exists(nm) Then ix = d.Item(nm)
            End If
        End If
        key = key & Format(ix, "00000") & "."
        Set doc = Nothing
        Set doc = chain(i).GetModelDoc2                  ' cap duoi: cay cua cum con
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    TreeKey = key
End Function

' So thu tu component trong cay FeatureManager cua 1 assembly (ten component chu thuong -> so)
Private Function TreeOrderOf(ByVal doc As Object) As Object
    Dim d As Object, f As Object, nx As Object, n As Long, key As String, guard As Long
    If treeCache Is Nothing Then Set treeCache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    key = LCase(doc.GetPathName)
    If treeCache.Exists(key) Then Set TreeOrderOf = treeCache.Item(key): Exit Function
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = doc.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And guard < 200000
        guard = guard + 1
        TreeOrderAdd f, d, n, 0
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = f.GetNextFeature
        Set f = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
    treeCache.Add key, d
    Set TreeOrderOf = d
End Function

Private Sub TreeOrderAdd(ByVal f As Object, d As Object, n As Long, ByVal depth As Long)
    Dim tn As String, comp As Object, nm As String, fo As Object, subF As Variant, i As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    tn = f.GetTypeName2
    If tn = "Reference" Then
        Set comp = f.GetSpecificFeature2
        nm = ""
        If Not comp Is Nothing Then nm = comp.Name2
        If nm = "" Then nm = f.Name
        nm = LCase(LastSeg(nm))
        n = n + 1
        If Not d.Exists(nm) Then d.Add nm, n
    ElseIf tn = "FtrFolder" And depth < 10 Then
        ' thu muc: cac component ben trong theo thu tu tai vi tri thu muc
        Set fo = f.GetSpecificFeature2
        subF = Empty
        If Not fo Is Nothing Then subF = fo.GetFeatures
        If IsArray(subF) Then
            For i = LBound(subF) To UBound(subF)
                TreeOrderAdd subF(i), d, n, depth + 1
            Next i
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Doan cuoi cua ten component ("Cum-1/ChiTiet-1" -> "ChiTiet-1")
Private Function LastSeg(ByVal s As String) As String
    LastSeg = mid(s, InStrRev(s, "/") + 1)
End Function

' Ban lap khac cua cung file: giu vi tri NHO NHAT (xuat hien dau tien trong cay)
Private Sub KeepFirstKey(dict As Object, ByVal k As String, ByVal tk As String)
    Dim it As Variant
    it = dict.Item(k)
    If tk < it(3) Then
        it(3) = tk
        dict.Item(k) = it
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
'  BAN VE LAP (cum tong & moi cum con, tuy chon ASM_SHEET):
'  3 hinh chieu (chinh = huong dien tich lon nhat) + kich thuoc bao, truc do mang balloon,
'  BOM Top-level goc tren-phai (BOM cao -> goc tren-trai). Bo cuc:
'    BOM + truc do: cot ben phai (tren khung ten) | 3 hinh chieu: phan con lai, ti le tu dong
'===========================================================================
Public Function MakeAssemblySheet(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, Optional ByVal cfgName As String = "") As String
    Dim asmPath As String, tmpl As String, msg As String
    asmPath = asmModel.GetPathName
    If sheetCount = 0 Or swDrawModel Is Nothing Then Set allDims = New Collection
    dimLog = dimLog & "BAN VE LAP: " & asmPath & IIf(cfgName <> "", " [" & cfgName & "]", "") & vbCrLf

    ' ---- hop bao cum (toa do assembly) -> hinh chinh = huong co DIEN TICH LON NHAT (giong chi tiet) ----
    Dim swAsm As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc, box As Variant, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Dim vIdx As Long, w As Double, h As Double, t As Double, vName As String
    Set swAsm = asmModel
    On Error Resume Next
    box = swAsm.GetBox(0)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(box) Then MakeAssemblySheet = "LOI: khong doc duoc hop bao cua cum": Exit Function
    partBox = box                                   ' GetViewBox / PlaceCluster dung hop bao nay
    dx = Abs(box(3) - box(0)): dy = Abs(box(4) - box(1)): dz = Abs(box(5) - box(2))
    vIdx = 0
    If dx * dz > dx * dy * 1.001 Then vIdx = 1
    If dz * dy > IIf(vIdx = 1, dx * dz, dx * dy) * 1.001 Then vIdx = 2
    Select Case vIdx
        Case 0: w = dx: h = dy: t = dz
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Front", ChrW(&H524D) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case 1: w = dx: h = dz: t = dy
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Top", ChrW(&H4E0A) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case Else: w = dz: h = dy: t = dx
                vName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Right", ChrW(&H53F3) & ChrW(&H89C6))
    End Select

    ' ---- sheet: ban ve moi (sheet dau) hoac sheet moi giong sheet dau ----
    Dim sNum As Double, sDen As Double, newDoc As Boolean
    ChooseScale w, h, t, sNum, sDen
    If swDrawModel Is Nothing Or sheetCount = 0 Then
        tmpl = DRAWING_TEMPLATE
        If tmpl = "" Then tmpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(swDefaultTemplateDrawing)
        Set swDrawModel = swApp.NewDocument(tmpl, swDwgPaperA3size, SHEET_W, SHEET_H)
        If swDrawModel Is Nothing Then
            MakeAssemblySheet = "LOI: khong tao duoc ban ve. Template: " & tmpl: Exit Function
        End If
        Set swDraw = swDrawModel
        newDoc = True
        If STANDARD_FILE <> "" Then
            If Dir(STANDARD_FILE) <> "" Then
                On Error Resume Next
                swDrawModel.Extension.LoadDraftingStandard STANDARD_FILE
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
    Else
        EnsureDrawingActive
        If Not AddSheetLikeFirst(sNum, sDen) Then
            MakeAssemblySheet = "LOI: khong kich hoat duoc sheet moi": Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    sheetCount = sheetCount + 1
    Dim swSheet As SldWorks.Sheet, sp As Variant
    Set swSheet = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet
    sp = swSheet.GetProperties2
    swSheet.SetProperties2 sp(0), sp(1), sNum, sDen, FIRST_ANGLE, sp(5), sp(6), True
    sc = sNum / sDen
    ' kho giay THUC cua sheet (template co the la A3 / ANSI B...) -> bo cuc & BOM theo kho giay that
    asmPW = SHEET_W: asmPH = SHEET_H
    If IsArray(sp) Then
        If sp(5) > 0.05 And sp(6) > 0.05 Then asmPW = sp(5): asmPH = sp(6)
    End If

    ' ---- 4 hinh chieu: chinh, bang (duoi), canh (phai) + truc do ----
    Dim vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View, vIso As SldWorks.View
    Set vMain = swDraw.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3(asmPath, vName, asmPW * 0.25, asmPH * 0.65, 0)
    If vMain Is Nothing Then
        If newDoc Then CloseNewDrawing: sheetCount = 0
        MakeAssemblySheet = "LOI: khong tao duoc hinh chieu chinh cua cum (" & vName & ")": Exit Function
    End If
    SetViewCfg vMain, cfgName
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    Set vBelow = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(asmPW * 0.25, asmPH * 0.25, 0, False)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    Set vRight = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(asmPW * 0.5, asmPH * 0.65, 0, False)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    Dim isoName As String
    isoName = FindViewName(asmModel, "Isometric", ChrW(&H7B49) & ChrW(&H8F74) & ChrW(&H6D4B))
    Set vIso = swDraw.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3(asmPath, isoName, asmPW * 0.8, asmPH * 0.45, 0)
    SetViewCfg vBelow, cfgName
    SetViewCfg vRight, cfgName
    SetViewCfg vIso, cfgName
    SetViewHLR vMain: SetViewHLR vBelow: SetViewHLR vRight: SetViewHLR vIso
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False

    ' ---- BOM (Top-level) tren hinh truc do: goc tren-phai (BOM cao -> goc tren-trai) ----
    Dim bom As Object, bomInfo As String, bw As Double, bH As Double, nRow As Long, cfg As String, tall As Boolean
    Dim fx0 As Double, fx1 As Double, fy0 As Double, fy1 As Double, obs As New Collection
    fx0 = FRAME_L: fx1 = asmPW - FRAME_R: fy0 = FRAME_B: fy1 = asmPH - FRAME_T
    cfg = cfgName
    If cfg = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        cfg = vMain.ReferencedConfiguration
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    If Not vIso Is Nothing Then Set bom = InsertAsmBom(vIso, cfg, bomInfo, nRow) Else Set bom = InsertAsmBom(vMain, cfg, bomInfo, nRow)
    If Not bom Is Nothing And ASM_BOM_OUTSIDE Then
        ' BOM NGOAI kho giay: mep trai bang sat mep phai to giay, mep tren ngang mep tren to giay
        PlaceTableTopRight bom, asmPW, asmPH, bw, bH                ' (lan 1: do kich thuoc bang)
