        PlaceTableTopRight bom, asmPW + bw, asmPH, bw, bH
        bomInfo = bomInfo & ", ngoai kho giay (sat mep phai)"
    ElseIf Not bom Is Nothing Then
        PlaceTableTopRight bom, fx1, fy1, bw, bH
        If bH > (fy1 - fy0) - TITLE_H - 0.04 Then
            tall = True
            PlaceTableTopRight bom, fx0 + bw, fy1, bw, bH
            bomInfo = bomInfo & ", goc tren-trai (BOM cao)"
            obs.Add Array(fx0, fy1 - bH, fx0 + bw, fy1)
        Else
            obs.Add Array(fx1 - bw, fy1 - bH, fx1, fy1)
        End If
        If bH > fy1 - fy0 Then bomInfo = bomInfo & " (CAO HON KHUNG: " & nRow & " hang)"
    End If
    obs.Add Array(fx1 - TITLE_W, fy0, fx1, fy0 + TITLE_H)             ' khung ten (goc duoi-phai)

    ' ---- kich thuoc THAT (1:1) cua tung hinh: tu dinh / canh ngoai cung (hop bao cum thuong rong hon) ----
    Dim offM As Variant, offB As Variant, offR As Variant, offI As Variant, dmy As Double
    Dim wM As Double, hM As Double, wR As Double, hB As Double, wI As Double, hi As Double
    AsmGeomInit vMain, offM, wM, hM
    AsmGeomInit vRight, offR, wR, dmy
    AsmGeomInit vBelow, offB, dmy, hB
    AsmGeomInit vIso, offI, wI, hi

    ' ---- bo cuc: 3 hinh chieu sat goc tren-trai; truc do vao VUNG TRONG LON NHAT con lai
    '      (ben phai cum hinh / duoi hinh canh / duoi cum hinh), tranh BOM & khung ten.
    '      Chon cap ti le can doi: truc do >= 2/3 ti le 3 hinh chieu, uu tien ti le lon ----
    Dim ax As Double, at As Double, gx As Double, gy As Double, nums As Variant, dens As Variant
    Dim i As Long, s As Double, sI As Double, score As Double, bestScore As Double, bestI As Long, bestJ As Long
    Dim jI As Long, rI As Variant, bestR As Variant, nTry As Long, sAct As Double
    ax = fx0 + ASM_DIM_ROOM + 0.004: at = fy1 - ASM_DIM_ROOM - 0.004
    If tall Then ax = fx0 + bw + ASM_DIM_ROOM + 0.004
    gx = IIf(wR > 0, ASM_VIEW_GAP, 0): gy = IIf(hB > 0, ASM_VIEW_GAP, 0)
    ScaleList nums, dens, True
    bestI = -1: bestScore = -1
    For i = 0 To UBound(nums)
        s = nums(i) / dens(i)
        If AsmClusterFits(s, ax, at, wM, hM, wR, hB, gx, gy, obs) Then
            jI = AsmIsoRegion(s, ax, at, wM, hM, wR, hB, gx, gy, wI, hi, obs, rI)
            sI = nums(jI) / dens(jI)
            If sI > s Then sI = s: jI = i                               ' truc do khong lon hon 3 hinh chieu
            score = s
            If sI / ASM_ISO_RATIO < score Then score = sI / ASM_ISO_RATIO
            If score > bestScore * 1.000001 Then
                bestScore = score: bestI = i: bestJ = jI: bestR = rI
            End If
            nTry = nTry + 1
            If nTry >= 10 Then Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    If bestI < 0 Then                                                 ' khong vua: ti le nho nhat
        bestI = UBound(nums): bestJ = UBound(nums): bestR = Array(fx0, fy0, fx1 - TITLE_W, fy1)
    End If
    i = bestI: jI = bestJ
    ApplyScale nums(i), dens(i), vMain, vBelow, vRight
    sAct = ViewScale(vMain): sc = sAct
    AsmPlaceViews vMain, vBelow, vRight, offM, offB, offR, ax, at, gx, gy
    If Not vIso Is Nothing Then
        Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
        SetViewScaleCustom vIso, nums(jI), dens(jI)
        AsmGeomRect vIso, offI, xL, xR, yB, yT
        MoveView vIso, (bestR(0) + bestR(2)) / 2 - (xL + xR) / 2, (bestR(1) + bestR(3)) / 2 - (yB + yT) / 2
        swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    End If

    ' ---- kich thuoc BAO: dai + cao (hinh chinh), sau (hinh bang / hinh canh) ----
    Dim nDim As Long, dInfo As String
    nDim = AsmOverallDims(vMain, vBelow, vRight, dInfo)

    ' ---- balloon tu dong tren truc do (sau BOM -> so balloon = so thu tu BOM) ----
    Dim nBal As Long
    If vIso Is Nothing Or UCase(ASM_BALLOON_VIEW) = "MAIN" Then nBal = AutoBalloonView(vMain) Else nBal = AutoBalloonView(vIso)
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2

    msg = "Ti le " & nums(i) & ":" & dens(i) & IIf(vIso Is Nothing, " (khong tao duoc truc do)", _
          " | truc do " & nums(jI) & ":" & dens(jI)) & _
          " | kich thuoc bao: " & nDim & "/3" & dInfo & _
          " | BOM: " & IIf(bom Is Nothing, "LOI - " & bomInfo, bomInfo) & _
          " | balloon: " & IIf(nBal > 0, CStr(nBal), "0 (AutoBalloon khong tao duoc)")
    dimLog = dimLog & msg & vbCrLf
    If bom Is Nothing Then msg = "CANH BAO: " & msg
    MakeAssemblySheet = msg
End Function

' Cau hinh cua hinh chieu (cum con: cau hinh dung trong cum cha)
Private Sub SetViewCfg(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal cfgName As String)
    Dim vo As Object
    If v Is Nothing Or cfgName = "" Then Exit Sub
    Set vo = v
    On Error Resume Next
    If StrComp(vo.ReferencedConfiguration, cfgName, vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then vo.ReferencedConfiguration = cfgName
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' An net khuat (Hidden Lines Removed)
Private Sub SetViewHLR(v As SldWorks.View)
    Dim vo As Object
    If v Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Set vo = v
    On Error Resume Next
    vo.SetDisplayMode3 False, 2, False, True          ' 2 = swHIDDEN
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Ti le RIENG cho 1 hinh (khong theo ti le sheet)
Private Sub SetViewScaleCustom(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal n As Double, ByVal d As Double)
    Dim vo As Object
    If v Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Set vo = v
    On Error Resume Next
    vo.UseSheetScale = False
    vo.ScaleRatio = Array(n, d)
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    If Abs(ViewScale(v) - n / d) > 0.0000001 Then
        vo.ScaleDecimal = n / d
        swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  BO CUC SHEET LAP
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Khung hinh hoc THAT cua hinh (tu dinh / canh ngoai cung) so voi hop bao cum chieu len giay:
' off = do lech 4 canh (don vi 1:1) de tinh lai nhanh sau khi doi ti le / di chuyen; w1, h1 = kich thuoc 1:1
Private Sub AsmGeomInit(v As SldWorks.View, off As Variant, w1 As Double, h1 As Double)
    Dim bxL As Double, bxR As Double, byB As Double, byT As Double, ex As Variant, s As Double
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    off = Array(0#, 0#, 0#, 0#)
    If v Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    s = ViewScale(v)
    GetViewBox v, bxL, bxR, byB, byT
    xL = bxL: xR = bxR: yB = byB: yT = byT
    If AsmExtremes(v, ex) Then
        ' hop le: nam trong hop bao (+5 mm) & >= 40% hop bao (loai truong hop doc sai toa do)
        If ex(1) > bxL - 0.005 And ex(6) < bxR + 0.005 And ex(11) > byB - 0.005 And ex(16) < byT + 0.005 And _
           (ex(6) - ex(1)) > 0.4 * (bxR - bxL) And (ex(16) - ex(11)) > 0.4 * (byT - byB) Then
            xL = ex(1): xR = ex(6): yB = ex(11): yT = ex(16)
        End If
    End If
    off = Array((xL - bxL) / s, (bxR - xR) / s, (yB - byB) / s, (byT - yT) / s)
    w1 = (xR - xL) / s: h1 = (yT - yB) / s
End Sub

Private Sub AsmGeomRect(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal off As Variant, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double)
    Dim s As Double
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    s = ViewScale(v)
    xL = xL + off(0) * s: xR = xR - off(1) * s: yB = yB + off(2) * s: yT = yT - off(3) * s
End Sub

' Dat hinh chinh (goc tren-trai hinh hoc tai aX, aT), hinh canh ben phai cach gx, hinh bang ben duoi cach gy
Private Sub AsmPlaceViews(vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View, ByVal offM As Variant, _
                          ByVal offB As Variant, ByVal offR As Variant, ByVal ax As Double, ByVal at As Double, _
                          ByVal gx As Double, ByVal gy As Double)
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double, a As Double, b As Double, c As Double, d As Double
    AsmGeomRect vMain, offM, xL, xR, yB, yT
    MoveView vMain, ax - xL, at - yT
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    AsmGeomRect vMain, offM, xL, xR, yB, yT
    If Not vRight Is Nothing Then
        AsmGeomRect vRight, offR, a, b, c, d
        MoveView vRight, (xR + gx) - a, 0
        swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    End If
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then
        AsmGeomRect vBelow, offB, a, b, c, d
        MoveView vBelow, 0, (yB - gy) - d
        swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    End If
End Sub

' Cac vung bi 3 hinh chieu chiem (ke ca cho kich thuoc bao) o ti le s
Private Function AsmClusterRects(ByVal s As Double, ByVal ax As Double, ByVal at As Double, ByVal wM As Double, _
                                 ByVal hM As Double, ByVal wR As Double, ByVal hB As Double, ByVal gx As Double, _
                                 ByVal gy As Double) As Collection
    Dim c As New Collection, mR As Double, mB As Double
    mR = ax + wM * s: mB = at - hM * s
    c.Add Array(ax - ASM_DIM_ROOM, mB, mR, at + ASM_DIM_ROOM)                  ' hinh chinh + kich thuoc tren / trai
    If wR > 0 Then c.Add Array(mR + gx, mB, mR + gx + wR * s, at + IIf(hB > 0, 0, ASM_DIM_ROOM))
    If hB > 0 Then c.Add Array(ax - ASM_DIM_ROOM, mB - gy - hB * s, mR, mB - gy) ' hinh bang + kich thuoc trai
    Set AsmClusterRects = c
End Function

' 3 hinh chieu o ti le s: nam trong khung & khong de len BOM / khung ten?
' (asmPW / asmPH = kho giay thuc, dat trong MakeAssemblySheet)
Private Function AsmClusterFits(ByVal s As Double, ByVal ax As Double, ByVal at As Double, ByVal wM As Double, _
                                ByVal hM As Double, ByVal wR As Double, ByVal hB As Double, ByVal gx As Double, _
                                ByVal gy As Double, obs As Collection) As Boolean
    Dim r As Variant, o As Variant
    For Each r In AsmClusterRects(s, ax, at, wM, hM, wR, hB, gx, gy)
        If r(0) < FRAME_L - 0.0001 Or r(2) > asmPW - FRAME_R + 0.0001 Or _
           r(1) < FRAME_B - 0.0001 Or r(3) > asmPH - FRAME_T + 0.0001 Then Exit Function
        For Each o In obs
            If RectsHit(r, o) Then Exit Function
        Next o
    Next r
    AsmClusterFits = True
End Function

' Vung trong tot nhat cho truc do (ti le lon nhat, chua le balloon). Tra ve chi so ti le; rg = vung
Private Function AsmIsoRegion(ByVal s As Double, ByVal ax As Double, ByVal at As Double, ByVal wM As Double, _
                              ByVal hM As Double, ByVal wR As Double, ByVal hB As Double, ByVal gx As Double, _
                              ByVal gy As Double, ByVal wI As Double, ByVal hi As Double, obs As Collection, _
                              rg As Variant) As Long
    Dim fx0 As Double, fx1 As Double, fy0 As Double, fy1 As Double, mR As Double, mB As Double
    Dim rR As Double, bB As Double, m As Double, cand As New Collection, outC As Collection
    Dim allObs As New Collection, c As Variant, r As Variant, idx As Long, ar As Double, bestAr As Double
    fx0 = FRAME_L: fx1 = asmPW - FRAME_R: fy0 = FRAME_B: fy1 = asmPH - FRAME_T
    m = 0.006
    mR = ax + wM * s: mB = at - hM * s
    rR = mR: If wR > 0 Then rR = mR + gx + wR * s
    bB = mB: If hB > 0 Then bB = mB - gy - hB * s
    cand.Add Array(rR + m, fy0, fx1, fy1)                                  ' ben phai cum hinh
    cand.Add Array(mR + m, fy0, fx1, mB - m)                               ' duoi hinh canh, phai hinh bang
    cand.Add Array(fx0, fy0, fx1, bB - ASM_DIM_ROOM * 0.5)                 ' duoi cum hinh
    For Each c In obs
        allObs.Add c
    Next c
    For Each c In AsmClusterRects(s, ax, at, wM, hM, wR, hB, gx, gy)
        allObs.Add c
    Next c
    AsmIsoRegion = 9999: bestAr = -1
    rg = Array(fx0, fy0, fx1, fy1)
    For Each c In cand
        Set outC = New Collection
        ClipRects c, allObs, 1, outC
        For Each r In outC
            idx = AsmFitIndex(wI, hi, (r(2) - r(0)) - 2 * ASM_BALLOON_ROOM, (r(3) - r(1)) - 2 * ASM_BALLOON_ROOM)
            ar = (r(2) - r(0)) * (r(3) - r(1))
            If idx < AsmIsoRegion Or (idx = AsmIsoRegion And ar > bestAr) Then
                AsmIsoRegion = idx: rg = r: bestAr = ar
            End If
        Next r
    Next c
    If AsmIsoRegion = 9999 Then
        Dim nums As Variant, dens As Variant
        ScaleList nums, dens, True
        AsmIsoRegion = UBound(nums)
    End If
End Function

' Cat vung r cho khong de len cac vat can (moi vat can: thu cat 4 phia) -> cac vung con lai vao outC
Private Sub ClipRects(ByVal r As Variant, obs As Collection, ByVal k As Long, outC As Collection)
    Dim o As Variant, q As Variant
    If r(2) - r(0) < 0.02 Or r(3) - r(1) < 0.02 Then Exit Sub
    If k > obs.Count Then
        outC.Add r
        Exit Sub
    End If
    o = obs.Item(k)
    If Not RectsHit(r, o) Then
        ClipRects r, obs, k + 1, outC
        Exit Sub
    End If
    q = r: q(2) = o(0): ClipRects q, obs, k + 1, outC        ' vat can ben phai
    q = r: q(0) = o(2): ClipRects q, obs, k + 1, outC        ' vat can ben trai
    q = r: q(3) = o(1): ClipRects q, obs, k + 1, outC        ' vat can phia tren
    q = r: q(1) = o(3): ClipRects q, obs, k + 1, outC        ' vat can phia duoi
End Sub

Private Function RectsHit(ByVal a As Variant, ByVal b As Variant) As Boolean
    RectsHit = (a(0) < b(2) - 0.0001 And a(2) > b(0) + 0.0001 And a(1) < b(3) - 0.0001 And a(3) > b(1) + 0.0001)
End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  KICH THUOC BAO CUA CUM: bat vao dinh / canh ngoai cung nhin thay tren hinh chieu
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function AsmOverallDims(vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View, _
                                info As String) As Long
    Dim ex As Variant
    If AsmExtremes(vMain, ex) Then
        If AsmDimExt(vMain, ex, True, info) Then AsmOverallDims = AsmOverallDims + 1      ' dai
        If AsmDimExt(vMain, ex, False, info) Then AsmOverallDims = AsmOverallDims + 1     ' cao
    Else
        info = info & " (hinh chinh: khong doc duoc dinh/canh)"
    End If
    If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then
        If AsmExtremes(vBelow, ex) Then
            If AsmDimExt(vBelow, ex, False, info) Then AsmOverallDims = AsmOverallDims + 1  ' sau (doc tren hinh bang)
        End If
    ElseIf Not vRight Is Nothing Then
        If AsmExtremes(vRight, ex) Then
            If AsmDimExt(vRight, ex, True, info) Then AsmOverallDims = AsmOverallDims + 1   ' sau (ngang tren hinh canh)
        End If
    End If
End Function

' Bien ngoai cung tren giay cua hinh chieu cum. Moi bien 5 gia tri (thu tu xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax):
'   ex(5k) = doi tuong, ex(5k+1) = toa do bien, ex(5k+2) = loai, ex(5k+3), ex(5k+4) = diem bat tren giay
' loai: 0 = dinh, 1 = canh tron nhin nghieng (thanh doan thang), 2 = duong tron nhin thang (bien = tam +- r)
Private Function AsmExtremes(v As SldWorks.View, ex As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim comps As Variant, cI As Long, comp As Object, xfV As Object, xfC As Object, ol As Variant
    Dim ents As Variant, i As Long, p As Variant, e As SldWorks.edge, c As Object, cp As Variant
    Dim uu As Variant, ww As Variant, pts As Collection, it As Variant, inA As Long, inB As Long, useA As Boolean
    Dim a As Variant, sv As Double, best(3) As Variant, k As Long, j As Long, oe() As Variant
    ex = Empty
    If v Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    ol = v.GetOutline
    Set xfV = v.ModelToViewTransform
    comps = v.GetVisibleComponents
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(comps) Or IsEmpty(ol) Then Exit Function
    sv = ViewScale(v)
    ' Cum con: lay tung CHI TIET ben trong (dinh / canh cua cum con khong doc truc tiep duoc)
    Dim leaf As New Collection
    For cI = 0 To UBound(comps)
        AddLeafComps comps(cI), leaf, 0
    Next cI
    For Each comp In leaf
        Set xfC = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set xfC = comp.Transform2
        On Error GoTo 0
        ' ung vien: Array(doi tuong, loai, tam/diem, diem tren duong tron (u), diem tren duong tron (w), ban kinh)
        Set pts = New Collection
        ents = Empty
        On Error Resume Next
        ents = v.GetVisibleEntities2(comp, swViewEntityType_Vertex)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If IsArray(ents) Then
            For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
                p = Empty
                On Error Resume Next
                p = ents(i).GetPoint
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not IsEmpty(p) Then pts.Add Array(ents(i), 0, Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2)), Empty, Empty, 0#)
            Next i
        End If
        ents = Empty
        On Error Resume Next
        ents = v.GetVisibleEntities2(comp, swViewEntityType_Edge)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If IsArray(ents) Then
            For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
                Set e = Nothing: Set c = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                Set e = ents(i)
                Set c = e.GetCurve
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not c Is Nothing Then
                    If c.IsCircle Then
                        cp = c.CircleParams              ' tam (0-2), truc (3-5), ban kinh (6)
                        CirclePlaneAxes cp(3), cp(4), cp(5), uu, ww
                        pts.Add Array(e, IIf(IsFullCircle(e), 2, 1), Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2)), _
                                      Dbl3(cp(0) + cp(6) * uu(0), cp(1) + cp(6) * uu(1), cp(2) + cp(6) * uu(2)), _
                                      Dbl3(cp(0) + cp(6) * ww(0), cp(1) + cp(6) * ww(1), cp(2) + cp(6) * ww(2)), cp(6))
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
        End If
        If pts.Count > 0 Then
            ' Toa do: khong gian component (qua Transform2) hay khong gian cum -> chon cach cho diem NAM TRONG hinh
            inA = 0: inB = 0
            For Each it In pts
                a = AsmProj(it(2), xfC, xfV, True)
                If InOutline(a, ol) Then inA = inA + 1
                a = AsmProj(it(2), xfC, xfV, False)
                If InOutline(a, ol) Then inB = inB + 1
            Next it
            useA = (inA >= inB) And Not xfC Is Nothing
            For Each it In pts
                AsmAddCand it, xfC, xfV, useA, sv, best
            Next it
        End If
    Next comp
    For k = 0 To 3
        If IsEmpty(best(k)) Then Exit Function
    Next k
    ' mang ket qua RIENG kieu Variant (bien a dang giu mang Double tu phep chieu -> khong gan doi tuong duoc)
    ReDim oe(19)
    For k = 0 To 3
        Set oe(5 * k) = best(k)(0)
        For j = 1 To 4
            oe(5 * k + j) = best(k)(j)
        Next j
    Next k
    ex = oe
    AsmExtremes = True
End Function

' Gom cac chi tiet (component khong co con) cua 1 component; bo qua component bi an / suppress
Private Sub AddLeafComps(ByVal c As Object, col As Collection, ByVal depth As Long)
    Dim ch As Variant, i As Long, hasCh As Boolean
    If c Is Nothing Or depth > 20 Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    If c.IsSuppressed Then Exit Sub
    If c.Visible = 0 Then Exit Sub                         ' swComponentHidden
    ch = Empty
    ch = c.GetChildren
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsArray(ch) Then
        For i = LBound(ch) To UBound(ch)
            hasCh = True
            AddLeafComps ch(i), col, depth + 1
        Next i
    End If
    If Not hasCh Then col.Add c
End Sub

' Cap nhat bien (0 = xMin, 1 = xMax, 2 = yMin, 3 = yMax) voi 1 ung vien
Private Sub AsmAddCand(ByVal it As Variant, ByVal xfC As Object, ByVal xfV As Object, ByVal useA As Boolean, _
                       ByVal sv As Double, best() As Variant)
    Dim c0 As Variant, cu As Variant, cw As Variant, hx As Double, hy As Double, rs As Double, kind As Long
    c0 = AsmProj(it(2), xfC, xfV, useA)
    kind = it(1)
    If kind = 0 Then
        AsmTakeExt best, 0, it(0), c0(0), 0, False, c0(0), c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 1, it(0), c0(0), 0, True, c0(0), c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 2, it(0), c0(1), 0, False, c0(0), c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 3, it(0), c0(1), 0, True, c0(0), c0(1)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' canh tron: nua truc elip chieu theo x / y
    cu = AsmProj(it(3), xfC, xfV, useA): cw = AsmProj(it(4), xfC, xfV, useA)
    hx = Sqr((cu(0) - c0(0)) ^ 2 + (cw(0) - c0(0)) ^ 2)
    hy = Sqr((cu(1) - c0(1)) ^ 2 + (cw(1) - c0(1)) ^ 2)
    rs = it(5) * sv
    If rs <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    If hx < 0.02 * rs Then                                         ' nhin nghieng -> doan thang dung: bien trai/phai
        AsmTakeExt best, 0, it(0), c0(0), 1, False, c0(0), c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 1, it(0), c0(0), 1, True, c0(0), c0(1)
    End If
    If hy < 0.02 * rs Then                                         ' nhin nghieng -> doan thang ngang: bien duoi/tren
        AsmTakeExt best, 2, it(0), c0(1), 1, False, c0(0), c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 3, it(0), c0(1), 1, True, c0(0), c0(1)
    End If
    If kind = 2 And Abs(hx - rs) < 0.02 * rs And Abs(hy - rs) < 0.02 * rs Then   ' duong tron nhin thang
        AsmTakeExt best, 0, it(0), c0(0) - rs, 2, False, c0(0) - rs, c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 1, it(0), c0(0) + rs, 2, True, c0(0) + rs, c0(1)
        AsmTakeExt best, 2, it(0), c0(1) - rs, 2, False, c0(0), c0(1) - rs
        AsmTakeExt best, 3, it(0), c0(1) + rs, 2, True, c0(0), c0(1) + rs
    End If
End Sub

' Giu ung vien xa nhat; bang nhau -> uu tien dinh, roi canh nhin nghieng
Private Sub AsmTakeExt(best() As Variant, ByVal k As Long, ByVal ent As Object, ByVal pv As Double, _
                       ByVal kind As Long, ByVal isMax As Boolean, ByVal qx As Double, ByVal qy As Double)
    Dim cur As Variant, better As Boolean
    If IsEmpty(best(k)) Then
        best(k) = Array(ent, pv, kind, qx, qy)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    cur = best(k)
    If Abs(pv - cur(1)) < 0.0000001 Then
        better = (kind < cur(2))
    ElseIf isMax Then
        better = (pv > cur(1))
    Else
        better = (pv < cur(1))
    End If
    If better Then best(k) = Array(ent, pv, kind, qx, qy)
End Sub

' Diem model -> giay; qua Transform2 cua component (useA) hoac khong
Private Function AsmProj(ByVal pt As Variant, ByVal xfC As Object, ByVal xfV As Object, ByVal useA As Boolean) As Variant
    Dim mp As Object
    Set mp = swMath.CreatePoint(pt)
    If useA And Not xfC Is Nothing Then Set mp = mp.MultiplyTransform(xfC)
    Set mp = mp.MultiplyTransform(xfV)
    AsmProj = mp.ArrayData
End Function

Private Function InOutline(ByVal a As Variant, ByVal ol As Variant) As Boolean
    InOutline = (a(0) > ol(0) - 0.003 And a(0) < ol(2) + 0.003 And a(1) > ol(1) - 0.003 And a(1) < ol(3) + 0.003)
End Function

' 2 vector don vi vuong goc nhau nam trong mat phang duong tron (truc ax, ay, az)
Private Sub CirclePlaneAxes(ByVal ax As Double, ByVal ay As Double, ByVal az As Double, u As Variant, w As Variant)
    Dim hx As Double, hy As Double, hz As Double, ux As Double, uy As Double, uz As Double, L As Double
    If Abs(ax) < 0.9 Then hx = 1 Else hy = 1
    ux = ay * hz - az * hy: uy = az * hx - ax * hz: uz = ax * hy - ay * hx
    L = Sqr(ux * ux + uy * uy + uz * uz)
    If L < 0.000000001 Then L = 1
    ux = ux / L: uy = uy / L: uz = uz / L
    u = Array(ux, uy, uz)
    w = Array(ay * uz - az * uy, az * ux - ax * uz, ax * uy - ay * ux)
End Sub

' Ghi 1 kich thuoc bao (ngang: xMin-xMax, dat tren hinh; doc: yMin-yMax, dat ben trai hinh).
' Cach 1: chon TAI DIEM tren giay (dung ban lap dang nhin thay); cach 2: chon theo doi tuong.
' Gia tri phai bang dung khoang bien do duoc, khong dung -> xoa (khong de kich thuoc sai)
Private Function AsmDimExt(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ex As Variant, ByVal horiz As Boolean, info As String) As Boolean
    Dim b1 As Long, b2 As Long, lo As Double, hi As Double, PX As Double, py As Double, want As Double
    Dim md As Long, dd As Object, hasArc As Boolean
    If horiz Then
        b1 = 0: b2 = 5
        PX = (ex(1) + ex(6)) / 2: py = ex(16) + DIM_FIRST
    Else
        b1 = 10: b2 = 15
        PX = ex(1) - DIM_FIRST: py = (ex(11) + ex(16)) / 2
    End If
    lo = ex(b1 + 1): hi = ex(b2 + 1)
    want = (hi - lo) / ViewScale(v)
    If want < 0.0001 Then Exit Function
    Dim bxL As Double, bxR As Double, byB As Double, byT As Double, bSpan As Double
    GetViewBox v, bxL, bxR, byB, byT
    bSpan = IIf(horiz, bxR - bxL, byT - byB)
    If bSpan > 0 And (hi - lo) < 0.6 * bSpan Then
        info = info & " (" & IIf(horiz, "ngang", "doc") & ": bien do duoc " & Format(want * 1000#, "0.0") & _
               " qua nho so voi hop bao cum -> bo qua)"
        Exit Function
    End If
    hasArc = (ex(b1 + 2) = 2 Or ex(b2 + 2) = 2)
    For md = 1 To 2
        Set dd = AsmMakeDim(v, ex, b1, b2, horiz, PX, py, md)
        If Not dd Is Nothing Then
            If AsmDimValueOk(dd, want, hasArc) Then
                FitPrecision dd
                AsmDimExt = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            DeleteDimension dd
        End If
    Next md
    info = info & " (" & IIf(horiz, "ngang", "doc") & ": khong ghi dung duoc " & Format(want * 1000#, "0.0") & " -> bo qua)"
End Function

' Tao kich thuoc ngang / doc giua 2 bien (md = 1: chon tai diem tren giay, md = 2: chon theo doi tuong)
Private Function AsmMakeDim(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ex As Variant, ByVal b1 As Long, ByVal b2 As Long, _
                            ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal PX As Double, ByVal py As Double, ByVal md As Long) As Object
    Dim ok1 As Boolean, ok2 As Boolean, dd As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If md = 1 Then
        ok1 = AsmPickAt(ex(b1 + 3), ex(b1 + 4), ex(b1 + 2), False)
        If ok1 Then ok2 = AsmPickAt(ex(b2 + 3), ex(b2 + 4), ex(b2 + 2), True)
    Else
        If Not ex(b1) Is ex(b2) Then
            ok1 = SelectInView(v, ex(b1), False, True)
            If ok1 Then ok2 = SelectInView(v, ex(b2), True, True)
        End If
    End If
    If ok1 And ok2 Then
        If horiz Then
            Set dd = swDrawModel.AddHorizontalDimension2(PX, py, 0)
        Else
            Set dd = swDrawModel.AddVerticalDimension2(PX, py, 0)
        End If
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set AsmMakeDim = dd
End Function

' Chon dinh / canh tai diem (x, y) tren giay
Private Function AsmPickAt(ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ByVal kind As Long, ByVal appendSel As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim tp As String, i As Long, dx As Variant, dy As Variant
    tp = IIf(kind = 0, "VERTEX", "EDGE")
    dx = Array(0#, 0.0001, -0.0001, 0#, 0#)
    dy = Array(0#, 0#, 0#, 0.0001, -0.0001)
    For i = 0 To 4
        If swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2("", tp, X + dx(i), Y + dy(i), 0, appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0) Then
            AsmPickAt = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function

' Gia tri kich thuoc = khoang bien mong muon? (bien la duong tron: thu chuyen diem bat tu tam ra mep)
Private Function AsmDimValueOk(ByVal dd As Object, ByVal want As Double, ByVal hasArc As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim cur As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    cur = -1
    cur = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Abs(cur - want) < 0.00005 Then
        AsmDimValueOk = True
    ElseIf hasArc Then
        AsmDimValueOk = FixArcExtreme(dd, want)
    End If
End Function

' Kich thuoc toi duong tron: thu cac kieu bat (tam / gan / xa) cho den khi dung gia tri mong muon
Private Function FixArcExtreme(ByVal dd As Object, ByVal want As Double) As Boolean
    Dim cur As Double, ix As Long, cn As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    For ix = 0 To 2
        For cn = 0 To 3
            Err.Clear
            dd.SetArcEndCondition ix, cn
            If Err.Number = 0 Then
                swDrawModel.EditRebuild3
                cur = -1: cur = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
                If Abs(cur - want) < 0.00005 Then FixArcExtreme = True: Exit Function
            End If
        Next cn
    Next ix
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Chen BOM vao hinh cum (InsertBomTable4, du phong InsertBomTable2).
' Top-level ra bang rong (loi da biet) -> thu lai khong chi dinh cau hinh -> cuoi cung Indented
Private Function InsertAsmBom(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal cfg As String, info As String, nRow As Long) As Object
    Dim vo As Object, bom As Object, tpl As String, bT As Long, tryN As Long, cf As String
    tpl = BomTemplatePath()
    Set vo = v
    For tryN = 1 To 3
        bT = ASM_BOM_TYPE: cf = cfg
        If tryN = 2 Then cf = ""
        If tryN = 3 And ASM_BOM_TYPE = swBomType_TopLevelOnly Then bT = swBomType_Indented
        Set bom = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set bom = vo.InsertBomTable4(False, asmPW - FRAME_R, asmPH - FRAME_T, swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopRight, _
                                     bT, cf, tpl, False, BOM_NUMBERING, False)
        If bom Is Nothing Then
            Err.Clear
            Set bom = vo.InsertBomTable2(False, asmPW - FRAME_R, asmPH - FRAME_T, swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopRight, _
                                         bT, cf, tpl)
        End If
        nRow = 0
        If Not bom Is Nothing Then nRow = bom.RowCount
        On Error GoTo 0
        If bom Is Nothing Then
            info = "khong chen duoc BOM (template: " & IIf(tpl = "", "mac dinh", tpl) & ")"
        Else
            Select Case bT
                Case swBomType_TopLevelOnly: info = "Top-level"
                Case swBomType_PartsOnly: info = "Parts only"
                Case Else: info = "Indented"
            End Select
            info = info & ", " & nRow & " hang" & IIf(bT <> ASM_BOM_TYPE, " (Top-level bi rong)", "")
            If nRow <> 1 Then Exit For                         ' co du lieu (hoac khong doc duoc so hang)
            If tryN < 3 Then DeleteTableAnn bom                ' chi co dong tieu de -> xoa, thu cach khac
        End If
    Next tryN
    Set InsertAsmBom = bom
End Function

' Template BOM: BOM_TEMPLATE, roi bom-standard.sldbomtbt trong thu muc ngon ngu cua SolidWorks
Private Function BomTemplatePath() As String
    Dim p As String, lang As String, ex As String
    If BOM_TEMPLATE <> "" Then
        If Dir(BOM_TEMPLATE) <> "" Then BomTemplatePath = BOM_TEMPLATE: Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    ex = swApp.GetExecutablePath
    lang = swApp.GetCurrentLanguage
    If Right(ex, 1) = "\" Then ex = Left(ex, Len(ex) - 1)
    If lang = "" Then lang = "english"
    p = ex & "\lang\" & lang & "\bom-standard.sldbomtbt"
    If Dir(p) = "" Then p = ex & "\lang\english\bom-standard.sldbomtbt"
    If Dir(p) = "" Then p = ""
    On Error GoTo 0
    BomTemplatePath = p
End Function

' Dat bang (BOM) sao cho goc TREN-PHAI cua bang tai (xR, yT) tren giay; tra ve rong / cao bang
Private Function PlaceTableTopRight(ByVal tb As Object, ByVal xR As Double, ByVal yT As Double, _
                                    w As Double, h As Double) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long, nc As Long, nr As Long, at As Long, PX As Double, py As Double, ann As Object, pos As Variant
    w = 0: h = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    nc = tb.ColumnCount: nr = tb.RowCount
    For i = 0 To nc - 1
        w = w + tb.GetColumnWidth(i)
    Next i
    For i = 0 To nr - 1
        h = h + tb.GetRowHeight(i)
    Next i
    If tb.Anchored Then tb.Anchored = False
    tb.AnchorType = swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopRight
    at = -1
    at = tb.AnchorType
    Select Case at                           ' toa do vi tri = goc NEO cua bang
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_TopLeft: PX = xR - w: py = yT
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_BottomLeft: PX = xR - w: py = yT - h
        Case swBOMConfigurationAnchor_BottomRight: PX = xR: py = yT - h
        Case Else: PX = xR: py = yT
    End Select
    Set ann = tb.GetAnnotation
    ann.SetPosition PX, py, 0
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    pos = Empty: pos = ann.GetPosition
    If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then PlaceTableTopRight = (Abs(pos(0) - PX) < 0.0005 And Abs(pos(1) - py) < 0.0005)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Xoa 1 bang (annotation) khoi ban ve
Private Sub DeleteTableAnn(ByVal tb As Object)
    Dim ann As Object, ok As Boolean
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ann = tb.GetAnnotation
    If Not ann Is Nothing Then
        If ann.Select3(False, Nothing) Then
            ok = swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0)
            If Not ok Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
End Sub

' Chi so ti le LON NHAT (trong ScaleList) de hinh (wv x hv tai 1:1) lot vua aw x ah
Private Function AsmFitIndex(ByVal wv As Double, ByVal hv As Double, ByVal aw As Double, ByVal ah As Double) As Long
    Dim nums As Variant, dens As Variant, i As Long, s As Double
    ScaleList nums, dens, True
    For i = 0 To UBound(nums)
        s = nums(i) / dens(i)
        If wv * s <= aw And hv * s <= ah Then AsmFitIndex = i: Exit Function
    Next i
    AsmFitIndex = UBound(nums)
End Function

' Balloon tu dong cho hinh cum (AutoBalloon5: kieu / co balloon theo tieu chuan ban ve). Tra ve so balloon
Private Function AutoBalloonView(v As SldWorks.View) As Long
    Dim res As Variant
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error Resume Next
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 v.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    On Error GoTo 0
    res = RunAutoBalloon()
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    AutoBalloonView = CountBalloons(v)
    If AutoBalloonView = 0 And IsArray(res) Then AutoBalloonView = UBound(res) - LBound(res) + 1
End Function

' AutoBalloon5 cho cac hinh chieu DANG CHON (kieu / co balloon theo tieu chuan ban ve; moi chi tiet 1 balloon)
Private Function RunAutoBalloon() As Variant
    Dim dOb As Object, opt As Object, res As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dOb = swDraw
    Set opt = dOb.CreateAutoBalloonOptions()
    If Not opt Is Nothing Then
        opt.Layout = swDetailingBalloonLayout_Square        ' xep balloon quanh hinh
        opt.IgnoreMultiple = True                           ' moi chi tiet 1 balloon (so luong xem BOM)
        opt.UpperTextContent = swBalloonTextItemNumber      ' so thu tu trong BOM
        opt.LeaderAttachmentToFaces = BALLOON_ATTACH_FACES   ' duong dan balloon chi vao MAT chi tiet (khong vao canh)
        res = Empty
        res = dOb.AutoBalloon5(opt)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunAutoBalloon = res
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  BALLOON SHEET DANG MO (nut Auto balloon)
'  - Hinh gan balloon: cac hinh chieu DANG CHON (Ctrl+click hinh hoac doi tuong trong hinh truoc khi chay);
'    khong chon -> hinh truc do (khong co -> hinh chieu lon nhat)
'  - delOld = True : xoa MOI balloon BOM tren sheet roi gan lai
'  - delOld = False: giu balloon cu, chi THEM balloon cho chi tiet chua co (SolidWorks bo qua chi tiet da co balloon)
'===========================================================================
Public Function BalloonSheet(ByVal delOld As Boolean) As String
    Dim views As Collection, v As Object, nBefore As Long, nDel As Long, nAfter As Long, names As String
    Dim have As Object, nDup As Long, nNew As Long, src As String
    ' hinh can gan: hinh dang chon luc chay macro -> hinh dang chon hien tai -> mac dinh (truc do / hinh lon nhat)
    Set views = New Collection
    If Not preSelViews Is Nothing Then
        For Each v In preSelViews
            If ViewOnCurrentSheet(v) Then views.Add v
        Next v
    End If
    src = "hinh dang chon"
    If views.Count = 0 Then Set views = SelectedDrawingViews()
    If views.Count = 0 Then
        src = "mac dinh"
        Set v = DefaultBalloonView()
        If v Is Nothing Then BalloonSheet = "LOI: sheet dang mo khong co hinh chieu model.": Exit Function
        views.Add v
    End If
    nBefore = CountSheetBalloons()
    If delOld Then nDel = DeleteSheetBalloons()
    ' so balloon da co tren sheet (khi khong xoa balloon cu: giu lai -> khong gan trung)
    Set have = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If Not delOld Then CollectBalloonItems have
    ' gan LAN LUOT TUNG HINH (AutoBalloon nhieu hinh 1 lan co the chi gan hinh dau)
    For Each v In views
        nNew = nNew + BalloonOneView(v, have, nDup)
        names = names & v.GetName2 & " "
    Next v
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    nAfter = CountSheetBalloons()
    If nAfter = 0 Then
        BalloonSheet = "LOI: AutoBalloon khong tao duoc balloon (hinh: " & Trim(names) & ")."
    Else
        BalloonSheet = IIf(delOld, "Xoa " & nDel & " balloon cu, ", "") & "them " & (nAfter - (nBefore - nDel)) & _
                       " balloon tren " & views.Count & " hinh (" & src & "): " & Trim(names) & _
                       IIf(nDup > 0, " | bo " & nDup & " balloon trung so", "")
    End If
    dimLog = dimLog & BalloonSheet & vbCrLf
End Function

' AutoBalloon cho 1 hinh; balloon moi trung so voi balloon da co tren sheet -> xoa (BALLOON_NO_DUPLICATE)
Private Function BalloonOneView(ByVal v As Object, have As Object, nDup As Long) As Long
    Dim before As Object, nt As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, nm As String, t As String
    Dim dels As New Collection, a As Variant, res As Variant
    Set before = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    ' balloon dang co trong hinh nay (de nhan ra balloon moi)
    Set nt = v.GetFirstNote
    Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
        g = g + 1
        If nt.IsBomBalloon Then before(nt.GetAnnotation.GetName) = 1
        Set nx = Nothing: Set nx = nt.GetNext: Set nt = nx
    Loop
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 v.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    res = RunAutoBalloon()
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    ' balloon moi: ghi nhan so; trung so da co -> xoa
    Set nt = Nothing: Set nt = v.GetFirstNote
    g = 0
    Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
        g = g + 1
        If nt.IsBomBalloon Then
            nm = "": nm = nt.GetAnnotation.GetName
            If Not before.Exists(nm) Then
                t = "": t = Trim(nt.GetText)
                If BALLOON_NO_DUPLICATE And t <> "" And have.Exists(t) Then
                    dels.Add nt.GetAnnotation
                Else
                    If t <> "" Then have(t) = 1
                    BalloonOneView = BalloonOneView + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
        Set nx = Nothing: Set nx = nt.GetNext: Set nt = nx
    Loop
    If dels.Count > 0 Then
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        For Each a In dels
            a.Select3 True, Nothing
        Next a
        If Not swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0) Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        nDup = nDup + dels.Count
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' So (chu) cua moi balloon BOM dang co tren sheet
Private Sub CollectBalloonItems(have As Object)
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, nt As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, t As String
    On Error Resume Next
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsArray(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            Set nt = Nothing: Set nt = vws(j).GetFirstNote
            g = 0
            Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
                g = g + 1
                If nt.IsBomBalloon Then
                    t = "": t = Trim(nt.GetText)
                    If t <> "" Then have(t) = 1
                End If
                Set nx = Nothing: Set nx = nt.GetNext: Set nt = nx
            Loop
        Next j
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Hinh chieu co nam tren sheet dang mo?
Private Function ViewOnCurrentSheet(ByVal v As Object) As Boolean
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, nm As String
    On Error Resume Next
    nm = v.GetName2
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsArray(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            If vws(j).GetName2 = nm Then ViewOnCurrentSheet = True: Exit Function
        Next j
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Hinh TRUC DO (hinh noi): ca 3 truc model X, Y, Z deu hien thanh doan co do dai tren giay
Private Function IsPictorialView(ByVal v As Object) As Boolean
    Dim xf As Object, a0 As Variant, ax As Variant, i As Long, L As Double, s As Double, nOk As Long
    On Error GoTo fin
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    s = v.ScaleDecimal
    If s <= 0 Then s = 1
    a0 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(0, 0, 0)).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    For i = 0 To 2
        ax = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(IIf(i = 0, 0.01, 0), IIf(i = 1, 0.01, 0), IIf(i = 2, 0.01, 0))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        L = Sqr((ax(0) - a0(0)) ^ 2 + (ax(1) - a0(1)) ^ 2) / (0.01 * s)
        If L > 0.3 Then nOk = nOk + 1
    Next i
    IsPictorialView = (nOk = 3)
fin:
End Function

' Hinh chieu dang chon (chon hinh, hoac chon doi tuong nam trong hinh) - khong trung
Private Function SelectedDrawingViews() As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, seen As Object, selMgr As Object, n As Long, i As Long, tp As Long
    Dim ob As Object, vw As Object
    Set SelectedDrawingViews = col
    Set seen = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selMgr = swDrawModel.SelectionManager
    n = selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    For i = 1 To n
        Set vw = Nothing
        tp = selMgr.GetSelectedObjectType3(i, -1)
        If tp = swSelDRAWINGVIEWS Then
            Set vw = selMgr.GetSelectedObject6(i, -1)
        Else
            Set vw = selMgr.GetSelectedObjectsDrawingView2(i, -1)
        End If
        If Not vw Is Nothing Then
            If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" And Not seen.Exists(vw.GetName2) Then
                seen.Add vw.GetName2, 1
                col.Add vw
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Mac dinh: hinh truc do cua sheet; khong co -> hinh chieu model lon nhat
Private Function DefaultBalloonView() As Object
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, vw As Object, orName As String
    On Error Resume Next
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsArray(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            Set vw = vws(j)
            orName = ""
            orName = vw.GetOrientationName
            If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" And (InStr(1, orName, "Iso", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or _
               orName = "*" & ChrW(&H7B49) & ChrW(&H8F74) & ChrW(&H6D4B) Or IsPictorialView(vw)) Then
                Set DefaultBalloonView = vw
                Exit Function
            End If
        Next j
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set DefaultBalloonView = MainViewOfSheet()
End Function

' So balloon BOM tren sheet dang mo (moi hinh chieu)
Private Function CountSheetBalloons() As Long
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsArray(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            CountSheetBalloons = CountSheetBalloons + CountBalloons(vws(j))
        Next j
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Xoa moi balloon BOM tren sheet dang mo. Tra ve so balloon da xoa
Private Function DeleteSheetBalloons() As Long
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, nt As Object, nx As Object, g As Long, anns As New Collection, a As Variant, n0 As Long
    n0 = CountSheetBalloons()
    If n0 = 0 Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    If IsArray(vws) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
            Set nt = Nothing
            Set nt = vws(j).GetFirstNote
            g = 0
            Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
                g = g + 1
                If nt.IsBomBalloon Then anns.Add nt.GetAnnotation
                Set nx = Nothing
                Set nx = nt.GetNext
                Set nt = nx
            Loop
        Next j
    End If
    ' xoa ca nhom, con sot -> xoa tung cai
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    For Each a In anns
        a.Select3 True, Nothing
    Next a
    If Not swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0) Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If CountSheetBalloons() > 0 Then
        For Each a In anns
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            If a.Select3(False, Nothing) Then
                If Not swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2(0) Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
            End If
        Next a
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    DeleteSheetBalloons = n0 - CountSheetBalloons()
End Function

' So balloon BOM tren 1 hinh
Private Function CountBalloons(ByVal v As Object) As Long
    Dim nt As Object, nx As Object, g As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set nt = v.GetFirstNote
    Do While Not nt Is Nothing And g < 5000
        g = g + 1
        If nt.IsBomBalloon Then CountBalloons = CountBalloons + 1
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = nt.GetNext
        Set nt = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Dong ban ve vua tao (chua luu) khi khong dung duoc
Private Sub CloseNewDrawing()
    Dim t As String
    If swDrawModel Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    t = swDrawModel.GetTitle
    On Error Resume Next
    swApp.CloseDoc t
    If InStr(t, " - ") > 0 Then swApp.CloseDoc Left(t, InStr(t, " - ") - 1)
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set swDrawModel = Nothing: Set swDraw = Nothing
End Sub

' Hinh chieu cua ASSEMBLY?
Public Function IsAsmView(ByVal v As Object) As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    IsAsmView = (LCase(Right(v.GetReferencedModelName, 7)) = ".sldasm")
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Sheet hien hanh la ban ve lap (chi co hinh chieu assembly, khong co hinh chieu part)?
Public Function SheetIsAssembly() As Boolean
    Dim vws As Variant, j As Long, nm As String, nAsm As Long, nPrt As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    vws = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetViews
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(vws) Then Exit Function
    For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
        nm = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        nm = LCase(vws(j).GetReferencedModelName)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Right(nm, 7) = ".sldasm" Then
            nAsm = nAsm + 1
        ElseIf Right(nm, 7) = ".sldprt" Then
            nPrt = nPrt + 1
        End If
    Next j
    SheetIsAssembly = (nAsm > 0 And nPrt = 0)
End Function

' Component dang SUPPRESS (hoac nam trong cum con dang suppress)?
Public Function IsCompSuppressed(ByVal comp As Object) As Boolean
    Dim c As Object, nx As Object, guard As Long
    Set c = comp
    On Error Resume Next
    Do While Not c Is Nothing And guard < 50
        guard = guard + 1
        If c.IsSuppressed Then IsCompSuppressed = True: Exit Function
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = c.GetParent
        Set c = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Public Function IsToolboxPart(pm As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As Boolean
    If pm Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    Dim ext As Object, tb As Long
    Set ext = pm.Extension
    On Error Resume Next
    tb = ext.ToolboxPartType                 ' 0 = khong phai Toolbox
    On Error GoTo 0
    IsToolboxPart = (tb <> 0)
End Function

Public Function DrawingPathOf(ByVal partPath As String) As String
    DrawingPathOf = Left(partPath, InStrRev(partPath, ".")) & "SLDDRW"
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  TAO BAN VE CHO 1 PART  (tra ve ket qua dang chu; dong dau = tom tat)
'===========================================================================
Public Function MakePartDrawing(swPartModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2) As String
    report = ""
    Dim partPath As String
    partPath = swPartModel.GetPathName
    If partPath = "" Then MakePartDrawing = "LOI: part chua duoc luu": Exit Function

    ' ---- Phan loai chi tiet & chon hinh chieu chinh ----
    Dim swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc
    Set swPart = swPartModel
    nSelFail = 0: nDimFail = 0: nDimCalls = 0: nSlotMarks = 0
    Set cmPick = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cmLines = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set turnDiaDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set pendingDetail = New Collection: chainSeq = 0
    Set slotFeatSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If Not batchMode Or sheetCount = 0 Then Set allDims = New Collection
    dimLog = "LOG GHI KICH THUOC - " & Now & vbCrLf

    Dim box As Variant, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    box = swPart.GetPartBox(True)
    partBox = box
    dx = Abs(box(3) - box(0)): dy = Abs(box(4) - box(1)): dz = Abs(box(5) - box(2))

    ' vIdx: 0 = Front (nhin theo Z), 1 = Top (nhin theo Y), 2 = Right (nhin theo X)
    Dim turned As Boolean, tAx As Long, vIdx As Long, axisHoriz As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 0 To 2
        Set axDone(i) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        axOverall(i) = False
    Next i
    turned = DetectTurned(swPart, tAx)
    If turned Then
        ' Chi tiet tien: hinh chinh = hinh chieu doc truc
        If tAx = 2 Then vIdx = 2 Else vIdx = 0
        axisHoriz = (vIdx = 0 And tAx = 0) Or (vIdx = 2 And tAx = 2)
    Else
        ' Hinh chinh dien = hinh chieu co DIEN TICH LON NHAT (Front: X*Y, Top: X*Z, Right: Z*Y)
        vIdx = 0
        If dx * dz > dx * dy * 1.001 Then vIdx = 1
        If dz * dy > IIf(vIdx = 1, dx * dz, dx * dy) * 1.001 Then vIdx = 2
    End If
    mainAx = Choose(vIdx + 1, 2, 1, 0)      ' truc phap tuyen cua hinh chinh

    Dim w As Double, h As Double, vName As String
    Select Case vIdx
        Case 0: w = dx: h = dy: thick = dz
                vName = FindViewName(swPartModel, "Front", ChrW(&H524D) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case 1: w = dx: h = dz: thick = dy
                vName = FindViewName(swPartModel, "Top", ChrW(&H4E0A) & ChrW(&H89C6))
        Case Else: w = dz: h = dy: thick = dx
                vName = FindViewName(swPartModel, "Right", ChrW(&H53F3) & ChrW(&H89C6))
    End Select

    BuildThreadMap swPartModel
    Set partModelRef = swPartModel
    Dim bodiesNow As Variant
    bodiesNow = swPart.GetBodies2(swSolidBody, True)
    On Error Resume Next
    partBodies = Empty                       ' (neu mang cu bi khoa, bo qua)
    partBodies = bodiesNow
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' ---- Ti le ----
    Dim sNum As Double, sDen As Double
    ChooseScale w, h, thick, sNum, sDen
    sc = sNum / sDen

    ' ---- Ban ve moi (part) / sheet moi trong ban ve chung (assembly) ----
    Dim tmpl As String
    If batchMode And sheetCount > 0 Then
        EnsureDrawingActive
        If Not AddSheetLikeFirst(sNum, sDen) Then
            MakePartDrawing = "LOI: khong kich hoat duoc sheet moi (hien hanh: " & _
                              swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName & ")": Exit Function
        End If
        GoTo SheetReady
    End If
    tmpl = DRAWING_TEMPLATE
    If tmpl = "" Then tmpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(swDefaultTemplateDrawing)
    Set swDrawModel = swApp.NewDocument(tmpl, swDwgPaperA3size, SHEET_W, SHEET_H)
    If swDrawModel Is Nothing Then
        MakePartDrawing = "LOI: khong tao duoc ban ve. Template: " & tmpl: Exit Function
    End If
    Set swDraw = swDrawModel
    If STANDARD_FILE <> "" Then
        If Dir(STANDARD_FILE) <> "" Then
            Dim extL As Object
            Set extL = swDrawModel.Extension
            On Error Resume Next
            extL.LoadDraftingStandard STANDARD_FILE
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    End If

SheetReady:
    sheetCount = sheetCount + 1
    Dim swSheet As SldWorks.Sheet, sp As Variant
    Set swSheet = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet
    sp = swSheet.GetProperties2
    swSheet.SetProperties2 sp(0), sp(1), sNum, sDen, FIRST_ANGLE, sp(5), sp(6), True

    With swDrawModel.Extension
        .SetUserPreferenceToggle swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForHoles, swDetailingNoOptionSpecified, True
        .SetUserPreferenceToggle swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForSlots, swDetailingNoOptionSpecified, True
    End With

    ' ---- 3 hinh chieu (goc chieu thu nhat): CHINH (tren-trai), DUOI (hinh chieu bang), PHAI (canh trai) ----
    Dim mx As Double, my As Double
    mx = 0.08 + w * sc / 2                                   ' le trai 20 mm + cho kich thuoc 60 mm
    my = SHEET_H - 0.065 - h * sc / 2                        ' le tren 15 mm + cho kich thuoc 50 mm
    Dim vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, vRight As SldWorks.View
    Set vMain = swDraw.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3(partPath, vName, mx, my, 0)
    If vMain Is Nothing Then
        MakePartDrawing = "LOI: khong tao duoc hinh chieu chinh (" & vName & ")": Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh chinh " & vMain.GetName2 & " nam tren sheet: " & vMain.Sheet.GetName & vbCrLf
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' HINH CAT A-A tu hinh chinh: thay cho hinh duoi (truc nam ngang / tam-khoi) hoac hinh phai (truc dung)
    Dim secBelow As Boolean, secRight As Boolean, cutAx As Long, cutPt As Variant
    If ADD_SECTION_VIEW Then
        Dim hA0 As Long, hS0 As Long, vA0 As Long, vS0 As Long
        ViewAxes vMain, hA0, hS0, vA0, vS0
        If turned Then
            cutAx = tAx: cutPt = turnAxisPt                     ' cat doc theo truc
            If axisHoriz Then secBelow = True Else secRight = True
        ElseIf SECTION_FOR_PLATES Then
            ' Cat qua nhieu lo KHUAT (net dut) nhat; uu tien sau: lo nhin thang (de thay chieu sau)
            Dim cutHoriz As Boolean
            cutPt = BestCutForHoles(swPart, mainAx, hA0, vA0, cutHoriz)
            If Not IsEmpty(cutPt) Then
                If cutHoriz Then
                    cutAx = hA0: secBelow = True                 ' duong cat ngang -> hinh cat phia duoi
                Else
                    cutAx = vA0: secRight = True                 ' duong cat dung -> hinh cat ben phai
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If
    If secBelow Then Set vBelow = CreateSectionFromMain(vMain, cutAx, cutPt, mx, my - h * sc / 2 - 0.035 - thick * sc / 2, "A")
    If vBelow Is Nothing Then
        secBelow = False
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
        Set vBelow = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(mx, my - h * sc / 2 - 0.035 - thick * sc / 2, 0, False)
    End If
    If secRight Then Set vRight = CreateSectionFromMain(vMain, cutAx, cutPt, mx + w * sc / 2 + 0.045 + thick * sc / 2, my, "A")
    If vRight Is Nothing Then
        secRight = False
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2 vMain.GetName2, "DRAWINGVIEW", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
        Set vRight = swDraw.CreateUnfoldedViewAt3(mx + w * sc / 2 + 0.045 + thick * sc / 2, my, 0, False)
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If ADD_ISO_VIEW Then
        swDraw.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3 partPath, _
            FindViewName(swPartModel, "Isometric", ChrW(&H7B49) & ChrW(&H8F74) & ChrW(&H6D4B)), _
            SHEET_W * 0.82, SHEET_H * 0.78, 0
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    If AUTO_SCALE Then
        AutoScaleAndLayout vMain, vBelow, vRight, sNum, sDen     ' ti le theo kich thuoc that + bo tri can doi
    Else
        LayoutViews vMain, vBelow, vRight                      ' do kich thuoc that & gian cach cac hinh chieu
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    InitOccupancy vMain, vBelow, vRight        ' vung bi chiem de dat ghi chu cho thoang
    SetDatumSigns vMain                        ' goc kich thuoc chung cho 3 hinh chieu

    ' ---- Kich thuoc (3 hinh chieu) ----
    DimensionAllViews swPartModel, vMain, vBelow, vRight, turned, tAx, axisHoriz, secBelow, secRight, sNum, sDen
    report = report & StyleOrdinateMain(vMain, vBelow, vRight, turned)
    If DELETE_EMPTY_VIEWS And Not batchMode Then DeleteEmptyViews
    If CLEANUP_DIMS And Not batchMode Then report = report & CleanupAllSheets()
    If AUTO_ARRANGE And Not batchMode Then report = report & SapXepTatCaSheet() & vbCrLf
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2

    ' ---- Luu ----
    Dim dwgPath As String, msg As String
    dwgPath = DrawingPathOf(partPath)
    If batchMode Then
        msg = "Sheet " & sheetCount & vbCrLf
    ElseIf Not SAVE_DRAWING Then
        msg = "Ban ve dang mo, CHUA LUU" & vbCrLf
    Else
        Dim errs As Long, warns As Long, doSave As Boolean
        doSave = True
        If Dir(dwgPath) <> "" Then
            doSave = (MsgBox("Da co ban ve:" & vbCrLf & dwgPath & vbCrLf & "Ghi de?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbYes)
        End If
        If doSave Then
            If swDrawModel.Extension.SaveAs(dwgPath, swSaveAsCurrentVersion, swSaveAsOptions_Silent, Nothing, errs, warns) Then
                msg = "Da luu: " & dwgPath & vbCrLf
            Else
                msg = "LOI luu ban ve (ma " & errs & "): " & dwgPath & vbCrLf
            End If
        Else
            msg = "Chua luu (khong ghi de): " & dwgPath & vbCrLf
        End If
    End If

    ' Che do part: ghi log canh part. Che do assembly: log tong do BatchAssembly ghi
    If Not batchMode Then
        Dim logPath As String, ts As Object
        logPath = Left(partPath, InStrRev(partPath, "\")) & "DimLog.txt"
        On Error Resume Next
        Set ts = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").CreateTextFile(logPath, True)
        ts.Write report & vbCrLf & dimLog
        ts.Close
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If

    MakePartDrawing = msg & "Ti le: " & sNum & ":" & sDen & "   |   Hinh chinh: " & vName & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & report & _
                      "Loi chon/tao: " & nSelFail & "/" & nDimFail
End Function

' Ghi kich thuoc cho 3 hinh chieu cua 1 chi tiet (dung chung: tao ban ve moi & XUAT LAI kich thuoc sheet dang mo)
Public Sub DimensionAllViews(swPartModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, _
                             vRight As SldWorks.View, ByVal turned As Boolean, ByVal tAx As Long, ByVal axisHoriz As Boolean, _
                             ByVal secBelow As Boolean, ByVal secRight As Boolean, ByVal sNum As Double, ByVal sDen As Double)
    ' Truc model cua hinh chinh: ngang (hA) / doc (vA). Hinh DUOI nhin theo vA, hinh PHAI nhin theo hA
    Dim hA As Long, hS As Long, vA As Long, vS As Long
    ViewAxes vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS
    report = ""
    Set thrAxDone = New Collection
    If turned Then
        report = "Chi tiet TIEN (truc " & Choose(tAx + 1, "X", "Y", "Z") & ")" & vbCrLf
        If secBelow Or secRight Then
            ' CO HINH CAT: moi kich thuoc doc truc (chieu dai, O ngoai, O trong, ren) ghi tren HINH CAT;
            ' hinh chinh chi giu lo ngang (vi tri + Hole Callout)
            ' Hinh chinh: CHI kich thuoc bao (chieu dai tong + O lon nhat)
            DimensionTurnedView vMain, tAx, axisHoriz, 3
            ' Hinh cat: moi kich thuoc chi tiet (bac, ranh, O trong, ren, chieu sau lo) + canh thang (hoc, lo ngang)
            ' Phuong ban kinh tren hinh cat lay goc tu DUONG TAM truc
            Dim axS As Variant
            If secBelow Then
                DimensionTurnedView vBelow, tAx, axisHoriz, 4
                axS = AxisSheetPos(vBelow)
                DimensionPlateView vBelow, vA, False, False, False, "Cat A-A", True, IIf(axisHoriz, 2, 1), _
                                   IIf(axisHoriz, axS(1), axS(0))
            Else
                DimensionTurnedView vRight, tAx, axisHoriz, 4
                axS = AxisSheetPos(vRight)
                DimensionPlateView vRight, hA, False, True, False, "Cat A-A", True, IIf(axisHoriz, 2, 1), _
                                   IIf(axisHoriz, axS(1), axS(0))
            End If
            If axisHoriz Then
                If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DimensionEndView vRight, tAx
            Else
                If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DimensionEndView vBelow, tAx
            End If
        Else
            DimensionTurnedView vMain, tAx, axisHoriz, 0
            If axisHoriz Then
                If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DimensionEndView vRight, tAx
                If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vBelow, vA, False, False, False, "Duoi"
            Else
                If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DimensionEndView vBelow, tAx
                If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vRight, hA, False, True, False, "Phai"
            End If
        End If
    Else
        ' Chinh: chuoi ngang dat PHIA TREN (vi ben duoi la hinh chieu bang), chuoi doc ben trai
        ' Luot 1 hinh chinh: lo, ranh, kich thuoc bao + hinh dang DANG A (duong bao kin nam trong hinh chinh)
        ' (kieu Ordinate: hinh chinh ghi het, sau do doi sang ordinate)
        DimensionPlateView vMain, mainAx, True, False, True, "Chinh", True, 0, 0, IIf(DIM_STYLE = 3, 0, 1)
        ' Hinh bang & hinh canh: ghi truoc cac vi tri DANG B (duong ho, chay ra mep: ranh thong, bac...)
        If Not vBelow Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vBelow, vA, False, False, True, IIf(secBelow, "Cat A-A", "Duoi")
        If Not vRight Is Nothing Then DimensionPlateView vRight, hA, False, True, True, IIf(secRight, "Cat A-A", "Phai")
        ' Luot bo sung hinh chinh: vi tri DANG B chua ghi duoc o hinh bang / canh (vd chi nhin thay o hinh chinh)
        If DIM_STYLE <> 3 Then DimensionPlateView vMain, mainAx, True, False, False, "Chinh (bo sung)", True, 0, 0, 2
    End If
    ' HINH CAT: kich thuoc REN vao 2 NET MANH (Cosmetic Thread) cua moi lo ren bi mat cat di qua
    ' (lo ren ngang / xien / lo ren tren chi tiet tam; lo ren doc truc da ghi o DimensionTurnedView)
    Dim nThr As Long
    If secBelow Then nThr = nThr + SectionThreadDims(vBelow, turned, tAx)
    If secRight Then nThr = nThr + SectionThreadDims(vRight, turned, tAx)
    If nThr > 0 Then report = report & "Hinh cat: " & nThr & " kich thuoc ren (2 net manh)" & vbCrLf
    If ADD_DETAIL_VIEW Then
        If pendingDetail.Count > 0 Then report = report & MakeDetailViews(sNum, sDen)
    End If
    ' Nhan "SECTION A-A" dat duoi tang kich thuoc thap nhat cua hinh cat (khong bi de)
    If secBelow Then MoveViewLabelBelowDims vBelow
    If secRight Then MoveViewLabelBelowDims vRight
    If ADD_CHAMFER_NOTE Then ChamferNotes swPartModel, vMain, vBelow, vRight
End Sub

' Them sheet moi cung kho giay & khung ten (sheet format) voi sheet dau tien,
' roi KICH HOAT sheet moi (view luon duoc dat len sheet hien hanh)
Public Function AddSheetLikeFirst(ByVal sNum As Double, ByVal sDen As Double) As Boolean
    Dim before As Variant, s1 As SldWorks.Sheet, sp As Variant
    Dim nm As String, k As Long, tryN As Long, cur As String, oldSet As Object, it As Variant

    before = swDraw.GetSheetNames
    Set oldSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each it In before
        oldSet(UCase(Trim(it))) = 1
    Next it
    Set s1 = swDraw.Sheet(before(0))
    sp = s1.GetProperties2

    ' Ten TAM cua sheet moi luc dang chay: T97_k (chay xong doi lai 1, 2, 3...)
    k = UBound(before) + 2
    Do While oldSet.Exists(UCase(TempSheetName(k)))
        k = k + 1
    Loop
    nm = TempSheetName(k)

    ' SW2020: NewSheet3 co the tra ve False du da tao sheet -> khong dua vao gia tri tra ve
    Dim rNew As Boolean
    rNew = swDraw.NewSheet3(nm, sp(0), sp(1), sNum, sDen, FIRST_ANGLE, s1.GetTemplateName, sp(5), sp(6), "")
    DoEvents
    Dim after As Variant, newName As String
    after = swDraw.GetSheetNames
    For Each it In after
        If Not oldSet.Exists(UCase(Trim(it))) Then newName = it
    Next it
    dimLog = dimLog & "NewSheet3=" & rNew & " | sheet moi: '" & newName & "'" & vbCrLf
    If newName = "" Then Exit Function              ' that su khong tao duoc sheet

    ' Kich hoat sheet moi & cho SolidWorks cap nhat
    For tryN = 1 To 5
        cur = UCase(Trim(swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName))
        If cur = UCase(Trim(newName)) Then
            AddSheetLikeFirst = True
            Exit For
        End If
        swDraw.ActivateSheet newName
        DoEvents
        swDrawModel.GraphicsRedraw2
    Next tryN
    If Not AddSheetLikeFirst Then
        ' Sheet da tao (NewSheet3 tu kich hoat sheet moi) nhung chua xac nhan duoc -> van tiep tuc
        AddSheetLikeFirst = True
        dimLog = dimLog & "CANH BAO: chua xac nhan duoc sheet hien hanh, van dat view" & vbCrLf
    End If
    dimLog = dimLog & "Sheet hien hanh: " & swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName & vbCrLf
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  KICH THUOC HINH CHIEU CHINH
'===========================================================================
' Ghi kich thuoc 1 hinh chieu kieu tam/khoi:
'  - Chuan = canh trai (ngang) & canh duoi (doc); moi HE LO 1 tang: chuan -> lo 1 -> lo 2...
'  - Toa do da ghi o hinh chieu khac (cung truc model) -> khong ghi lai
'  - Kich thuoc bao moi truc model chi ghi 1 lan (allowOverall)
Public Sub DimensionPlateView(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal nAx As Long, ByVal hAbove As Boolean, _
                               ByVal vRight As Boolean, ByVal allowOverall As Boolean, ByVal label As String, _
                               Optional ByVal shapeDims As Boolean = True, Optional ByVal centerIdx As Long = 0, _
                               Optional ByVal centerPos As Double = 0, Optional ByVal shapeMode As Long = 0)
    ' shapeMode: 0 = day du; 1 = hinh chinh luot 1 (lo, ranh, bao + hinh dang DANG A: duong bao kin ben trong);
    '            2 = hinh chinh luot bo sung (chi hinh dang DANG B con lai, chua ghi duoc o hinh bang / canh)
    Dim oldMain As Long, oldThick As Double
    oldMain = mainAx: oldThick = thick
    mainAx = nAx
    thick = Abs(partBox(3 + nAx) - partBox(nAx))       ' chieu sau theo huong nhin (de xet lo xuyen)

    Dim circles As Collection
    ' Canh tron cua lo lay TU PART (du ca bac, lo bac phia sau...) -> moi lo cung loai co cung quy cach
    Set circles = GetModelCirclesAlong(v, nAx)
    If circles.Count = 0 Then Set circles = GetCirclesAlong(v, nAx)
    If skipHoles Then Set circles = New Collection        ' lo da ghi trong Hole Table
    If shapeMode = 2 Then Set circles = New Collection     ' luot bo sung: lo da ghi o luot 1

    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    Dim hAx As Long, hSg As Long, vAx As Long, vSg As Long
    ViewAxes v, hAx, hSg, vAx, vSg
    ' Goc kich thuoc cua hinh nay: cung goc vat ly voi hinh chinh (vd hinh canh goc 1 -> canh PHAI)
    Dim datL As Boolean, datB As Boolean
    datL = True: datB = True
    If DATUM_SAME_CORNER Then
        If datumSg(hAx) <> 0 Then datL = (datumSg(hAx) * hSg > 0)
        If datumSg(vAx) <> 0 Then datB = (datumSg(vAx) * vSg > 0)
    End If
    report = report & "  [" & label & "] goc kich thuoc: " & IIf(datL, "trai", "phai") & " - " & IIf(datB, "duoi", "tren") & vbCrLf
    ' Canh bien = CANH THANG THAT nam tren bien hop bao (khong chon theo diem giua -> tranh trung ranh/bac)
    Dim lines As Collection
    Set lines = GetViewLines(v)
    Dim eL As Variant, eR As Variant, eB As Variant, eT As Variant
    BoundaryRef lines, True, xL, Array(xL, (yB + yT) / 2), eL
    BoundaryRef lines, True, xR, Array(xR, (yB + yT) / 2), eR
    BoundaryRef lines, False, yB, Array((xL + xR) / 2, yB), eB
    BoundaryRef lines, False, yT, Array((xL + xR) / 2, yT), eT

    ' 1) Gom he lo
    Dim grp As Object, gKey As String, ck As String, it As Variant, gd As Object, tmp As Variant
    Set grp = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each it In circles
        If it(6) Then gKey = "HW:" & it(5) Else gKey = "D:" & Format(it(4) * 2000#, "0.00")
        If Not grp.Exists(gKey) Then grp.Add gKey, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        Set gd = grp.Item(gKey)
        ck = CenterKey(it)
        If Not gd.Exists(ck) Then
            gd.Add ck, it
        Else
            tmp = gd.Item(ck)
            If it(4) < tmp(4) Then gd.Item(ck) = it
        End If
    Next it

    ' 1b) Ranh (slot)
    Dim slots As Collection, sl As Variant
    Set slots = GetSlots(v, nAx)
    Dim scx As Double, scy As Double, sp As Object
    Set slotBoxes = New Collection
    For Each sl In slots
        ' khung bao ranh = 2 tam cung +/- ban kinh (tren giay), noi 0.3 mm
        slotBoxes.Add Array(MinD0(sl(2), sl(4)) - sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal - 0.0003, MinD0(sl(3), sl(5)) - sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal - 0.0003, _
                            MaxD(sl(2), sl(4)) + sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal + 0.0003, MaxD(sl(3), sl(5)) + sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal + 0.0003)
        If sl(7) <> "" Then slotFeatSet(sl(7)) = 1               ' canh thang 2 ben ranh: khong ghi kich thuoc
        gKey = "SL:" & sl(7) & "|" & Format(sl(6) * 2000#, "0.00")
        If Not grp.Exists(gKey) Then grp.Add gKey, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        Set gd = grp.Item(gKey)
        ' Chi ghi vi tri TAM RANH: dung SLOT CENTER MARK cua SolidWorks (khong ve diem sketch)
        scx = (sl(2) + sl(4)) / 2: scy = (sl(3) + sl(5)) / 2
        Dim bxx As Variant
        bxx = slotBoxes.Item(slotBoxes.Count)
        Set sp = Nothing
        If shapeMode <> 2 Then Set sp = SlotCenterMarkAnn(v, sl, bxx)   ' luot bo sung: khong tao lai center mark
        If Not sp Is Nothing Then
            it = Array(sp, scx, scy, 0#, sl(6), sl(7), False)
            ck = CenterKey(it): If Not gd.Exists(ck) Then gd.Add ck, it
        End If
    Next sl
    ' Cung le nam trong khung ranh (dau ranh) -> khong ghi kich thuoc rieng
    If slotBoxes.Count > 0 And loneArcs.Count > 0 Then
        Dim keepA As Collection, lz As Variant
        Set keepA = New Collection
        For Each lz In loneArcs
            If Not PointInSlot(lz(1), lz(2)) Then keepA.Add lz
        Next lz
        Set loneArcs = keepA
    End If

    If shapeMode = 2 Then Set grp = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")   ' luot bo sung: chi hinh dang
    ' 2) Sap xep he: nhieu lo truoc
    Dim gKeys As Variant, nG As Long, gi As Long, gj As Long
    nG = grp.Count
    If nG > 0 Then
        gKeys = grp.Keys
        For gi = 0 To nG - 2
            For gj = gi + 1 To nG - 1
                If grp.Item(gKeys(gj)).Count > grp.Item(gKeys(gi)).Count Then
                    tmp = gKeys(gi): gKeys(gi) = gKeys(gj): gKeys(gj) = tmp
                End If
            Next gj
        Next gi
    End If

    ' 3) Chuoi kich thuoc (goc = canh trai / canh duoi)
    Dim pts As Collection, k2 As Variant, cnt As Long, gIdx As Long
    Dim tBot As Long, tTop As Long, tLft As Long, tRgt As Long, linePos As Double, ux As Variant, uy As Variant
    Dim chH As New Collection, chV As New Collection     ' cac chuoi ngang / doc (sap xep truoc khi dat)

    ' 3a) HINH DANG: vi tri cac canh thang (bac, be rong khoi, ranh...) - tang trong cung
    ' Settings - muc do: Basic (1) = chi bao + lo; Standard (2) = + hinh dang; Full (3) = moi canh thang nhin thay
    If ADD_SHAPE_DIMS And shapeDims And DIM_LEVEL >= 2 Then
        ' Huong nhin (tu chi tiet ve phia nguoi xem) trong model = truc ngang x truc doc
        Dim hv(2) As Double, vv(2) As Double, vd As Variant
        hv(hAx) = hSg: vv(vAx) = vSg
        vd = Array(hv(1) * vv(2) - hv(2) * vv(1), hv(2) * vv(0) - hv(0) * vv(2), hv(0) * vv(1) - hv(1) * vv(0))
        Dim colX As Collection, colY As Collection, la As Variant
        Set colX = OutlinePositions(lines, True, xL, xR, (yB + yT) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
        Set colY = OutlinePositions(lines, False, yB, yT, (xL + xR) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
        If colX.Count + colY.Count = 0 And lines.Count > 8 Then
            ' Du phong: neu phap tuyen mat bi nguoc chieu -> thu huong nhin nguoc lai
            vd = Array(-vd(0), -vd(1), -vd(2))
            Set colX = OutlinePositions(lines, True, xL, xR, (yB + yT) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
            Set colY = OutlinePositions(lines, False, yB, yT, (xL + xR) / 2, vd, DIM_LEVEL >= 3)
            dimLog = dimLog & "[" & label & "] dao huong nhin khi loc canh khuat" & vbCrLf
        End If
        ' BUOC DUONG BAO: canh doc / ngang tao bac tren duong bao ngoai cua hinh (vd thanh khoi cao - thap)
        ' -> luon ghi vi tri (ke ca khi bo loc mat phang o tren bo sot)
        Dim nEnv As Long
        nEnv = AddEnvelopeSteps(lines, colX, True, xL, xR) + AddEnvelopeSteps(lines, colY, False, yB, yT)
        If nEnv > 0 Then dimLog = dimLog & "[" & label & "] them " & nEnv & " buoc duong bao" & vbCrLf
        ' DANG A (duong bao kin ben trong hinh) ghi o hinh chinh; DANG B (duong ho / chay ra mep)
        ' uu tien ghi o hinh bang & hinh canh, con lai ghi o hinh chinh (luot bo sung)
        If shapeMode = 1 Then
            Set colX = FilterShapeKind(colX, True): Set colY = FilterShapeKind(colY, True)
        ElseIf shapeMode = 2 Then
            Set colX = FilterShapeKind(colX, False): Set colY = FilterShapeKind(colY, False)
        End If
        Dim lp As Object, la2 As Variant, arcsUse As Collection
        Set arcsUse = loneArcs
        If shapeMode = 2 Or arcsUse Is Nothing Then Set arcsUse = New Collection
        For Each la In arcsUse                  ' TAM cung le (center mark) nam chung chuoi hinh dang
            Set lp = ArcCenterMarkAnn(v, la(0), la(1), la(2), la(4))
            If lp Is Nothing Then
                la2 = la
            Else
                la2 = Array(lp, la(1), la(2), la(3), la(4), la(5), la(6))
            End If
            colX.Add la2: colY.Add la2
        Next la
        ux = UniqueModel(colX, 1, xL, xR, hSg, hAx)
        uy = UniqueModel(colY, 2, yB, yT, vSg, vAx)
        If Not IsEmpty(ux(0)) Then
            chH.Add ux
            report = report & "  [" & label & "] Hinh dang ngang: " & (UBound(ux) + 1) & " canh" & vbCrLf
        End If
        If Not IsEmpty(uy(0)) Then
            chV.Add uy
            report = report & "  [" & label & "] Hinh dang doc: " & (UBound(uy) + 1) & " canh" & vbCrLf
        End If
    End If

    ' 3b) HE LO / RANH
    For gi = 0 To nG - 1
        Set gd = grp.Item(gKeys(gi))
        Set pts = New Collection
        For Each k2 In gd.Keys
            pts.Add gd.Item(k2)
        Next k2
        ux = UniqueModel(pts, 1, xL, xR, hSg, hAx)
        uy = UniqueModel(pts, 2, yB, yT, vSg, vAx)
        If Not IsEmpty(ux(0)) Then chH.Add ux
        If Not IsEmpty(uy(0)) Then chV.Add uy
        If Not IsEmpty(ux(0)) Or Not IsEmpty(uy(0)) Then
            report = report & "  [" & label & "] He " & (gIdx + 1) & ": " & pts.Count & " vi tri " & _
                     GroupLabel(CStr(gKeys(gi)), pts) & vbCrLf
            gIdx = gIdx + 1
        End If
    Next gi

    ' 3c) Dat cac chuoi: chuoi VUON XA hon (diem cuoi xa goc hon) nam XA hinh chieu hon
    ' Chi tiet tru tron: phuong vuong goc truc lay GOC = DUONG TAM (centerIdx 1: ngang, 2: doc)
    ' (xep tiep sau cac tang O da dat o phia thap cua hinh)
    ' Settings - kieu ghi BASELINE: moi vi tri 1 kich thuoc tu canh goc (tach chuoi thanh tung vi tri)
    If DIM_STYLE = 2 Then
        Set chH = SplitChains(chH)
        Set chV = SplitChains(chV)
    End If
    If centerIdx = 1 Then tBot = turnTierLo
    If centerIdx = 2 Then tLft = turnTierLo
    If centerIdx = 1 Then
        cnt = cnt + CenterDims(v, chH, 1, True, centerPos, yB, yT, xL, xR, tBot)
    ElseIf datL Then
        cnt = cnt + PlaceChains(v, chH, 1, True, eL, xL, yB, yT, (yB + yT) / 2, tBot, tTop)
    Else
        ' goc = canh PHAI: chuoi bat dau tu vi tri gan canh phai nhat
        cnt = cnt + PlaceChains(v, ReverseChains(chH), 1, True, eR, xR, yB, yT, (yB + yT) / 2, tBot, tTop)
    End If
    If centerIdx = 2 Then
        cnt = cnt + CenterDims(v, chV, 2, False, centerPos, xL, xR, yB, yT, tLft)
    ElseIf datB Then
        cnt = cnt + PlaceChains(v, chV, 2, False, eB, yB, xL, xR, (xL + xR) / 2, tLft, tRgt)
    Else
        ' goc = canh TREN
        cnt = cnt + PlaceChains(v, ReverseChains(chV), 2, False, eT, yT, xL, xR, (xL + xR) / 2, tLft, tRgt)
    End If

    ' 4) Kich thuoc bao (ngoai cung) - moi truc model 1 lan
    If allowOverall And Not axOverall(hAx) Then
        If hAbove Then
            linePos = yT + DIM_FIRST + tTop * DIM_STEP: tTop = tTop + 1
        Else
            linePos = yB - DIM_FIRST - tBot * DIM_STEP: tBot = tBot + 1
        End If
        If AddDim(v, eL, eR, True, (xL + xR) / 2, linePos) Then
            cnt = cnt + 1: axOverall(hAx) = True
            RecordDimRect True, xL, xR, linePos
            RecordDim lastDD, v, True, xL, xR, linePos
        End If
    End If
    If allowOverall And Not axOverall(vAx) Then
        If vRight Then
            linePos = xR + DIM_FIRST + tRgt * DIM_STEP: tRgt = tRgt + 1
        Else
            linePos = xL - DIM_FIRST - tLft * DIM_STEP: tLft = tLft + 1
        End If
        If AddDim(v, eB, eT, False, linePos, (yB + yT) / 2) Then
            cnt = cnt + 1: axOverall(vAx) = True
            RecordDimRect False, yB, yT, linePos
            RecordDim lastDD, v, False, yB, yT, linePos
        End If
    End If
    ' Vung kich thuoc cua hinh nay -> vung bi chiem (de dat ghi chu cho thoang)
    SetNoteBox xL, xR, yB, yT, DIM_FIRST + tLft * DIM_STEP, DIM_FIRST + tRgt * DIM_STEP, _
               DIM_FIRST + tBot * DIM_STEP, DIM_FIRST + tTop * DIM_STEP
    ' 4b) Ban kinh ranh ban nguyet: "2-R2"
    If loneArcs.Count > 0 And shapeMode <> 2 Then cnt = cnt + RadiusDims(v, loneArcs)

    report = report & "Hinh " & label & ": " & cnt & " kich thuoc, " & circles.Count & " duong tron, " & _
             slots.Count & " ranh, " & loneArcs.Count & " cung le" & vbCrLf

    ' 5) Hole Callout & ranh: dat ngoai cac tang kich thuoc
    If (circles.Count > 0 Or slots.Count > 0) And shapeMode <> 2 Then
        Dim xNoteL As Double, xNoteR As Double
        xNoteL = xL - DIM_FIRST - tLft * DIM_STEP - 0.012
        xNoteR = xR + DIM_FIRST + tRgt * DIM_STEP + 0.012
        nL = 0: nr = 0: noteSide = 0
        HoleNotes v, circles, xNoteL, xNoteR, yT, yB
        SlotNotes v, slots, xNoteL, xNoteR, yT, yB
    End If

    mainAx = oldMain: thick = oldThick
End Sub

' Truc model nam ngang / doc tren hinh chieu (0=X,1=Y,2=Z) va chieu (+1/-1)
' Goc kich thuoc chung (theo hinh chinh): truc ngang -> phia TRAI, truc doc -> phia DUOI,
' truc sau -> MAT TRUOC (mat huong ve nguoi nhin hinh chinh)
Public Sub SetDatumSigns(vMain As SldWorks.View)
    Dim hA As Long, hS As Long, vA As Long, vS As Long, dA As Long
    Dim hv(2) As Double, uv(2) As Double, tv(2) As Double
    datumSg(0) = 0: datumSg(1) = 0: datumSg(2) = 0
    If vMain Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    ViewAxes vMain, hA, hS, vA, vS
    If hA = vA Then Exit Sub
    dA = 3 - hA - vA
    hv(hA) = hS: uv(vA) = vS
