        '  1) canh O NGOAI CUNG (bac / mieng lo, khong phai vat mep) nam o MAT CHI TIET (mieng lo)
        '  2) cac canh con lai cua O ngoai, 3) cac canh khac (ngoai -> trong), canh vat mep sau cung
        Dim eList As Collection, pass2 As Long, ck2 As Long, oIdx As Long, zA As Double, zB As Double, zF As Double
        Dim bestE As Object, bestD As Double, cand As Variant, eE As Variant
        Set eList = New Collection
        oIdx = 0
        For rI = nc - 1 To 0 Step -1
            If Not OnlyChamferEdges(arr(rI)(4)) Then
                If rI = 0 Or (arr(rI)(1) - arr(rI)(0)) / sc > 0.00005 Then oIdx = rI: Exit For
            End If
        Next rI
        zA = partBox(mainAx) * sc: zB = partBox(3 + mainAx) * sc
        bestD = 1E+30: Set bestE = Nothing
        For Each cand In arr(oIdx)(4)
            ck2 = 0
            If UBound(cand) >= 7 Then ck2 = cand(7)
            If ck2 = 0 Then
                zF = MinD(Abs(cand(3) - zA), Abs(cand(3) - zB))
                If zF < bestD Then bestD = zF: Set bestE = cand(0)
            End If
        Next cand
        If Not bestE Is Nothing Then eList.Add bestE
        For Each cand In arr(oIdx)(4)
            If Not cand(0) Is bestE Then eList.Add cand(0)
        Next cand
        For pass2 = 0 To 1
            For rI = nc - 1 To 0 Step -1
                If rI <> oIdx Then
                    For Each eE In arr(rI)(4)
                        ck2 = 0
                        If UBound(eE) >= 7 Then ck2 = eE(7)
                        If (pass2 = 0 And ck2 = 0) Or (pass2 = 1 And ck2 <> 0) Then eList.Add eE(0)
                    Next eE
                End If
            Next rI
        Next pass2
        If Not bestE Is Nothing Then Set repE = bestE
        ' Noi dung Hole Callout do SOLIDWORKS tu doc (khong ghi de): lo giong nhau = cung hinh hoc
        ' + cung thong so Hole Wizard (ke ca lo nhan ban bang Pattern / Mirror tu lo Hole Wizard)
        Dim hwk As String
        hwk = HoleFeatureKey(arr(0)(2)(0))
        thr = ""
        dimLog = dimLog & "Lo O" & Format(arr(0)(2)(4) * 2000#, "0.00") & ": feature=" & fname & _
                 IIf(hwk <> "", " [" & hwk & "]", "") & " quy cach=" & parts & vbCrLf
        sk = "H|" & HoleSpecText(parts, holeThru) & "|" & hwk
        If spec.Exists(sk) Then
            g = spec.Item(sk): g(0) = g(0) + 1
            If isHW And Not g(9) Then
                ' lo Hole Wizard: SolidWorks doc du quy cach -> thu canh cua lo nay truoc
                g(8).Add Array(eList, it(1), it(2)), , 1
                g(9) = True: Set g(1) = repE: g(6) = it(1): g(7) = it(2)
            ElseIf g(8).Count < 4 Then
                g(8).Add Array(eList, it(1), it(2))
            End If
            spec.Item(sk) = g
        Else
            Dim alts As Collection
            Set alts = New Collection
            alts.Add Array(eList, it(1), it(2))
            spec.Add sk, Array(1, repE, thr, holeThru, arr(0)(2)(4), parts, it(1), it(2), alts, isHW)
        End If
    Next key

    ' 4) Dat Hole Callout xen ke trai / phai
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    Dim PX As Double, py As Double, dd As Object, n As Long
    Dim nCall As Long, nFallback As Long, t1 As String, nThr As Long
    For Each key In spec.Keys
        g = spec.Item(key)
        n = g(0)
        NoteNear g(6), g(7), PX, py                ' dat callout gan lo nhat
        Set dd = Nothing
        ' Thu Hole Callout tren tung canh (ngoai -> trong) cua toi da 4 lo trong nhom
        Dim alt As Variant, eD As Variant, tried As Long
        tried = 0
        For Each alt In g(8)
            For Each eD In alt(0)
                swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
                tried = tried + 1
                If SelectInView(v, eD, False, True) Then Set dd = swDraw.AddHoleCallout2(PX, py, 0)
                If Not dd Is Nothing Then Exit For
            Next eD
            If Not dd Is Nothing Then Exit For
        Next alt
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True

        If Not dd Is Nothing Then
            nCall = nCall + 1
            ' CHI lay noi dung Hole Callout cua SolidWorks (lien ket model: sua lo -> callout tu cap nhat)
            ' + TONG so lo giong nhau. Chi chinh so le hien thi (5.5 khong bi lam tron thanh 6).
            Dim edD As Double
            edD = EdgeDiaMM(eD)
            If edD <= 0 Then edD = MainDia(CStr(g(5)))
            FitPrecision dd, edD
            AddCountPrefix dd, n
            dimLog = dimLog & "HoleCallout OK: " & n & " lo, quy cach " & g(5) & " | " & CalloutTextDump(dd) & vbCrLf
        Else
            nFallback = nFallback + 1
            dimLog = dimLog & "HoleCallout LOI (" & tried & " canh): " & n & " lo, quy cach " & g(5) & vbCrLf
            If ALLOW_NOTE_FALLBACK Then
                If g(2) <> "" Then
                    ThreadNote v, g(1), n, CStr(g(2)), PX, py
                Else
                    ThreadNote v, g(1), n, HoleSpecText(CStr(g(5)), CBool(g(3))), PX, py
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next key
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True

    report = report & "Hole Callout: " & nCall & "/" & spec.Count & " quy cach lo" & _
             IIf(nFallback > 0, "  (KHONG tao duoc callout: " & nFallback & " quy cach)", "") & vbCrLf
End Sub


' Tham chieu: Edge (chon truc tiep) hoac Array(x, y) = diem tren canh (toa do giay)
Public Function SelectRef(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ref As Variant, ByVal appendSel As Boolean) As Boolean
    If IsObject(ref) Then
        SelectRef = SelectInView(v, ref, appendSel)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim i As Long, dxy As Variant
    dxy = Array(0#, 0.0002, -0.0002)          ' thu dung diem, roi lech nhe vao trong/ra ngoai
    For i = 0 To 2
        SelectRef = swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2("", "EDGE", ref(0) + dxy(i), ref(1) + dxy(i), 0, _
                                                     appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0)
        If SelectRef Then Exit Function
    Next i
    nSelFail = nSelFail + 1
End Function


' Hop bao part chieu len giay: xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax
Public Sub GetViewBox(v As SldWorks.View, xMin As Double, xMax As Double, yMin As Double, yMax As Double)
    Dim xf As SldWorks.MathTransform, mp As SldWorks.MathPoint, a As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, k As Long, first As Boolean
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    first = True
    For i = 0 To 1
        For j = 0 To 1
            For k = 0 To 1
                Set mp = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(partBox(i * 3), partBox(1 + j * 3), partBox(2 + k * 3)))
                a = mp.MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                If first Then
                    xMin = a(0): xMax = a(0): yMin = a(1): yMax = a(1): first = False
                Else
                    If a(0) < xMin Then xMin = a(0)
                    If a(0) > xMax Then xMax = a(0)
                    If a(1) < yMin Then yMin = a(1)
                    If a(1) > yMax Then yMax = a(1)
                End If
            Next k
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub


' MathUtility.CreatePoint can mang Double (mang Variant tu Array() bi doc thanh 0)
Public Function Dbl3(ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ByVal z As Double) As Variant
    Dim d(2) As Double
    d(0) = X: d(1) = Y: d(2) = z
    Dbl3 = d
End Function


Public Function SelectInView(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ent As Object, ByVal appendSel As Boolean, _
                              Optional ByVal quiet As Boolean = False) As Boolean
    Dim selMgr As SldWorks.SelectionMgr, sd As SldWorks.SelectData, en As SldWorks.Entity
    Dim n0 As Long
    Set selMgr = swDrawModel.SelectionManager
    If appendSel Then n0 = selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    Set sd = selMgr.CreateSelectData
    sd.View = v
    If TypeOf ent Is SldWorks.Annotation Then
        ' Center mark: CHON TAI TAM (diem chon quyet dinh SolidWorks do toi tam hay toi canh tay dau tam)
        Dim pos As Variant, pk As String
        pk = CStr(ObjPtr(ent))
        On Error Resume Next
        If Not cmPick Is Nothing Then
            If cmPick.Exists(pk) Then
                pos = cmPick.Item(pk)
                SelCenterMarkAt pos(0), pos(1), appendSel
            End If
        End If
        If selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) <= n0 Then
            pos = Empty
            pos = ent.GetPosition
            If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then SelCenterMarkAt pos(0), pos(1), appendSel
        End If
        If selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) <= n0 Then ent.Select3 appendSel, Nothing
        On Error GoTo 0
        SelectInView = (selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > n0)
        If Not SelectInView And Not quiet Then nSelFail = nSelFail + 1
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    Set en = ent
    On Error GoTo 0
    If en Is Nothing Then
        ' Khong phai canh model (vd: duong tam sketch) -> chon truc tiep
        On Error Resume Next
        ent.Select4 appendSel, Nothing
        On Error GoTo 0
        SelectInView = (selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > n0)
        If Not SelectInView And Not quiet Then nSelFail = nSelFail + 1
        Exit Function
    End If
    en.Select4 appendSel, sd
    If selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) <= n0 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        v.SelectEntity ent, appendSel
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    SelectInView = (selMgr.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > n0)
    If Not SelectInView And Not quiet Then nSelFail = nSelFail + 1
End Function



'===========================================================================
'  HINH HOC TRONG VIEW
'===========================================================================
' Duong tron kin nhin thang. Phan tu: Array(edge, x, y, z (toa do giay), r (m), tenFeature, laHoleWizard)
Public Function GetFacingCircles(v As SldWorks.View) As Collection
    Set GetFacingCircles = GetCirclesAlong(v, mainAx)
End Function


'===========================================================================
'  HINH CHIEU CUM VE NHU PART (cum con han): engine kich thuoc doc canh / dinh cua TUNG CHI TIET trong cum
'  - asmDimMode = True (chi trong MakeWeldAsmSheet): ViewEnts gom canh / dinh moi chi tiet nhin thay,
'    ghi transform chi tiet -> cum vao compXf (doi tuong -> MathTransform), ten chi tiet vao compNm
'  - AsmPt / AsmCP / AsmCirc: doi toa do he chi tiet -> he cum. Part thuong (asmDimMode = False): tra nguyen
'===========================================================================
' Canh / dinh nhin thay cua hinh chieu (part: nhu cu; cum han: moi chi tiet, kem transform)
Public Function ViewEnts(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal entType As Long) As Variant
    Dim comps As Variant, leaf As New Collection, c As Object, ents As Variant, i As Long, col As New Collection
    Dim xfC As Object, useA As Boolean, arr() As Object, n As Long, it As Variant
    If Not asmDimMode Then
        ViewEnts = v.GetVisibleEntities2(Nothing, entType)
        Exit Function
    End If
    If compXf Is Nothing Then Set compXf = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If compNm Is Nothing Then Set compNm = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    On Error Resume Next
    comps = v.GetVisibleComponents
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(comps) Then Exit Function
    For i = 0 To UBound(comps)
        AsmLeafComps comps(i), leaf, 0
    Next i
    For Each c In leaf
        ents = Empty
        Set xfC = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        ents = v.GetVisibleEntities2(c, entType)
        Set xfC = c.Transform2
        On Error GoTo 0
        If IsArray(ents) Then
            useA = CompNeedsXf(v, ents, xfC)
            For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
                If Not ents(i) Is Nothing Then
                    col.Add ents(i)
                    If useA Then Set compXf.Item(ents(i)) = xfC
                    compNm.Item(ents(i)) = c.Name2
                End If
            Next i
        End If
    Next c
    If col.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    ReDim arr(0 To col.Count - 1)
    For Each it In col
        Set arr(n) = it: n = n + 1
    Next it
    ViewEnts = arr
End Function

' Chi tiet (la) nhin thay trong cum, bo qua chi tiet suppress / an
Private Sub AsmLeafComps(ByVal c As Object, col As Collection, ByVal depth As Long)
    Dim ch As Variant, i As Long, hasCh As Boolean
    If c Is Nothing Or depth > 20 Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    If c.IsSuppressed Then Exit Sub
    If c.Visible = 0 Then Exit Sub
    ch = Empty
    ch = c.GetChildren
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsArray(ch) Then
        For i = LBound(ch) To UBound(ch)
            hasCh = True
            AsmLeafComps ch(i), col, depth + 1
        Next i
    End If
    If Not hasCh Then col.Add c
End Sub

' Toa do canh / dinh cua chi tiet co can nhan transform chi tiet khong? (thu: diem roi vao khung hinh chieu)
Private Function CompNeedsXf(v As SldWorks.View, ents As Variant, xfC As Object) As Boolean
    Dim ol As Variant, xfV As Object, i As Long, n As Long, p As Variant, inA As Long, inB As Long
    Dim a As Variant, b As Variant
    If xfC Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    ol = v.GetOutline
    Set xfV = v.ModelToViewTransform
    For i = 0 To UBound(ents)
        p = Empty
        If TypeOf ents(i) Is SldWorks.Vertex Then
            p = ents(i).GetPoint
        Else
            p = ents(i).GetCurveParams2
        End If
        If IsArray(p) Then
            a = Empty: b = Empty
            a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xfC).MultiplyTransform(xfV).ArrayData
            b = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xfV).ArrayData
            If IsArray(a) Then If PtInOutline(a, ol) Then inA = inA + 1
            If IsArray(b) Then If PtInOutline(b, ol) Then inB = inB + 1
            n = n + 1
            If n >= 12 Then Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    CompNeedsXf = (inA >= inB)
End Function

Private Function PtInOutline(ByVal a As Variant, ByVal ol As Variant) As Boolean
    If Not IsArray(ol) Then PtInOutline = True: Exit Function
    PtInOutline = (a(0) > ol(0) - 0.003 And a(0) < ol(2) + 0.003 And a(1) > ol(1) - 0.003 And a(1) < ol(3) + 0.003)
End Function

' Doi tuong co transform chi tiet (hinh chieu cum han)?
Public Function AsmHas(ByVal ent As Object) As Boolean
    If Not asmDimMode Or compXf Is Nothing Or ent Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    AsmHas = compXf.Exists(ent)
End Function

' Diem (0-2) he chi tiet -> he cum
Public Function AsmPt(ByVal ent As Object, ByVal p As Variant) As Variant
    Dim a As Variant, q As Variant
    AsmPt = p
    If Not AsmHas(ent) Then Exit Function
    a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(compXf.Item(ent)).ArrayData
    q = p: q(0) = a(0): q(1) = a(1): q(2) = a(2)
    AsmPt = q
End Function

' GetCurveParams2: diem dau (0-2), diem cuoi (3-5) -> he cum; tham so (6, 7...) giu nguyen
Public Function AsmCP(ByVal ent As Object, ByVal cp As Variant) As Variant
    Dim a As Variant, b As Variant, q As Variant, xf As Object
    AsmCP = cp
    If IsEmpty(cp) Then Exit Function
    If Not AsmHas(ent) Then Exit Function
    Set xf = compXf.Item(ent)
    a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    b = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(3), cp(4), cp(5))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    q = cp
    q(0) = a(0): q(1) = a(1): q(2) = a(2): q(3) = b(0): q(4) = b(1): q(5) = b(2)
    AsmCP = q
End Function

' CircleParams: tam (0-2) -> he cum; truc (3-5) xoay theo chi tiet; ban kinh (6) giu nguyen
Public Function AsmCirc(ByVal ent As Object, ByVal p As Variant) As Variant
    Dim a As Variant, d As Variant, q As Variant, xf As Object, L As Double
    AsmCirc = p
    If IsEmpty(p) Then Exit Function
    If Not AsmHas(ent) Then Exit Function
    Set xf = compXf.Item(ent)
    a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    d = swMath.CreateVector(Dbl3(p(3), p(4), p(5))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    L = Sqr(d(0) ^ 2 + d(1) ^ 2 + d(2) ^ 2)
    If L < 0.000000001 Then L = 1
    q = p
    q(0) = a(0): q(1) = a(1): q(2) = a(2)
    q(3) = d(0) / L: q(4) = d(1) / L: q(5) = d(2) / L
    AsmCirc = q
End Function

' Ket thuc che do hinh chieu cum
Public Sub AsmDimEnd()
    asmDimMode = False
    Set compXf = Nothing
    Set compNm = Nothing
End Sub

' Duong tron kin co truc song song truc axIdx (0=X,1=Y,2=Z cua model)
Public Function GetCirclesAlong(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal axIdx As Long) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection
    Set GetCirclesAlong = col
    Dim ents As Variant
    ents = ViewEnts(v, swViewEntityType_Edge)            ' part: canh nhin thay | cum han: canh cua moi chi tiet
    If IsEmpty(ents) Then Exit Function

    Dim xf As SldWorks.MathTransform
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    Dim k As Long, e As SldWorks.edge, c As SldWorks.Curve, p As Variant
    Dim mv As SldWorks.MathVector, mp As SldWorks.MathPoint, a As Variant, pt As Variant
    Dim nrm As Double, fname As String, isHW As Boolean

    For k = 0 To UBound(ents)
        Set e = ents(k)
        Set c = e.GetCurve
        If Not c Is Nothing Then
            If c.IsCircle Then
                If IsFullCircle(e) Then
                    p = AsmCirc(e, c.CircleParams)                ' cum han: doi ve he toa do cum
                    nRawCircles = nRawCircles + 1
                    ' Lo nhin thang = truc lo song song truc chinh cua hinh chieu
                    If Abs(p(3 + axIdx)) > 0.99 Then
                        Set mp = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2)))
                        Set mp = mp.MultiplyTransform(xf)
                        pt = mp.ArrayData
                        GetEdgeFeature e, fname, isHW
                        ' z = toa do tam lo doc theo truc lo (m model) * ti le -> giu cung don vi voi x,y
                        col.Add Array(e, pt(0), pt(1), p(axIdx) * sc, p(6), fname, isHW)
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next k
End Function


' Canh thang trong view. Phan tu: Array(edge, x1, y1, x2, y2) (toa do giay)
Public Function GetViewLines(v As SldWorks.View) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection
    Set GetViewLines = col
    Dim ents As Variant
    ents = ViewEnts(v, swViewEntityType_Edge)
    If IsEmpty(ents) Then Exit Function

    Dim xf As SldWorks.MathTransform
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    Dim k As Long, e As SldWorks.edge, c As SldWorks.Curve, cp As Variant
    Dim p1 As SldWorks.MathPoint, p2 As SldWorks.MathPoint, a1 As Variant, a2 As Variant
    For k = 0 To UBound(ents)
        Set e = ents(k)
        Set c = e.GetCurve
        If Not c Is Nothing Then
            If c.IsLine Then
                cp = AsmCP(e, e.GetCurveParams2)
                Set p1 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf)
                Set p2 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(3), cp(4), cp(5))).MultiplyTransform(xf)
                a1 = p1.ArrayData: a2 = p2.ArrayData
                col.Add Array(e, a1(0), a1(1), a2(0), a2(1))
            End If
        End If
    Next k
End Function


Public Function IsFullCircle(e As SldWorks.edge) As Boolean
    If e.GetStartVertex Is Nothing Then IsFullCircle = True: Exit Function
    Dim cp As Variant
    cp = e.GetCurveParams2
    If Not IsEmpty(cp) Then IsFullCircle = (Abs(cp(7) - cp(6)) > 6.27)
End Function


Public Sub GetEdgeFeature(e As SldWorks.edge, fname As String, isHW As Boolean)
    Dim faces As Variant, j As Long, f As SldWorks.Face2, ft As SldWorks.Feature
    fname = "": isHW = False
    faces = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If IsEmpty(faces) Then Exit Sub
    For j = 0 To UBound(faces)
        If Not faces(j) Is Nothing Then
            Set f = faces(j)
            Set ft = f.GetFeature
            If Not ft Is Nothing Then
                If ft.GetTypeName2 = "HoleWzd" Then
                    fname = ft.Name: isHW = True
                    Exit For
                End If
                If f.GetSurface.IsCylinder Then fname = ft.Name
            End If
        End If
    Next j
    ' cum han: feature cua 2 chi tiet khac nhau co the trung ten -> them ten chi tiet
    If asmDimMode And fname <> "" And Not compNm Is Nothing Then
        If compNm.Exists(e) Then fname = compNm.Item(e) & "/" & fname
    End If
End Sub


'===========================================================================
'  PART: TRUC LO CHINH, TI LE, TEN HUONG NHIN
'===========================================================================
Public Function MainHoleAxis(swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc) As Long
    Dim bodies As Variant, b As Long, edges As Variant, k As Long
    Dim e As SldWorks.edge, c As SldWorks.Curve, p As Variant
    Dim cnt(2) As Long, bd As SldWorks.Body2
    bodies = swPart.GetBodies2(swSolidBody, True)
    MainHoleAxis = 2
    If IsEmpty(bodies) Then Exit Function
    For b = 0 To UBound(bodies)
        Set bd = bodies(b)
        edges = bd.GetEdges
        If Not IsEmpty(edges) Then
            For k = 0 To UBound(edges)
                Set e = edges(k)
                Set c = e.GetCurve
                If c.IsCircle Then
                    If IsFullCircle(e) Then
                        p = c.CircleParams
                        If Abs(p(3)) > 0.99 Then
                            cnt(0) = cnt(0) + 1
                        ElseIf Abs(p(4)) > 0.99 Then
                            cnt(1) = cnt(1) + 1
                        ElseIf Abs(p(5)) > 0.99 Then
                            cnt(2) = cnt(2) + 1
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next k
        End If
    Next b
    If cnt(0) > cnt(MainHoleAxis) Then MainHoleAxis = 0
    If cnt(1) > cnt(MainHoleAxis) Then MainHoleAxis = 1
End Function


'===========================================================================
'  REN: Cosmetic Thread & Hole Wizard taro
'===========================================================================
Public Sub BuildThreadMap(swModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2)
    Set threadMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set thrByDia = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set ctList = New Collection
    Set ctModel = swModel
    Dim f As SldWorks.Feature, sf As SldWorks.Feature, tn As String
    Set f = swModel.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        tn = f.GetTypeName2
        If tn = "HoleWzd" Then AddHwThread f
        If tn = "CosmeticThread" Then AddCtThread f, ""
        Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
        Do While Not sf Is Nothing
            If sf.GetTypeName2 = "CosmeticThread" Then AddCtThread sf, f.Name
            Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
        Loop
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop

    ' Lo ren nhan ban bang PATTERN / MIRROR: mat lo thuoc feature nhan ban -> mang thong tin ren cua feature goc
    Dim par As Variant, i As Long, pf As Object, tn2 As String
    Set f = swModel.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        tn2 = f.GetTypeName2
        If Not threadMap.Exists(f.Name) And (InStr(1, tn2, "Pattern", vbTextCompare) > 0 _
                                         Or InStr(1, tn2, "Mirror", vbTextCompare) > 0) Then
            par = Empty
            On Error Resume Next
            par = f.GetParents
            On Error GoTo 0
            If Not IsEmpty(par) Then
                For i = 0 To UBound(par)
                    Set pf = par(i)
                    If Not pf Is Nothing Then
                        If threadMap.Exists(pf.Name) Then
                            threadMap(f.Name) = threadMap.Item(pf.Name)
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    End If
                Next i
            End If
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
End Sub


Public Sub AddCtThread(f As SldWorks.Feature, ByVal ownerName As String)
    Dim d As Object, sz As String, dia As Double, depth As Double, endc As Long
    Dim par As Variant, i As Long, info As Variant, pf As SldWorks.Feature
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    sz = d.Size
    dia = d.Diameter
    depth = d.BlindDepth
    endc = d.EndCondition
    On Error GoTo 0
    If sz = "" Or LCase(sz) = "none" Then sz = "M" & ToMM(dia)
    ' EndCondition: 0 = Blind; khac 0 = Through / Up to next
    ' (3) = O danh nghia ren (mm): uu tien doc tu co ren "M5x0.8" -> 5; du phong O cua Cosmetic Thread
    Dim nomD As Double
    If UCase(Left(sz, 1)) = "M" Then nomD = Val(mid(sz, 2))
    If nomD <= 0 Then nomD = dia * 1000#
    info = Array(sz, (endc <> 0), depth, nomD, True)

    ' Uu tien: lay CANH LO ma ren gan vao -> chi lo do duoc ghi ren
    Dim e As Object, cp As Variant, okEdge As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    If d.AccessSelections(ctModel, Nothing) Then
        Set e = d.edge
        If Not e Is Nothing Then
            cp = e.GetCurve.CircleParams
            If Not IsEmpty(cp) Then
                ctList.Add Array(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2), cp(3), cp(4), cp(5), info, dia)
                okEdge = True
                ' lo cung O trong chi tiet (Pattern / Mirror / copy cua lo nay) cung la lo ren
                If Not thrByDia Is Nothing Then
                    If Not thrByDia.Exists(Format(cp(6) * 2000#, "0.00")) Then thrByDia.Add Format(cp(6) * 2000#, "0.00"), info
                End If
            End If
        End If
        d.ReleaseSelectionAccess
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If okEdge Then Exit Sub

    ' Du phong: gan theo feature tao lo
    If ownerName <> "" Then
        If Not threadMap.Exists(ownerName) Then threadMap(ownerName) = info     ' khong de len du lieu Hole Wizard
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    par = f.GetParents
    If Not IsEmpty(par) Then
        For i = 0 To UBound(par)
            Set pf = par(i)
            If Not pf Is Nothing Then
                If Left(pf.GetTypeName2, 6) <> "Profil" And pf.GetTypeName2 <> "RefPlane" Then
                    If Not threadMap.Exists(pf.Name) Then threadMap(pf.Name) = info
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub


Public Sub AddHwThread(f As SldWorks.Feature)
    Dim d As Object, fs As String, tdepth As Double, tend As Long, nom As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    fs = d.FastenerSize
    tdepth = d.ThreadDepth
    tend = d.ThreadEndCondition
    On Error GoTo 0
    If UCase(Left(fs, 1)) = "M" Then
        nom = Val(mid(fs, 2))
        If nom > 0 And Not threadMap.Exists(f.Name) Then
            threadMap(f.Name) = Array(fs, (tend = swEndCondThroughAll), tdepth, nom, False)
        End If
    End If
End Sub


' Tra ve chu thich ren cho feature (rong neu khong phai lo ren)
' Hole Wizard ghi "M5" nhung lo >= 5 mm la lo lap bulong, khong phai ren -> bo qua
Public Function ThreadText(ByVal featName As String, ByVal holeR As Double, ByVal holeThru As Boolean) As String
    If threadMap Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If featName = "" Then Exit Function
    If Not threadMap.Exists(featName) Then Exit Function
    Dim t As Variant, dHole As Double, dNom As Double
    t = threadMap.Item(featName)
    ' Chi la lo REN khi O lo hop voi co ren: 0.7*O danh nghia <= O lo <= O danh nghia
    '  (vd M5: lo mui khoan 4.2 -> ren; lo O3 cung feature -> KHONG; lo lap bulong O5.5 -> KHONG)
    dHole = holeR * 2000#: dNom = t(3)
    If dNom > 0 Then
        If dHole < 0.7 * dNom Or dHole > dNom + 0.05 Then Exit Function
    End If
    ThreadText = ThreadInfoText(t, holeThru)
End Function


Public Function ThreadInfoText(t As Variant, ByVal holeThru As Boolean) As String
    If t(1) Or (holeThru And (t(2) <= 0 Or t(2) >= thick * 0.98)) Then
        ThreadInfoText = t(0) & THRU_TEXT
    ElseIf t(2) > 0 Then
        ThreadInfoText = t(0) & DEPTH_TEXT & ToMM(t(2))
    Else
        ThreadInfoText = t(0)
    End If
End Function


' Ren cua dung lo nay: Cosmetic Thread co canh nam tren truc lo (sai lech < 0.01 mm)
Public Function CtTextAt(ByVal holeEdge As Object, ByVal holeThru As Boolean) As String
    If ctList Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If ctList.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    Dim p As Variant, c As Variant, vx As Double, vy As Double, vz As Double, dt As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    p = holeEdge.GetCurve.CircleParams
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(p) Then Exit Function
    For Each c In ctList
        If Abs(c(3) * p(3) + c(4) * p(4) + c(5) * p(5)) > 0.99 Then          ' truc song song
            vx = c(0) - p(0): vy = c(1) - p(1): vz = c(2) - p(2)
            dt = vx * p(3) + vy * p(4) + vz * p(5)
            If Sqr((vx - dt * p(3)) ^ 2 + (vy - dt * p(4)) ^ 2 + (vz - dt * p(5)) ^ 2) < 0.00001 Then
                ' cung truc: con phai cung CO (O mat tru ~ O ren, sai lech <= 25%) -> chi tiet truc co nhieu bac
                Dim inf As Variant, nm As Double
                inf = c(6): nm = inf(3) / 1000#                       ' O danh nghia ren (m)
                If nm <= 0 Then nm = c(7)
                If nm <= 0 Or (2 * p(6) >= 0.7 * nm And 2 * p(6) <= nm + 0.00005) Then
                    CtTextAt = ThreadInfoText(c(6), holeThru)
                    Exit Function
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next c
End Function


Public Function ThreadNote(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal e As Object, ByVal n As Long, ByVal txt As String, _
                            ByVal PX As Double, ByVal py As Double) As Boolean
    Dim nt As Object
    If n > 1 Then txt = n & COUNT_SEP & txt
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not SelectInView(v, e, False) Then Exit Function
    Set nt = swDrawModel.InsertNote(txt)            ' canh dang chon -> note co leader chi vao lo
    If nt Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    nt.GetAnnotation.SetPosition PX, py, 0
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    ThreadNote = True
End Function


Public Function ToMM(ByVal m As Double) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = Replace(Format(m * 1000#, "0.##"), ",", ".")
    If Right(t, 1) = "." Then t = Left(t, Len(t) - 1)
    ToMM = t
End Function


' Kich thuoc cho 1 canh (canh tron nhin nghieng = duong kinh)
Public Function AddDim1(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal e As Object, ByVal horiz As Boolean, _
                         ByVal PX As Double, ByVal py As Double) As Boolean
    Dim dd As Object, t As String
    Set lastDD = Nothing
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not SelectInView(v, e, False) Then Exit Function
    If horiz Then
        Set dd = swDrawModel.AddHorizontalDimension2(PX, py, 0)
    Else
        Set dd = swDrawModel.AddVerticalDimension2(PX, py, 0)
    End If
    If dd Is Nothing Then
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If SelectInView(v, e, False) Then Set dd = swDrawModel.AddDimension2(PX, py, 0)
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If dd Is Nothing Then
        nDimFail = nDimFail + 1
        dimLog = dimLog & "O tai (" & Format(PX * 1000, "0.0") & "," & Format(py * 1000, "0.0") & ") = Nothing" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    If horiz Then RecordDimRect True, PX - 0.006, PX + 0.006, py Else RecordDimRect False, py - 0.006, py + 0.006, PX
    ' Them ky hieu O neu SolidWorks chua tu them
    On Error Resume Next
    t = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix)
    If InStr(1, t, "DIAM", vbTextCompare) = 0 And InStr(t, ChrW(&H2300)) = 0 And InStr(t, ChrW(&HD8)) = 0 Then
        dd.SetText swDimensionTextPrefix, "<MOD-DIAM>" & t
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    FitPrecision dd
    Set lastDD = dd
    ' Ghi lai de buoc kiem tra: nhip do = duong kinh chieu len giay
    Dim ecx As Double, ecy As Double, rR As Double, cpp As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    cpp = e.GetCurve.CircleParams
    rR = cpp(6) * v.ScaleDecimal
    EdgeSheetPos v, e, ecx, ecy
    On Error GoTo 0
    If horiz Then RecordDim dd, v, True, ecx - rR, ecx + rR, py Else RecordDim dd, v, False, ecy - rR, ecy + rR, PX
    AddDim1 = True
End Function


'===========================================================================
'  RANH (SLOT): 2 nua cung tron cung ban kinh doi dien nhau
'===========================================================================
' Phan tu: Array(cung1, cung2, x1, y1, x2, y2, r, tenFeature, thru, sau)
Public Function GetSlots(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal axIdx As Long) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection
    Set GetSlots = col
    Set loneArcs = New Collection
    Dim ents As Variant
    ents = ViewEnts(v, swViewEntityType_Edge)
    If IsEmpty(ents) Then Exit Function

    Dim xf As SldWorks.MathTransform
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    Dim k As Long, e As SldWorks.edge, c As SldWorks.Curve, p As Variant, cp As Variant
    Dim pt As Variant, fname As String, isHW As Boolean, key As String, a As Variant
    Dim arcs As Object, midPt As Variant, tm As Double, mdx As Double, mdy As Double
    Set arcs = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")   ' feature|r|tam -> Array(edge, x, y, r, f, zmin, zmax, huong x, huong y)

    For k = 0 To UBound(ents)
        Set e = ents(k)
        Set c = e.GetCurve
        If Not c Is Nothing Then
            If c.IsCircle Then
                cp = AsmCP(e, e.GetCurveParams2)
                If Not IsEmpty(cp) Then
                    p = AsmCirc(e, c.CircleParams)
                    If IsHalfArc(cp, p(6)) Then                                   ' nua duong tron
                        If Abs(p(3 + axIdx)) > 0.99 Then
                            pt = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                            GetEdgeFeature e, fname, isHW
                            ' Khoa = ban kinh + tam (KHONG theo feature: cung mat tren/duoi cua 1 ranh co the thuoc feature khac nhau)
                            key = Format(p(6) * 2000#, "0.00") & "|" & _
                                  Format(pt(0) / sc * 1000#, "0.00") & "_" & Format(pt(1) / sc * 1000#, "0.00")
                            If arcs.Exists(key) Then
                                a = arcs.Item(key)
                                If p(axIdx) < a(5) Then a(5) = p(axIdx)
                                If p(axIdx) > a(6) Then a(6) = p(axIdx)
                                If a(4) = "" Then a(4) = fname
                                arcs.Item(key) = a
                            Else
                                ' Huong phinh cua cung (tren giay) + 2 dau mut cung (tren giay)
                                ArcBulge e, c, p, cp, xf, pt, mdx, mdy
                                Dim ea As Variant, eB As Variant
                                ea = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                                eB = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(3), cp(4), cp(5))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                                arcs.Add key, Array(e, pt(0), pt(1), p(6), fname, p(axIdx), p(axIdx), mdx, mdy, _
                                                    Array(ea(0), ea(1), eB(0), eB(1)))
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next k

    ' Ghep cap: cung gan nhat cung feature & ban kinh
    Dim aKeys As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, bestJ As Long, bestD As Double, d As Double
    Dim ai As Variant, aj As Variant, used As Object, ai0 As Variant
    If arcs.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    If arcs.Count = 1 Then
        Dim itms As Variant
        itms = arcs.items
        ai0 = itms(0)
        loneArcs.Add Array(ai0(0), ai0(1), ai0(2), 0#, ai0(3), ai0(4), False)
        Exit Function
    End If
    aKeys = arcs.Keys
    Set used = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim vLines As Collection
    Set vLines = GetViewLines(v)
    For i = 0 To UBound(aKeys)
        If Not used.Exists(i) Then
            ai = arcs.Item(aKeys(i)): bestJ = -1: bestD = 1E+30
            For j = 0 To UBound(aKeys)
                If j <> i And Not used.Exists(j) Then
                    aj = arcs.Item(aKeys(j))
                    If Abs(aj(3) - ai(3)) < 0.0000001 Then
                        d = Sqr((aj(1) - ai(1)) ^ 2 + (aj(2) - ai(2)) ^ 2)
                        ' Ranh that: 2 nua cung NOI VOI NHAU BANG 2 CANH THANG (dau mut trung nhau),
                        ' hoac (du phong) cung feature & 2 cung phinh RA XA nhau
                        If d > 0.0000001 And d < bestD Then
                            If ArcsLinked(ai, aj, vLines) Then
                                bestD = d: bestJ = j
                            ElseIf aj(4) = ai(4) And ArcsFaceApart(ai, aj) Then
                                bestD = d: bestJ = j
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next j
            If bestJ >= 0 Then
                aj = arcs.Item(aKeys(bestJ))
                used.Add i, 1: used.Add bestJ, 1
                Dim zMin As Double, zmax As Double
                zMin = ai(5): If aj(5) < zMin Then zMin = aj(5)
                zmax = ai(6): If aj(6) > zmax Then zmax = aj(6)
                col.Add Array(ai(0), aj(0), ai(1), ai(2), aj(1), aj(2), ai(3), ai(4), _
                              (zmax - zMin) >= thick * 0.98, zmax - zMin)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    ' Cung khong ghep cap -> cung le
    For i = 0 To UBound(aKeys)
        If Not used.Exists(i) Then
            ai = arcs.Item(aKeys(i))
            loneArcs.Add Array(ai(0), ai(1), ai(2), 0#, ai(3), ai(4), False)
        End If
    Next i
End Function


' Chu thich ranh: "n-RANH rong x dai THRU" (dai = tong chieu dai ranh)
Public Sub SlotNotes(v As SldWorks.View, slots As Collection, ByVal xLeft As Double, _
                      ByVal xRight As Double, ByVal yTop As Double, ByVal yBot As Double)
    If slots.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub
    Dim grp As Object, sl As Variant, w As Double, L As Double, txt As String, g As Variant
    Dim key As Variant, PX As Double, py As Double, nOk As Long
    Set grp = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each sl In slots
        w = sl(6) * 2
        L = Sqr((sl(4) - sl(2)) ^ 2 + (sl(5) - sl(3)) ^ 2) / sc + w
        txt = SLOT_TEXT & ToMM(w) & "x" & ToMM(L)
        If sl(8) Then
            txt = txt & THRU_TEXT
        ElseIf sl(9) > 0.00001 Then
            txt = txt & DEPTH_TEXT & ToMM(sl(9))
        End If
        If grp.Exists(txt) Then
            g = grp.Item(txt): g(0) = g(0) + 1: grp.Item(txt) = g
        Else
            grp.Add txt, Array(1, sl(0), sl(1), (sl(2) + sl(4)) / 2, (sl(3) + sl(5)) / 2)
        End If
    Next sl

    ' Goi ranh bang HOLE CALLOUT (SolidWorks ho tro ranh Hole Wizard Slot & Cut-Extrude tu Straight Slot)
    Dim dd As Object, nCall As Long, nNote As Long, k As Long
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    For Each key In grp.Keys
        g = grp.Item(key)
        NoteNear g(3), g(4), PX, py
        Set dd = Nothing
        For k = 1 To 2                                  ' thu lan luot 2 cung cua ranh
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            If SelectInView(v, g(k), False, True) Then Set dd = swDraw.AddHoleCallout2(PX, py, 0)
            If Not dd Is Nothing Then Exit For
        Next k
        If Not dd Is Nothing Then
            nCall = nCall + 1
            FitPrecision dd
            AddCountPrefix dd, g(0)
            dimLog = dimLog & "Slot HoleCallout OK: " & g(0) & " ranh " & key & vbCrLf
        Else
            dimLog = dimLog & "Slot HoleCallout LOI: " & g(0) & " ranh " & key & vbCrLf
            If ALLOW_NOTE_FALLBACK Then
                If ThreadNote(v, g(1), g(0), CStr(key), PX, py) Then nNote = nNote + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next key
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    report = report & "Ranh (slot): " & slots.Count & " ranh  |  Hole Callout " & nCall & _
             IIf(nNote > 0, "  |  note du phong " & nNote, "") & vbCrLf
End Sub


'===========================================================================
'  VAT MEP (CHAMFER): doc tu feature, ghi "C1" / "2x30<MOD-DEG>" co mui ten
'===========================================================================
Public Sub ChamferNotes(swModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, vMain As SldWorks.View, vBelow As SldWorks.View, _
                         vSide As SldWorks.View)
    ' 1) Doc cac feature vat mep: chu ghi ("2-C1") + cac mat vat
    Dim f As SldWorks.Feature, d As Object, tp As Long, d0 As Double, d1 As Double, ang As Double
    Dim txt As String, faces As Variant, nFace As Long
    Dim feats As New Collection
    Set f = swModel.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "Chamfer" Then
            tp = 0: d0 = 0: d1 = 0: ang = 0
            On Error Resume Next
            Set d = f.GetDefinition
            tp = d.Type
            d0 = d.GetEdgeChamferDistance(0)
            d1 = d.GetEdgeChamferDistance(1)
            ang = d.EdgeChamferAngle * 57.2957795
            On Error GoTo 0
            If tp = 1 Then
                If Abs(ang - 45) < 0.5 Then txt = "C" & ToMM(d0) Else txt = ToMM(d0) & "x" & Format(ang, "0.#") & "<MOD-DEG>"
            ElseIf tp = 2 And Abs(d0 - d1) > 0.000001 And d1 > 0 Then
                txt = ToMM(d0) & "x" & ToMM(d1)
            Else
                txt = "C" & ToMM(d0)
            End If
            faces = f.GetFaces
            nFace = 0
            If Not IsEmpty(faces) Then nFace = UBound(faces) + 1
            If d0 > 0 And nFace > 0 Then
                If nFace > 1 Then txt = nFace & COUNT_SEP & txt
                feats.Add Array(txt, faces, nFace)
            End If
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    If feats.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub

    ' 2) Moi hinh chieu: toi da MAX_C_PER_VIEW vi tri C, uu tien goc vat gan GOC NGOAI cua hinh,
    '    feature da ghi o hinh truoc thi khong ghi lai
    Dim noted As Object, vv As Variant, vw As SldWorks.View, nOk As Long
    Set noted = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each vv In Array(vMain, vBelow, vSide)
        If Not vv Is Nothing Then
            Set vw = vv
            nOk = nOk + ChamferNotesInView(vw, feats, noted)
        End If
    Next vv
    report = report & "Vat mep: ghi " & nOk & " vi tri / " & feats.Count & " feature" & vbCrLf
End Sub

Private Function ChamferNotesInView(v As SldWorks.View, feats As Collection, noted As Object) As Long
    Const MAX_C_PER_VIEW As Long = 2
    Dim xf As SldWorks.MathTransform, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, k As Long, ft As Variant, fc As Object, edges As Variant, e As Object
    Dim cp As Variant, pt As Variant, mp As SldWorks.MathPoint, sc0 As Double, best As Double
    Dim cand As New Collection, bestE As Object, bestPt As Variant
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT

    ' Ung vien: moi feature chua ghi -> canh vat hien thanh duong xien, gan goc hop bao nhat
    For i = 1 To feats.Count
        If Not noted.Exists(i) Then
            ft = feats(i)
            best = 1E+30: Set bestE = Nothing
            For j = 0 To ft(2) - 1
                Set fc = ft(1)(j)
                edges = fc.GetEdges
                If Not IsEmpty(edges) Then
                    For k = 0 To UBound(edges)
                        Set e = edges(k)
                        If EdgeLooksSlanted(e, xf) Then
                            cp = e.GetCurveParams2
                            Set mp = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3((cp(0) + cp(3)) / 2, (cp(1) + cp(4)) / 2, (cp(2) + cp(5)) / 2))
                            pt = mp.MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                            ' khoang cach toi goc hop bao gan nhat
                            sc0 = MinD(Abs(pt(0) - xL), Abs(pt(0) - xR)) + MinD(Abs(pt(1) - yB), Abs(pt(1) - yT))
                            If sc0 < best Then best = sc0: Set bestE = e: bestPt = pt
                        End If
                    Next k
                End If
            Next j
            If Not bestE Is Nothing Then cand.Add Array(best, i, bestE, bestPt)
        End If
    Next i
    If cand.Count = 0 Then Exit Function

    ' Sap theo do gan goc, lay toi da MAX_C_PER_VIEW
    Dim arr() As Variant, n As Long, t As Variant
    n = cand.Count
    ReDim arr(n - 1)
    For i = 1 To n: arr(i - 1) = cand(i): Next i
    For i = 0 To n - 2
        For j = i + 1 To n - 1
            If arr(j)(0) < arr(i)(0) Then t = arr(i): arr(i) = arr(j): arr(j) = t
        Next j
    Next i

    Dim nt As Object, PX As Double, py As Double, cnt As Long
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If cnt >= MAX_C_PER_VIEW Then Exit For
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If SelectInView(v, arr(i)(2), False, True) Then
            ft = feats(arr(i)(1))
            Set nt = swDrawModel.InsertNote(CStr(ft(0)))
            If Not nt Is Nothing Then
                pt = arr(i)(3)
                ChamferNotePos pt(0), pt(1), xL, xR, yB, yT, Len(CStr(ft(0))), PX, py
                On Error Resume Next
                nt.GetAnnotation.SetPosition PX, py, 0
                On Error GoTo 0
                noted(arr(i)(1)) = True
                cnt = cnt + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    ChamferNotesInView = cnt
End Function

' Vi tri chu vat mep: CHEO RA NGOAI tu goc vat, mui ten ngan (8..20 mm), chi ne kich thuoc & ghi chu khac
Private Sub ChamferNotePos(ByVal cx As Double, ByVal cy As Double, ByVal xL As Double, ByVal xR As Double, _
                           ByVal yB As Double, ByVal yT As Double, ByVal nChar As Long, PX As Double, py As Double)
    Dim w As Double, h As Double, r As Double, k As Long, sx As Double, sy As Double, dirs As Variant
    Dim x1 As Double, y1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double
    If usedNotes Is Nothing Then Set usedNotes = New Collection
    If dimRects Is Nothing Then Set dimRects = New Collection
    w = 0.0025 * nChar + 0.002: h = 0.005
    sx = IIf(cx >= (xL + xR) / 2, 1, -1): sy = IIf(cy >= (yB + yT) / 2, 1, -1)
    dirs = Array(Array(sx, sy), Array(sx, -sy), Array(-sx, sy))
    For r = 0.008 To 0.0201 Step 0.004
        For k = 0 To UBound(dirs)
            PX = cx + dirs(k)(0) * r * 0.7071
            py = cy + dirs(k)(1) * r * 0.7071
            If dirs(k)(0) < 0 Then PX = PX - w
            If dirs(k)(1) > 0 Then py = py + h
            x1 = PX: y1 = py - h: x2 = PX + w: y2 = py
            If Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, dimRects) And Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, usedNotes) Then
                usedNotes.Add Array(x1, y1, x2, y2)
                Exit Sub
            End If
        Next k
    Next r
    ' khong ne duoc: van dat cheo ngan 10 mm
    PX = cx + sx * 0.007: py = cy + sy * 0.007
    If sx < 0 Then PX = PX - w
    If sy > 0 Then py = py + h
    usedNotes.Add Array(PX, py - h, PX + w, py)
End Sub

Private Function MinD(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a < b Then MinD = a Else MinD = b
End Function


' Them so luong "n-" vao dong dau cua Hole Callout (neu SolidWorks chua tu ghi so luong)
Public Sub AddCountPrefix(ByVal dd As Object, ByVal n As Long)
    Dim t1 As String, t2 As String
    On Error Resume Next
    ' So luong tu dong cua SolidWorks (<NUM_INST>X) chi dem lo trong 1 feature -> thay bang TONG so lo giong nhau
    t1 = "": t1 = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove)
    t2 = StripNumInst(t1)
    If t2 <> t1 Then dd.SetText swDimensionTextCalloutAbove, t2
    t1 = "": t1 = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix)
    t2 = StripNumInst(t1)
    If t2 <> t1 Then dd.SetText swDimensionTextPrefix, t2
    If n <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    t1 = "": t1 = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove)
    If Trim(t1) <> "" Then
        If Not IsNumeric(Left(Trim(t1), 1)) Then dd.SetText swDimensionTextCalloutAbove, n & COUNT_SEP & t1
    Else
        t1 = "": t1 = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix)
        If Not IsNumeric(Left(Trim(t1), 1)) Then dd.SetText swDimensionTextPrefix, n & COUNT_SEP & t1
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Bo "<NUM_INST>" (+ "X" theo sau) khoi chu callout
Private Function StripNumInst(ByVal t As String) As String
    Dim p As Long, q As Long
    p = InStr(1, t, "<NUM_INST>", vbTextCompare)
    If p = 0 Then StripNumInst = t: Exit Function
    q = p + Len("<NUM_INST>")
    Do While q <= Len(t)
        If mid(t, q, 1) = " " Then
            q = q + 1
        ElseIf UCase(mid(t, q, 1)) = "X" Then
            q = q + 1
            Do While q <= Len(t)
                If mid(t, q, 1) <> " " Then Exit Do
                q = q + 1
            Loop
            Exit Do
        Else
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop
    StripNumInst = Left(t, p - 1) & mid(t, q)
End Function


' Dam bao ban ve chung la tai lieu hien hanh (ten cua so ban ve co dang "Draw1 - Sheet1")
Public Sub EnsureDrawingActive()
    Dim act As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, aErr As Long, t As String
    Set act = swApp.ActiveDoc
    If Not act Is Nothing Then
        If act.GetType = swDocDRAWING And act.GetTitle = swDrawModel.GetTitle Then Exit Sub
    End If
    t = swDrawModel.GetTitle
    swApp.ActivateDoc3 t, False, swDontRebuildActiveDoc, aErr
    If aErr <> 0 And InStr(t, " - ") > 0 Then
        swApp.ActivateDoc3 Left(t, InStr(t, " - ") - 1), False, swDontRebuildActiveDoc, aErr
    End If
End Sub


'===========================================================================
'  THU MUC BO QUA (vd "TBTC") TRONG CAY ASSEMBLY
'===========================================================================
' Tra ve tap ten component (Name2) nam trong cac thu muc SKIP_FOLDERS (ke ca thu muc con)
Public Function GetFolderComponents(asmModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, Optional ByVal folderList As String = "") As Object
    Dim d As Object, f As SldWorks.Feature, names As Variant, i As Long, fn As String
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set GetFolderComponents = d
    If folderList = "" Then folderList = SKIP_FOLDERS             ' mac dinh: thu muc bo qua (TBTC/TBC/TBD)
    If Trim(folderList) = "" Then Exit Function
    names = Split(UCase(folderList), ",")
    Set f = asmModel.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "FtrFolder" Then
            fn = UCase(Trim(f.Name))
            For i = 0 To UBound(names)
                If FolderNameMatch(fn, Trim(names(i))) Then CollectFolder f, d: Exit For
            Next i
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
End Function


Public Sub CollectFolder(ByVal f As Object, d As Object)
    Dim fld As Object, feats As Variant, i As Long, sf As Object, comp As Object, nm As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Set fld = f.GetSpecificFeature2
    feats = fld.GetFeatures
    On Error GoTo 0
    If IsEmpty(feats) Then Exit Sub
    For i = 0 To UBound(feats)
        Set sf = feats(i)
        If Not sf Is Nothing Then
            If sf.GetTypeName2 = "FtrFolder" Then
                CollectFolder sf, d                      ' thu muc long nhau
            Else
                Set comp = Nothing: nm = ""
                On Error Resume Next
                Set comp = sf.GetSpecificFeature2        ' feature cua component -> Component2
                nm = comp.Name2
                ' cum con chua mo rieng: GetSpecificFeature2 co the khong tra ve component -> dung TEN FEATURE
                If nm = "" And sf.GetTypeName2 = "Reference" Then nm = sf.Name
                On Error GoTo 0
                If nm <> "" Then
                    d(UCase(nm)) = 1
                    d(UCase(mid(nm, InStrRev(nm, "/") + 1))) = 1     ' ten tuong doi (bo "CumCon-1/")
                End If
                ' them ten feature cua component (= ten component trong cum) phong khi Name2 khac dang
                If sf.GetTypeName2 = "Reference" And sf.Name <> "" Then d(UCase(sf.Name)) = 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub


' Thu muc bo qua cua 1 cum con, duyet cay COMPONENT (ngu canh cum tong). Ten: day du & tuong doi
Private Function CompFolderComponents(ByVal par As Object, Optional ByVal folderList As String = "") As Object
    Dim d As Object, f As Object, nx As Object, names As Variant, i As Long, fn As String, guard As Long
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set CompFolderComponents = d
    If folderList = "" Then folderList = SKIP_FOLDERS
    If Trim(folderList) = "" Then Exit Function
    names = Split(UCase(folderList), ",")
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = par.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And guard < 100000
        guard = guard + 1
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "FtrFolder" Then
            fn = UCase(Trim(f.Name))
            For i = 0 To UBound(names)
                If FolderNameMatch(fn, Trim(names(i))) Then CollectFolder f, d: Exit For
            Next i
        End If
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = f.GetNextFeature
        Set f = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Component co nam trong thu muc bo qua khong - xet O MOI CAP:
'  - cum tong: ten component (Name2) nam trong thu muc TBTC/TBC/TBD cua cum tong
'  - cum con : ten TUONG DOI cua component trong cum con nam trong thu muc TBTC/TBC/TBD cua cum con
'  - neu 1 cum con nam trong thu muc bo qua -> moi chi tiet ben trong cung bi bo qua
Public Function InSkipFolder(ByVal comp As SldWorks.Component2, skipSet As Object) As Boolean
    Dim c As SldWorks.Component2, par As SldWorks.Component2, relName As String, subSet As Object
    Set c = comp
    Do While Not c Is Nothing
        Set par = c.GetParent
        If par Is Nothing Then
            ' cap cum tong
            If Not skipSet Is Nothing Then
                If skipSet.Exists(UCase(c.Name2)) Then InSkipFolder = True: Exit Function
            End If
        Else
            ' cap cum con: ten tuong doi trong cum con (bo phan "TenCumCon-1/")
            relName = c.Name2
            If UCase(Left(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 1)) = UCase(par.Name2 & "/") Then relName = mid(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 2)
            Set subSet = SubAsmSkipSet(par)
            If Not subSet Is Nothing Then
                If subSet.Exists(UCase(relName)) Then InSkipFolder = True: Exit Function
            End If
        End If
        Set c = par
    Loop
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  THU MUC HAN (WELD_FOLDERS, vd "BVHAN"): component nam trong thu muc han o MOI CAP,
'  hoac nam trong 1 cum con dang o thu muc han (chi tiet cua cum han)
'===========================================================================
' Component nam TRUC TIEP trong 1 folder thuoc folderList (tai cap cua no: cum tong hoac cum con chua no)?
' cache: Dictionary (duong dan cum con -> tap ten component trong folder) do noi goi giu
Public Function DirectInFolderList(ByVal comp As SldWorks.Component2, topSet As Object, ByVal folderList As String, _
                                   cache As Object) As Boolean
    Dim par As SldWorks.Component2, relName As String, p As String, md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
    Dim d As Object, d2 As Object, k As Variant
    Set par = comp.GetParent
    If par Is Nothing Then
        If Not topSet Is Nothing Then DirectInFolderList = topSet.Exists(UCase(comp.Name2))
        Exit Function
    End If
    relName = comp.Name2
    If UCase(Left(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 1)) = UCase(par.Name2 & "/") Then relName = mid(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 2)
    p = LCase(par.GetPathName)
    If p = "" Then Exit Function
    If Not cache.Exists(p) Then
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        On Error Resume Next
        Set md = Nothing
        Set md = par.GetModelDoc2
        If md Is Nothing Then Set md = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(par.GetPathName)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not md Is Nothing Then
            If md.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                Set d2 = GetFolderComponents(md, folderList)
                For Each k In d2.Keys
                    d(k) = 1
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set d2 = CompFolderComponents(par, folderList)
        For Each k In d2.Keys
            d(k) = 1
        Next k
        cache.Add p, d
    End If
    DirectInFolderList = cache.Item(p).Exists(UCase(relName))
    ' du phong: doan cuoi cua Name2 ("Cum-1/CumCon-1/ChiTiet-1" -> "ChiTiet-1")
    If Not DirectInFolderList Then DirectInFolderList = cache.Item(p).Exists(UCase(mid(comp.Name2, InStrRev(comp.Name2, "/") + 1)))
End Function

Public Sub ResetWeldCache()
    Set weldSubCache = Nothing
End Sub

' directOnly = True: chi xet CHINH component (nam truc tiep trong thu muc han o cap cua no),
'                    khong tinh truong hop nam ben trong 1 cum han
Public Function InWeldFolder(ByVal comp As SldWorks.Component2, topSet As Object, _
                             Optional ByVal directOnly As Boolean = False) As Boolean
    Dim c As SldWorks.Component2, par As SldWorks.Component2, relName As String, subSet As Object
    Set c = comp
    Do While Not c Is Nothing
        Set par = c.GetParent
        If par Is Nothing Then
            If Not topSet Is Nothing Then
                If topSet.Exists(UCase(c.Name2)) Then InWeldFolder = True: Exit Function
            End If
        Else
            relName = c.Name2
            If UCase(Left(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 1)) = UCase(par.Name2 & "/") Then relName = mid(relName, Len(par.Name2) + 2)
            Set subSet = WeldSubSet(par)
            If Not subSet Is Nothing Then
                If subSet.Exists(UCase(relName)) Then InWeldFolder = True: Exit Function
            End If
        End If
        If directOnly Then Exit Function
        Set c = par                                   ' cum cha nam trong thu muc han -> chi tiet nay cung la chi tiet han
    Loop
End Function

Private Function WeldSubSet(ByVal par As SldWorks.Component2) As Object
    Dim p As String, md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, d As Object, k As Variant, d2 As Object
    If weldSubCache Is Nothing Then Set weldSubCache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    p = LCase(par.GetPathName)
    If p = "" Then Exit Function
    If Not weldSubCache.Exists(p) Then
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        On Error Resume Next
        Set md = Nothing
        Set md = par.GetModelDoc2
        If md Is Nothing Then Set md = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(par.GetPathName)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not md Is Nothing Then
            If md.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                Set d2 = GetFolderComponents(md, WELD_FOLDERS)
                For Each k In d2.Keys
                    d(k) = 1
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set d2 = CompFolderComponents(par, WELD_FOLDERS)
        For Each k In d2.Keys
            d(k) = 1
        Next k
        weldSubCache.Add p, d
    End If
    Set WeldSubSet = weldSubCache.Item(p)
End Function

' Tap ten component trong thu muc bo qua cua 1 cum con (luu dem theo duong dan file cum con)
Private Function SubAsmSkipSet(ByVal par As SldWorks.Component2) As Object
    Dim p As String, md As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, cache As Object
    If subSkipCache Is Nothing Then Set subSkipCache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set cache = subSkipCache
    p = LCase(par.GetPathName)
    If p = "" Then Exit Function
    If Not cache.Exists(p) Then
        ' Gop 2 cach doc thu muc TBTC/TBC/TBD cua cum con:
        '  (1) cay cua file cum con; (2) cay cua component trong ngu canh cum tong (khong can mo file cum con)
        Dim d As Object, k As Variant, d2 As Object
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        On Error Resume Next
        Set md = Nothing
        Set md = par.GetModelDoc2
        If md Is Nothing Then Set md = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(par.GetPathName)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not md Is Nothing Then
            If md.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                Set d2 = GetFolderComponents(md)
                For Each k In d2.Keys
                    d(k) = 1
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set d2 = CompFolderComponents(par)
        For Each k In d2.Keys
            d(k) = 1
        Next k
        cache.Add p, d
    End If
    Set SubAsmSkipSet = cache.Item(p)
End Function


'===========================================================================
'  KICH THUOC HINH DANG (tu canh thang) & BAN KINH
'===========================================================================
' Chon canh thang dai nhat nam tren bien (pos) lam tham chieu; khong co -> dung diem du phong
Public Sub BoundaryRef(lines As Collection, ByVal vertical As Boolean, ByVal pos As Double, _
                        ByVal fallback As Variant, outRef As Variant)
    Dim it As Variant, best As Object, bestLen As Double, ln As Double, tol As Double
    tol = 0.00005
    For Each it In lines
        If vertical Then
            If Abs(it(1) - it(3)) < 0.000001 And Abs(it(1) - pos) < tol Then
                ln = Abs(it(4) - it(2))
                If ln > bestLen Then bestLen = ln: Set best = it(0)
            End If
        Else
            If Abs(it(2) - it(4)) < 0.000001 And Abs(it(2) - pos) < tol Then
                ln = Abs(it(3) - it(1))
                If ln > bestLen Then bestLen = ln: Set best = it(0)
            End If
        End If
    Next it
    If best Is Nothing Then
        outRef = fallback
    Else
        Set outRef = best
    End If
End Sub


' Vi tri cac canh thang song song (doc: vertical=True -> toa do x), bo canh sat bien va
' canh sat nhau < MIN_GAP (canh vat mep) - giu canh dai hon. Tra ve phan tu dang Array(edge, x, y, ...)
Public Function OutlinePositions(lines As Collection, ByVal vertical As Boolean, ByVal lo As Double, _
                                  ByVal hi As Double, ByVal midOther As Double, vd As Variant, _
                                  Optional ByVal loose As Boolean = False) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, it As Variant, n As Long, i As Long, j As Long, gap As Double
    Dim pos() As Double, lens() As Double, eds() As Object, mids() As Double, t As Double, tObj As Object
    Dim flg() As Boolean, tf As Boolean
    Set OutlinePositions = col
    gap = MIN_GAP * sc
    ReDim pos(lines.Count): ReDim lens(lines.Count): ReDim eds(lines.Count): ReDim mids(lines.Count)
    ReDim flg(lines.Count)                              ' True = canh cua duong bao KIN ben trong mat truoc (dang A)
    For Each it In lines
        If loose Then
            If Not IsShapeEdgeLoose(it(0), vd) Then GoTo nextLine   ' Full: moi canh nhin thay (tru vat mep / bo tron)
        Else
            If Not IsShapeEdge(it(0), vd) Then GoTo nextLine      ' canh khuat / canh vat mep / canh bo tron
        End If
        If LineInSlot(it) Then GoTo nextLine                    ' canh thang nam trong khung bao ranh
        If vertical Then
            If Abs(it(1) - it(3)) < 0.000001 Then
                If it(1) - lo > gap And hi - it(1) > gap Then
                    pos(n) = it(1): lens(n) = Abs(it(4) - it(2)): mids(n) = (it(2) + it(4)) / 2
                    flg(n) = EdgeInInnerLoop(it(0), vd)
                    Set eds(n) = it(0): n = n + 1
                End If
            End If
        Else
            If Abs(it(2) - it(4)) < 0.000001 Then
                If it(2) - lo > gap And hi - it(2) > gap Then
                    pos(n) = it(2): lens(n) = Abs(it(3) - it(1)): mids(n) = (it(1) + it(3)) / 2
                    flg(n) = EdgeInInnerLoop(it(0), vd)
                    Set eds(n) = it(0): n = n + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
nextLine:
    Next it
    If n = 0 Then Exit Function
    ' sap xep theo vi tri
    For i = 0 To n - 2
        For j = i + 1 To n - 1
            If pos(j) < pos(i) Then
                t = pos(i): pos(i) = pos(j): pos(j) = t
                t = lens(i): lens(i) = lens(j): lens(j) = t
                t = mids(i): mids(i) = mids(j): mids(j) = t
                tf = flg(i): flg(i) = flg(j): flg(j) = tf
                Set tObj = eds(i): Set eds(i) = eds(j): Set eds(j) = tObj
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
    ' gop canh sat nhau, giu canh dai nhat
    Dim kp As Double, kl As Double, ke As Object, km As Double, kf As Boolean
    kp = pos(0): kl = lens(0): km = mids(0): Set ke = eds(0): kf = flg(0)
    For i = 1 To n
        If i < n Then
            If pos(i) - kp < gap Then
                If flg(i) Then kf = True                  ' cung vi tri: 1 canh thuoc duong bao kin -> dang A
                If lens(i) > kl Then kp = pos(i): kl = lens(i): km = mids(i): Set ke = eds(i)
                GoTo nextI
            End If
        End If
        ' phan tu (7): True = dang A (duong bao kin ben trong hinh), False = dang B (duong ho, chay ra mep)
        If vertical Then
            col.Add Array(ke, kp, km, 0#, 0#, "", False, kf)
        Else
            col.Add Array(ke, km, kp, 0#, 0#, "", False, kf)
        End If
        If i < n Then kp = pos(i): kl = lens(i): km = mids(i): Set ke = eds(i): kf = flg(i)
nextI:
    Next i
End Function

' Canh thuoc VONG BIEN TRONG (duong bao kin: hoc, cua so, ranh kin...) cua mat huong ve nguoi xem?
' (canh thuoc vong bien ngoai cua mat = duong ho / chay ra mep chi tiet -> False)
Public Function EdgeInInnerLoop(ByVal e As Object, vd As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim ces As Variant, i As Long, lp As Object, fc As Object, nV As Variant
    On Error GoTo fin
    ces = e.GetCoEdges
    If IsEmpty(ces) Then GoTo fin
    For i = 0 To UBound(ces)
        Set lp = Nothing
        Set lp = ces(i).GetLoop
        If Not lp Is Nothing Then
            If Not lp.IsOuter Then
                Set fc = lp.GetFace
                nV = Empty
                nV = fc.Normal
                If Not IsEmpty(nV) Then
                    If nV(0) * vd(0) + nV(1) * vd(1) + nV(2) * vd(2) > 0.1 Then EdgeInInnerLoop = True: Exit Function
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
fin:
End Function

' Loc vi tri hinh dang theo dang: wantClosed = True -> chi dang A; False -> chi dang B (ke ca buoc duong bao)
Public Function FilterShapeKind(col As Collection, ByVal wantClosed As Boolean) As Collection
    Dim c As New Collection, it As Variant, isA As Boolean
    For Each it In col
        isA = False
        If UBound(it) >= 7 Then isA = it(7)
        If isA = wantClosed Then c.Add it
    Next it
    Set FilterShapeKind = c
End Function


' Ban kinh cung le, gom theo ban kinh: "2-R2"
Public Function RadiusDims(v As SldWorks.View, arcsCol As Collection) As Long
    Dim g As Object, it As Variant, k As String, a As Variant, key As Variant, dd As Object
    Set g = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each it In arcsCol
        k = Format(it(4) * 2000#, "0.00")
        If g.Exists(k) Then
            a = g.Item(k): a(0) = a(0) + 1: g.Item(k) = a
        Else
            g.Add k, Array(1, it)
        End If
    Next it
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    For Each key In g.Keys
        a = g.Item(key): it = a(1)
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If SelectInView(v, it(0), False) Then
            Dim rpx As Double, rpy As Double
            NoteNear it(1), it(2), rpx, rpy
            Set dd = swDrawModel.AddRadialDimension2(rpx, rpy, 0)
            If Not dd Is Nothing Then
                RadiusDims = RadiusDims + 1
                AddCountPrefix dd, a(0)
            End If
        End If
    Next key
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
End Function


' 2 nua cung cua 1 ranh phai phinh ra xa nhau
Public Function ArcsFaceApart(ai As Variant, aj As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim vx As Double, vy As Double
    If (ai(7) = 0 And ai(8) = 0) Or (aj(7) = 0 And aj(8) = 0) Then ArcsFaceApart = True: Exit Function
    vx = aj(1) - ai(1): vy = aj(2) - ai(2)
    ArcsFaceApart = (ai(7) * vx + ai(8) * vy < 0) And (aj(7) * vx + aj(8) * vy > 0)
End Function


' Canh dung de ghi kich thuoc hinh dang:
'  - KHONG thuoc mat vat mep (Chamfer) hay mat bo tron (Fillet)
'  - THAY DUOC: it nhat 1 mat phang ke canh huong ve phia nguoi xem (loai canh khuat phia sau)
' Muc do FULL: moi canh thang nhin thay - chi bo canh vat mep / bo tron va canh khuat (net dut)
Public Function IsShapeEdgeLoose(ByVal e As Object, vd As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim faces As Variant, j As Long, f As Object, ft As Object, tn As String
    On Error GoTo done
    faces = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If Not IsEmpty(faces) Then
        For j = 0 To UBound(faces)
            If Not faces(j) Is Nothing Then
                Set f = faces(j)
                Set ft = f.GetFeature
                If Not ft Is Nothing Then
                    tn = ft.GetTypeName2
                    If tn = "Chamfer" Or InStr(1, tn, "Fillet", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then Exit Function
                End If
            End If
        Next j
    End If
    IsShapeEdgeLoose = True
    If SKIP_HIDDEN_EDGES Then
        If EdgeOccluded(e, vd) Then IsShapeEdgeLoose = False
    End If
done:
End Function

' BUOC DUONG BAO NGOAI cua hinh chieu: canh vuong goc phuong do, nam tren duong bao TREN/DUOI (vertical = True)
' hoac TRAI/PHAI (vertical = False), noi 2 muc khac nhau cua duong bao (vd thanh khoi cao -> phan thap).
' Them vi tri chua co vao col (cung dang phan tu voi OutlinePositions). Tra ve so vi tri them.
Public Function AddEnvelopeSteps(lines As Collection, col As Collection, ByVal vertical As Boolean, _
                                 ByVal lo As Double, ByVal hi As Double) As Long
    Dim it As Variant, hS As New Collection, vS As New Collection, tol As Double, dlt As Double, gap As Double
    Dim p As Double, a1 As Double, a2 As Double, tA As Double, tb As Double, bA As Double, bB As Double
    Dim hasA As Boolean, hasB As Boolean, tMx As Double, tMn As Double, bMx As Double, bMn As Double
    Dim stepT As Boolean, stepB As Boolean, c As Variant, dup As Boolean, cI As Long
    tol = 0.0003: dlt = 0.0004
    gap = MIN_GAP * sc: If gap < 0.0002 Then gap = 0.0002
    cI = IIf(vertical, 1, 2)                                         ' chi so toa do trong phan tu cua col
    ' doan SONG SONG phuong do (tao duong bao) -> hs: (dau, cuoi, muc); doan VUONG GOC (buoc) -> vs: (vi tri, dau, cuoi, canh)
    For Each it In lines
        If vertical Then
            If Abs(it(2) - it(4)) < 0.000001 Then hS.Add Array(MinD2(it(1), it(3)), MaxD2(it(1), it(3)), it(2))
            If Abs(it(1) - it(3)) < 0.000001 Then vS.Add Array(it(1), MinD2(it(2), it(4)), MaxD2(it(2), it(4)), it(0))
        Else
            If Abs(it(1) - it(3)) < 0.000001 Then hS.Add Array(MinD2(it(2), it(4)), MaxD2(it(2), it(4)), it(1))
            If Abs(it(2) - it(4)) < 0.000001 Then vS.Add Array(it(2), MinD2(it(1), it(3)), MaxD2(it(1), it(3)), it(0))
        End If
    Next it
    For Each it In vS
        p = it(0): a1 = it(1): a2 = it(2)
        If p - lo > gap And hi - p > gap Then
            EnvAt hS, p - dlt, tA, bA, hasA
            EnvAt hS, p + dlt, tb, bB, hasB
            If hasA Or hasB Then
                If Not hasA Then tA = -1E+30: bA = 1E+30
                If Not hasB Then tb = -1E+30: bB = 1E+30
                tMx = MaxD2(tA, tb): tMn = MinD2(tA, tb)
                bMn = MinD2(bA, bB): bMx = MaxD2(bA, bB)
                ' bac TREN: dau tren cua canh = muc cao hon, canh keo xuong toi muc thap hon
                stepT = (tMx - tMn > tol) And (Abs(a2 - tMx) < tol) And (a1 <= tMn + tol)
                ' bac DUOI: dau duoi cua canh = muc thap hon, canh keo len toi muc cao hon
                stepB = (bMx - bMn > tol) And (Abs(a1 - bMn) < tol) And (a2 >= bMx - tol)
                If (stepT Or stepB) And Not PointInSlot(IIf(vertical, p, (a1 + a2) / 2), IIf(vertical, (a1 + a2) / 2, p)) Then
                    dup = False
                    For Each c In col
                        If Abs(c(cI) - p) < gap Then dup = True: Exit For
                    Next c
                    If Not dup Then
                        If vertical Then
                            col.Add Array(it(3), p, (a1 + a2) / 2, 0#, 0#, "", False)
                        Else
                            col.Add Array(it(3), (a1 + a2) / 2, p, 0#, 0#, "", False)
                        End If
                        AddEnvelopeSteps = AddEnvelopeSteps + 1
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next it
End Function

' Muc cao nhat / thap nhat cua cac doan song song phuong do phu qua toa do q
Private Sub EnvAt(hS As Collection, ByVal q As Double, tMax As Double, tMin As Double, has As Boolean)
    Dim s As Variant
    has = False: tMax = -1E+30: tMin = 1E+30
    For Each s In hS
        If q >= s(0) - 0.000001 And q <= s(1) + 0.000001 Then
            has = True
            If s(2) > tMax Then tMax = s(2)
            If s(2) < tMin Then tMin = s(2)
        End If
    Next s
End Sub

Public Function IsShapeEdge(ByVal e As Object, vd As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim faces As Variant, j As Long, f As Object, ft As Object, tn As String, nV As Variant, dt As Double
    On Error GoTo done
    faces = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If IsEmpty(faces) Then GoTo done
    For j = 0 To UBound(faces)
        If Not faces(j) Is Nothing Then
            Set f = faces(j)
            Set ft = f.GetFeature
            If Not ft Is Nothing Then
                tn = ft.GetTypeName2
                If tn = "Chamfer" Or InStr(1, tn, "Fillet", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                    IsShapeEdge = False
                    Exit Function
                End If
            End If
            nV = f.Normal                                  ' mat phang: vecto phap; mat cong: (0,0,0)
            If Not IsEmpty(nV) Then
                dt = nV(0) * vd(0) + nV(1) * vd(1) + nV(2) * vd(2)
                If dt > 0.1 Then IsShapeEdge = True
            End If
        End If
    Next j
    ' Mat huong ve nguoi xem nhung bi vat lieu phia truoc che -> canh khuat (net dut)
    If IsShapeEdge And SKIP_HIDDEN_EDGES Then
        If EdgeOccluded(e, vd) Then IsShapeEdge = False
    End If
done:
End Function

' Ban 2 tia tu 2 ben canh (lech 0.15 mm) ve phia nguoi xem; ca 2 tia deu cham vat lieu -> canh bi che
Public Function EdgeOccluded(ByVal e As Object, vd As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim cp As Variant, d(2) As Double, pp(2) As Double, nrm As Double, s As Long, n As Long
    Dim bp(2) As Double, vv(2) As Double, ext As Object, i As Long, blocked As Long
    If partModelRef Is Nothing Or IsEmpty(partBodies) Then Exit Function
    On Error GoTo fail
    cp = e.GetCurveParams2
    For i = 0 To 2
        d(i) = cp(3 + i) - cp(i)
        vv(i) = vd(i)
    Next i
    ' huong lech = vd x d (nam trong mat giay, vuong goc canh)
    pp(0) = vd(1) * d(2) - vd(2) * d(1)
    pp(1) = vd(2) * d(0) - vd(0) * d(2)
    pp(2) = vd(0) * d(1) - vd(1) * d(0)
    nrm = Sqr(pp(0) ^ 2 + pp(1) ^ 2 + pp(2) ^ 2)
    If nrm < 0.0000000001 Then Exit Function
    Set ext = partModelRef.Extension
    For s = -1 To 1 Step 2
        For i = 0 To 2
            bp(i) = (cp(i) + cp(3 + i)) / 2 + s * 0.00015 * pp(i) / nrm + 0.00015 * vd(i)
        Next i
        ' Dau ngoac (..) = truyen BAN SAO TAM theo gia tri: SolidWorks khoa ban sao,
        ' mang goc khong bi khoa (tranh loi 10 "array is fixed or temporarily locked")
        n = ext.RayIntersections((partBodies), (bp), (vv), RAY_OPTS, 0.0000001, 0, False)
        If n > 0 Then blocked = blocked + 1
    Next s
    EdgeOccluded = (blocked = 2)
    Exit Function
fail:
    EdgeOccluded = False
End Function


'===========================================================================
'  VI TRI GHI CHU GAN DOI TUONG
'===========================================================================
Public Sub SetNoteBox(ByVal xL As Double, ByVal xR As Double, ByVal yB As Double, ByVal yT As Double, _
                       ByVal offL As Double, ByVal offR As Double, ByVal offB As Double, ByVal offT As Double)
    nbXL = xL: nbXR = xR: nbYB = yB: nbYT = yT
    nbOL = offL: nbOR = offR: nbOB = offB: nbOT = offT
    If occRects Is Nothing Then Set occRects = New Collection
    If usedNotes Is Nothing Then Set usedNotes = New Collection
    If dimRects Is Nothing Then Set dimRects = New Collection
End Sub

' Vung bi chiem: khung ten + THAN cac hinh chieu (chi noi 2 mm). Kich thuoc duoc ghi lai rieng (dimRects)
Public Sub InitOccupancy(ByVal v1 As Object, ByVal v2 As Object, ByVal v3 As Object)
    Dim vv As Variant, vw As SldWorks.View
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    Set occRects = New Collection
    Set usedNotes = New Collection
    Set dimRects = New Collection
    Set viewBoxes = New Collection
    occRects.Add Array(SHEET_W - TITLE_W, 0#, SHEET_W, TITLE_H)
    For Each vv In Array(v1, v2, v3)
        If Not vv Is Nothing Then
            Set vw = vv
            GetViewBox vw, xL, xR, yB, yT
            occRects.Add Array(xL - 0.002, yB - 0.002, xR + 0.002, yT + 0.002)
            viewBoxes.Add Array(xL, yB, xR, yT)
        End If
    Next vv
End Sub

' Tim vi tri GAN doi tuong (cx, cy) nhat cho 1 ghi chu ma KHONG TRUNG voi:
'  than hinh chieu, cac kich thuoc da ghi (duong + chu so), khung ten, ghi chu khac.
'  Thu huong cheo truoc (dep hon), roi ngang/doc; ban kinh tang dan tu 10 mm.
Public Sub NoteNear(ByVal cx As Double, ByVal cy As Double, PX As Double, py As Double)
    Dim dirs As Variant, r As Double, k As Long, ddx As Double, ddy As Double, nrm As Double
    Dim x1 As Double, y1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double, ox As Double, oy As Double
    If occRects Is Nothing Then Set occRects = New Collection
    If usedNotes Is Nothing Then Set usedNotes = New Collection
    ' Uu tien huong ra xa tam hinh chieu hien tai
    ox = IIf(cx >= (nbXL + nbXR) / 2, 1, -1)
    oy = IIf(cy >= (nbYB + nbYT) / 2, 1, -1)
    dirs = Array(Array(ox, oy), Array(-ox, oy), Array(ox, -oy), Array(-ox, -oy), _
                 Array(ox, 0), Array(0, oy), Array(-ox, 0), Array(0, -oy))
    If dimRects Is Nothing Then Set dimRects = New Collection
    For r = 0.01 To 0.12 Step 0.004
        For k = 0 To UBound(dirs)
            ddx = dirs(k)(0): ddy = dirs(k)(1)
            nrm = Sqr(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy)
            PX = cx + r * ddx / nrm
            py = cy + r * ddy / nrm
            ' chu nam ve phia huong ra ngoai cua mui ten
            If ddx < 0 Then PX = PX - NOTE_W
            If ddy > 0 Then py = py + NOTE_H
