            x1 = PX: y1 = py - NOTE_H: x2 = PX + NOTE_W: y2 = py
            If x1 > 0.012 And y1 > 0.012 And x2 < SHEET_W - 0.012 And y2 < SHEET_H - 0.012 Then
                If Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, occRects) And Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, usedNotes) _
                   And Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, dimRects) And Not HitsOtherViewBand(x1, y1, x2, y2) Then
                    usedNotes.Add Array(x1 - 0.002, y1 - 0.002, x2 + 0.002, y2 + 0.002)
                    Exit Sub
                End If
            End If
        Next k
    Next r
    ' Khong tim duoc cho trong: dat ngoai mep gan nhat nhu cu
    PX = IIf(ox > 0, nbXR + nbOR + 0.006, nbXL - nbOL - NOTE_W)
    py = cy + 0.008
    usedNotes.Add Array(PX, py - NOTE_H, PX + NOTE_W, py)
End Sub

Public Function RectHits(ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double, ByVal x2 As Double, ByVal y2 As Double, _
                         rects As Collection) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    For Each q In rects
        If x1 < q(2) And x2 > q(0) And y1 < q(3) And y2 > q(1) Then RectHits = True: Exit Function
    Next q
End Function


' Bo phan " THRU" / " SAU x" -> chi con co ren (M5x0.8)
Public Function ThreadSizeOnly(ByVal t As String) As String
    Dim k As Long
    k = InStr(1, t, THRU_TEXT, vbTextCompare)
    If k > 0 Then t = Left(t, k - 1)
    k = InStr(1, t, DEPTH_TEXT, vbTextCompare)
    If k > 0 Then t = Left(t, k - 1)
    ThreadSizeOnly = Trim(t)
End Function


' Canh thang hien thanh duong XIEN tren hinh chieu (khong ngang, khong dung, khong thu ve diem)
Public Function EdgeLooksSlanted(ByVal e As Object, xf As SldWorks.MathTransform) As Boolean
    Dim c As Object, cp As Variant, p1 As SldWorks.MathPoint, p2 As SldWorks.MathPoint
    Dim a1 As Variant, a2 As Variant, ddx As Double, ddy As Double
    On Error GoTo fin
    Set c = e.GetCurve
    If Not c.IsLine Then GoTo fin
    cp = e.GetCurveParams2
    Set p1 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(0), cp(1), cp(2)))
    Set p2 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(cp(3), cp(4), cp(5)))
    a1 = p1.MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    a2 = p2.MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    ddx = Abs(a2(0) - a1(0)): ddy = Abs(a2(1) - a1(1))
    If ddx > 0.0002 And ddy > 0.0002 Then
        EdgeLooksSlanted = (ddx / ddy > 0.2 And ddx / ddy < 5)
    End If
fin:
End Function


' Ghi lai vung 1 kich thuoc thang: duong kich thuoc tai linePos, tu a den b; chu so ben tren / ben trai
Public Sub RecordDimRect(ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double, ByVal linePos As Double)
    Dim lo As Double, hi As Double
    If dimRects Is Nothing Then Set dimRects = New Collection
    lo = a: hi = b
    If hi < lo Then lo = b: hi = a
    If horiz Then
        dimRects.Add Array(lo - 0.002, linePos - 0.0015, hi + 0.002, linePos + 0.0055)
    Else
        dimRects.Add Array(linePos - 0.0055, lo - 0.002, linePos + 0.0015, hi + 0.002)
    End If
End Sub

' Chua 20 mm quanh CAC HINH CHIEU KHAC (noi kich thuoc cua chung se duoc ghi sau)
Public Function HitsOtherViewBand(ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double, ByVal x2 As Double, ByVal y2 As Double) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    If viewBoxes Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    For Each q In viewBoxes
        If Not (Abs(q(0) - nbXL) < 0.000001 And Abs(q(1) - nbYB) < 0.000001) Then     ' khong phai hinh hien tai
            If x1 < q(2) + 0.02 And x2 > q(0) - 0.02 And y1 < q(3) + 0.02 And y2 > q(1) - 0.02 Then
                HitsOtherViewBand = True: Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next q
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  BO QUA THEO FILE & THEO PATTERN / MIRROR
'===========================================================================
' Them duong dan file cua component (va moi chi tiet con neu la cum con) vao tap bo qua
Public Sub AddCompPaths(ByVal comp As Object, paths As Object)
    Dim p As String, ch As Variant, i As Long
    If comp Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    p = LCase(comp.GetPathName)
    If p <> "" Then paths(p) = 1
    On Error Resume Next
    ch = comp.GetChildren
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsEmpty(ch) Then
        For i = 0 To UBound(ch)
            AddCompPaths ch(i), paths
        Next i
    End If
End Sub

' Duyet cay 1 assembly: voi moi Pattern / Mirror component, neu chi tiet goc (seed) thuoc tap bo qua
' thi them moi chi tiet do feature sinh ra vao tap bo qua
' exportMode (xuat Excel thiet bi): seed doc tu dinh nghia feature truoc (khong lay nham chi tiet lam huong),
'             chi them duong dan CHINH component sinh ra (khong them cac chi tiet ben trong no)
Public Sub AddPatternSkips(ByVal asmDoc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, paths As Object, Optional ByVal exportMode As Boolean = False)
    Dim f As SldWorks.Feature, tn As String, seeds As Collection, s As Variant, hit As Boolean
    Dim sf As SldWorks.Feature, rc As Object, pass As Long, changed As Boolean
    ' Lap 2 lan: pattern cua pattern / mirror cua pattern
    For pass = 1 To 2
        changed = False
        Set f = asmDoc.FirstFeature
        Do While Not f Is Nothing
            tn = f.GetTypeName2
            If InStr(1, tn, "Pattern", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, tn, "Mirror", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                Set seeds = PatternSeeds(f, asmDoc, exportMode)
                If exportMode Then
                    If PatternDevices(f, seeds, paths) Then changed = True
                    GoTo NextPatFeat
                End If
                hit = False
                For Each s In seeds
                    If paths.Exists(s) Then hit = True: Exit For
                Next s
                ' Du phong: 1 chi tiet sinh ra trung file voi file bo qua -> coi ca nhom thuoc TBTC
                If Not hit Then
                    Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
                    Do While Not sf Is Nothing
                        Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
                        If Not rc Is Nothing Then
                            If paths.Exists(LCase(rc.GetPathName)) Then hit = True: Exit Do
                        End If
                        Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
                    Loop
                End If
                If hit Then
                    Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
                    Do While Not sf Is Nothing
                        Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
                        If Not rc Is Nothing Then
                            If Not paths.Exists(LCase(rc.GetPathName)) Then changed = True
                            AddCompPaths rc, paths
                        End If
                        Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
                    Loop
                End If
            End If
NextPatFeat:
            Set f = f.GetNextFeature
        Loop
        If Not changed Then Exit For
    Next pass
End Sub

' Xuat Excel: component do Pattern / Mirror sinh ra la THIET BI khi cung file voi 1 thiet bi (ban sao),
' hoac la ban doi xung (opposite hand, file moi) mang ten file thiet bi goc. Chi them CHINH component do,
' khong them cac chi tiet ben trong; component khac trong cung feature (vd cum co khi) khong bi tinh nham.
' Tra ve True neu co them file moi vao paths.
Private Function PatternDevices(ByVal f As Object, seeds As Collection, paths As Object) As Boolean
    Dim names As New Collection, s As Variant, sf As Object, rc As Object, p As String, b As String, nm As Variant
    For Each s In seeds
        If paths.Exists(s) Then names.Add PatBaseName(CStr(s))
    Next s
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not sf Is Nothing
        Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
        If Not rc Is Nothing Then
            p = LCase(rc.GetPathName)
            If paths.Exists(p) Then names.Add PatBaseName(p)
        End If
        Set rc = Nothing
        Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    If names.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not sf Is Nothing
        Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
        If Not rc Is Nothing Then
            p = LCase(rc.GetPathName)
            If p <> "" And Not paths.Exists(p) Then
                b = PatBaseName(p)
                For Each nm In names
                    If nm <> "" And InStr(1, b, nm, vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
                        paths(p) = 1: PatternDevices = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next nm
            End If
        End If
        Set rc = Nothing
        Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' File chi tiet DOI XUNG (opposite hand) do feature Mirror Components tao ra trong 1 assembly:
' map(duong dan file mirror, chu thuong) = Array(duong dan file goc (chu thuong), duong dan assembly chua feature, ten feature)
' File goc: tu dinh nghia feature (hoac quan he cha-con); nhieu goc -> goc co ten nam trong ten file mirror (dai nhat)
' Ban sao cung huong (copy) co cung file voi goc -> khong phai file mirror
Public Sub CollectMirrorFiles(ByVal asmDoc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, map As Object)
    Dim f As Object, sf As Object, rc As Object, seeds As Object, sc As Collection, d As Object, arr As Variant
    Dim s As Variant, g As String, gb As String, sb As String, best As String, bL As Long, i As Long
    If asmDoc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = asmDoc.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If InStr(1, f.GetTypeName2, "Mirror", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            Set seeds = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            Set sc = Nothing
            Set sc = PatternSeeds(f, asmDoc, True)
            If Not sc Is Nothing Then
                For Each s In sc
                    If CStr(s) <> "" Then seeds(CStr(s)) = 1
                Next s
            End If
            Set d = Nothing
            Set d = f.GetDefinition
            If Not d Is Nothing Then
                If d.AccessSelections(asmDoc, Nothing) Then
                    arr = Empty
                    arr = CallByName(d, "ComponentsToInstance", VbGet)
                    If IsArray(arr) Then
                        For i = 0 To UBound(arr)
                            seeds(LCase(arr(i).GetPathName)) = 1
                        Next i
                    End If
                    d.ReleaseSelectionAccess
                End If
            End If
            Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
            Do While Not sf Is Nothing
                Set rc = Nothing
                Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
                If Not rc Is Nothing Then
                    g = "": g = LCase(rc.GetPathName)
                    If g <> "" And seeds.Count > 0 And Not seeds.Exists(g) And Not map.Exists(g) Then
                        best = "": bL = 0: gb = PatBaseName(g)
                        For Each s In seeds.Keys
                            sb = PatBaseName(CStr(s))
                            If seeds.Count = 1 Then
                                best = s
                            ElseIf sb <> "" And InStr(1, gb, sb, vbBinaryCompare) > 0 And Len(sb) > bL Then
                                best = s: bL = Len(sb)
                            End If
                        Next s
                        If best <> "" Then map(g) = Array(best, asmDoc.GetPathName, f.Name)
                    End If
                End If
                Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
            Loop
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Doi ten 1 file mirror bang cach SUA feature Mirror Components (SolidWorks khong cho doi ten truc tiep):
'  B1: ap lai feature voi tien to "Mirror" -> SolidWorks dat lai ten = "Mirror" + ten HIEN TAI cua file goc (da doi ten)
'  B2: chua doi -> sua ten trong danh sach MirroredComponentFilenames (neu phien ban SW co) roi ap lai
' Tra ve True CHI KHI kiem tra lai thay feature da co file mang ten moi; logTxt = cach da lam / ly do loi
Public Function MirrorFeatRename(ByVal docPath As String, ByVal featName As String, ByVal oldBase As String, _
                                 ByVal newBase As String, logTxt As String) As Boolean
    Dim doc As Object, f As Object, d As Object, ok As Boolean, md As String, fn As Variant, i As Long
    Dim hit As Boolean, nb As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Set doc = swApp.GetOpenDocumentByName(docPath)
    If doc Is Nothing Then logTxt = "khong tim thay assembly chua feature mirror": Exit Function
    Set f = doc.FeatureByName(featName)
    If f Is Nothing Then logTxt = "khong tim thay feature " & featName: Exit Function
    ' B1
    Set d = Nothing
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If d Is Nothing Then logTxt = "khong doc duoc feature " & featName: Exit Function
    If Not d.AccessSelections(doc, Nothing) Then logTxt = "khong mo duoc feature " & featName: Exit Function
    md = "": md = CallByName(d, "NameModifier", VbGet)
    If md <> "Mirror" Then CallByName d, "NameModifier", VbLet, "Mirror"
    ok = False
    ok = f.ModifyDefinition(d, doc, Nothing)
    If Not ok Then d.ReleaseSelectionAccess
    If MirrorFeatHasFile(doc, featName, newBase) Then
        MirrorFeatRename = True: logTxt = "qua feature " & featName: Exit Function
    End If
    ' B2
    Set f = Nothing: Set f = doc.FeatureByName(featName)
    Set d = Nothing: Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If Not d Is Nothing Then
        If d.AccessSelections(doc, Nothing) Then
            fn = Empty
            fn = CallByName(d, "MirroredComponentFilenames", VbGet)
            hit = False
            If IsArray(fn) Then
                For i = LBound(fn) To UBound(fn)
                    nb = "": nb = CStr(fn(i))
                    If nb <> "" And PatBaseName(nb) = LCase(oldBase) Then
                        If InStrRev(nb, ".") > InStrRev(nb, "\") Then
                            fn(i) = Left(nb, InStrRev(nb, "\")) & newBase & mid(nb, InStrRev(nb, "."))
                        Else
                            fn(i) = Left(nb, InStrRev(nb, "\")) & newBase
                        End If
                        hit = True
                    End If
                Next i
            End If
            ok = False
            If hit Then
                CallByName d, "MirroredComponentFilenames", VbLet, fn
                ok = f.ModifyDefinition(d, doc, Nothing)
            End If
            If Not ok Then d.ReleaseSelectionAccess
        End If
    End If
    If MirrorFeatHasFile(doc, featName, newBase) Then
        MirrorFeatRename = True: logTxt = "qua danh sach ten file cua feature " & featName: Exit Function
    End If
    logTxt = "feature " & featName & " khong doi duoc ten file"
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Feature mirror co component nao tro toi file ten newBase khong (kiem tra sau khi sua feature)
Private Function MirrorFeatHasFile(ByVal doc As Object, ByVal featName As String, ByVal newBase As String) As Boolean
    Dim f As Object, sf As Object, rc As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = doc.FeatureByName(featName)
    If f Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    Set sf = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not sf Is Nothing
        Set rc = Nothing
        Set rc = FeatureComponent(sf)
        If Not rc Is Nothing Then
            If PatBaseName(rc.GetPathName) = LCase(newBase) Then MirrorFeatHasFile = True: Exit Function
        End If
        Set sf = sf.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Ten file chu thuong, khong duong dan, khong duoi
Private Function PatBaseName(ByVal p As String) As String
    p = LCase(mid(p, InStrRev(p, "\") + 1))
    If InStrRev(p, ".") > 0 Then p = Left(p, InStrRev(p, ".") - 1)
    PatBaseName = p
End Function

' Duong dan file cac chi tiet goc cua Pattern / Mirror (doc tu quan he cha-con va tu dinh nghia feature)
Private Function PatternSeeds(ByVal f As SldWorks.Feature, ByVal asmDoc As SldWorks.ModelDoc2, _
                              Optional ByVal defFirst As Boolean = False) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, par As Variant, i As Long, c As Object, d As Object, arr As Variant
    Dim nm As Variant
    Set PatternSeeds = col
    On Error Resume Next
    ' Doc truc tiep danh sach seed trong dinh nghia (ten thuoc tinh khac nhau theo loai feature)
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If Not d Is Nothing Then
        d.AccessSelections asmDoc, Nothing
        For Each nm In Array("SeedComponentArray", "ComponentsToMirror", "MirroredComponents", "Components")
            arr = Empty
            arr = CallByName(d, CStr(nm), VbGet)
            If IsArray(arr) Then
                For i = 0 To UBound(arr)
                    If Not arr(i) Is Nothing Then col.Add LCase(arr(i).GetPathName)
                Next i
            End If
        Next nm
        d.ReleaseSelectionAccess
    End If
    ' Quan he cha-con: co the gom ca chi tiet chi dung lam HUONG / truc -> che do defFirst chi dung khi dinh nghia rong
    If Not (defFirst And col.Count > 0) Then
        par = f.GetParents
        If Not IsEmpty(par) Then
            For i = 0 To UBound(par)
                Set c = FeatureComponent(par(i))
                If Not c Is Nothing Then col.Add LCase(c.GetPathName)
            Next i
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Component2 ung voi 1 feature trong cay assembly (Nothing neu khong phai component)
Private Function FeatureComponent(ByVal ft As Object) As Object
    Dim o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set o = ft.GetSpecificFeature2
    If Not o Is Nothing Then
        If TypeName(o) = "Component2" Or TypeName(o) = "IComponent2" Then
            Set FeatureComponent = o
        Else
            ' du phong: doi tuong co Name2 & GetPathName (.sldprt/.sldasm) -> la component
            Dim nm2 As String, pth As String
            nm2 = "": pth = ""
            nm2 = o.Name2
            pth = o.GetPathName
            If nm2 <> "" And (LCase(Right(pth, 7)) = ".sldprt" Or LCase(Right(pth, 7)) = ".sldasm") Then Set FeatureComponent = o
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  HINH TRICH (DETAIL VIEW) CHO VUNG KICH THUOC CHEN CHUC
'===========================================================================
Public Function MakeDetailViews(ByVal sNum As Double, ByVal sDen As Double) As String
    ' 1) Gom cac cap theo hinh goc va theo vi tri gan nhau (< 15 mm tren giay)
    Dim clusters As New Collection, it As Variant, cL As Variant, k As Long, found As Boolean
    Dim PX As Double, py As Double, qx As Double, qy As Double, pv As SldWorks.View
    For Each it In pendingDetail
        Set pv = it(0)
        PairSheetPos pv, it(1), it(2), PX, py
        found = False
        For k = 1 To clusters.Count
            cL = clusters(k)
            If cL(0) Is pv Then
                If Abs(cL(1) - PX) < 0.015 And Abs(cL(2) - py) < 0.015 Then
                    cL(3).Add it
                    found = True
                    Exit For
                End If
            End If
        Next k
        If Not found Then
            Dim lst As Collection
            Set lst = New Collection
            lst.Add it
            clusters.Add Array(pv, PX, py, lst)
        End If
    Next it

    ' 2) Moi cum -> 1 hinh trich
    Dim nOk As Long, lbl As String, msg As String
    For k = 1 To clusters.Count
        cL = clusters(k)
        lbl = Chr(65 + nOk)
        If DetailForCluster(cL(0), cL(3), sNum, sDen, lbl) Then nOk = nOk + 1
    Next k
    MakeDetailViews = "Hinh trich: " & nOk & "/" & clusters.Count & " (" & pendingDetail.Count & " kich thuoc nho)" & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function DetailForCluster(ByVal pvObj As Object, ByVal pairs As Collection, ByVal sNum As Double, _
                                  ByVal sDen As Double, ByVal lbl As String) As Boolean
    Dim pv As SldWorks.View
    Set pv = pvObj
    Dim it As Variant, x1 As Double, y1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double, minGap As Double
    Dim ax As Double, ay As Double, bx As Double, by As Double, g As Double, first As Boolean
    Dim mx As Double, my As Double, mz As Double, nPts As Long, mp As Variant
    first = True: minGap = 1
    For Each it In pairs
        EdgeSheetPos pv, it(1), ax, ay
        EdgeSheetPos pv, it(2), bx, by
        If it(3) Then g = Abs(bx - ax) Else g = Abs(by - ay)
        If g > 0.000001 And g < minGap Then minGap = g
        If first Then
            x1 = MinD(ax, bx): x2 = MaxD2(ax, bx): y1 = MinD(ay, by): y2 = MaxD2(ay, by): first = False
        Else
            x1 = MinD(x1, MinD(ax, bx)): x2 = MaxD2(x2, MaxD2(ax, bx))
            y1 = MinD(y1, MinD(ay, by)): y2 = MaxD2(y2, MaxD2(ay, by))
        End If
        mp = EdgeModelPos(it(1)): mx = mx + mp(0): my = my + mp(1): mz = mz + mp(2): nPts = nPts + 1
        mp = EdgeModelPos(it(2)): mx = mx + mp(0): my = my + mp(1): mz = mz + mp(2): nPts = nPts + 1
    Next it
    mx = mx / nPts: my = my / nPts: mz = mz / nPts

    ' Ban kinh vong trich (tren giay, hinh goc) & he so phong to
    Dim cxS As Double, cyS As Double, r As Double, vS As Double, need As Double, fac As Double, f As Variant
    cxS = (x1 + x2) / 2: cyS = (y1 + y2) / 2
    r = 0.5 * Sqr((x2 - x1) ^ 2 + (y2 - y1) ^ 2) + 0.004
    If r < 0.006 Then r = 0.006
    need = 0.008 / minGap                                ' doan ngan nhat sau phong to >= 8 mm
    fac = 10
    For Each f In Array(2, 2.5, 4, 5, 10)
        If f >= need Then fac = f: Exit For
    Next f
    vS = pv.ScaleDecimal

    ' Cho trong tren giay cho hinh trich (+ cho kich thuoc)
    Dim sz As Double, fx As Double, fy As Double
    sz = 2 * r * fac + 0.03
    If Not FindFreeRect(sz, sz, fx, fy) Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh trich " & lbl & ": khong con cho trong (" & Format(sz * 1000, "0") & " mm)" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Ve vong tron trich tren hinh goc (toa do sketch cua view)
    Dim sx As Double, sy As Double, sr As Double, seg As Object
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(pv, mx, my, mz, cxS, cyS, sx, sy) Then Exit Function
    sr = r / vS
    swDraw.ActivateView pv.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    Set seg = swDrawModel.SketchManager.CreateCircle(sx, sy, 0, sx + sr, sy, 0)
    If seg Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh trich " & lbl & ": khong ve duoc vong tron" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    seg.Select4 False, Nothing

    ' Tao hinh trich
    Dim dv As SldWorks.View, dNum As Double, dDen As Double, dl As Object, dvo As Object
    dNum = sNum * fac: dDen = sDen
    Set dl = swDraw
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dvo = dl.CreateDetailViewAt4(fx, fy, 0, swDetViewSTANDARD, dNum, dDen, lbl, _
                                     swDetCircleCIRCLE, True, False, False, 5)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not dvo Is Nothing Then Set dv = dvo
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If dv Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh trich " & lbl & ": CreateDetailViewAt4 = Nothing" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    If Not viewBoxes Is Nothing Then viewBoxes.Add Array(fx - sz / 2, fy - sz / 2, fx + sz / 2, fy + sz / 2)
    If Not occRects Is Nothing Then occRects.Add Array(fx - sz / 2, fy - sz / 2, fx + sz / 2, fy + sz / 2)

    ' Ghi cac kich thuoc nho tren hinh trich: moi chuoi 1 tang, ngang o duoi, doc ben trai
    Dim dcx As Double, dcy As Double, dR As Double, tH As Object, tier As Long, key As String
    Dim px1 As Double, py1 As Double, px2 As Double, py2 As Double, lp As Double, nDim As Long
    Set tH = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    mp = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(mx, my, mz)).MultiplyTransform(dv.ModelToViewTransform).ArrayData
    dcx = mp(0): dcy = mp(1): dR = r * fac
    For Each it In pairs
        key = it(4) & "|" & it(3)
        If Not tH.Exists(key) Then tH.Add key, tH.Count
        tier = tH.Item(key)
        EdgeSheetPos dv, it(1), px1, py1
        EdgeSheetPos dv, it(2), px2, py2
        If it(3) Then
            lp = dcy - dR - DIM_FIRST - tier * DIM_STEP
            If AddDim(dv, it(1), it(2), True, (px1 + px2) / 2, lp) Then nDim = nDim + 1
        Else
            lp = dcx - dR - DIM_FIRST - tier * DIM_STEP
            If AddDim(dv, it(1), it(2), False, lp, (py1 + py2) / 2) Then nDim = nDim + 1
        End If
    Next it
    dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh trich " & lbl & ": ti le " & dNum & ":" & dDen & ", " & nDim & "/" & pairs.Count & " kich thuoc" & vbCrLf
    DetailForCluster = True
End Function

' Diem giua cua cap canh (toa do giay tren hinh v)
Private Sub PairSheetPos(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal e1 As Object, ByVal e2 As Object, PX As Double, py As Double)
    Dim ax As Double, ay As Double, bx As Double, by As Double
    EdgeSheetPos v, e1, ax, ay
    EdgeSheetPos v, e2, bx, by
    PX = (ax + bx) / 2: py = (ay + by) / 2
End Sub

' Diem dai dien cua canh trong model: duong thang -> trung diem; cung/tron -> tam
Public Function EdgeModelPos(ByVal e As Object) As Variant
    Dim c As Object, cp As Variant, p As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set c = e.GetCurve
    If c.IsCircle Then
        p = AsmCirc(e, c.CircleParams)
        EdgeModelPos = Array(p(0), p(1), p(2))
    Else
        cp = AsmCP(e, e.GetCurveParams2)
        EdgeModelPos = Array((cp(0) + cp(3)) / 2, (cp(1) + cp(4)) / 2, (cp(2) + cp(5)) / 2)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Public Sub EdgeSheetPos(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal e As Object, PX As Double, py As Double)
    Dim mp As Variant, a As Variant, m As SldWorks.MathPoint
    mp = EdgeModelPos(e)
    If IsEmpty(mp) Then Exit Sub
    Set m = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(mp(0), mp(1), mp(2)))
    a = m.MultiplyTransform(v.ModelToViewTransform).ArrayData
    PX = a(0): py = a(1)
End Sub

' Diem tren GIAY (sheetX, sheetY) -> toa do sketch cua view.
' Trong ban ve, "model" cua sketch view chinh la khong gian to giay -> dung Sketch.ModelToSketchTransform
' tren TOA DO GIAY (khong phai toa do part). Du phong: (giay - goc view) / ti le view.
Public Function ModelToViewSketch(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal mx As Double, ByVal my As Double, ByVal mz As Double, _
                                  ByVal sheetX As Double, ByVal sheetY As Double, sx As Double, sy As Double) As Boolean
    Dim sk As Object, xf As Object, a As Variant, vo As Object, xfV As Variant
    Set vo = v
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sk = vo.GetSketch
    If Not sk Is Nothing Then Set xf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform
    If Not xf Is Nothing Then
        a = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(sheetX, sheetY, 0)).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        If Not IsEmpty(a) Then sx = a(0): sy = a(1): ModelToViewSketch = True
    End If
    If Not ModelToViewSketch Then
        ' GetXform: (0..1) = goc view tren giay, (2) = ti le
        xfV = vo.GetXform
        If Not IsEmpty(xfV) Then
            sx = (sheetX - xfV(0)) / xfV(2): sy = (sheetY - xfV(1)) / xfV(2)
            ModelToViewSketch = True
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    dimLog = dimLog & "Sketch view: giay (" & Format(sheetX * 1000, "0.0") & "," & Format(sheetY * 1000, "0.0") & _
             ") -> sketch (" & Format(sx * 1000, "0.0") & "," & Format(sy * 1000, "0.0") & ")" & vbCrLf
End Function

' Tim cho trong w x h tren giay (quet tu tren-phai sang trai, xuong duoi); tra ve tam (cx, cy)
Public Function FindFreeRect(ByVal w As Double, ByVal h As Double, cx As Double, cy As Double) As Boolean
    Dim X As Double, Y As Double, x1 As Double, y1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double
    If occRects Is Nothing Then Set occRects = New Collection
    If dimRects Is Nothing Then Set dimRects = New Collection
    If usedNotes Is Nothing Then Set usedNotes = New Collection
    For Y = SHEET_H - FRAME_T - 0.005 To FRAME_B + h + 0.005 Step -0.005
        For X = SHEET_W - FRAME_R - w - 0.005 To FRAME_L + 0.005 Step -0.005
            x1 = X: y1 = Y - h: x2 = X + w: y2 = Y
            If Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, occRects) And Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, dimRects) _
               And Not RectHits(x1, y1, x2, y2, usedNotes) And Not RectHitsViews(x1, y1, x2, y2, 0.01) Then
                cx = (x1 + x2) / 2: cy = (y1 + y2) / 2
                FindFreeRect = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        Next X
    Next Y
End Function

Private Function RectHitsViews(ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double, ByVal x2 As Double, ByVal y2 As Double, _
                               ByVal margin As Double) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    If viewBoxes Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    For Each q In viewBoxes
        If x1 < q(2) + margin And x2 > q(0) - margin And y1 < q(3) + margin And y2 > q(1) - margin Then
            RectHitsViews = True: Exit Function
        End If
    Next q
End Function

Private Function MaxD2(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a > b Then MaxD2 = a Else MaxD2 = b
End Function

Private Function MinD2(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a < b Then MinD2 = a Else MinD2 = b
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  HINH CAT A-A TU HINH CHINH
'===========================================================================
' Ve duong cat tren hinh chinh: duong thang theo truc model lineAx, di qua diem pt (m model),
' dai qua 2 dau chi tiet 3 mm; roi tao hinh cat tai (posX, posY)
Public Function CreateSectionFromMain(vMain As SldWorks.View, ByVal lineAx As Long, ByVal pt As Variant, _
                                      ByVal posX As Double, ByVal posY As Double, ByVal lbl As String) As SldWorks.View
    If IsEmpty(pt) Then Exit Function
    Dim p1(2) As Double, p2(2) As Double, i As Long, a1 As Variant, a2 As Variant
    Dim s1x As Double, s1y As Double, s2x As Double, s2y As Double, seg As Object
    For i = 0 To 2
        p1(i) = pt(i): p2(i) = pt(i)
    Next i
    p1(lineAx) = MinD(partBox(lineAx), partBox(3 + lineAx)) - 0.003
    p2(lineAx) = MaxD2(partBox(lineAx), partBox(3 + lineAx)) + 0.003
    a1 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p1(0), p1(1), p1(2))).MultiplyTransform(vMain.ModelToViewTransform).ArrayData
    a2 = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p2(0), p2(1), p2(2))).MultiplyTransform(vMain.ModelToViewTransform).ArrayData
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(vMain, p1(0), p1(1), p1(2), a1(0), a1(1), s1x, s1y) Then Exit Function
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(vMain, p2(0), p2(1), p2(2), a2(0), a2(1), s2x, s2y) Then Exit Function

    swDraw.ActivateView vMain.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    Set seg = swDrawModel.SketchManager.CreateLine(s1x, s1y, 0, s2x, s2y, 0)
    If seg Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh cat: khong ve duoc duong cat" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    seg.Select4 False, Nothing

    Dim dl As Object, sv As Object, vEx As Variant
    Set dl = swDraw
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sv = dl.CreateSectionViewAt5(posX, posY, 0, lbl, 0, vEx, 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If sv Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh cat: CreateSectionViewAt5 = Nothing -> dung hinh chieu thuong" & vbCrLf
        ' xoa duong cat thua
        seg.Select4 False, Nothing
        swDrawModel.EditDelete
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        Exit Function
    End If
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    dimLog = dimLog & "Hinh cat " & lbl & "-" & lbl & ": " & sv.GetName2 & vbCrLf
    Set CreateSectionFromMain = sv
End Function

' Diem tam (m model) cua 1 lo thuoc HANG lo (cung toa do doc tren hinh) co nhieu lo nhat;
' Empty neu hinh chinh khong co lo nhin thang
Public Function HoleRowPoint(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal nAx As Long) As Variant
    Dim circles As Collection, it As Variant, rows As Object, rowIt As Object, ck As Object
    Dim k As String, cen As String, bestK As String, bestN As Long, key As Variant, p As Variant
    Set circles = GetCirclesAlong(v, nAx)
    If circles.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    Set rows = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")      ' hang (y) -> tap tam (x)
    Set rowIt = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")     ' hang (y) -> 1 duong tron dai dien
    For Each it In circles
        k = Format(it(2) / sc * 1000#, "0.0")             ' hang = cung y (0.1 mm)
        cen = Format(it(1) / sc * 1000#, "0.0")
        If Not rows.Exists(k) Then
            rows.Add k, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            rowIt.Add k, it
        End If
        Set ck = rows.Item(k)
        If Not ck.Exists(cen) Then ck.Add cen, 1
    Next it
    For Each key In rows.Keys
        Set ck = rows.Item(key)
        If ck.Count > bestN Then bestN = ck.Count: bestK = key
    Next key
    it = rowIt.Item(bestK)
    p = it(0).GetCurve.CircleParams
    HoleRowPoint = Array(p(0), p(1), p(2))
End Function

' Chon duong cat cho chi tiet tam/khoi tren hinh chinh (truc phap tuyen nAx, ngang hA, doc vA):
'  - lo co truc theo hA (khuat, nam ngang trong hinh chinh) / theo vA (khuat, nam doc): diem 2
'  - lo nhin thang (truc nAx): diem 1 (hinh cat cho thay chieu sau, lo bac)
'  Duong cat NGANG o toa do vA = c qua: lo truc nAx hoac hA co tam vA = c
'  Duong cat DUNG  o toa do hA = c qua: lo truc nAx hoac vA co tam hA = c
'  Tra ve 1 diem tren duong cat (m model), cutHoriz = True neu duong cat ngang
Public Function BestCutForHoles(swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc, ByVal nAx As Long, ByVal hA As Long, _
                                ByVal vA As Long, cutHoriz As Boolean) As Variant
    Dim bodies As Variant, b As Long, edges As Variant, k As Long, e As SldWorks.edge, c As Object, p As Variant
    Dim ax As Long, a As Long, seen As Object, key As String
    Dim hS As Object, vS As Object, hp As Object, vP As Object, sc0 As Long, kk As String
    Set seen = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set hS = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set vS = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set hp = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Set vP = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    bodies = swPart.GetBodies2(swSolidBody, True)
    If IsEmpty(bodies) Then Exit Function
    For b = 0 To UBound(bodies)
        edges = bodies(b).GetEdges
        If Not IsEmpty(edges) Then
            For k = 0 To UBound(edges)
                Set e = edges(k)
                Set c = e.GetCurve
                If c.IsCircle Then
                    If IsFullCircle(e) Then
                        p = c.CircleParams
                        ax = -1
                        For a = 0 To 2
                            If Abs(p(3 + a)) > 0.99 Then ax = a
                        Next a
                        If ax >= 0 Then
                            ' 1 lo = 1 truc (bo trung cac canh tron cung truc)
                            key = ax & "|" & Format(p((ax + 1) Mod 3) * 1000#, "0.0") & "|" & Format(p((ax + 2) Mod 3) * 1000#, "0.0")
                            If Not seen.Exists(key) Then
                                seen.Add key, 1
                                ' duong cat ngang (qua toa do vA)
                                If ax = nAx Or ax = hA Then
                                    sc0 = IIf(ax = hA, 2, 1)
                                    kk = Format(p(vA) * 1000#, "0.0")
                                    hS(kk) = hS(kk) + sc0
                                    If Not hp.Exists(kk) Then hp.Add kk, Array(p(0), p(1), p(2))
                                End If
                                ' duong cat dung (qua toa do hA)
                                If ax = nAx Or ax = vA Then
                                    sc0 = IIf(ax = vA, 2, 1)
                                    kk = Format(p(hA) * 1000#, "0.0")
                                    vS(kk) = vS(kk) + sc0
                                    If Not vP.Exists(kk) Then vP.Add kk, Array(p(0), p(1), p(2))
                                End If
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next k
        End If
    Next b
    Dim best As Long, bestK As String, isH As Boolean, kv As Variant
    For Each kv In hS.Keys
        If hS.Item(kv) > best Then best = hS.Item(kv): bestK = kv: isH = True
    Next kv
    For Each kv In vS.Keys
        If vS.Item(kv) > best Then best = vS.Item(kv): bestK = kv: isH = False
    Next kv
    If best = 0 Then Exit Function
    cutHoriz = isH
    If isH Then BestCutForHoles = hp.Item(bestK) Else BestCutForHoles = vP.Item(bestK)
    dimLog = dimLog & "Duong cat: " & IIf(isH, "ngang", "dung") & ", diem uu tien " & best & vbCrLf
End Function

' Duong tron kin co truc theo axIdx, lay TU PART (moi khoi dac) roi chieu len hinh v.
' Phan tu: Array(edge, x, y, z*sc, r, tenFeature, laHoleWizard) - cung dinh dang GetCirclesAlong
Public Function GetModelCirclesAlong(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal axIdx As Long) As Collection
    Dim col As New Collection, b As Long, edges As Variant, k As Long, bd As Object
    Dim e As SldWorks.edge, c As Object, p As Variant, pt As Variant, xf As SldWorks.MathTransform
    Dim fname As String, isHW As Boolean, mp As SldWorks.MathPoint
    Set GetModelCirclesAlong = col
    If IsEmpty(partBodies) Then Exit Function
    Set xf = v.ModelToViewTransform
    For b = 0 To UBound(partBodies)
        Set bd = partBodies(b)
        edges = bd.GetEdges
        If Not IsEmpty(edges) Then
            For k = 0 To UBound(edges)
                Set e = edges(k)
                Set c = e.GetCurve
                If c.IsCircle Then
                    If IsFullCircle(e) Then
                        p = c.CircleParams
                        If Abs(p(3 + axIdx)) > 0.99 Then
                            Set mp = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(p(0), p(1), p(2)))
                            pt = mp.MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
                            GetEdgeFeature e, fname, isHW
                            col.Add Array(e, pt(0), pt(1), p(axIdx) * sc, p(6), fname, isHW, ChamferKind(e))
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next k
        End If
    Next b
End Function

' Canh tron ke mat VAT MEP / BO TRON:
'  0 = khong; 1 = canh nam tren MAT PHANG (mat dau / mat bac) -> giu vi tri doc truc, bo khoi nhom O
'  2 = canh nam tren MAT TRU (phia than truc)              -> bo khoi vi tri doc truc (giu cho nhom O)
Public Function ChamferKind(ByVal e As Object) As Long
    Dim faces As Variant, j As Long, f As Object, ft As Object, tn As String, hasCh As Boolean
    Dim otherPlanar As Boolean, nV As Variant
    On Error GoTo fin
    faces = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If IsEmpty(faces) Then GoTo fin
    For j = 0 To UBound(faces)
        If Not faces(j) Is Nothing Then
            Set f = faces(j)
            Set ft = f.GetFeature
            tn = ""
            If Not ft Is Nothing Then tn = ft.GetTypeName2
            If tn = "Chamfer" Or InStr(1, tn, "Fillet", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                hasCh = True
            Else
                nV = f.Normal
                If Not IsEmpty(nV) Then
                    If Abs(nV(0)) + Abs(nV(1)) + Abs(nV(2)) > 0.5 Then otherPlanar = True
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next j
    If hasCh Then ChamferKind = IIf(otherPlanar, 1, 2)
fin:
End Function

' Ve DUONG TAM (sketch centerline) trong hinh v: vertical=True -> duong doc x = pos, tu lo-3mm den hi+3mm
' (lo/hi la toa do giay theo phuong con lai). Tra ve SketchSegment de chon lam goc kich thuoc.
Public Function MakeViewCenterline(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal vertical As Boolean, ByVal pos As Double, _
                                   ByVal lo As Double, ByVal hi As Double) As Object
    Dim x1 As Double, y1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double
    Dim s1x As Double, s1y As Double, s2x As Double, s2y As Double, seg As Object
    If vertical Then
        x1 = pos: y1 = lo - 0.003: x2 = pos: y2 = hi + 0.003
    Else
        x1 = lo - 0.003: y1 = pos: x2 = hi + 0.003: y2 = pos
    End If
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(v, 0, 0, 0, x1, y1, s1x, s1y) Then Exit Function
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(v, 0, 0, 0, x2, y2, s2x, s2y) Then Exit Function
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set seg = swDrawModel.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine(s1x, s1y, 0, s2x, s2y, 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If seg Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Khong ve duoc duong tam tren " & v.GetName2 & vbCrLf
    Else
        Set MakeViewCenterline = seg
    End If
End Function

' Doi nhan hinh (vd "SECTION A-A") xuong duoi kich thuoc thap nhat nam duoi hinh do
Public Sub MoveViewLabelBelowDims(v As SldWorks.View)
    Dim xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double, q As Variant, lowY As Double
    Dim ann As Object, nt As Object, txt As String, pos As Variant, vo As Object, nxt As Object
    If v Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    lowY = yB
    If Not dimRects Is Nothing Then
        For Each q In dimRects
            ' kich thuoc nam duoi hinh va giao voi be rong hinh
            If q(3) <= yB + 0.001 And q(2) > xL - 0.02 And q(0) < xR + 0.02 Then
                If q(1) < lowY Then lowY = q(1)
            End If
        Next q
    End If
    If lowY >= yB - 0.0001 Then Exit Sub
    Set vo = v
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ann = vo.GetFirstAnnotation3
    Do While Not ann Is Nothing
        If ann.GetType = swNote Then
            Set nt = ann.GetSpecificAnnotation
            txt = UCase(nt.GetText)
            If InStr(txt, "SECTION") > 0 Or InStr(txt, "A-A") > 0 Or InStr(txt, "MAT CAT") > 0 Then
                pos = ann.GetPosition
                ann.SetPosition pos(0), lowY - 0.006, 0
                dimLog = dimLog & "Doi nhan hinh cat xuong y=" & Format((lowY - 0.006) * 1000, "0.0") & " mm" & vbCrLf
                Exit Do
            End If
        End If
        Set nxt = ann.GetNext3
        Set ann = nxt
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

'===========================================================================
'  KIEM TRA SAU KHI XUAT: XOA KICH THUOC THUA, GO CHONG CHEO
'===========================================================================
' Ghi lai 1 kich thuoc thang: nhip [a, b] theo phuong do, duong kich thuoc tai linePos
Public Sub RecordDim(ByVal dd As Object, v As SldWorks.View, ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal a As Double, _
                     ByVal b As Double, ByVal linePos As Double)
    If dd Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If allDims Is Nothing Then Set allDims = New Collection
    Dim lo As Double, hi As Double, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
    lo = a: hi = b
    If hi < lo Then lo = b: hi = a
    GetViewBox v, xL, xR, yB, yT
    ' tam view theo phuong vuong goc duong kich thuoc (de biet huong "ra ngoai")
    allDims.Add Array(dd, v.GetName2, horiz, lo, hi, linePos, IIf(horiz, (xL + xR) / 2, (yB + yT) / 2), _
                      IIf(horiz, (yB + yT) / 2, (xL + xR) / 2), v.ScaleDecimal)
End Sub

' Di lan luot tung sheet
Public Function CleanupAllSheets(Optional ByVal onlyCurrent As Boolean = False) As String
    Dim names As Variant, i As Long, sh As SldWorks.Sheet, vws As Variant, j As Long
    Dim vset As Object, vb As Collection, nDel As Long, nMove As Long, cur As String
    If allDims Is Nothing Then Set allDims = New Collection   ' van kiem tra trung tren ban ve
    cur = swDraw.GetCurrentSheet.GetName
    names = swDraw.GetSheetNames
    For i = IIf(onlyCurrent, 0, sheetFrom) To UBound(names)      ' noi tiep: chi cac sheet moi
        If onlyCurrent And UCase(names(i)) <> UCase(cur) Then GoTo nextSheetCl
        swDraw.ActivateSheet names(i)
        Set sh = swDraw.Sheet(names(i))
        Set vset = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        Set vb = New Collection
        vws = Empty
        On Error Resume Next
        vws = sh.GetViews
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not IsEmpty(vws) Then
            For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
                Dim vw As SldWorks.View, xL As Double, xR As Double, yB As Double, yT As Double
                Set vw = vws(j)
                vset(vw.GetName2) = 1
                If vw.GetReferencedModelName <> "" And Not IsAsmView(vw) Then     ' bo qua hinh cum (ban ve lap)
                    GetViewBox vw, xL, xR, yB, yT
                    vb.Add Array(xL, yB, xR, yT)
                End If
            Next j
            ' Kich thuoc TRUNG doc truc tiep tu ban ve (moi kich thuoc trong tung hinh, ke ca O, Hole Callout)
            Set dedupDel = DedupeSheetDims(vws, nDel)
            CleanupSheet vset, vb, nDel, nMove
        End If
nextSheetCl:
    Next i
    swDraw.ActivateSheet cur
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    swDrawModel.ForceRebuild3 False
    CleanupAllSheets = "Kiem tra kich thuoc: xoa " & nDel & " (trung/bang 0), dich " & nMove & " (chong cheo)" & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Sub CleanupSheet(vset As Object, vbox As Collection, nDel As Long, nMove As Long)
    Dim recs As New Collection, r As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, RA As Variant, rB As Variant
    Dim keep() As Boolean, n As Long, arr() As Variant
    For Each r In allDims
        If vset.Exists(r(1)) Then recs.Add r
    Next r
    n = recs.Count
    If n = 0 Then Exit Sub
    ReDim keep(1 To n): ReDim arr(1 To n)
    For i = 1 To n: arr(i) = recs.Item(i): keep(i) = True: Next i

    ' 1) Kich thuoc bang 0 & kich thuoc TRUNG (cung view, cung phuong, cung nhip)
    For i = 1 To n
        RA = arr(i)
        ' Da xoa o buoc kiem tra trung tren ban ve -> bo qua
        Dim nmI As String
        nmI = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        nmI = RA(0).GetAnnotation.GetName
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not dedupDel Is Nothing Then
            If dedupDel.Exists(RA(1) & "|" & nmI) Then keep(i) = False: GoTo nextRec
        End If
        ' Gia tri that < 0.5 mm (hien "0") hoac nhip = 0 -> thua
        If RA(4) - RA(3) < 0.00005 Then keep(i) = False
        If RA(8) > 0 Then
            If (RA(4) - RA(3)) / RA(8) < 0.0005 Then keep(i) = False
        End If
        If keep(i) Then
            For j = 1 To i - 1
                If keep(j) Then
                    rB = arr(j)
                    If rB(1) = RA(1) And rB(2) = RA(2) And Abs(rB(3) - RA(3)) < 0.00002 And Abs(rB(4) - RA(4)) < 0.00002 Then
                        keep(i) = False: Exit For
                    End If
                End If
            Next j
        End If
        If Not keep(i) Then
            DeleteDimension RA(0)
            nDel = nDel + 1
        End If
nextRec:
    Next i
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True

    ' 2) Go chong cheo: chu so khong de len chu khac, duong kich thuoc khac, than hinh
    Dim acc As New Collection, lines As New Collection, q As Variant
    For Each q In vbox
        acc.Add Array(q(0) + 0.001, q(1) + 0.001, q(2) - 0.001, q(3) - 0.001)       ' than hinh (thu nho 1 mm)
    Next q
    For i = 1 To n
        If keep(i) Then lines.Add Array(i, LineRect(arr(i), arr(i)(5)))
    Next i
    Dim w As Double, tx As Double, lp As Double, outw As Double, k As Long, cand As Variant, okPos As Boolean
    Dim bx As Variant, lr As Variant, bestTx As Double, bestLp As Double
    For i = 1 To n
        If keep(i) Then
            RA = arr(i)
            w = TextWidth(RA(0))
            tx = (RA(3) + RA(4)) / 2: lp = RA(5)
            outw = IIf(lp >= RA(7), 1, -1)                                    ' huong ra xa than hinh
            okPos = False
            ' Ung vien: giu nguyen, chu ra ngoai 2 dau mui ten, roi day ra tang ngoai
            For k = 0 To 6
                Select Case k
                    Case 0: bestTx = tx: bestLp = lp
                    Case 1: bestTx = RA(3) - w / 2 - 0.004: bestLp = lp
                    Case 2: bestTx = RA(4) + w / 2 + 0.004: bestLp = lp
                    Case Else: bestTx = tx: bestLp = lp + outw * (k - 2) * DIM_STEP
                End Select
                bx = TextRect(RA(2), bestTx, bestLp, w)
                lr = LineRect(RA, bestLp)
                If Not HitsAny(bx, acc) And Not HitsLines(bx, lines, i) And Not HitsAny(lr, acc) Then
                    okPos = True: Exit For
                End If
            Next k
            If Not okPos Then bestTx = tx: bestLp = lp: bx = TextRect(RA(2), tx, lp, w)
            If k > 0 And okPos Then
                On Error Resume Next
                If RA(2) Then
                    RA(0).GetAnnotation.SetPosition bestTx, bestLp, 0
                Else
                    RA(0).GetAnnotation.SetPosition bestLp, bestTx, 0
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                nMove = nMove + 1
                ' cap nhat duong kich thuoc cua no
                Dim li As Variant
                For j = 1 To lines.Count
                    li = lines.Item(j)
                    If li(0) = i Then
                        lines.Remove j
                        lines.Add Array(i, LineRect(RA, bestLp))
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next j
            End If
            acc.Add bx
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' Khung chu so (ngang: tren duong kich thuoc; doc: ben trai duong kich thuoc)
Private Function TextRect(ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal t As Double, ByVal lp As Double, ByVal w As Double) As Variant
    Const h As Double = 0.0045
    If horiz Then
        TextRect = Array(t - w / 2, lp + 0.0003, t + w / 2, lp + h)
    Else
        TextRect = Array(lp - h, t - w / 2, lp - 0.0003, t + w / 2)
    End If
End Function

Private Function LineRect(r As Variant, ByVal lp As Double) As Variant
    If r(2) Then
        LineRect = Array(r(3) + 0.0005, lp - 0.0004, r(4) - 0.0005, lp + 0.0004)
    Else
        LineRect = Array(lp - 0.0004, r(3) + 0.0005, lp + 0.0004, r(4) - 0.0005)
    End If
End Function

Private Function TextWidth(ByVal dd As Object) As Double
    Dim s As String, v As Double, pre As String
    On Error Resume Next
    v = dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue
    pre = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix)
    On Error GoTo 0
    s = ToMM(v)
    If InStr(1, pre, "DIAM", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then s = "D" & s
    If Left(pre, 1) = "M" Then s = pre                                   ' co ren ghi de
    TextWidth = Len(s) * 0.0022 + 0.002
End Function

Private Function HitsAny(bx As Variant, rects As Collection) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    For Each q In rects
        If bx(0) < q(2) And bx(2) > q(0) And bx(1) < q(3) And bx(3) > q(1) Then HitsAny = True: Exit Function
    Next q
End Function

Private Function HitsLines(bx As Variant, lines As Collection, ByVal self As Long) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant, r As Variant
    For Each q In lines
        If q(0) <> self Then
            r = q(1)
            If bx(0) < r(2) And bx(2) > r(0) And bx(1) < r(3) And bx(3) > r(1) Then HitsLines = True: Exit Function
        End If
    Next q
End Function

' Canh thuoc mat cua feature tao ranh (slot)?
Public Function EdgeOfSlot(ByVal e As Object) As Boolean
    Dim faces As Variant, j As Long, ft As Object
    If slotFeatSet Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If slotFeatSet.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    On Error GoTo fin
    faces = e.GetTwoAdjacentFaces2
    If IsEmpty(faces) Then GoTo fin
    For j = 0 To UBound(faces)
        If Not faces(j) Is Nothing Then
            Set ft = faces(j).GetFeature
            If Not ft Is Nothing Then
                If slotFeatSet.Exists(ft.Name) Then EdgeOfSlot = True: Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next j
fin:
End Function

' Diem sketch tai vi tri tren giay (sheetX, sheetY) trong hinh v (de ghi kich thuoc toi tam ranh...)
Public Function MakeViewPoint(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal sheetX As Double, ByVal sheetY As Double) As Object
    Dim sx As Double, sy As Double, p As Object
    If Not ModelToViewSketch(v, 0, 0, 0, sheetX, sheetY, sx, sy) Then Exit Function
    swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set p = swDrawModel.SketchManager.CreatePoint(sx, sy, 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    If p Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Khong tao duoc diem tam ranh tren " & v.GetName2 & vbCrLf
    Else
        Set MakeViewPoint = p
    End If
End Function

' Noi dung kieu Hole Callout tu quy cach "d1/sau1;d2/sau2;..." (d tang dan, mm):
'   dong 1: O lo chinh (nho nhat) + THRU / sau
'   dong 2: bac (O lon hon, sau ngan hon) -> "<HOLE-CBORE> O.. <HOLE-DEPTH> .."
Public Function HoleSpecText(ByVal parts As String, ByVal holeThru As Boolean) As String
    Dim d As Variant, t As String
    d = SpecSeg(parts, 1)
    If IsEmpty(d) Then Exit Function
    t = "<MOD-DIAM>" & Num2(d(0)) & IIf(holeThru, THRU_TEXT, " <HOLE-DEPTH>" & Num2(d(1)))
    If CountDia(parts) >= 2 Then t = t & vbCrLf & CboreLineText(parts)
    HoleSpecText = t
End Function

' Doan thu k (1 = lo chinh nho nhat, -1 = duong kinh LON NHAT = bac) cua quy cach -> Array(O, sau)
Public Function SpecSeg(ByVal parts As String, ByVal k As Long) As Variant
    Dim seg As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, last As String, want As Long
    seg = Split(parts, ";")
    For i = 0 To UBound(seg)
        If Trim(seg(i)) <> "" And InStr(seg(i), "/") > 0 Then
            n = n + 1: last = seg(i)
            If n = k Then SpecSeg = Split(seg(i), "/"): Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    If k = -1 And last <> "" Then SpecSeg = Split(last, "/")
End Function

Private Function Num2(ByVal s As Variant) As String
    Dim v As Double
    v = Val(Replace(CStr(s), ",", "."))
    Num2 = ToMM(v / 1000#)
End Function

' Nhom canh chi gom canh ke mat vat mep / bo tron?
Public Function OnlyChamferEdges(col As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim c As Variant, anyN As Boolean
    OnlyChamferEdges = True
    For Each c In col
        If UBound(c) < 7 Then OnlyChamferEdges = False: Exit Function
        If c(7) = 0 Then OnlyChamferEdges = False: Exit Function
    Next c
End Function

' So duong kinh trong quy cach "d1/s1;d2/s2;..."
Public Function CountDia(ByVal parts As String) As Long
    Dim seg As Variant, i As Long
    seg = Split(parts, ";")
    For i = 0 To UBound(seg)
        If Trim(seg(i)) <> "" Then CountDia = CountDia + 1
    Next i
End Function

' Callout co thong tin BAC (counterbore) khong? Doc moi phan chu cua kich thuoc
Public Function CalloutHasCbore(ByVal dd As Object) As Boolean
    Dim t As String, s As String, nD As Long, p As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix): t = t & "|" & s
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextSuffix): t = t & "|" & s
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove): t = t & "|" & s
    s = "": s = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow): t = t & "|" & s
    On Error GoTo 0
    t = UCase(t)
    If InStr(t, "CBORE") > 0 Or InStr(t, "SPOT") > 0 Or InStr(t, "CBR") > 0 Or InStr(t, "HW-CB") > 0 _
       Or InStr(t, ChrW(&H2334)) > 0 Then CalloutHasCbore = True: Exit Function
    ' >= 2 ky hieu O trong callout -> SolidWorks da ghi du bac
    p = InStr(t, "DIAM")
    Do While p > 0
        nD = nD + 1: p = InStr(p + 4, t, "DIAM")
    Loop
    nD = nD + Len(t) - Len(Replace(t, ChrW(&H2300), "")) + Len(t) - Len(Replace(t, ChrW(&HD8), ""))
    CalloutHasCbore = (nD >= 2)
End Function

' Tim ma ky hieu bac (vd "<HOLE-...>" khac DEPTH/SINK) trong chu cua 1 Hole Callout that
Public Sub CaptureCboreCode(ByVal dd As Object)
    Dim k As Long, s As String, p As Long, q As Long, tok As String
    On Error Resume Next
    For k = 0 To 6
        s = ""
        s = dd.GetText(k)
        p = InStr(1, s, "<HOLE-", vbTextCompare)
        Do While p > 0
            q = InStr(p, s, ">")
            If q = 0 Then Exit Do
            tok = mid(s, p, q - p + 1)
            If InStr(1, tok, "DEPTH", vbTextCompare) = 0 And InStr(1, tok, "SINK", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                cboreCode = tok
                dimLog = dimLog & "Ma ky hieu bac lay tu SolidWorks: " & tok & vbCrLf
                Exit Sub
            End If
            p = InStr(q, s, "<HOLE-", vbTextCompare)
        Loop
    Next k
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Canh thang (Array(edge, x1, y1, x2, y2)) nam trong khung bao 1 ranh slot cua hinh dang xu ly?
Public Function LineInSlot(it As Variant) As Boolean
    LineInSlot = PointInSlot((it(1) + it(3)) / 2, (it(2) + it(4)) / 2)
End Function

' Diem (toa do giay) nam trong khung bao 1 ranh slot cua hinh dang xu ly?
Public Function PointInSlot(ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double) As Boolean
    Dim q As Variant
    If slotBoxes Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    For Each q In slotBoxes
        If X >= q(0) And X <= q(2) And Y >= q(1) And Y <= q(3) Then PointInSlot = True: Exit Function
    Next q
End Function

' Ma ky hieu bac dung cho ghi chu: uu tien ma lay tu Hole Callout that cua SolidWorks
Public Function CboreSym() As String
    If cboreCode <> "" Then CboreSym = cboreCode Else CboreSym = CBORE_SYM
End Function

' So le vua du cho gia tri kich thuoc (5.5 -> 1 so le, 4.25 -> 2 so le; so nguyen giu theo tieu chuan)
Public Sub FitPrecision(ByVal dd As Object, Optional ByVal mmVal As Double = -1)
    Dim dm As Object, dec As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    If mmVal < 0 Then
        Set dm = dd.GetDimension2(0)
        If dm Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
        mmVal = Abs(dm.SystemValue) * 1000#
    End If
    If Abs(mmVal - Round(mmVal, 0)) < 0.0005 Then Exit Sub
    If Abs(mmVal - Round(mmVal, 1)) < 0.0005 Then dec = 1 Else dec = 2
    dd.SetPrecision3 dec, -1, -1, -1
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Gia tri O cua Hole Callout phai la O LO CHINH (nho nhat) cua quy cach; sai -> ghi de gia tri
Public Sub FixCalloutValue(ByVal dd As Object, ByVal d0 As Double)
    Dim dm As Object, cur As Double
    If d0 <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dm = dd.GetDimension2(0)
    If Not dm Is Nothing Then cur = Abs(dm.SystemValue) * 1000#
    If cur > 0 And Abs(cur - d0) > 0.005 Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "  callout doc O" & Format(cur, "0.00") & " <> O lo chinh " & Format(d0, "0.00") & " -> ghi de" & vbCrLf
        dd.SetOverride True, d0 / 1000#
    End If
    FitPrecision dd, d0
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' O lo chinh (mm) = duong kinh dau tien trong quy cach "3.00/5.0;4.00/5.0;"
Public Function MainDia(ByVal parts As String) As Double
    Dim seg As Variant
    seg = Split(parts, ";")
    If UBound(seg) < 0 Then Exit Function
    If InStr(seg(0), "/") = 0 Then Exit Function
    MainDia = Val(Replace(Split(seg(0), "/")(0), ",", "."))
End Function

' Dong bac: "<bac> O4 <sau> 5" tu duong kinh thu 2 trong quy cach
Public Function CboreLineText(ByVal parts As String) As String
    Dim d As Variant
    If CountDia(parts) < 2 Then Exit Function
    d = SpecSeg(parts, -1)
    If IsEmpty(d) Then Exit Function
    CboreLineText = CboreSym() & "<MOD-DIAM>" & Num2(d(0)) & " <HOLE-DEPTH>" & Num2(d(1))
End Function

' Them dong bac vao duoi Hole Callout (callout below); khong nhan -> noi xuong dong o hau to
Public Sub AddCboreLine(ByVal dd As Object, ByVal ln As String)
    Dim t As String
    If ln = "" Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    t = ""
    t = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow)
    If Trim(t) = "" Then
        dd.SetText swDimensionTextCalloutBelow, ln
    Else
        dd.SetText swDimensionTextCalloutBelow, t & vbCrLf & ln
    End If
    t = ""
    t = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow)
    If InStr(1, t, "<MOD-DIAM>", vbTextCompare) = 0 And InStr(1, t, "HOLE", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
        t = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextSuffix)
        dd.SetText swDimensionTextSuffix, t & vbCrLf & ln
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Noi dung cac phan chu cua 1 kich thuoc (ghi vao log de kiem tra)
Public Function CalloutTextDump(ByVal dd As Object) As String
    Dim k As Long, s As String, t As String
    On Error Resume Next
    For k = 1 To 4
        s = ""
        s = dd.GetText(k)
        t = t & "[" & k & ":" & Replace(s, vbCrLf, "/") & "]"
    Next k
    On Error GoTo 0
    CalloutTextDump = t
End Function

' Khoa tam lo theo dung sai: tam cach tam cum da co < min(0.5 mm, 0.5 x ban kinh nho) -> cung 1 lo
Public Function HoleClusterKey(cL As Collection, ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ByVal r As Double) As String
    Dim i As Long, q As Variant, d As Double, tol As Double, rM As Double
    For i = 1 To cL.Count
        q = cL.Item(i)
        rM = q(2): If r < rM Then rM = r
        tol = 0.5 * rM: If tol > 0.0005 Then tol = 0.0005
        d = Sqr((X - q(0)) ^ 2 + (Y - q(1)) ^ 2) / sc
        If d < tol Then HoleClusterKey = q(3): Exit Function
    Next i
    Dim nk As String
    nk = Format(X / sc * 1000#, "0.000") & "_" & Format(Y / sc * 1000#, "0.000")
    cL.Add Array(X, Y, r, nk)
    HoleClusterKey = nk
End Function

' 2 nua cung (Array(..., 9 = dau mut tren giay)) duoc noi bang canh thang: dau canh trung dau cung i, cuoi trung dau cung j
Public Function ArcsLinked(ai As Variant, aj As Variant, lines As Collection) As Boolean
    Dim ln As Variant, n As Long, ei As Variant, ej As Variant, tol As Double
    If UBound(ai) < 9 Or UBound(aj) < 9 Then Exit Function
    ei = ai(9): ej = aj(9)
    tol = 0.00003
    For Each ln In lines
        If (NearArcEnd(ln(1), ln(2), ei, tol) And NearArcEnd(ln(3), ln(4), ej, tol)) Or _
           (NearArcEnd(ln(3), ln(4), ei, tol) And NearArcEnd(ln(1), ln(2), ej, tol)) Then n = n + 1
        If n >= 2 Then ArcsLinked = True: Exit Function
    Next ln
End Function

Private Function NearArcEnd(ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ep As Variant, ByVal tol As Double) As Boolean
    NearArcEnd = (Abs(X - ep(0)) < tol And Abs(Y - ep(1)) < tol) Or (Abs(X - ep(2)) < tol And Abs(Y - ep(3)) < tol)
End Function

' Huong phinh cua nua cung tren giay (mdx, mdy) = diem giua cung - tam.
' Diem giua = tam +/- r x (phap tuyen x day cung); chon diem NAM TREN CANH (GetClosestPointOn) -> khong phu thuoc chieu tham so
Public Sub ArcBulge(ByVal e As Object, ByVal c As Object, ByVal p As Variant, ByVal cp As Variant, ByVal xf As Object, _
                    pt As Variant, mdx As Double, mdy As Double)
    Dim chx As Double, chy As Double, chz As Double, PX As Double, py As Double, pz As Double, L As Double
    Dim m1 As Variant, m2 As Variant, d1 As Double, d2 As Double, am As Variant, q As Variant
    mdx = 0: mdy = 0
    On Error GoTo fallback
    ' cum han: p / cp da doi sang he cum -> lay lai so lieu goc (he part) de dung GetClosestPointOn / Evaluate2
    If AsmHas(e) Then p = c.CircleParams: cp = e.GetCurveParams2
    chx = cp(3) - cp(0): chy = cp(4) - cp(1): chz = cp(5) - cp(2)
    PX = p(4) * chz - p(5) * chy: py = p(5) * chx - p(3) * chz: pz = p(3) * chy - p(4) * chx
    L = Sqr(PX * PX + py * py + pz * pz)
    If L < 0.0000000001 Then GoTo fallback
    PX = PX / L * p(6): py = py / L * p(6): pz = pz / L * p(6)
    m1 = Dbl3(p(0) + PX, p(1) + py, p(2) + pz)
    m2 = Dbl3(p(0) - PX, p(1) - py, p(2) - pz)
    q = e.GetClosestPointOn(m1(0), m1(1), m1(2))
    If IsEmpty(q) Then GoTo fallback
    d1 = Sqr((q(0) - m1(0)) ^ 2 + (q(1) - m1(1)) ^ 2 + (q(2) - m1(2)) ^ 2)
    q = e.GetClosestPointOn(m2(0), m2(1), m2(2))
    If IsEmpty(q) Then GoTo fallback
    d2 = Sqr((q(0) - m2(0)) ^ 2 + (q(1) - m2(1)) ^ 2 + (q(2) - m2(2)) ^ 2)
    If d1 <= d2 Then am = m1 Else am = m2
    am = AsmPt(e, am)
    am = swMath.CreatePoint(am).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
    mdx = am(0) - pt(0): mdy = am(1) - pt(1)
    Exit Sub
fallback:
    ' Du phong: tham so giua (chuan hoa khoang tham so ve 0..2pi)
    On Error GoTo -1
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim t0 As Double, sp As Double, mp As Variant
    t0 = cp(6): sp = cp(7) - cp(6)
    If sp < 0 Then sp = sp + 6.28318530718
    mp = c.Evaluate2(t0 + sp / 2, 0)
    If Not IsEmpty(mp) Then
        mp = AsmPt(e, Dbl3(mp(0), mp(1), mp(2)))
        am = swMath.CreatePoint(Dbl3(mp(0), mp(1), mp(2))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        mdx = am(0) - pt(0): mdy = am(1) - pt(1)
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Nua duong tron: day cung (2 dau mut) = duong kinh, hoac khoang tham so = pi (khong phu thuoc chieu tham so)
Public Function IsHalfArc(cp As Variant, ByVal r As Double) As Boolean
    Dim ch As Double, sp As Double
    On Error GoTo fin
    If r <= 0 Then Exit Function
    ch = Sqr((cp(3) - cp(0)) ^ 2 + (cp(4) - cp(1)) ^ 2 + (cp(5) - cp(2)) ^ 2)
    If Abs(ch - 2 * r) < 0.002 * r + 0.000001 Then
        ' day cung = duong kinh: loai truong hop duong tron kin (2 dau trung nhau thi ch = 0, khong vao day)
        IsHalfArc = True: Exit Function
    End If
    sp = Abs(cp(7) - cp(6))
    Do While sp > 6.28318530718: sp = sp - 6.28318530718: Loop
    IsHalfArc = (Abs(sp - 3.14159265) < 0.02)
fin:
End Function

'===========================================================================
'  CENTER MARK (dau tam) CUA SOLIDWORKS: tam ranh / tam cung -> goc ghi kich thuoc
'===========================================================================
' Slot center mark cua ranh sl (Array(cung1, cung2, ...)); bx = khung ranh tren giay (x0, y0, x1, y1)
' Co san (tu dong chen khi tao hinh) -> dung lai; chua co -> chon cung ranh, InsertCenterMark3 (Slot = True)
Public Function SlotCenterMarkAnn(v As SldWorks.View, sl As Variant, bx As Variant) As Object
    Dim ann As Object, cM As Object, k As Long, cx As Double, cy As Double, tol As Double
    cx = (sl(2) + sl(4)) / 2: cy = (sl(3) + sl(5)) / 2
    ' chi nhan center mark co tam TRUNG TAM RANH (bo dau tam cua tung cung o 2 dau ranh)
    tol = sl(6) * v.ScaleDecimal * 0.3: If tol < 0.0003 Then tol = 0.0003
    Set ann = FindCenterMarkIn(v, cx - tol, cy - tol, cx + tol, cy + tol)
    If ann Is Nothing Then
        swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
        For k = 0 To 1
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            If SelectInView(v, sl(k), False, True) Then
                Set cM = NewCenterMark(True)
                If Not cM Is Nothing Then Exit For
            End If
        Next k
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        On Error Resume Next
        If Not cM Is Nothing Then Set ann = cM.GetAnnotation
        On Error GoTo 0
        If ann Is Nothing Then Set ann = FindCenterMarkIn(v, cx - tol, cy - tol, cx + tol, cy + tol)
    End If
    If ann Is Nothing Then
        dimLog = dimLog & "Khong tao duoc Slot Center Mark tren " & v.GetName2 & vbCrLf
    Else
        nSlotMarks = nSlotMarks + 1
        SetCmPick ann, cx, cy, bx(0), bx(1), bx(2), bx(3)     ' ghi kich thuoc: chon center mark TAI TAM RANH
    End If
    Set SlotCenterMarkAnn = ann
End Function

' Ghi nho diem chon cua 1 center mark (toa do giay)
Public Sub SetCmPick(ByVal ann As Object, ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ByVal x0 As Double, _
                     ByVal y0 As Double, ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double)
    If cmPick Is Nothing Then Set cmPick = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    cmPick(CStr(ObjPtr(ann))) = Array(X, Y, x0, y0, x1, y1)
End Sub

' Center mark tai tam 1 cung le (x, y tren giay; r ban kinh model)
Public Function ArcCenterMarkAnn(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal e As Object, ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, _
                                 ByVal r As Double) As Object
    Dim ann As Object, cM As Object, tol As Double
    tol = r * v.ScaleDecimal * 0.3: If tol < 0.0003 Then tol = 0.0003
    Set ann = FindCenterMarkIn(v, X - tol, Y - tol, X + tol, Y + tol)
    If ann Is Nothing Then
        swDraw.ActivateView v.GetName2
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        If SelectInView(v, e, False, True) Then Set cM = NewCenterMark(False)
        swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
        On Error Resume Next
        If Not cM Is Nothing Then Set ann = cM.GetAnnotation
        On Error GoTo 0
        If ann Is Nothing Then Set ann = FindCenterMarkIn(v, X - tol, Y - tol, X + tol, Y + tol)
    End If
    If Not ann Is Nothing Then SetCmPick ann, X, Y, X - r * v.ScaleDecimal, Y - r * v.ScaleDecimal, _
                                         X + r * v.ScaleDecimal, Y + r * v.ScaleDecimal
    Set ArcCenterMarkAnn = ann
End Function

' Chen center mark cho doi tuong dang chon (kieu don = 1; thu 0 neu phien ban dung ma khac)
Private Function NewCenterMark(ByVal isSlot As Boolean) As Object
    Dim cM As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cM = swDraw.InsertCenterMark3(1, False, isSlot)
    If cM Is Nothing Then Set cM = swDraw.InsertCenterMark3(0, False, isSlot)
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set NewCenterMark = cM
End Function

' Center mark co vi tri nam trong khung (toa do giay) cua hinh v -> Annotation
Public Function FindCenterMarkIn(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal x0 As Double, ByVal y0 As Double, _
                                 ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double) As Object
    Dim cM As Object, nx As Object, ann As Object, pos As Variant, guard As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cM = v.GetFirstCenterMark
    Do While Not cM Is Nothing And guard < 2000
        guard = guard + 1
        Set ann = Nothing
        Set ann = cM.GetAnnotation
        If Not ann Is Nothing Then
            pos = Empty
            pos = ann.GetPosition
            If Not IsEmpty(pos) Then
                If pos(0) >= x0 And pos(0) <= x1 And pos(1) >= y0 And pos(1) <= y1 Then
                    Set FindCenterMarkIn = ann
                    Exit Function
                End If
            End If
        End If
        Set nx = Nothing
        Set nx = cM.GetNext
        Set cM = nx
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Chon center mark tai diem (x, y) tren giay (ten loai chon khac nhau giua cac phien ban)
Public Function SelCenterMarkAt(ByVal X As Double, ByVal Y As Double, ByVal appendSel As Boolean) As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    SelCenterMarkAt = swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2("", "CENTERMARKSYMS", X, Y, 0, appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0)
    If Not SelCenterMarkAt Then _
        SelCenterMarkAt = swDrawModel.Extension.SelectByID2("", "CENTERMARKSYM", X, Y, 0, appendSel, 0, Nothing, 0)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Tham chieu la center mark (annotation)?
Public Function IsCmRef(ByVal r As Variant) As Boolean
    If Not IsObject(r) Then Exit Function
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    IsCmRef = (TypeOf r Is SldWorks.Annotation)
End Function

' Vi tri (tren giay) cua tham chieu theo phuong do: ngang -> x, doc -> y
Public Function refPos(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal r As Variant, ByVal horiz As Boolean, pos As Double) As Boolean
    Dim a As Variant, X As Double, Y As Double, pk As String
    On Error GoTo fin
    If IsCmRef(r) Then
        pk = CStr(ObjPtr(r))
        If cmPick Is Nothing Then Exit Function
        If Not cmPick.Exists(pk) Then Exit Function
        a = cmPick.Item(pk)
        pos = IIf(horiz, a(0), a(1)): refPos = True
    ElseIf IsObject(r) Then
        If TypeOf r Is SldWorks.edge Then
            X = -1E+30
            EdgeSheetPos v, r, X, Y
            If X > -1E+29 Then pos = IIf(horiz, X, Y): refPos = True
        End If
    Else
        pos = IIf(horiz, r(0), r(1)): refPos = True
    End If
fin:
End Function

' Sau khi ghi kich thuoc toi center mark: dat chu dung cho (px, py) va so gia tri voi khoang cach that.
' Sai (SolidWorks do toi canh tay dau tam) -> xoa, tra ve False de ghi lai bang duong tam
Public Function CmDimCheck(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal dd As Object, ByVal e1 As Variant, ByVal e2 As Variant, _
                           ByVal horiz As Boolean, ByVal PX As Double, ByVal py As Double) As Boolean
    Dim pa As Double, pb As Double, want As Double, got As Double
    CmDimCheck = True
    If dd Is Nothing Then CmDimCheck = False: Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    dd.GetAnnotation.SetPosition PX, py, 0
    If refPos(v, e1, horiz, pa) And refPos(v, e2, horiz, pb) Then
        want = Abs(pa - pb) / v.ScaleDecimal
        got = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
        If Abs(got - want) > 0.00002 + want * 0.002 Then
            dimLog = dimLog & "  kich thuoc center mark = " & Format(got * 1000#, "0.00") & " <> " & _
                     Format(want * 1000#, "0.00") & " -> xoa" & vbCrLf
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            dd.GetAnnotation.Select3 False, Nothing
            swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
            If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > 0 Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
            swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
            CmDimCheck = False
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Duong tam (sketch, net tam) cua ranh/cung theo phuong can ghi:
'  ghi NGANG -> duong DOC qua tam;  ghi DOC -> duong NGANG qua tam. Ve 1 lan, dung lai.
Public Function CmAxisRef(v As SldWorks.View, ByVal ann As Variant, ByVal horiz As Boolean) As Object
    Dim pk As String, k As String, a As Variant, seg As Object
    pk = CStr(ObjPtr(ann))
    If cmPick Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If Not cmPick.Exists(pk) Then Exit Function
    If cmLines Is Nothing Then Set cmLines = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    k = pk & IIf(horiz, "|V", "|H")
    If cmLines.Exists(k) Then Set CmAxisRef = cmLines.Item(k): Exit Function
    a = cmPick.Item(pk)
    ' MakeViewCenterline keo dai 3 mm moi dau -> bu lai de duong tam chi vuot khung ranh ~1 mm
    If horiz Then
        Set seg = MakeViewCenterline(v, True, a(0), a(3) + 0.002, a(5) - 0.002)
    Else
        Set seg = MakeViewCenterline(v, False, a(1), a(2) + 0.002, a(4) - 0.002)
    End If
    If Not seg Is Nothing Then cmLines.Add k, seg
    Set CmAxisRef = seg
End Function

' Kich thuoc TRUNG trong cung 1 hinh chieu (doc tu SolidWorks, khong chi danh sach macro tu ghi):
'  - kich thuoc O / R va Hole Callout: cung gia tri + cung noi dung chu -> giu cai dau, xoa cac cai sau
'    (vd 2 ranh cung O13.89 -> chi giu 1 "O13.89")
'  - kich thuoc thang: cung gia tri + cung phuong + cung 2 vi tri dau (da xet o CleanupSheet)
Private Function DedupeSheetDims(vws As Variant, nDel As Long) As Object
    Dim del As Object, seenV As Object, j As Long, vw As Object, dd As Object, nx As Object
    Dim vl As Double, txt As String, key As String, isDia As Boolean, isCall As Boolean
    Dim an As Object, nm As String, guard As Long
    Set del = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set DedupeSheetDims = del
    If IsEmpty(vws) Then Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    For j = 0 To UBound(vws)
        Set vw = vws(j)
        Set seenV = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        Set dd = Nothing
        Set dd = vw.GetFirstDisplayDimension5
        guard = 0
        Do While Not dd Is Nothing And guard < 5000
            guard = guard + 1
            Set nx = Nothing
            Set nx = dd.GetNext5
            If DimSignature(dd, vl, txt, isDia, isCall) Then
                If isDia Or isCall Then
                    key = IIf(isCall, "C|", "D|") & Format(vl * 1000#, "0.00") & "|" & txt
                    If seenV.Exists(key) Then
                        Set an = Nothing: nm = ""
                        Set an = dd.GetAnnotation
                        nm = an.GetName
                        DeleteDimension dd
                        del(vw.GetName2 & "|" & nm) = 1
                        nDel = nDel + 1
                        dimLog = dimLog & "Xoa kich thuoc trung [" & vw.GetName2 & "]: " & Format(vl * 1000#, "0.00") & _
                                 " " & Replace(txt, vbCrLf, "/") & vbCrLf
                    Else
                        seenV.Add key, 1
                    End If
                End If
            End If
            Set dd = nx
        Loop
    Next j
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' Dac trung 1 kich thuoc: gia tri (m), noi dung chu (prefix|suffix|tren|duoi), co phai O/R, co phai Hole Callout
Private Function DimSignature(ByVal dd As Object, vl As Double, txt As String, isDia As Boolean, _
                              isCall As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim pre As String, suf As String, ab As String, be As String, tp As Long
    On Error GoTo fin
    vl = Abs(dd.GetDimension2(0).SystemValue)
    On Error Resume Next
    pre = "": suf = "": ab = "": be = "": tp = 0
    pre = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextPrefix)
    suf = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextSuffix)
    ab = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutAbove)
    be = dd.GetText(swDimensionTextCalloutBelow)
    tp = dd.GetType
    On Error GoTo fin
    txt = UCase(Trim(pre) & "|" & Trim(suf) & "|" & Trim(ab) & "|" & Trim(be))
    isDia = (tp = swDiameterDimension) Or (tp = swRadialDimension) Or InStr(txt, "DIAM") > 0 _
            Or InStr(txt, ChrW(&H2300)) > 0 Or InStr(txt, ChrW(&HD8)) > 0
    isCall = InStr(txt, "THRU") > 0 Or InStr(txt, "<HOLE") > 0 Or InStr(txt, "HW-") > 0 _
             Or Trim(ab) <> "" Or Trim(be) <> ""
    If isDia Then
        ' O go tay (<MOD-DIAM>) hay O tu dong cua SolidWorks: cung la 1 kich thuoc
        txt = Replace(Replace(Replace(txt, "<MOD-DIAM>", ""), ChrW(&H2300), ""), ChrW(&HD8), "")
    End If
    If tp = swRadialDimension Then txt = "R|" & txt
    DimSignature = True
fin:
End Function

' Xoa 1 kich thuoc (chon annotation -> DeleteSelection2, du phong EditDelete)
Public Sub DeleteDimension(ByVal dd As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    dd.GetAnnotation.Select3 False, Nothing
    swDrawModel.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
    If swDrawModel.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) > 0 Then swDrawModel.EditDelete
    swDrawModel.ClearSelection2 True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Ren theo DUONG KINH lo (lo khong mang du lieu ren): lo ren cung O da biet, hoac bang mui khoan taro
Public Function ThreadByDia(ByVal r As Double, ByVal holeThru As Boolean) As String
    Dim k As String, sz As String
    k = Format(r * 2000#, "0.00")
    If Not thrByDia Is Nothing Then
        If thrByDia.Exists(k) Then
            ThreadByDia = ThreadInfoText(thrByDia.Item(k), holeThru)
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    If Not INFER_THREAD_TAPDRILL Then Exit Function
    sz = TapDrillThread(r * 2000#)
    If sz <> "" Then
        ThreadByDia = ThreadInfoText(Array(sz, False, 0#, Val(mid(sz, 2)), False), holeThru)
        dimLog = dimLog & "Lo O" & k & " khong co du lieu ren -> theo mui khoan taro: " & sz & vbCrLf
    End If
End Function

' Ghi nho: lo O nay cua chi tiet la lo ren
Public Sub RememberThreadDia(ByVal r As Double, ByVal thr As String)
    Dim k As String, sz As String
    If thrByDia Is Nothing Then Set thrByDia = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    k = Format(r * 2000#, "0.00")
    If thrByDia.Exists(k) Then Exit Sub
    sz = ThreadSizeOnly(thr)
    If sz = "" Then Exit Sub
